2010013001.en_text: In 1924 America’s National Research Council sent two engineers to supervise a series of experiments at a telephone-parts factory called the Hawthorne Plant near Chicago.
2010013001.cn_text: 1924年，美国国家研究委员会派遣两名工程师，前往芝加哥附近一家名为霍桑工厂的电话零件厂监督一系列实验。

2010013002.en_text: It hoped they would learn how shop-floor lighting affected workers’ productivity.
2010013002.cn_text: 委员会希望他们能够了解车间照明对工人生产率的影响。

2010013003.en_text: Instead, the studies ended up giving their name to the “Hawthorne effect”, the extremely influential idea that the very act of being experimented upon changed subjects’ behavior.
2010013003.cn_text: 然而，这些研究最终却以「霍桑效应」命名，这一极具影响力的观点认为，仅仅是被实验本身这一行为就改变了实验对象的行为表现。

2010013004.en_text: The idea arose because of the perplexing behavior of the women in the plant.
2010013004.cn_text: 这一观点的产生源于工厂中女工令人困惑的行为表现。

2010013005.en_text: According to accounts of the experiments, their hourly output rose when lighting was increased, but also when it was dimmed.
2010013005.cn_text: 根据实验记录，她们的小时产量在照明增强时会上升，但在照明减弱时也同样上升。

2010013006.en_text: It did not matter what was done in the experiment; so long as something was changed, productivity rose.
2010013006.cn_text: 实验中采取何种措施并不重要；只要有所改变，生产率就会提高。

2010013007.en_text: A(n) awareness that they were being experimented upon seemed to be enough to alter workers’ behavior by itself.
2010013007.cn_text: 意识到自己正在被实验这一点，似乎本身就足以改变工人的行为。

2010013008.en_text: After several decades, the same data were subjected to econometric analysis.
2010013008.cn_text: 数十年后，同样的数据被用于计量经济学分析。

2010013009.en_text: The Hawthorne experiments had another surprise in store.
2010013009.cn_text: 霍桑实验还蕴藏着另一个令人意外的发现。

2010013010.en_text: Contrary to the descriptions on record, no systematic evidence was found that levels of productivity were related to changes in lighting.
2010013010.cn_text: 与记录中的描述相反，没有系统性证据表明生产率水平与照明变化存在关联。

2010013011.en_text: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to misleading interpretations of what happened.
2010013011.cn_text: 事实表明，实验开展的特殊方式可能导致了对所发生情况的误导性解读。

2010013012.en_text: For example, lighting was always changed on a Sunday.
2010013012.cn_text: 例如，照明调整总是在星期日进行。

2010013013.en_text: When work started again on Monday, output duly rose compared with the previous Saturday and continued to rise for the next couple of days.
2010013013.cn_text: 当周一重新开工时,产量相比之前的周六照例会上升,并在随后几天持续增长。

2010013014.en_text: However, a comparison with data for weeks when there was no experimentation showed that output always went up on Mondays.
2010013014.cn_text: 然而，与未进行实验的周的数据对比显示，产量在周一总是会上升。

2010013015.en_text: Workers tended to be diligent for the first few days of the week in any case, before hitting a plateau and then slackening off.
2010013015.cn_text: 工人们往往在每周前几天较为勤勉，之后达到一个平稳期，随即逐渐松懈。

2010013016.en_text: This suggests that the alleged “Hawthorne effect” is hard to pin down.
2010013016.cn_text: 这表明所谓的「霍桑效应」难以明确界定。

2010013017.en_text: Of all the changes that have taken place in English-language newspapers during the past quarter-century, perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
2010013017.cn_text: 在过去二十五年里，英语报纸发生的所有变化中，影响最为深远的也许是其艺术报道在范围和严肃性上不可遏制的衰退。

2010013018.en_text: It is difficult to the point of impossibility for the average reader under the age of forty to imagine a time when high-quality arts criticism could be found in most big-city newspapers.
2010013018.cn_text: 对于四十岁以下的普通读者而言，要想象大多数大城市报纸曾刊载高质量艺术评论的那个时代，几乎是不可能的。

2010013019.en_text: Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.
2010013019.cn_text: 然而，二十世纪出版的许多最重要的评论集，在很大程度上是由报纸评论构成的。

2010013020.en_text: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
2010013020.cn_text: 今天阅读这些著作，不禁会惊叹于其深厚的学术内容曾被认为适宜在面向大众发行的日报上刊载。

2010013021.en_text: We are even farther removed from the unfocused newspaper reviews published in England between the turn of the 20th century and the eve of World War II, at a time when newsprint was dirt-cheap and stylish arts criticism was considered an ornament to the publications in which it appeared.
2010013021.cn_text: 我们与二十世纪之交至二战前夕英国发表的那些主题松散的报纸评论相隔更加遥远，彼时新闻纸价格低廉，文雅的艺术评论被视为其所载刊物的装饰。

2010013022.en_text: In those far-off days, it was taken for granted that the critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered.
2010013022.cn_text: 在那些久远的岁月里，主要报纸的评论家详尽而深入地撰写其所报道事件，这被视为理所当然。

2010013023.en_text: Theirs was a serious business, and even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly, like George Bernard Shaw and Ernest Newman, could be trusted to know what they were about.
2010013023.cn_text: 这是一项严肃的事业,即便是那些不事张扬其学识的评论家,如乔治·伯纳德·萧和欧内斯特·纽曼,也能令人信赖其对本职工作的精通。

2010013024.en_text: These men believed in journalism as a calling, and were proud to be published in the daily press.
2010013024.cn_text: 这些人视新闻业为一种使命，并为能在日报上发表文章而自豪。

2010013025.en_text: “So few authors have brains enough or literary gift enough to keep their own end up in journalism,” Newman wrote, “that I am tempted to define ‘journalism’ as ‘a term of contempt applied by writers who are not read to writers who are’.”
2010013025.cn_text: 纽曼写道:「拥有足够才智或文学天赋以在新闻界立足的作者实在太少，以至于我想将'新闻业'定义为'不为人所读的作家用来蔑称为人所读的作家的一个术语'。」

2010013026.en_text: Unfortunately, these critics are virtually forgotten.
2010013026.cn_text: 遗憾的是，这些评论家几乎已被遗忘。

2010013027.en_text: Neville Cardus, who wrote for the Manchester Guardian from 1917 until shortly before his death in 1975, is now known solely as a writer of essays on the game of cricket.
2010013027.cn_text: 内维尔·卡杜斯自1917年起为《曼彻斯特卫报》撰稿直至1975年去世前不久，如今仅以撰写板球比赛随笔的作者身份为人所知。

2010013028.en_text: During his lifetime, though, he was also one of England’s foremost classical-music critics, and a stylist so widely admired that his Autobiography (1947) became a best-seller.
2010013028.cn_text: 然而在其生前，他也是英国最杰出的古典音乐评论家之一，且其文风广受推崇，以至于他的《自传》（1947年）成为畅销之作。

2010013029.en_text: He was knighted in 1967, the first music critic to be so honored.
2010013029.cn_text: 1967年他被授予爵士头衔，是首位获此殊荣的音乐评论家。

2010013030.en_text: Yet only one of his books is now in print, and his vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
2010013030.cn_text: 然而他的著作中如今仅有一本尚在印行，他那大量音乐论著除专业研究者外无人知晓。

2010013031.en_text: Is there any chance that Cardus’s criticism will enjoy a revival?
2010013031.cn_text: 卡杜斯的评论有可能重获关注吗？

2010013032.cn_text: 这一前景似乎颇为渺茫。

2010013033.en_text: Journalistic tastes had changed long before his death, and postmodern readers have little use for the richly upholstered Vicwardian prose in which he specialized.
2010013033.cn_text: 新闻品味早在他去世前就已改变，而后现代读者对他所擅长的那种雕琢繁复的维多利亚-爱德华风格散文几无用处。

2010013034.en_text: Moreover, the amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
2010013034.cn_text: 此外，音乐评论中的业余传统也已急剧式微。

2010013060.en_text: Over the past decade, thousands of patents have been granted for what are called business methods.
2010013060.cn_text: 在过去十年里，数以千计的所谓商业方法专利被授予。

2010013061.en_text: Amazon.com received one for its “one-click” online payment system.
2010013061.cn_text: 亚马逊公司因其「一键」在线支付系统获得了一项专利。

2010013062.en_text: Merrill Lynch got legal protection for an asset allocation strategy.
2010013062.cn_text: 美林公司为一项资产配置策略获得了法律保护。

2010013063.en_text: One inventor patented a technique for lifting a box.
2010013063.cn_text: 一位发明人为一种提箱技术申请了专利。

2010013064.en_text: Now the nation’s top patent court appears completely ready to scale back on businessmethod patents, which have been controversial ever since they were first authorized 10 years ago.
2010013064.cn_text: 如今，美国最高专利法院似乎已完全准备好缩减商业方法专利的授予规模，这类专利自十年前首次获得授权以来一直备受争议。

2010013065.en_text: In a move that has intellectual-property lawyers abuzz, the US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit said it would use a particular case to conduct a broad review of businessmethod patents.
2010013065.cn_text: 在一项引发知识产权律师热议的举措中，美国联邦巡回上诉法院表示将利用一个特定案件对商业方法专利进行全面审查。

2010013066.en_text: In re Bilski, as the case is known, is “a very big deal,” says Dennis D. Crouch of the University of Missouri School of Law.
2010013066.cn_text: 密苏里大学法学院的丹尼斯·D·克劳奇表示,这个被称为「比尔斯基案」的案件「是一件非常重大的事」。

2010013068.en_text: It “has the potential to eliminate an entire class of patents.”
2010013068.cn_text: 它「有可能消除整整一类专利」。

2010013069.en_text: Curbs on business-method claims would be a dramatic about-face, because it was the Federal Circuit itself that introduced such patents with its 1998 decision in the so-called State Street Bank case, approving a patent on a way of pooling mutual-fund assets.
2010013069.cn_text: 对商业方法专利申请的限制将是一次戏剧性的彻底转向,因为正是联邦巡回法院本身在1998年的所谓「州街银行案」判决中引入了此类专利,当时它批准了一项有关共同基金资产汇集方式的专利。

2010013070.en_text: That ruling produced an explosion in business-method patent filings, initially by emerging Internet companies trying to stake out exclusive rights to specific types of online transactions.
2010013070.cn_text: 该裁决引发了商业方法专利申请的激增,最初申请者是新兴互联网公司,它们试图为特定类型的在线交易获取专有权。

2010013071.en_text: Later, more established companies raced to add such patents to their files, if only as a defensive move against rivals that might beat them to the punch.
2010013071.cn_text: 后来,更多老牌公司竞相将此类专利添加到自己的档案中,哪怕仅仅是为了防御可能抢先一步的竞争对手。

2010013072.en_text: In 2005, IBM noted in a court filing that it had been issued more than 300 business-method patents, despite the fact that it questioned the legal basis for granting them.
2010013072.cn_text: 2005年,IBM在一份法庭文件中指出,它已获得300多项商业方法专利,尽管它对授予这些专利的法律依据表示质疑。

2010013073.en_text: Similarly, some Wall Street investment firms armed themselves with patents for financial products, even as they took positions in court cases opposing the practice.
2010013073.cn_text: 类似地,一些华尔街投资公司也为金融产品配备了专利,尽管它们在法庭案件中反对这种做法。

2010013074.en_text: The Bilski case involves a claimed patent on a method for hedging risk in the energy market.
2010013074.cn_text: 比尔斯基案涉及一项声称可在能源市场中对冲风险的方法专利。

2010013075.en_text: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court’s judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should “reconsider” its State Street Bank ruling.
2010013075.cn_text: 联邦巡回法院发布了一项不同寻常的命令,声明该案将由法院全部12名法官审理,而非常规的三人合议庭,并且它希望评估的一个问题是是否应当「重新考虑」其在州街银行案中的裁决。

2010013076.en_text: The Federal Circuit’s action comes in the wake of a series of recent decisions by the Supreme Court that has narrowed the scope of protections for patent holders.
2010013076.cn_text: 联邦巡回法院的此项举措是在最高法院近期一系列缩小专利持有人保护范围的判决之后作出的。

2010013077.en_text: Last April, for example, the justices signaled that too many patents were being upheld for “inventions” that are obvious.
2010013077.cn_text: 例如,去年四月,大法官们指出,有太多显而易见的「发明」获得了专利维持。

2010013078.en_text: The judges on the Federal Circuit are “reacting to the anti-patent trend at the Supreme Court,” says Harold C. Wegner, a patent attorney and professor at George Washington University, Law School.
2010013078.cn_text: 乔治华盛顿大学法学院专利律师兼教授哈罗德·C·韦格纳表示,联邦巡回法院的法官们正在「对最高法院的反专利趋势作出反应」。

2010013101.en_text: A looming threat to the business-method patents.
2010013101.cn_text: 商业方法专利面临的迫在眉睫的威胁

2010013102.cn_text: 对商业方法专利持有人的保护

2010013103.en_text: A legal case regarding business-method patents.
2010013103.cn_text: 一起有关商业方法专利的法律案件

2010013104.en_text: A prevailing trend against business-method patents.
2010013104.cn_text: 反对商业方法专利的普遍趋势

2010013105.en_text: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that “social epidemics” are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials, who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected.
2010013105.cn_text: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在其著作《引爆点》中指出，「社会流行潮」在很大程度上是由极少数特殊个体的行为所驱动的，这些人通常被称为影响者，他们往往具有超常的信息量、说服力或社交网络。

2010013106.en_text: The idea is intuitively compelling, but it doesn’t explain how ideas actually spread.
2010013106.cn_text: 这一观点在直觉上颇具说服力，但它无法解释思想实际传播的机制。

2010013107.en_text: The supposed importance of influentials derives from a plausible-sounding but largely untested theory called the “two-step flow of communication”: Information flows from the media to the influentials and from them to everyone else.
2010013107.cn_text: 所谓影响者的重要性源于一个听起来合理但基本未经检验的理论，即「传播的两级流动」：信息从媒体流向影响者，再由他们流向普通大众。

2010013108.en_text: Marketers have embraced the twostep flow because it suggests that if they can just find and influence the influentials, those select people will do most of the work for them.
2010013108.cn_text: 营销人员之所以接受两级流动理论，是因为该理论表明，只要他们能够找到并影响这些影响者，这些精英人群就会为他们完成大部分传播工作。

2010013109.en_text: The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods.
2010013109.cn_text: 该理论似乎也能解释某些外观、品牌或地区突然流行且出人意料的现象。

2010013110.en_text: In many such cases, a cursory search for causes finds that some small group of people was wearing, promoting, or developing whatever it is before anyone else paid attention.
2010013110.cn_text: 在许多此类案例中，对原因进行粗略探寻后会发现，在其他人关注之前，总有某个小群体率先使用、推广或开发相关事物。

2010013111.en_text: Anecdotal evidence of this kind fits nicely with the idea that only certain special people can drive trends.
2010013111.cn_text: 这类轶事证据与「只有某些特殊人物才能引领潮流」的观点十分契合。

2010013112.en_text: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.
2010013112.cn_text: 然而，在近期的研究中，一些研究人员发现，影响者对社会流行潮的作用远低于普遍认知。

2010013113.en_text: In fact, they don’t seem to be required at all.
2010013113.cn_text: 事实上，他们似乎完全不是必要条件。

2010013114.en_text: The researchers’ argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey — whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal influence — even the most influential members of a population simply don’t interact with that many others.
2010013114.cn_text: 研究人员的论点基于对社会影响的一个简单观察：除了奥普拉·温弗瑞等少数名人——其巨大影响力主要源于媒体而非人际关系——即使是群体中最具影响力的成员，其互动对象也相当有限。

2010013115.en_text: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.
2010013115.cn_text: 然而，按照两级流动理论，正是这些非名人影响者被认为能够通过直接影响其朋友和同事来推动社会流行潮。

2010013116.en_text: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
2010013116.cn_text: 但是，要形成社会流行潮，每个受影响的人必须进而影响其熟人，这些熟人又必须继续影响他们的熟人，如此循环；而这一传播链条中每个环节有多少人关注，与最初的影响者关系甚微。

2010013117.en_text: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won’t propagate very far or affect many people.
2010013117.cn_text: 例如，如果网络中与最初影响者相隔两层关系的人表现出抵触，变革的连锁反应就不会传播很远，也不会影响很多人。

2010013118.en_text: Building on the basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people’s ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.
2010013118.cn_text: 基于人际影响的基本事实，研究人员通过对人群进行数千次计算机模拟来研究社会影响的动态机制，并操控了与人们影响他人的能力及其易受影响程度相关的若干变量。

2010013119.en_text: They found that the principal requirement for what is called “global cascades” — the widespread propagation of influence through networks — is the presence not of a few influentials but, rather, of a critical mass of easily influenced people.
2010013119.cn_text: 他们发现，所谓「全局级联」——即影响力通过网络的广泛传播——的首要条件并非少数影响者的存在，而是大量易受影响者达到临界数量。

2010013140.en_text: What is the essential element in the dynamics of social influence?
2010013140.cn_text: 社会影响动态机制的核心要素是什么?

2010013144.en_text: The inclination to rely on others.

2010013145.en_text: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public.
2010013145.cn_text: 银行家们在公开场合为自己的困境进行自我检讨。

2010013146.en_text: Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.
2010013146.cn_text: 而在幕后，他们却将矛头对准了另一群人：会计准则制定者。

2010013147.en_text: Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it’s just not fair.
2010013147.cn_text: 银行抱怨称，这些准则迫使它们报告巨额亏损，这实在不公平。

2010013148.en_text: These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
2010013148.cn_text: 这些准则要求银行必须按第三方愿意支付的价格对某些资产进行估值，而非按管理者和监管者所希望达到的价格估值。

2010013149.en_text: Unfortunately, banks’ lobbying now seems to be working.
2010013149.cn_text: 不幸的是，银行的游说活动如今似乎正在见效。

2010013150.en_text: The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
2010013150.cn_text: 具体细节或许难以知晓,但对资本市场正常运作至关重要的准则制定者独立性正在遭受损害。

2010013151.en_text: And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.
2010013151.cn_text: 而且，除非银行以能够吸引买家的价格持有有毒资产，否则银行体系的复苏将困难重重。

2010013152.en_text: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America’s Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes.
2010013152.cn_text: 在与国会经历了一场激烈交锋后，美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）火速推行了准则修订。

2010013153.en_text: These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements.
2010013153.cn_text: 这些修订赋予银行更大的自由度，允许其使用模型对非流动性资产进行估值，并在损益表中更灵活地确认长期资产损失。

2010013154.en_text: Bob Herz, the FASB’s chairman, cried out against those who “question our motives.” Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls “the use of judgment by management.”
2010013154.cn_text: FASB主席鲍勃·赫兹对那些「质疑我们动机」的人强烈抗议。然而银行股应声上涨，而这些修订强化了某游说团体委婉称作「管理层判断的运用」的做法。

2010013155.en_text: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.
2010013155.cn_text: 欧洲各国部长立即要求国际会计准则理事会（IASB）效仿此举。

2010013156.en_text: The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.
2010013156.cn_text: IASB表示不愿在缺乏整体规划的情况下贸然行动，但在今年晚些时候完成准则重构时妥协的压力巨大。

2010013157.en_text: Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did “not live in a political vacuum” but “in the real world” and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
2010013157.cn_text: 欧盟委员查理·麦克里维警告IASB，称其「并非生活在政治真空中」而是「身处现实世界」，并表示欧洲仍可能制定不同的准则。

2010013158.en_text: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.
2010013158.cn_text: 真正脱离实际的是银行，它们的账目严重高估了资产价值。

2010013159.en_text: Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts.
2010013159.cn_text: 如今它们辩称市场价格夸大了损失，因为这些价格主要反映的是市场暂时性的流动性不足，而非坏账的实际规模。

2010013160.en_text: The truth will not be known for years.
2010013160.cn_text: 真相需要数年后方能揭晓。

2010013161.en_text: But banks’ shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.
2010013161.cn_text: 但银行股价低于其账面价值，这表明投资者持怀疑态度。

2010013162.en_text: And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
2010013162.cn_text: 而市场陷入停滞，部分原因在于银行处于瘫痪状态：它们既因担心确认账面损失而不愿出售资产，又不愿收购那些所谓的低价资产。

2010013163.en_text: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with.
2010013163.cn_text: 要使体系重新运转，就必须承认并处理损失。

2010013164.en_text: America’s new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive.
2010013164.cn_text: 美国收购有毒资产的新计划能否奏效，取决于银行是否将资产标价至买家认为具有吸引力的水平。

2010013165.en_text: Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters.
2010013165.cn_text: 成功的市场需要独立甚至强硬的准则制定者。

2010013166.en_text: The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests.
2010013166.cn_text: FASB和IASB正是这样做的，例如在特殊利益集团的敌意下整顿了股票期权和养老金方面的准则。

2010013167.en_text: But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
2010013167.cn_text: 但如今向批评者妥协，无异于招致要求更多让步的压力。

2010013193.en_text: The first and more important is the consumer’s growing preference for eating out: the consumption of food and drink in places other than homes has risen from about 32 percent of total consumption in 1995 to 35 percent in 2000 and is expected to approach 38 percent by 2005.
2010013193.cn_text: 首要且更为重要的是消费者日益偏好外出就餐：在家庭以外场所消费食品饮料的比例已从1995年约占总消费的32%上升至2000年的35%，预计到2005年将接近38%。

2010013194.en_text: This development is boosting wholesale demand from the food service segment by 4 to 5 percent a year across Europe, compared with growth in retail demand of 1 to 2 percent.
2010013194.cn_text: 这一发展态势推动整个欧洲食品服务领域的批发需求年增长率达到4%至5%，相比之下零售需求的增长率仅为1%至2%。

2010013195.en_text: Meanwhile, as the recession is looming large, people are getting anxious.
2010013195.cn_text: 与此同时，随着经济衰退阴霾日益笼罩，人们愈发焦虑不安。

2010013196.en_text: They tend to keep a tighter hold on their purse and consider eating at home a realistic alternative.
2010013196.cn_text: 他们倾向于更加紧缩开支，并将居家用餐视为切实可行的替代选择。

2010013197.en_text: Retail sales of food and drink in Europe’s largest markets are at a standstill, leaving European grocery retailers hungry for opportunities to grow.
2010013197.cn_text: 欧洲主要市场的食品饮料零售销售陷入停滞，致使欧洲杂货零售商急切寻求增长机遇。

2010013198.en_text: Most leading retailers have already tried e-commerce, with limited success, and expansion abroad.
2010013198.cn_text: 多数领先零售商已尝试电子商务但成效有限，并尝试海外扩张。

2010013199.en_text: But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
2010013199.cn_text: 但几乎所有零售商都忽视了近在眼前的巨大盈利机会：食品饮料批发贸易，这恰恰是零售商所需的那类市场。

2010013200.en_text: Will such variations bring about a change in the overall structure of the food and drink market?
2010013200.cn_text: 此类波动会引发食品饮料市场整体结构的变革吗？

2010013202.en_text: The functioning of the market is based on flexible trends dominated by potential buyers.
2010013202.cn_text: 市场运作基于潜在买方主导的灵活趋势。

2010013203.en_text: In other words, it is up to the buyer, rather than the seller, to decide what to buy.
2010013203.cn_text: 换言之，决定购买何物的是买方而非卖方。

2010013204.en_text: At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever- growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
2010013204.cn_text: 无论当前消费模式持续多久，这种变化终将获得日益增多的国内外消费者的认可。

2010013205.en_text: All in all, this clearly seems to be a market in which big retailers could profitably apply their gigantic scale, existing infrastructure, and proven skills in the management of product ranges, logistics, and marketing intelligence.
2010013205.cn_text: 总而言之，这显然是一个大型零售商可充分发挥其庞大规模、既有基础设施以及在产品组合管理、物流和市场情报方面成熟技能以获取利润的市场。

2010013206.en_text: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby.
2010013206.cn_text: 精通欧洲批发业务复杂性的零售商完全有望借此获得丰厚利润。

2010013207.en_text: At least, that is how it looks as a whole.
2010013207.cn_text: 至少从整体上看是如此。

2010013208.en_text: Closer inspection reveals important differences among the biggest national markets, especially in their customer segments and wholesale structures, as well as the competitive dynamics of individual food and drink categories.
2010013208.cn_text: 细致考察则会发现各主要国家市场之间存在重大差异，尤其体现在客户细分、批发结构以及各类食品饮料的竞争态势方面。

2010013209.en_text: Big retailers must understand these differences before they can identify the segments of European wholesaling in which their particular abilities might unseat smaller but entrenched competitors.
2010013209.cn_text: 大型零售商必须理解这些差异，才能识别出欧洲批发业中哪些细分领域可凭借其独特优势撼动规模较小却根基牢固的竞争对手。

2010013210.en_text: New skills and unfamiliar business models are needed too.
2010013210.cn_text: 同时还需要掌握新技能和陌生的商业模式。

2010013211.en_text: Despite variations in detail, wholesale markets in the countries that have been closely examined — France, Germany, Italy and Spain — are made out of the same building blocks.
2010013211.cn_text: 尽管细节有别，经深入考察的法国、德国、意大利和西班牙等国的批发市场均由相同的构成要素组成。

2010013212.en_text: Demand comes mainly from two sources: independent mom-and-pop grocery stores which, unlike large retail chains, are too small to buy straight from producers, and food service operators that cater to consumers when they don’t eat at home.
2010013212.cn_text: 需求主要源于两类：一是独立经营的夫妻杂货店，这类店铺不同于大型零售连锁，规模不足以直接向生产商采购；二是面向消费者提供外出用餐服务的食品服务运营商。

2010013213.en_text: Such food service operators range from snack machines to large institutional catering ventures, but most of these businesses are known in the trade as “horeca”: hotels, restaurants and cafés.
2010013213.cn_text: 此类食品服务运营商涵盖从自动售货机到大型机构餐饮企业等各种形式，但其中大部分在业内被统称为「horeca」：酒店、餐厅和咖啡馆。

2010013214.en_text: Overall, Europe’s wholesale market for food and drink is growing at the same sluggish pace as the retail market, but the figures, when added together, mask two opposing trends.
2010013214.cn_text: 总体而言，欧洲食品饮料批发市场的增长速度与零售市场同样缓慢，但这些数据汇总后掩盖了两种对立趋势。

2010013215.en_text: For example, wholesale food and drink sales came to $268 billion in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and the United Kingdom in 2000 — more than 40 percent of retail sales.
2010013215.cn_text: 例如，2000年法国、德国、意大利、西班牙和英国的食品饮料批发销售额达2680亿美元，超过零售额的40%。

2010013216.en_text: Moreover, average overall margins are higher in wholesale than in retail; wholesale demand from the food service sector is growing quickly as more Europeans eat out more often; and changes in the competitive dynamics of this fragmented industry are at last making it feasible for wholesalers to consolidate.
2010013216.cn_text: 此外，批发的整体平均利润率高于零售；随着更多欧洲人更频繁外出就餐，食品服务领域对批发的需求快速增长；而这一分散行业竞争格局的变化终于使批发商整合成为可能。

2010013217.en_text: However, none of these requirements should deter large retailers (and even some large food producers and existing wholesalers) from trying their hand, for those that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe stand to reap considerable gains.
2010013217.cn_text: 然而，这些要求均不应阻止大型零售商（乃至部分大型食品生产商和现有批发商）一试身手，因为那些精通欧洲批发业复杂性的企业将获得可观收益。

2010013223.en_text: One basic weakness in a conservation system based wholly on economic motives is that most members of the land community have no economic value.
2010013223.cn_text: 完全基于经济动机的保护体系存在一个根本性缺陷：土地共同体的大多数成员并不具有经济价值。

2010013224.en_text: Yet these creatures are members of the biotic community and, if its stability depends on its integrity, they are entitled to continuance.
2010013224.cn_text: 然而这些生物是生物共同体的成员，如果共同体的稳定有赖于其完整性，那么它们就有权继续生存。

2010013225.en_text: When one of these noneconomic categories is threatened and, if we happen to love it, we invent excuses to give it economic importance.
2010013225.cn_text: 当这些非经济类别中的某个物种受到威胁，而我们恰好珍视它时，我们便会编造理由赋予其经济重要性。

2010013226.en_text: At the beginning of the century songbirds were supposed to be disappearing.
2010013226.cn_text: 世纪之初，人们普遍认为鸣禽正在消失。

2010013227.en_text: Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them.
2010013227.cn_text: 科学家们急忙施以援手,提出一些明显站不住脚的证据,声称如果鸟类不能控制昆虫,昆虫就会将我们吞噬殆尽。

2010013228.en_text: The evidence had to be economic in order to be valid.
2010013228.cn_text: 证据必须具有经济意义才能被视为有效。

2010013229.en_text: It is painful to read these roundabout accounts today.
2010013229.cn_text: 今天再读这些迂回曲折的论述令人感到痛心。

2010013230.en_text: We have no land ethic yet, but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us.
2010013230.cn_text: 我们尚未建立土地伦理,但至少已接近于承认这样一点:鸟类应当作为一种内在权利而继续存在,无论其对我们是否具有经济价值。

2010013231.en_text: A parallel situation exists in respect of predatory mammals and fish-eating birds.
2010013231.cn_text: 类似的情况也存在于食肉哺乳动物和食鱼鸟类身上。

2010013232.en_text: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on “worthless” species.
2010013232.cn_text: 曾几何时,生物学家过度援引证据,认为这些生物通过捕杀体弱者来维持猎物种群的健康,或者它们只捕食「无价值」的物种。

2010013233.en_text: Here again, the evidence had to be economic in order to be valid.
2010013233.cn_text: 这里同样,证据必须具有经济意义才能被认为有效。

2010013234.en_text: It is only in recent years that we hear the more honest argument that predators are members of the community, and that no special interest has the right to exterminate them for the sake of a benefit, real or fancied, to itself.
2010013234.cn_text: 直到近年来我们才听到更为诚实的论点:捕食者是共同体的成员,任何特殊利益集团都无权为了自身利益——无论真实的还是臆想的——而将其灭绝。

2010013235.en_text: Some species of trees have been “read out of the party” by economics-minded foresters because they grow too slowly, or have too low a sale value to pay as timber crops.
2010013235.cn_text: 某些树种因生长过于缓慢或作为木材作物的销售价值过低,而被经济至上的林业工作者「开除出局」。

2010013236.en_text: In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason.
2010013236.cn_text: 在林业生态更为先进的欧洲,非商业树种被认定为本土森林共同体的成员,并在合理范围内受到保护。

2010013237.en_text: Moreover, some have been found to have a valuable function in building up soil fertility.
2010013237.cn_text: 此外,某些树种已被发现在增强土壤肥力方面具有重要功能。

2010013238.en_text: The interdependence of the forest and its constituent tree species, ground flora, and fauna is taken for granted.
2010013238.cn_text: 森林与其组成要素——树种、地被植物和动物之间的相互依存关系被视为理所当然。

2010013239.en_text: To sum up: a system of conservation based solely on economic self-interest is hopelessly lopsided.
2010013239.cn_text: 总而言之:一个完全建立在经济私利基础上的保护体系是无可救药的片面体系。

2010013240.en_text: It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning.
2010013240.cn_text: 它往往忽视并最终消除土地共同体中许多缺乏商业价值、但对其健康运转却至关重要的要素。

2010013241.en_text: It assumes, falsely, that the economic parts of the biotic clock will function without the uneconomic parts.
2010013241.cn_text: 它错误地认为生物系统中具有经济价值的部分可以脱离无经济价值的部分而运转。

2011013001.en_text: Ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle viewed laughter as “a bodily exercise precious to health.”
2011013001.cn_text: 古希腊哲学家亚里士多德将笑视为「对健康珍贵的身体锻炼」。

2011013002.en_text: But despite some claims to the contrary, laughing probably has little influence on physical fitness.
2011013002.cn_text: 但尽管存在一些相反的说法，笑对身体健康可能几乎没有影响。

2011013003.en_text: Laughter does produce short-term changes in the function of the heart and its blood vessels, boosting heart rate and oxygen consumption.
2011013003.cn_text: 笑确实会对心脏及其血管的功能产生短期改变，提升心率和氧气消耗量。

2011013004.en_text: But because hard laughter is difficult to sustain, a good laugh is unlikely to have measurable benefits the way, say, walking or jogging does.
2011013004.cn_text: 但由于大笑难以持续，一次开怀大笑不太可能像步行或慢跑那样产生可测量的益处。

2011013005.en_text: In fact, instead of straining muscles to build them, as exercise does, laughter apparently accomplishes the opposite.
2011013005.cn_text: 事实上，与锻炼通过拉紧肌肉来增强肌肉不同，笑显然达到了相反的效果。

2011013006.en_text: Studies dating back to the 1930s indicate that laughter relaxes muscles, decreasing muscle tone for up to 45 minutes after the laugh dies down.
2011013006.cn_text: 可追溯至20世纪30年代的研究表明，笑能够放松肌肉，在笑声停止后使肌肉张力降低最长达45分钟。

2011013007.en_text: Such bodily reaction might conceivably help moderate the effects of psychological stress.
2011013007.cn_text: 这种身体反应可以想见有助于缓解心理压力的影响。

2011013008.en_text: Anyway, the act of laughing probably does produce other types of physical feedback that improve an individual’s emotional state.
2011013008.cn_text: 无论如何,笑这一行为可能确实会产生其他类型的身体反馈,从而改善个体的情绪状态。

2011013009.en_text: According to one classical theory of emotion, our feelings are partially rooted in physical reactions.
2011013009.cn_text: 根据一种经典情绪理论,我们的感受部分根植于身体反应。

2011013010.en_text: It was argued at the end of the 19th century that humans do not cry because they are sad but that they become sad when the tears begin to flow.
2011013010.cn_text: 19世纪末有人提出,人类并非因为悲伤而哭泣,而是当眼泪开始流淌时才变得悲伤。

2011013011.en_text: Although sadness also precedes tears, evidence suggests that emotions can flow from muscular responses.
2011013011.cn_text: 尽管悲伤也会先于眼泪产生,但证据表明情绪可以由肌肉反应引发。

2011013012.en_text: In an experiment published in 1988, social psychologist Fritz Strack of the University of Würzburg in Germany asked volunteers to hold a pen either with their teeth — thereby creating an artificial smile — or with their lips, which would produce a(n) disappointed expression.
2011013012.cn_text: 在1988年发表的一项实验中,德国维尔茨堡大学的社会心理学家弗里茨·斯特拉克要求志愿者用牙齿咬住一支笔从而形成人为的微笑,或用嘴唇含住笔,这会产生失望的表情。

2011013013.en_text: Those forced to exercise their smiling muscles reacted more enthusiastically to funny cartoons than did those whose mouths were contracted in a frown, suggesting that expressions may influence emotions rather than just the other way around.
2011013013.cn_text: 那些被迫运用微笑肌肉的人对有趣漫画的反应比那些嘴部收缩成皱眉状的人更为热烈,这表明表情可能影响情绪而非仅仅相反。

2011013014.en_text: Similarly, the physical act of laughter could improve mood.
2011013014.cn_text: 同样地,笑这一身体行为可能改善情绪。

2011013015.en_text: The decision of the New York Philharmonic to hire Alan Gilbert as its next music director has been the talk of the classical-music world ever since the sudden announcement of his appointment in 2009.
2011013015.cn_text: 纽约爱乐乐团决定聘任艾伦·吉尔伯特担任下一任音乐总监，自2009年突然宣布这一任命以来，一直是古典音乐界热议的话题。

2011013016.en_text: For the most part, the response has been favorable, to say the least. “Hooray!
2011013016.cn_text: 总体而言，反响至少可以说是相当积极的。「太好了！」

2011013017.en_text: At last!” wrote Anthony Tommasini, a sober-sided classical-music critic.
2011013017.cn_text: 「终于等到了！」一位严肃的古典音乐评论家安东尼·托马西尼写道。

2011013018.en_text: One of the reasons why the appointment came as such a surprise, however, is that Gilbert is comparatively little known.
2011013018.cn_text: 然而，这一任命之所以如此出人意料，原因之一在于吉尔伯特相对而言并不太知名。

2011013019.en_text: Even Tommasini, who had advocated Gilbert’s appointment in the Times, calls him “an unpretentious musician with no air of the formidable conductor about him.”
2011013019.cn_text: 即便是曾在《纽约时报》上支持任命吉尔伯特的托马西尼，也称他为「一位朴实无华的音乐家,身上没有那种令人望而生畏的指挥家气势」。

2011013020.en_text: As a description of the next music director of an orchestra that has hitherto been led by musicians like Gustav Mahler and Pierre Boulez, that seems likely to have struck at least some Times readers as faint praise.
2011013020.cn_text: 作为对一个迄今为止一直由古斯塔夫·马勒和皮埃尔·布列兹这样的音乐家执掌的乐团的下一任音乐总监的描述，这似乎很可能让至少部分《纽约时报》读者觉得是意味寡淡的褒扬。

2011013021.en_text: For my part, I have no idea whether Gilbert is a great conductor or even a good one.
2011013021.cn_text: 就我而言，我无从判断吉尔伯特是否是一位伟大的指挥家，抑或哪怕是一位优秀的指挥家。

2011013022.en_text: To be sure, he performs an impressive variety of interesting compositions, but it is not necessary for me to visit Avery Fisher Hall, or anywhere else, to hear interesting orchestral music.
2011013022.cn_text: 诚然，他演绎了种类丰富且颇具趣味的作品，但我并不需要前往艾弗里·费舍尔音乐厅或任何其他地方去聆听有趣的管弦乐。

2011013023.en_text: All I have to do is to go to my CD shelf, or boot up my computer and download still more recorded music from iTunes.
2011013023.cn_text: 我只需走到CD架前，或者打开电脑从iTunes下载更多录制音乐即可。

2011013024.en_text: Devoted concertgoers who reply that recordings are no substitute for live performance are missing the point.
2011013024.cn_text: 那些回应称录音无法替代现场演出的忠实音乐会听众并未领会要点。

2011013025.en_text: For the time, attention, and money of the art-loving public, classical instrumentalists must compete not only with opera houses, dance troupes, theater companies, and museums, but also with the recorded performances of the great classical musicians of the 20th century.
2011013025.cn_text: 为了争夺热爱艺术的公众的时间、注意力和金钱,古典器乐演奏家不仅要与歌剧院、舞蹈团、剧院团体和博物馆竞争,还要与20世纪伟大古典音乐家的录音演出竞争。

2011013026.en_text: These recordings are cheap, available everywhere, and very often much higher in artistic quality than today’s live performances; moreover, they can be “consumed” at a time and place of the listener’s choosing.
2011013026.cn_text: 这些录音价格低廉、随处可得,而且艺术质量往往远高于当今的现场演出;此外,听众还可以在自己选择的时间和地点「消费」它们。

2011013027.en_text: The widespread availability of such recordings has thus brought about a crisis in the institution of the traditional classical concert.
2011013027.cn_text: 此类录音的广泛可得性因而给传统古典音乐会这一体制带来了危机。

2011013028.en_text: One possible response is for classical performers to program attractive new music that is not yet available on record.
2011013028.cn_text: 一种可能的应对之策是让古典音乐演奏者编排尚未录制成唱片的、具有吸引力的新曲目。

2011013029.en_text: Gilbert’s own interest in new music has been widely noted: Alex Ross, a classical-music critic, has described him as a man who is capable of turning the Philharmonic into “a markedly different, more vibrant organization.”
2011013029.cn_text: 吉尔伯特本人对新音乐的兴趣已被广泛关注:古典音乐评论家亚历克斯·罗斯形容他是一个能够将爱乐乐团变成「一个明显不同、更具活力的组织」的人。

2011013030.en_text: But what will be the nature of that difference?
2011013030.cn_text: 但这种不同的本质将会是什么呢？

2011013031.en_text: Merely expanding the orchestra’s repertoire will not be enough.
2011013031.cn_text: 仅仅拓展乐团的曲目库是不够的。

2011013032.en_text: If Gilbert and the Philharmonic are to succeed, they must first change the relationship between America’s oldest orchestra and the new audience it hopes to attract.
2011013032.cn_text: 如果吉尔伯特和爱乐乐团想要取得成功,他们必须首先改变美国这一历史最悠久的乐团与其希望吸引的新受众之间的关系。

2011013058.en_text: When Liam McGee departed as president of Bank of America in August, his explanation was surprisingly straight up.
2011013058.cn_text: 当利亚姆·麦基于8月辞去美国银行总裁职务时，他的解释出人意料地坦率直接。

2011013059.en_text: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving “to pursue my goal of running a company.”
2011013059.cn_text: 他没有用通常那些含糊其辞的借口来掩饰离职，而是直截了当地表示自己离开是为了「追求经营一家公司的目标」。

2011013060.en_text: Broadcasting his ambition was “very much my decision,” McGee says.
2011013060.cn_text: 麦基说，公开宣布自己的抱负「完全是我自己的决定」。

2011013061.en_text: Within two weeks, he was talking for the first time with the board of Hartford Financial Services Group, which named him CEO and chairman on September 29.
2011013061.cn_text: 两周之内，他便首次与哈特福德金融服务集团董事会进行了会谈，该集团于9月29日任命他为首席执行官兼董事长。

2011013062.en_text: McGee says leaving without a position lined up gave him time to reflect on what kind of company he wanted to run.
2011013062.cn_text: 麦基表示，在没有确定下一个职位的情况下离职，给了他时间思考自己想要经营什么样的公司。

2011013063.en_text: It also sent a clear message to the outside world about his aspirations.
2011013063.cn_text: 这也向外界清晰地传递了他的职业抱负。

2011013065.en_text: In recent weeks the No. 2 executives at Avon and American Express quit with the explanation that they were looking for a CEO post.
2011013065.cn_text: 最近几周，雅芳和美国运通的二号高管相继辞职，给出的理由都是在寻找首席执行官职位。

2011013067.en_text: As boards scrutinize succession plans in response to shareholder pressure, executives who don’t get the nod also may wish to move on.
2011013067.cn_text: 随着董事会迫于股东压力而严格审查继任计划，那些未能获得提名的高管也可能希望另谋出路。

2011013068.en_text: A turbulent business environment also has senior managers cautious of letting vague pronouncements cloud their reputations.
2011013068.cn_text: 动荡的商业环境也使得高级管理人员对模糊表态可能损害自身声誉这一点格外谨慎。

2011013069.en_text: As the first signs of recovery begin to take hold, deputy chiefs may be more willing to make the jump without a net.
2011013069.cn_text: 随着经济复苏的初步迹象开始显现，副职高管可能更愿意在没有退路的情况下冒险跳槽。

2011013070.en_text: In the third quarter, CEO turnover was down 23% from a year ago as nervous boards stuck with the leaders they had, according to Liberum Research.
2011013070.cn_text: 据Liberum研究公司统计，第三季度首席执行官更替率较去年同期下降了23%，原因是紧张不安的董事会选择坚守现有领导层。

2011013071.en_text: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.
2011013071.cn_text: 随着经济回暖，志向远大的领导者将迎来大量机会。

2011013072.en_text: The decision to quit a senior position to look for a better one is unconventional.
2011013072.cn_text: 辞去高级职位去寻找更好的机会，这一做法并不符合常规。

2011013073.en_text: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.
2011013073.cn_text: 多年来，高管和猎头公司一直遵循这样一条准则：最具吸引力的首席执行官候选人是那些必须被挖角的人。

2011013074.en_text: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey: “I can’t think of a single search I’ve done where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first.”
2011013074.cn_text: 光辉国际高级合伙人丹尼斯·凯里说：「我想不起在我经手的任何一次搜寻中，有哪个董事会没有要求我优先考察在任首席执行官。」

2011013075.en_text: Those who jumped without a job haven’t always landed in top positions quickly.
2011013075.cn_text: 那些在没有工作保障的情况下跳槽的人，并非总能迅速获得高层职位。

2011013076.en_text: Ellen Marram quit as chief of Tropicana a decade ago, saying she wanted to be a CEO.
2011013076.cn_text: 十年前，艾伦·马拉姆辞去纯果乐公司总裁职务，表示她想成为一名首席执行官。

2011013077.en_text: It was a year before she became head of a tiny Internet-based commodities exchange.
2011013077.cn_text: 一年之后，她才成为一家小型互联网大宗商品交易所的负责人。

2011013078.en_text: Robert Willumstad left Citigroup in 2005 with ambitions to be a CEO.
2011013078.cn_text: 罗伯特·威廉姆斯塔德于2005年带着成为首席执行官的雄心离开花旗集团。

2011013079.en_text: He finally took that post at a major financial institution three years later.
2011013079.cn_text: 三年后，他才在一家大型金融机构担任了该职位。

2011013080.en_text: Many recruiters say the old disgrace is fading for top performers.
2011013080.cn_text: 许多招聘人员表示，对于顶尖表现者而言，过去的那种耻辱感正在消退。

2011013081.en_text: The financial crisis has made it more acceptable to be between jobs or to leave a bad one. “The traditional rule was it’s safer to stay where you are, but that’s been fundamentally inverted,” says one headhunter. “The people who’ve been hurt the worst are those who’ve stayed too long.”
2011013081.cn_text: 金融危机使得处于工作空档期或离开一份糟糕工作变得更容易被接受。一位猎头说：「传统观念认为留在原地更安全，但这一点已被彻底颠覆。受伤最深的恰恰是那些待得太久的人。」

2011013105.cn_text: 高层管理者的无保障跳槽

2011013106.en_text: The Only Way Out for Top Performers
2011013106.cn_text: 顶尖表现者的唯一出路

2011013107.en_text: The rough guide to marketing success used to be that you got what you paid for.
2011013107.cn_text: 营销成功的简单法则曾经是一分钱一分货。

2011013109.en_text: While traditional “paid” media — such as television commercials and print advertisements — still play a major role, companies today can exploit many alternative forms of media.
2011013109.cn_text: 尽管传统「付费」媒体——如电视广告和平面广告——仍发挥着重要作用,但如今企业可以利用许多替代形式的媒体。

2011013110.en_text: Consumers passionate about a product may create “earned” media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage “owned” media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
2011013110.cn_text: 热衷于某种产品的消费者可能会通过主动向朋友推荐来创造「赢得」媒体,而企业则可以通过向其网站注册用户发送有关产品和促销的电子邮件提醒来利用「自有」媒体。

2011013111.en_text: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing’s impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
2011013111.cn_text: 消费者如今做出购买决策的方式意味着营销的影响力源于传统付费媒体之外的广泛因素。

2011013112.en_text: Paid and owned media are controlled by marketers promoting their own products.
2011013112.cn_text: 付费媒体和自有媒体由推广自身产品的营销人员控制。

2011013113.en_text: For earned media, such marketers act as the initiator for users' responses.
2011013113.cn_text: 对于赢得媒体,营销人员充当用户反应的发起者。

2011013114.en_text: But in some cases, one marketer’s owned media become another marketer’s paid media — for instance, when an ecommerce retailer sells ad space on its Web site.
2011013114.cn_text: 但在某些情况下,一个营销人员的自有媒体会成为另一个营销人员的付费媒体——例如,当电商零售商在其网站上出售广告位时。

2011013115.en_text: We define such sold media as owned media whose traffic is so strong that other organizations place their content or e-commerce engines within that environment.
2011013115.cn_text: 我们将这种售出媒体定义为流量强大到其他组织在其环境中投放内容或电子商务引擎的自有媒体。

2011013116.en_text: This trend, which we believe is still in its infancy, effectively began with retailers and travel providers such as airlines and hotels and will no doubt go further.
2011013116.cn_text: 我们认为这一趋势仍处于起步阶段,它实际上始于零售商和旅游服务提供商,如航空公司和酒店,并且无疑会进一步发展。

2011013117.en_text: Johnson & Johnson, for example, has created BabyCenter, a stand-alone media property that promotes complementary and even competitive products.
2011013117.cn_text: 例如,强生公司创建了BabyCenter这一独立媒体平台,用于推广互补乃至竞争产品。

2011013118.en_text: Besides generating income, the presence of other marketers makes the site seem objective, gives companies opportunities to learn valuable information about the appeal of other companies' marketing, and may help expand user traffic for all companies concerned.
2011013118.cn_text: 除了产生收入外,其他营销者的存在使网站显得客观,为企业提供了了解其他公司营销吸引力的宝贵信息的机会,并可能帮助所有相关企业扩大用户流量。

2011013119.en_text: The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
2011013119.cn_text: 同样这些戏剧性的技术变革在为营销人员提供更多（且更多样化）沟通选择的同时,也增加了热情消费者以更快、更显眼且更具破坏性的方式表达意见的风险。

2011013120.en_text: Such hijacked media are the opposite of earned media: an asset or campaign becomes hostage to consumers, other stakeholders, or activists who make negative allegations about a brand or product.
2011013120.cn_text: 这种被劫持媒体与赢得媒体正好相反:资产或营销活动沦为消费者、其他利益相关者或活动人士的人质,他们对品牌或产品提出负面指控。

2011013121.en_text: Members of social networks, for instance, are learning that they can hijack media to apply pressure on the businesses that originally created them.
2011013121.cn_text: 例如,社交网络成员正在认识到他们可以劫持媒体,向最初创建这些媒体的企业施加压力。

2011013122.en_text: If that happens, passionate consumers would try to persuade others to boycott products, putting the reputation of the target company at risk.
2011013122.cn_text: 如果发生这种情况,热情的消费者会试图说服他人抵制产品,使目标企业的声誉面临风险。

2011013123.en_text: In such a case, the company’s response may not be sufficiently quick or thoughtful, and the learning curve has been steep.
2011013123.cn_text: 在这种情况下,企业的反应可能不够迅速或周全,而且学习曲线一直很陡峭。

2011013124.en_text: Toyota Motor, for example, alleviated some of the damage from its recall crisis earlier this year with a relatively quick and well-orchestrated social-media response campaign, which included efforts to engage with consumers directly on sites such as Twitter and the social-news site Digg.
2011013124.cn_text: 例如,丰田汽车公司通过相对快速且精心策划的社交媒体应对活动,缓解了今年早些时候召回危机造成的部分损害,该活动包括在Twitter和社交新闻网站Digg等平台上直接与消费者互动。

2011013150.en_text: It’s no surprise that Jennifer Senior’s insightful, provocative magazine cover story, “I Love My Children, I Hate My Life,” is arousing much chatter — nothing gets people talking like the suggestion that child rearing is anything less than a completely fulfilling, lifeenriching experience.
2011013150.cn_text: 詹妮弗·西尼尔那篇见解深刻、发人深省的杂志封面文章「我爱我的孩子，我恨我的生活」引发了广泛讨论，这并不令人意外——没有什么比暗示养育子女并非完全令人满足、丰富人生的经历更能引起热议了。

2011013151.en_text: Rather than concluding that children make parents either happy or miserable, Senior suggests we need to redefine happiness: instead of thinking of it as something that can be measured by moment-to-moment joy, we should consider being happy as a past-tense condition.
2011013151.cn_text: 西尼尔并未简单断言孩子让父母幸福或痛苦，而是建议我们重新定义幸福：不应将其视为可通过瞬间的欢愉来衡量的东西，而应把幸福理解为一种过去时态的状态。

2011013152.en_text: Even though the day-to-day experience of raising kids can be soulcrushingly hard, Senior writes that “the very things that in the moment dampen our moods can later be sources of intense gratification and delight.”
2011013152.cn_text: 尽管日复一日养育孩子的经历可能令人身心俱疲，西尼尔写道：「那些在当下令我们情绪低落的事情，日后可能成为强烈满足感和喜悦的源泉。」

2011013153.en_text: The magazine cover showing an attractive mother holding a cute baby is hardly the only Madonna-and-child image on newsstands this week.
2011013153.cn_text: 本周报刊亭上，展示迷人母亲怀抱可爱婴儿的杂志封面，绝非唯一的圣母与圣婴形象。

2011013154.en_text: There are also stories about newly adoptive — and newly single — mom Sandra Bullock, as well as the usual “Jennifer Aniston is pregnant” news.
2011013154.cn_text: 还有关于刚收养孩子且新近单身的妈妈桑德拉·布洛克的报道，以及惯常出现的「詹妮弗·安妮斯顿怀孕了」之类的新闻。

2011013155.en_text: Practically every week features at least one celebrity mom, or mom-to-be, smiling on the newsstands.
2011013155.cn_text: 几乎每周都至少有一位名人母亲或准母亲面带微笑地出现在报刊亭上。

2011013156.en_text: In a society that so persistently celebrates procreation, is it any wonder that admitting you regret having children is equivalent to admitting you support kitten-killing?
2011013156.cn_text: 在一个如此执着地歌颂生育的社会里，承认后悔生孩子难道不等同于承认支持虐杀小猫吗？

2011013157.en_text: It doesn’t seem quite fair, then, to compare the regrets of parents to the regrets of the childless.
2011013157.cn_text: 因此，将为人父母者的后悔与无子女者的后悔相比较，似乎并不公平。

2011013158.en_text: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn’t have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
2011013158.cn_text: 不幸福的父母很少会被促使去思考自己是否不该生孩子，但不幸福的无子女者却不断被这样一种信息困扰：孩子是世界上最重要的东西，显然他们的痛苦必定是生活中缺少一个婴儿大小的空洞直接导致的。

2011013159.en_text: Of course, the image of parenthood that celebrity magazines like Us Weekly and People present is hugely unrealistic, especially when the parents are single mothers like Bullock.
2011013159.cn_text: 当然，像「Us Weekly」和「People」这类名人杂志所呈现的育儿形象极不真实，尤其当这些父母是像布洛克那样的单身母亲时。

2011013160.en_text: According to several studies concluding that parents are less happy than childless couples, single parents are the least happy of all.
2011013160.cn_text: 多项研究表明，有孩子的父母幸福感低于无子女夫妇，而单亲父母是所有群体中最不幸福的。

2011013161.en_text: No shock there, considering how much work it is to raise a kid without a partner to lean on; yet to hear Sandra and Britney tell it, raising a kid on their “own” (read: with round-the-clock help) is a piece of cake.
2011013161.cn_text: 考虑到没有伴侣依靠而独自抚养孩子需要付出多少辛劳，这并不令人震惊；然而听桑德拉和布兰妮的说法，她们「独自」（实为：在全天候帮助下）抚养孩子却轻而易举。

2011013162.en_text: It’s hard to imagine that many people are dumb enough to want children just because Reese and Angelina make it look so glamorous: most adults understand that a baby is not a haircut.
2011013162.cn_text: 很难想象会有那么多人愚蠢到仅仅因为瑞茜和安吉丽娜让育儿看起来如此光鲜就想要孩子：大多数成年人都明白，婴儿不是发型。

2011013163.en_text: But it’s interesting to wonder if the images we see every week of stress-free, happiness-enhancing parenthood aren’t in some small, subconscious way contributing to our own dissatisfactions with the actual experience, in the same way that a small part of us hoped getting “the Rachel” might make us look just a little bit like Jennifer Aniston.
2011013163.cn_text: 但值得思考的是，我们每周看到的那些无压力、增添幸福感的育儿形象，是否在某种微小的潜意识层面上加剧了我们对实际育儿体验的不满，就像我们内心曾有一小部分希望剪个「瑞秋头」能让自己看起来稍微像詹妮弗·安妮斯顿一样。

2011013184.en_text: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?
2011013184.cn_text: 从最后一段可以推断出以下哪项？

2011013185.en_text: Having children contributes little to the glamour of celebrity moms.
2011013185.cn_text: 有孩子对名人母亲的魅力贡献甚微。

2011013186.en_text: Celebrity moms have influenced our attitude towards child rearing.
2011013186.cn_text: 名人母亲影响了我们对育儿的态度。

2011013187.en_text: Having children intensifies our dissatisfaction with life.
2011013187.cn_text: 有孩子加剧了我们对生活的不满。

2011013188.en_text: We sometimes neglect the happiness from child rearing.
2011013188.cn_text: 我们有时忽略了育儿带来的幸福。

2011013189.en_text: No disciplines have seized on professionalism with as much enthusiasm as the humanities.
2011013189.cn_text: 没有哪个学科像人文学科那样热衷于专业化。

2011013190.en_text: You can, Mr. Menand points out, become a lawyer in three years and a medical doctor in four.
2011013190.cn_text: 正如梅南德先生所指出的，你可以在三年内成为律师，四年内成为医生。

2011013192.en_text: But the regular time it takes to get a doctoral degree in the humanities is nine years.
2011013192.cn_text: 但获得人文学科博士学位的常规时间却是九年。

2011013193.en_text: Not surprisingly, up to half of all doctoral students in English drop out before getting their degrees.
2011013193.cn_text: 不足为奇的是，多达一半的英语博士生在获得学位前就退学了。

2011013194.en_text: His concern is mainly with the humanities: literature, languages, philosophy and so on.
2011013194.cn_text: 他主要关注人文学科：文学、语言、哲学等。

2011013195.en_text: These are disciplines that are going out of style: 22% of American college graduates now major in business compared with only 2% in history and 4% in English.
2011013195.cn_text: 这些学科正在逐渐失宠：现在22%的美国大学毕业生主修商科，而主修历史的只有2%，主修英语的只有4%。

2011013196.en_text: However, many leading American universities want their undergraduates to have a grounding in the basic canon of ideas that every educated person should possess.
2011013196.cn_text: 然而，许多美国顶尖大学希望本科生掌握每个受过教育的人都应具备的基本经典思想。

2011013197.en_text: But most find it difficult to agree on what a “general education” should look like.
2011013197.cn_text: 但大多数人发现很难就「通识教育」应是何种形态达成共识。

2011013198.en_text: At Harvard, Mr. Menand notes, “the great books are read because they have been read” — they form a sort of social glue.
2011013198.cn_text: 梅南德先生指出，在哈佛，「经典著作之所以被阅读，正是因为它们一直被阅读」——它们构成了某种社会粘合剂。

2011013200.en_text: Equally unsurprisingly, only about half end up with professorships for which they entered graduate school.
2011013200.cn_text: 同样不足为奇的是，只有大约一半的人最终获得了他们当初进入研究生院时所期望的教授职位。

2011013201.en_text: There are simply too few posts.

2011013202.en_text: This is partly because universities continue to produce ever more PhDs.
2011013202.cn_text: 这部分是因为大学继续培养越来越多的博士。

2011013203.en_text: But fewer students want to study humanities subjects: English departments awarded more bachelor’s degrees in 1970-71 than they did 20 years later.
2011013203.cn_text: 但愿意学习人文学科的学生却越来越少：英语系在1970-71学年授予的学士学位比20年后还要多。

2011013204.cn_text: 学生减少意味着所需教师也减少。

2011013205.en_text: So, at the end of a decade of thesis- writing, many humanities students leave the profession to do something for which they have not been trained.
2011013205.cn_text: 因此，在经历十年论文写作后，许多人文学科学生离开了这个行业，去从事他们未曾接受过培训的工作。

2011013206.en_text: One reason why it is hard to design and teach such courses is that they cut across the insistence by top American universities that liberal-arts education and professional education should be kept separate, taught in different schools.
2011013206.cn_text: 设计和教授此类课程之所以困难，一个原因在于它们与美国顶尖大学的坚持相冲突——这些大学坚持将文科教育和职业教育分开，在不同学院分别教授。

2011013207.cn_text: 许多学生同时经历这两种教育。

2011013208.en_text: Although more than half of Harvard undergraduates end up in law, medicine or business, future doctors and lawyers must study a non-specialist liberal-arts degree before embarking on a professional qualification.
2011013208.cn_text: 尽管超过半数的哈佛本科生最终进入法律、医学或商业领域，但未来的医生和律师必须先修读非专业的文科学位，然后才能攻读职业资格。

2011013209.en_text: Besides professionalising the professions by this separation, top American universities have professionalised the professor.
2011013209.cn_text: 除了通过这种分离使各职业专业化之外,美国顶尖大学还使教授这一职业专业化了。

2011013210.en_text: The growth in public money for academic research has speeded the process: federal research grants rose fourfold between 1960 and 1990, but faculty teaching hours fell by half as research took its toll.
2011013210.cn_text: 学术研究公共资金的增长加速了这一过程：联邦研究经费在1960年至1990年间增长了四倍，但随着研究占据更多精力，教师的教学时间减少了一半。

2011013211.en_text: Professionalism has turned the acquisition of a doctoral degree into a prerequisite for a successful academic career: as late as 1969 a third of American professors did not possess one.
2011013211.cn_text: 专业化使获得博士学位成为成功学术生涯的先决条件：直到1969年，仍有三分之一的美国教授没有博士学位。

2011013212.en_text: But the key idea behind professionalisation, argues Mr. Menand, is that “the knowledge and skills needed for a particular specialisation are transmissible but not transferable.”
2011013212.cn_text: 但梅南德先生认为，专业化背后的核心理念是「特定专业所需的知识和技能是可传授的，但不可迁移的」。

2011013214.en_text: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
2011013214.cn_text: 因此，学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，也垄断了知识生产者的生产。

2011013215.en_text: The key to reforming higher education, concludes Mr. Menand, is to alter the way in which “the producers of knowledge are produced.”
2011013215.cn_text: 梅南德先生总结道，改革高等教育的关键是改变「知识生产者的生产方式」。

2011013217.en_text: Otherwise, academics will continue to think dangerously alike, increasingly detached from the societies which they study, investigate and criticise. “Academic inquiry, at least in some fields, may need to become less exclusionary and more holistic.”
2011013217.cn_text: 否则，学者们将继续危险地保持思维一致，越来越脱离他们所研究、调查和批评的社会。「学术研究，至少在某些领域，可能需要变得不那么排他，更加整体化。」

2011013218.en_text: Yet quite how that happens, Mr. Menand does not say.
2011013218.cn_text: 然而，这究竟如何实现，梅南德先生并未说明。

2011013220.en_text: The subtle and intelligent little book The Marketplace of Ideas: Reform and Resistance in the American University should be read by every student thinking of applying to take a doctoral degree.
2011013220.cn_text: 每一个考虑申请攻读博士学位的学生都应该阅读《思想市场：美国大学中的改革与抵制》这本精妙而睿智的小书。

2011013221.en_text: They may then decide to go elsewhere.
2011013221.cn_text: 读后他们可能会决定另谋出路。

2011013222.en_text: For something curious has been happening in American Universities, and Louis Menand, a professor of English at Harvard University, captured it skillfully.
2011013222.cn_text: 因为美国大学里正在发生一些奇特的现象，而哈佛大学英语教授路易斯·梅南德巧妙地捕捉到了这一点。

2011013228.en_text: With its theme that “Mind is the master weaver,” creating our inner character and outer circumstances, the book As a Man Thinketh by James Allen is an in-depth exploration of the central idea of self-help writing.
2011013228.cn_text: 詹姆斯·艾伦的《思想决定命运》一书以「心灵是主宰编织者」为主题，阐述心灵如何创造我们的内在品格与外在境遇，是对自助类写作核心理念的深入探索。

2011013229.en_text: Allen’s contribution was to take an assumption we all share — that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts — and reveal its erroneous nature.
2011013229.cn_text: 艾伦的贡献在于，他揭示了一个我们都默认的假设——因为我们不是机器人，所以能控制自己的思想——并揭露其错误本质。

2011013230.en_text: Because most of us believe that mind is separate from matter, we think that thoughts can be hidden and made powerless; this allows us to think one way and act another.
2011013230.cn_text: 由于我们大多数人认为心灵独立于物质之外,便以为思想可以隐藏起来并使其失去力量;这使得我们可以想法是一套,做法又是另一套。

2011013231.en_text: However, Allen believed that the unconscious mind generates as much action as the conscious mind, and while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone, in reality we are continually faced with a question: “Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?”
2011013231.cn_text: 然而,艾伦认为无意识心灵产生的行为与意识心灵同样多,尽管我们或许能够仅凭意识心灵维持控制的假象,但实际上我们不断面对一个问题:「为什么我无法让自己做到这件事或达成那个目标?」

2011013232.en_text: Since desire and will are damaged by the presence of thoughts that do not accord with desire, Allen concluded: “We do not attract what we want, but what we are.”
2011013232.cn_text: 由于欲望和意志会因与欲望不符的思想的存在而受损,艾伦得出结论:「我们吸引的不是我们想要的东西,而是我们所是的样子。」

2011013233.en_text: Achievement happens because you as a person embody the external achievement; you don’t “get” success but become it.
2011013233.cn_text: 成就之所以发生,是因为你作为一个人体现了外在的成就;你不是「获得」成功,而是成为成功本身。

2011013234.en_text: There is no gap between mind and matter.
2011013234.cn_text: 心灵与物质之间并无隔阂。

2011013235.en_text: Part of the fame of Allen’s book is its contention that “Circumstances do not make a person, they reveal him.”
2011013235.cn_text: 艾伦此书之所以广为人知,部分原因在于其论断:「环境不会造就一个人,而是揭示一个人。」

2011013236.en_text: This seems a justification for neglect of those in need, and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom.
2011013236.cn_text: 这似乎是在为忽视困苦者辩护,为剥削行为、为上层的优越地位与底层的劣势地位提供合理化解释。

2011013237.en_text: This, however, would be a knee-jerk reaction to a subtle argument.
2011013237.cn_text: 然而,这不过是对一个微妙论点的本能反应。

2011013238.en_text: Each set of circumstances, however bad, offers a unique opportunity for growth.
2011013238.cn_text: 每一种境遇,无论多么糟糕,都提供了独特的成长机会。

2011013239.en_text: If circumstances always determined the life and prospects of people, then humanity would never have progressed.
2011013239.cn_text: 倘若境遇总是决定人们的生活和前途,那么人类就永远不会进步。

2011013240.en_text: In fact, circumstances seem to be designed to bring out the best in us, and if we feel that we have been “wronged” then we are unlikely to begin a conscious effort to escape from our situation.
2011013240.cn_text: 事实上,境遇似乎正是为了激发我们的最佳潜能而设,倘若我们觉得自己「受到了不公」,便不太可能开始有意识地努力挣脱现状。

2011013241.en_text: Nevertheless, as any biographer knows, a person’s early life and its conditions are often the greatest gift to an individual.
2011013241.cn_text: 然而,正如任何传记作者都明白的,一个人的早年生活及其境遇往往是赐予个人的最大恩赐。

2011013242.en_text: The sobering aspect of Allen’s book is that we have no one else to blame for our present condition except ourselves.
2011013242.cn_text: 艾伦此书发人深省之处在于,对于我们目前的处境,除了自己之外无人可责。

2011013243.en_text: The upside is the possibilities contained in knowing that everything is up to us; where before we were experts in the array of limitations, now we become authorities of what is possible.
2011013243.cn_text: 而积极的一面在于,认识到一切取决于我们自己所蕴含的可能性;曾经我们是各种局限的行家,如今我们成为了各种可能的权威。

2012013001.en_text: The ethical judgments of the Supreme Court justices have become an important issue recently.
2012013001.cn_text: 最高法院大法官的道德判断近来已成为一个重要议题。

2012013002.en_text: The court cannot maintain its legitimacy as guardian of the rule of law when justices behave like politicians.
2012013002.cn_text: 当大法官的行为如同政客时，法院便无法维持其作为法治守护者的合法性。

2012013003.en_text: Yet, in several instances, justices acted in ways that weakened the court’s reputation for being independent and impartial.
2012013003.cn_text: 然而，在若干案例中，大法官的行为削弱了法院独立公正的声誉。

2012013004.en_text: Justice Antonin Scalia, for example, appeared at political events.
2012013004.cn_text: 例如，大法官安东宁·斯卡利亚曾现身政治活动。

2012013005.en_text: That kind of activity makes it less likely that the court’s decisions will be accepted as impartial judgments.
2012013005.cn_text: 此类行为降低了法院裁决被视为公正判决的可能性。

2012013006.en_text: Part of the problem is that the justices are not bound by an ethics code.
2012013006.cn_text: 问题之一在于大法官并不受伦理准则约束。

2012013007.en_text: At the very least, the court should make itself subject to the code of conduct that applies to the rest of the federal judiciary.
2012013007.cn_text: 至少，法院应当使自身遵守适用于联邦司法系统其他部门的行为准则。

2012013008.en_text: This and other similar cases raise the question of whether there is still a line between the court and politics.
2012013008.cn_text: 此案及其他类似案例引发了一个问题：法院与政治之间是否仍存在界限。

2012013009.en_text: The framers of the Constitution envisioned law as having authority apart from politics.
2012013009.cn_text: 宪法的制定者将法律设想为具有独立于政治的权威。

2012013010.en_text: They gave justices permanent positions so they would be free to upset those in power and have no need to cultivate political support.
2012013010.cn_text: 他们赋予大法官终身职位，使其得以无惧权势、无需寻求政治支持。

2012013011.en_text: Our legal system was designed to set law apart from politics precisely because they are so closely tied.
2012013011.cn_text: 我们的法律体系正是因为法律与政治联系紧密，才被设计为将二者分离。

2012013012.en_text: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social concepts like liberty and property.
2012013012.cn_text: 宪法法律具有政治性，因为它源于植根于自由和财产等基本社会理念的选择。

2012013013.en_text: When the court deals with social policy decisions, the law it shapes is inescapably political — which is why decisions split along ideological lines are so easily dismissed as unjust.
2012013013.cn_text: 当法院处理社会政策决定时,其所制定的法律不可避免地具有政治性——这正是按意识形态立场分裂的裁决极易被斥为不公的原因。

2012013014.en_text: The justices must address doubts about the court’s legitimacy by making themselves accountable to the code of conduct.
2012013014.cn_text: 大法官必须通过遵守行为准则来消除对法院合法性的质疑。

2012013015.en_text: That would make their rulings more likely to be seen as separate from politics and, as a result, convincing as law.
2012013015.cn_text: 这将使其裁决更可能被视为独立于政治,从而作为法律更具说服力。

2012013017.en_text: That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
2012013017.cn_text: 那种低声的暗示，半是邀请半是强迫，正是我们大多数人听到「同伴压力」一词时所想到的东西。

2012013018.en_text: It usually leads to no good — drinking, drugs and casual sex.
2012013018.cn_text: 它通常不会带来什么好结果——酗酒、吸毒和随意性行为。

2012013019.en_text: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
2012013019.cn_text: 但在她的新书《加入俱乐部》中,蒂娜·罗森伯格认为,同伴压力也可以成为一种积极力量,她称之为「社会疗法」,即组织和官员利用群体动力来帮助个人改善生活,甚至可能改变世界。

2012013020.en_text: Rosenberg, the recipient of a Pulitzer Prize, offers a host of examples of the social cure in action: In South Carolina, a state-sponsored antismoking program called Rage Against the Haze sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
2012013020.cn_text: 罗森伯格是普利策奖得主,她列举了大量社会疗法的实践案例:在南卡罗来纳州,一个名为「对抗烟雾」的州政府资助反吸烟项目致力于让香烟变得不酷。

2012013021.en_text: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
2012013021.cn_text: 在南非,一个名为「爱生活」的艾滋病预防项目招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。

2012013022.en_text: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer.
2012013022.cn_text: 这一想法看起来颇有前景,而罗森伯格是一位敏锐的观察者。

2012013023.en_text: Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology.
2012013023.cn_text: 她对许多公共卫生运动乏力现象的批评切中要害:这些运动未能调动同伴压力来促进健康习惯,并且暴露出对心理学的严重误读。

2012013024.en_text: “Dare to be different, please don’t smoke!” pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers — teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.
2012013024.cn_text: 「敢于与众不同,请不要吸烟!」一个旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌活动如此呼吁——而青少年最渴望的恰恰是融入群体。

2012013025.en_text: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
2012013025.cn_text: 罗森伯格令人信服地指出,公共卫生倡导者应该向精于运用同伴压力的广告商学习经验。

2012013026.en_text: But on the general effectiveness of the social cure, Rosenberg is less persuasive.
2012013026.cn_text: 但在社会疗法的总体有效性问题上,罗森伯格的论证不那么令人信服。

2012013027.en_text: Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful.
2012013027.cn_text: 《加入俱乐部》充斥着过多无关细节,却对使同伴压力如此强大的社会和生物因素探讨不足。

2012013028.en_text: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it’s presented here is that it doesn’t work very well for very long.
2012013028.cn_text: 书中所呈现的社会疗法最明显的缺陷在于,它无法长期保持良好效果。

2012013029.en_text: Rage Against the Haze failed once state funding was cut.
2012013029.cn_text: 「对抗烟雾」项目在州政府削减资金后便宣告失败。

2012013030.en_text: Evidence that the loveLife program produces lasting changes is limited and mixed.
2012013030.cn_text: 有关「爱生活」项目能否产生持久变化的证据既有限又不一致。

2012013031.en_text: There’s no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
2012013031.cn_text: 毫无疑问,我们的同伴群体对我们的行为产生巨大影响。

2012013032.en_text: An emerging body of research shows that positive health habits — as well as negative ones — spread through networks of friends via social communication.
2012013032.cn_text: 大量新兴研究表明,积极的健康习惯——以及消极的习惯——都会通过社交传播在朋友网络中扩散。

2012013033.en_text: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
2012013033.cn_text: 这是一种微妙的同伴压力形式:我们会无意识地模仿每天所见的行为。

2012013034.en_text: Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions.
2012013034.cn_text: 然而,专家和官僚能否成功地为我们选择同伴群体并将其活动引向良性方向,这远不确定。

2012013035.en_text: It’s like the teacher who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates.
2012013035.cn_text: 这就像老师通过将后排的捣乱者与表现较好的同学配对来拆散他们。

2012013036.cn_text: 这种策略从未真正奏效过。

2012013037.en_text: And that’s the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.
2012013037.cn_text: 这正是外部设计的社会疗法的问题所在:在现实世界中,正如在学校里,我们坚持自己选择朋友。

2012013038.en_text: According to the first paragraph, peer pressure often emerges as ____
2012013038.cn_text: 根据第一段,同伴压力通常表现为____

2012013039.en_text: a supplement to the social cure.

2012013043.en_text: Rosenberg holds that public-health advocates should ____
2012013043.cn_text: 罗森伯格认为公共卫生倡导者应该____

2012013048.en_text: In the author’s view, Rosenberg’s book fails to ____
2012013048.cn_text: 在作者看来,罗森伯格的书未能____

2012013049.en_text: adequately probe social and biological factors.
2012013049.cn_text: 充分探究社会和生物因素

2012013050.en_text: effectively evade the flaws of the social cure.
2012013050.cn_text: 有效规避社会疗法的缺陷

2012013051.en_text: illustrate the functions of state funding.

2012013053.en_text: Paragraph 5 shows that our imitation of behaviors ____
2012013053.cn_text: 第五段表明,我们对行为的模仿____

2012013054.en_text: is harmful to our networks of friends.
2012013054.cn_text: 对我们的朋友网络有害

2012013057.cn_text: 可能产生不良健康习惯

2012013058.en_text: The author suggests in the last paragraph that the effect of peer pressure is ____
2012013058.cn_text: 作者在最后一段暗示,同伴压力的作用是____

2012013063.en_text: A deal is a deal — except, apparently, when Entergy is involved.
2012013063.cn_text: 协议就是协议——但显然，当涉及 Entergy 公司时则另当别论。

2012013064.en_text: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state’s strict nuclear regulations.
2012013064.cn_text: 该公司是新英格兰地区的主要能源供应商，上周在佛蒙特州宣布将违背长期以来遵守该州严格核能法规的承诺，引发了正当的愤怒。

2012013065.en_text: Instead, the company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont’s rules in the federal court, as part of a desperate effort to keep its Vermont Yankee nuclear power plant running.
2012013065.cn_text: 相反，该公司恰恰做了它长期以来承诺不会做的事情：在联邦法院质疑佛蒙特州法规的合宪性，这是其力图维持佛蒙特洋基核电站运营的孤注一掷之举的一部分。

2012013066.cn_text: 这是一个令人震惊的举动。

2012013067.en_text: The conflict has been surfacing since 2002, when the corporation bought Vermont’s only nuclear power plant, an aging reactor in Vernon.
2012013067.cn_text: 自2002年该公司收购佛蒙特州唯一的核电站——一座位于弗农的老化反应堆以来，这一冲突就开始显现。

2012013068.en_text: As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to seek permission from state regulators to operate past 2012.
2012013068.cn_text: 作为获得州政府批准该交易的条件，该公司同意向州监管机构申请许可以在2012年后继续运营。

2012013069.en_text: In 2006, the state went a step further, requiring that any extension of the plant’s license be subject to Vermont legislature’s approval.
2012013069.cn_text: 2006年，州政府进一步要求，该电站许可证的任何延期都须经佛蒙特州立法机构批准。

2012013070.en_text: Then, too, the company went along.
2012013070.cn_text: 当时，该公司也表示同意。

2012013071.en_text: Either Entergy never really intended to live by those commitments, or it simply didn’t foresee what would happen next.
2012013071.cn_text: 要么 Entergy 从未真正打算履行这些承诺,要么它根本没有预见到接下来会发生什么。

2012013072.en_text: A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both Vermont Yankee’s safety and Entergy’s management — especially after the company made misleading statements about the pipe.
2012013072.cn_text: 一系列事故，包括2007年冷却塔部分坍塌和地下管道系统泄漏的发现，引发了对佛蒙特洋基核电站安全性及 Entergy 管理能力的严重质疑——尤其是在该公司就管道问题发表误导性声明之后。

2012013073.en_text: Enraged by Entergy’s behavior, the Vermont Senate voted 26 to 4 last year against allowing an extension.
2012013073.cn_text: 由于对 Entergy 行为的愤怒，佛蒙特州参议院去年以26票对4票的结果否决了延期申请。

2012013074.en_text: Now the company is suddenly claiming that the 2002 agreement is invalid because of the 2006 legislation, and that only the federal government has regulatory power over nuclear issues.
2012013074.cn_text: 现在该公司突然声称，由于2006年的立法，2002年的协议已失效，并且只有联邦政府对核问题拥有监管权。

2012013075.en_text: The legal issues in the case are obscure: whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say the Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
2012013075.cn_text: 该案的法律问题尚不明朗：尽管最高法院裁定各州确实对核能拥有一定的监管权，但法律学者表示，佛蒙特州案件将成为检验这些权力延伸范围的一次具有先例意义的考验。

2012013076.en_text: Certainly, there are valid concerns about the patchwork regulations that could result if every state sets its own rules.
2012013076.cn_text: 当然，如果每个州都制定自己的规则，由此可能导致的拼凑式法规确实令人担忧。

2012013077.en_text: But had Entergy kept its word, that debate would be beside the point.
2012013077.cn_text: 但如果 Entergy 信守承诺，这场争论就不会存在。

2012013078.en_text: The company seems to have concluded that its reputation in Vermont is already so damaged that it has nothing left to lose by going to war with the state.
2012013078.cn_text: 该公司似乎认定其在佛蒙特州的声誉已经损毁殆尽，因此与该州对抗也不会有更多损失。

2012013080.en_text: Permission to run a nuclear plant is a public trust.
2012013080.cn_text: 运营核电站的许可是一种公共信托。

2012013081.en_text: Entergy runs 11 other reactors in the United States, including Pilgrim Nuclear station in Plymouth.
2012013081.cn_text: Entergy 在美国运营着其他11座反应堆，包括位于普利茅斯的朝圣者核电站。

2012013082.en_text: Pledging to run Pilgrim safely, the company has applied for federal permission to keep it open for another 20 years.
2012013082.cn_text: 该公司承诺安全运营朝圣者核电站，并已向联邦申请许可使其再运营20年。

2012013083.en_text: But as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews the company’s application, it should keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth.

2012013109.en_text: In the idealized version of how science is done, facts about the world are waiting to be observed and collected by objective researchers who use the scientific method to carry out their work.
2012013109.cn_text: 在理想化的科学研究方式中，关于世界的事实等待着采用科学方法开展工作的客观研究者去观察和收集。

2012013110.en_text: But in the everyday practice of science, discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route.
2012013110.cn_text: 但在科学的日常实践中，发现往往遵循一条模糊而复杂的路径。

2012013111.en_text: We aim to be objective, but we cannot escape the context of our unique life experiences.
2012013111.cn_text: 我们力求客观，但无法摆脱各自独特生活经历的影响。

2012013112.en_text: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take.
2012013112.cn_text: 先前的知识和兴趣影响着我们的经历、我们对这些经历意义的理解以及我们随后采取的行动。

2012013113.en_text: Opportunities for misinterpretation, error, and self-deception abound.
2012013113.cn_text: 误读、错误和自欺的机会比比皆是。

2012013114.en_text: Consequently, discovery claims should be thought of as protoscience.
2012013114.cn_text: 因此，发现声明应被视为原初科学。

2012013115.en_text: Similar to newly staked mining claims, they are full of potential.
2012013115.cn_text: 类似于新开采的矿权声明，它们充满潜力。

2012013116.en_text: But it takes collective scrutiny and acceptance to transform a discovery claim into a mature discovery.
2012013116.cn_text: 但需要经过集体审查和认可，才能将发现声明转化为成熟的发现。

2012013117.en_text: This is the credibility process, through which the individual researcher’s me, here, now becomes the community’s anyone, anywhere, anytime.
2012013117.cn_text: 这就是可信度形成过程，通过这一过程，单个研究者的「我、此时、此地」转变为共同体的「任何人、任何地方、任何时间」。

2012013118.en_text: Objective knowledge is the goal, not the starting point.
2012013118.cn_text: 客观知识是目标，而非起点。

2012013119.en_text: Once a discovery claim becomes public, the discoverer receives intellectual credit.
2012013119.cn_text: 一旦发现声明公之于众，发现者便获得学术荣誉。

2012013120.en_text: But, unlike with mining claims, the community takes control of what happens next.
2012013120.cn_text: 但与采矿权声明不同，接下来发生的事情由共同体掌控。

2012013121.en_text: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
2012013121.cn_text: 在科学共同体复杂的社会结构中，研究人员做出发现；编辑和审稿人通过控制发表过程充当把关人；其他科学家利用新发现服务于自己的目的；最后，公众（包括其他科学家）接受新发现及可能伴随的技术。

2012013122.en_text: As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved transforms an individual’s discovery claim into the community’s credible discovery.
2012013122.cn_text: 当一项发现声明在共同体中传播时，关于相关科学和技术的共享信念与竞争性信念之间的互动和对抗，将个人的发现声明转化为共同体的可信发现。

2012013123.en_text: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.
2012013123.cn_text: 在这一可信性过程中始终存在两个悖论。

2012013124.en_text: First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect.
2012013124.cn_text: 首先，科学工作往往聚焦于被视为不完整或不正确的现有知识的某些方面。

2012013125.en_text: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
2012013125.cn_text: 重复和证实已知和已信之事很少能得到回报。

2012013126.en_text: The goal is new-search, not re-search.
2012013126.cn_text: 目标是新探索，而非再研究。

2012013127.en_text: Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers.
2012013127.cn_text: 因此不足为奇的是，新发表的发现声明和看似重要且令人信服的可信发现，总是会受到未来研究者的质疑，并有可能被修正或推翻。

2012013128.en_text: Second, novelty itself frequently provokes disbelief.
2012013128.cn_text: 其次，新颖性本身常常引发质疑。

2012013129.en_text: Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Gyorgyi once described discovery as “seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought.”
2012013129.cn_text: 诺贝尔奖得主、生理学家阿尔伯特·圣捷尔吉曾将发现描述为「看到所有人都看到的东西，思考无人曾思考过的问题」。

2012013130.en_text: But thinking what nobody else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views.
2012013130.cn_text: 但思考别人没想过的问题并告诉他们所忽略的东西，可能并不会改变他们的看法。

2012013131.en_text: Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.
2012013131.cn_text: 有时需要数年时间，真正新颖的发现声明才能被接受和认可。

2012013132.en_text: In the end, credibility “happens” to a discovery claim — a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
2012013132.cn_text: 最终，可信度「降临」于发现声明之上——这一过程正对应于哲学家安妮特·拜尔所描述的心智公地。

2012013133.en_text: “We reason together, challenge, revise, and complete each other’s reasoning and each other’s conceptions of reason.”
2012013133.cn_text: 「我们共同推理、质疑、修正，并完善彼此的推理和对理性的理解。」
