2012013159.en_text: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants.
2012013159.cn_text: 如果工会领袖吉米·霍法今天仍然在世，他或许会去代表公务员群体。

2012013160.en_text: When Hoffa’s Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do.
2012013160.cn_text: 1960年霍法领导的卡车司机工会处于鼎盛时期时，美国政府雇员中仅有十分之一加入工会；而如今这一比例已达36%。

2012013161.en_text: In 2009 the number of unionists in America’s public sector passed that of their fellow members in the private sector.
2012013161.cn_text: 2009年，美国公共部门的工会会员人数超过了私营部门的同行人数。

2012013162.en_text: In Britain, more than half of public-sector workers but only about 15% of private-sector ones are unionized.
2012013162.cn_text: 在英国，超过半数的公共部门雇员加入了工会，而私营部门的入会比例仅约为15%。

2012013163.en_text: There are three reasons for the public-sector unions’ thriving.
2012013163.cn_text: 公共部门工会兴旺发达的原因有三。

2012013164.en_text: First, they can shut things down without suffering much in the way of consequences.
2012013164.cn_text: 首先，他们可以采取停工行动而无需承担多少后果。

2012013165.en_text: Second, they are mostly bright and well-educated.
2012013165.cn_text: 其次，他们大多聪明且受教育程度较高。

2012013166.en_text: A quarter of America’s public-sector workers have a university degree.
2012013166.cn_text: 四分之一的美国公共部门雇员拥有大学学位。

2012013167.en_text: Third, they now dominate left-of-centre politics.
2012013167.cn_text: 第三，他们如今在中左翼政治中占据主导地位。

2012013168.en_text: Some of their ties go back a long way.
2012013168.cn_text: 他们的某些联系可以追溯到很久以前。

2012013169.en_text: Britain’s Labor Party, as its name implies, has long been associated with trade unionism.
2012013169.cn_text: 英国工党，顾名思义，长期以来与工会主义保持着密切联系。

2012013170.en_text: Its current leader, Ed Miliband, owes his position to votes from public-sector unions.
2012013170.cn_text: 该党现任领导人埃德·米利班德的当选有赖于公共部门工会的投票支持。

2012013171.en_text: At the state level their influence can be even more fearsome.
2012013171.cn_text: 在州一级，他们的影响力甚至更加令人畏惧。

2012013172.en_text: Mark Baldassare of the Public Policy Institute of California points out that much of the state’s budget is patrolled by unions.
2012013172.cn_text: 加州公共政策研究所的马克·巴尔达萨雷指出，该州预算的很大一部分受到工会的监控。

2012013173.en_text: The teachers’ unions keep an eye on schools, the CCPOA on prisons and a variety of labor groups on health care.
2012013173.cn_text: 教师工会监督学校系统，加州惩教和平官员协会监督监狱系统，而各类劳工组织则监督医疗保健领域。

2012013174.en_text: In many rich countries average wages in the state sector are higher than in the private one.
2012013174.cn_text: 在许多富裕国家，公共部门的平均工资高于私营部门。

2012013175.en_text: But the real gains come in benefits and work practices.
2012013175.cn_text: 但真正的收益体现在福利待遇和工作安排方面。

2012013176.en_text: Politicians have repeatedly “backloaded” public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
2012013176.cn_text: 政治家们反复采用「后置加载」的方式处理公共部门薪酬协议，将工资增长幅度控制在适度水平，但增加假期，尤其是增加本已十分优厚的养老金。

2012013177.en_text: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most notoriously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
2012013177.cn_text: 改革遭到了强烈抵制，其中以教育领域最为典型，特许学校、学院制学校以及绩效工资制度都经历了旷日持久的抗争。

2012013178.en_text: Even though there is plenty of evidence that the quality of the teachers is the most important variable, teachers’ unions have fought against getting rid of bad ones and promoting good ones.
2012013178.cn_text: 尽管有大量证据表明教师素质是最重要的影响因素，教师工会却一直反对淘汰不合格教师和提拔优秀教师的做法。

2012013179.en_text: As the cost to everyone else has become clearer, politicians have begun to clamp down.
2012013179.cn_text: 随着这一制度给其他人造成的成本日益显现，政治家们开始采取严厉措施。

2012013180.en_text: In Wisconsin the unions have rallied thousands of supporters against Scott Walker, the hardline Republican governor.
2012013180.cn_text: 在威斯康星州,工会组织了数千名支持者反对强硬派共和党州长斯科特·沃克。

2012013181.en_text: But many within the public sector suffer under the current system, too.
2012013181.cn_text: 但公共部门内部也有许多人在现行制度下深受其害。

2012013182.en_text: John Donahue at Harvard’s Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but is bad for high achievers.
2012013182.cn_text: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员系统中的文化规范适合那些安于现状的人，却不利于高成就者的发展。

2012013183.en_text: The only American public-sector workers who earn well above $250,sss000 a year are university sports coaches and the president of the United States.
2012013183.cn_text: 美国公共部门年收入远超25万美元的雇员只有大学体育教练和美国总统。

2012013184.en_text: Bankers’ fat pay packets have attracted much criticism, but a public-sector system that does not reward high achievers may be a much bigger problem for America.
2012013184.cn_text: 银行家的高薪酬包引发了大量批评，但一个不奖励高成就者的公共部门体系对美国而言可能是一个更严重的问题。

2012013210.en_text: Think of those fleeting moments when you look out of an aeroplane window and realise that you are flying, higher than a bird.
2012013210.cn_text: 想想那些转瞬即逝的时刻：当你从飞机舷窗向外眺望，意识到自己正飞行在比鸟儿更高的地方。

2012013211.en_text: Now think of your laptop, thinner than a brown-paper envelope, or your cellphone in the palm of your hand.
2012013211.cn_text: 再想想你的笔记本电脑，比牛皮纸信封还要纤薄；或是你掌心中的手机。

2012013212.en_text: Take a moment or two to wonder at those marvels.
2012013212.cn_text: 花片刻时间惊叹于这些奇迹吧。

2012013213.en_text: You are the lucky inheritor of a dream come true.
2012013213.cn_text: 你是梦想成真的幸运继承者。

2012013214.en_text: The second half of the 20th century saw a collection of geniuses, warriors, entrepreneurs and visionaries labour to create a fabulous machine that could function as a typewriter and printing press, studio and theatre, paintbrush and gallery, piano and radio, the mail as well as the mail carrier.
2012013214.cn_text: 20世纪下半叶，一批天才、斗士、企业家和远见者共同努力，创造出一台神奇的机器，它可以兼作打字机与印刷机、工作室与剧院、画笔与画廊、钢琴与收音机，既是邮件也是邮件载体。

2012013216.en_text: The networked computer is an amazing device, the first media machine that serves as the mode of production, means of distribution, site of reception, and place of praise and critique.
2012013216.cn_text: 联网计算机是一种惊人的设备，它是第一台同时充当生产方式、分发手段、接收场所以及赞美与批评之地的媒体机器。

2012013217.en_text: The computer is the 21st century’s culture machine.
2012013217.cn_text: 计算机是21世纪的文化机器。

2012013218.en_text: But for all the reasons there are to celebrate the computer, we must also act with caution.
2012013218.cn_text: 但是，尽管有诸多理由庆祝计算机的诞生，我们也必须保持谨慎。

2012013220.en_text: I call it a secret war for two reasons.
2012013220.cn_text: 我称之为秘密战争有两个原因。

2012013221.en_text: First, most people do not realise that there are strong commercial agendas at work to keep them in passive consumption mode.
2012013221.cn_text: 首先，大多数人没有意识到，有强大的商业议程正在运作，以使他们保持被动消费状态。

2012013222.en_text: Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
2012013222.cn_text: 其次，大多数使用联网计算机上传内容的人，甚至没有意识到他们所做之事的重要性。

2012013223.en_text: All animals download, but only a few upload.
2012013223.cn_text: 所有动物都会下载，但只有少数会上传。

2012013224.en_text: Beavers build dams and birds make nests.

2012013225.en_text: Yet for the most part, the animal kingdom moves through the world downloading.
2012013225.cn_text: 然而，大多数情况下，动物王国是通过下载的方式在世界中穿行。

2012013226.en_text: Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods — paintings, sculpture and architecture — and superfluous experiences — music, literature, religion and philosophy.
2012013226.cn_text: 人类的独特之处不仅在于能够制造工具，还能够转而利用这些工具创造出多余的物质产品——绘画、雕塑和建筑——以及多余的体验——音乐、文学、宗教和哲学。

2012013228.en_text: For all the possibilities of our new culture machines, most people are still stuck in download mode.
2012013228.cn_text: 尽管我们的新文化机器拥有各种可能性，大多数人仍然停留在下载模式中。

2012013229.en_text: Even after the advent of widespread social media, a pyramid of production remains, with a small number of people uploading material, a slightly larger group commenting on or modifying that content, and a huge percentage remaining content to just consume.
2012013229.cn_text: 即使在社交媒体广泛普及之后，生产的金字塔结构依然存在：少数人上传内容，稍多一些的人评论或修改这些内容，而绝大多数人则满足于仅仅消费。

2012013231.en_text: Television is a one-way tap flowing into our homes.
2012013231.cn_text: 电视是一个单向流入我们家中的水龙头。

2012013232.en_text: The hardest task that television asks of anyone is to turn the power off after he has turned it on.
2012013232.cn_text: 电视对任何人提出的最艰巨任务，就是在打开它之后再把它关掉。

2012013234.cn_text: 什么样的上传才算有意义？

2012013235.en_text: My definition revolves around the concept of “stickiness” — creations and experiences to which others adhere.
2012013235.cn_text: 我的定义围绕「粘性」这一概念——即能让他人依附的创作和体验。

2012013236.en_text: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human.
2012013236.cn_text: 当然，正是这些多余的事物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何为人类。

2012013237.en_text: Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
2012013237.cn_text: 下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但若无法超越下载阶段，就会剥夺自己作为人类的一个本质构成要素。

2012013238.en_text: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
2012013238.cn_text: 像tumblr.com这样的应用程序允许用户以创造性的方式组合图片、文字和其他媒体并加以分享，有可能通过娱乐、启迪他人来增加粘性。

2012013239.en_text: Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
2012013239.cn_text: 他们不仅开发出了这样的设备，而且到千禧年之交，还成功地将其嵌入一个每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统之中。

2012013240.en_text: This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading — between passive consumption and active creation — whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
2012013240.cn_text: 这是因为联网计算机引发了一场下载与上传之间的秘密战争——被动消费与主动创造之间的战争——其结果将以我们只能初步想象的方式塑造我们的集体未来。

2012013241.en_text: The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.
2012013241.cn_text: 因此，计算机对电视的挑战与一种格式被另一种格式取代的情况几乎毫无相似之处，不像唱片机被CD播放器取代那样。

2012013242.en_text: One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half- century, much of the world’s media culture has been defined by a single medium — television — and television is defined by downloading.
2012013242.cn_text: 这种生产金字塔持续存在的一个原因是，在过去半个世纪里，世界上大部分媒体文化都由单一媒介——电视——所定义，而电视的本质特征就是下载。

2012013243.en_text: The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
2012013243.cn_text: 联网计算机提供了50年来首次逆转信息流向的机会，以鼓励深思熟虑的下载，更重要的是，鼓励有意义的上传。

2012013249.en_text: Since the days of Aristotle, a search for universal principles has characterized the scientific enterprise.
2012013249.cn_text: 自亚里士多德时代以来，对普遍性原理的探寻一直是科学事业的标志性特征。

2012013250.en_text: In some ways, this quest for commonalities defines science.
2012013250.cn_text: 在某种意义上，正是这种对共性的追求界定了科学的本质。

2012013251.en_text: Newton’s laws of motion and Darwinian evolution each bind a host of different phenomena into a single explicatory framework.
2012013251.cn_text: 牛顿运动定律和达尔文进化论都将众多不同现象统摄于单一的解释框架之中。

2012013252.en_text: In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything — a single generative equation for all we see.
2012013252.cn_text: 在物理学中,有一种研究路径将这种统一冲动推向极致,力图寻找一个万有理论——一个能够生成我们所见一切的单一方程。

2012013253.en_text: It is becoming less clear, however, that such a theory would be a simplification, given the dimensions and universes that it might entail.
2012013253.cn_text: 然而,考虑到这一理论可能涉及的维度和宇宙,它是否真能带来简化,正变得越来越不明朗。

2012013254.en_text: Nonetheless, unification of sorts remains a major goal.
2012013254.cn_text: 尽管如此,某种意义上的统一仍然是一个重要目标。

2012013255.en_text: This tendency in the natural sciences has long been evident in the social sciences too.
2012013255.cn_text: 自然科学中的这一倾向,长期以来在社会科学中同样显著。

2012013256.en_text: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings.
2012013256.cn_text: 在此,达尔文主义似乎提供了理论依据,因为如果全人类拥有共同起源,那么认为文化多样性也可追溯至更为有限的起点,便显得合情合理。

2012013257.en_text: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection, perhaps the world’s languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
2012013257.cn_text: 正如纷繁复杂的人类求偶仪式或许都可视为性选择的不同形式,世界各地的语言、音乐、社会与宗教习俗乃至历史,可能也都受某些普遍性特征的支配。

2012013258.en_text: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
2012013258.cn_text: 将独特之处与共享之处区分开来,或许能使我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的,以及从进化或认知层面看是何种力量在引导它。

2012013259.en_text: That, at least, is the hope.
2012013259.cn_text: 至少,这是人们所抱持的希望。

2012013260.en_text: But a comparative study of linguistic traits published online today supplies a reality check.
2012013260.cn_text: 但今天在线发表的一项语言特征比较研究为这一希望提供了现实检验。

2012013261.en_text: Russell Gray at the University of Auckland and his colleagues consider the evolution of grammars in the light of two previous attempts to find universality in language.
2012013261.cn_text: 奥克兰大学的拉塞尔·格雷及其同事结合此前两次在语言中寻找普遍性的尝试,对语法演化进行了考察。

2012013262.en_text: The most famous of these efforts was initiated by Noam Chomsky, who suggested that humans are born with an innate language-acquisition capacity that dictates a universal grammar.
2012013262.cn_text: 这些尝试中最著名的由诺姆·乔姆斯基发起,他提出人类天生具有一种先天的语言习得能力,该能力决定了一种普遍语法。

2012013263.en_text: A few generative rules are then sufficient to unfold the entire fundamental structure of a language, which is why children can learn it so quickly.
2012013263.cn_text: 少数几条生成规则便足以展开一门语言的全部基础结构,这也是儿童能够如此迅速习得语言的原因。

2012013264.en_text: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.
2012013264.cn_text: 第二种由约书亚·格林伯格提出的方法对普遍性采取了更为经验主义的路径,通过识别许多语言共有的特征(尤其是词序方面),认为这些特征代表了由认知约束所致的偏向。

2012013265.en_text: Gray and his colleagues have put them to the test by examining four family trees that between them represent more than 2 000 languages.
2012013265.cn_text: 格雷及其同事通过考察四个语系树对这些理论进行了检验,这些语系树共涵盖2000余种语言。

2012013266.en_text: Chomsky’s grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations.
2012013266.cn_text: 乔姆斯基的语法理论应当显示出独立于语系树或其演化路径的语言变化模式,而格林伯格的普遍性则预测特定类型词序关系之间存在强相互依存性。

2012013267.en_text: Neither of these patterns is borne out by the analysis, suggesting that the structures of the languages are lineage-specific and not governed by universals.
2012013267.cn_text: 但分析结果并未证实这两种模式中的任何一种,这表明语言结构具有谱系特异性,并非受普遍性规律支配。

2013013001.en_text: People are, on the whole, poor at considering background information when making individual decisions.
2013013001.cn_text: 总体而言，人们在做出个人决策时不善于考虑背景信息。

2013013002.en_text: At first glance this might seem like a strength that grants the ability to make judgments which are unbiased by external factors.
2013013002.cn_text: 乍一看，这似乎是一种优势，能够赋予人们做出不受外部因素影响的判断的能力。

2013013003.en_text: But Dr. Uri Simonsohn speculated that an inability to consider the big picture was leading decision-makers to be biased by the daily samples of information they were working with.
2013013003.cn_text: 但乌里·西蒙松博士推测，无法考虑全局会导致决策者受到他们日常处理的信息样本的影响而产生偏见。

2013013005.en_text: For example, he theorised that a judge fearful of appearing too soft on crime might be more likely to send someone to prison if he had already sentenced five or six other defendants only to forced community service on that day.
2013013005.cn_text: 例如，他提出理论认为，一名担心显得对犯罪过于宽容的法官，如果当天已经判处五六名其他被告仅接受强制社区服务，可能更倾向于将某人判入狱。

2013013006.en_text: To test this idea, he turned to the university-admissions process.
2013013006.cn_text: 为了验证这一想法，他转向了大学招生过程。

2013013007.en_text: In theory, the success of an applicant should not depend on the few others chosen randomly for interview during the same day, but Dr. Simonsohn suspected the truth was otherwise.
2013013007.cn_text: 理论上，申请人的成功不应该取决于同一天随机选择参加面试的其他几位申请人，但西蒙松博士怀疑事实并非如此。

2013013009.en_text: He studied the results of 9,323 MBA interviews conducted by 31 admissions officers.
2013013009.cn_text: 他研究了由31名招生官进行的9323次MBA面试的结果。

2013013010.en_text: The interviewers had rated applicants on a scale of one to five.
2013013010.cn_text: 面试官按照一到五分的标准对申请人进行了评分。

2013013011.en_text: This scale took numerous factors into consideration.
2013013011.cn_text: 该评分标准考虑了众多因素。

2013013012.en_text: The scores were then used in conjunction with an applicant’s score on the Graduate Management Admission Test, or GMAT, a standardised exam which is marked out of 800 points, to make a decision on whether to accept him or her.
2013013012.cn_text: 这些分数随后与申请人在研究生管理科入学考试即GMAT中的分数结合使用，GMAT是一项满分为800分的标准化考试，用于决定是否录取该申请人。

2013013013.en_text: Dr. Simonsohn found if the score of the previous candidate in a daily series of interviewees was 0.75 points or more higher than that of the one before that, then the score for the next applicant would drop by an average of 0.075 points.
2013013013.cn_text: 西蒙松博士发现，如果当天系列面试中前一位候选人的分数比再前一位高出0.75分或更多，那么下一位申请人的分数平均会下降0.075分。

2013013015.en_text: This might sound small, but to undo the effects of such a decrease a candidate would need 30 more GMAT points than would otherwise have been necessary.
2013013015.cn_text: 这听起来可能影响不大，但要抵消这种下降的影响，候选人需要比原本所需多出30分的GMAT分数。

2013013016.en_text: In the 2006 film version of The Devil Wears Prada, Miranda Priestly, played by Meryl Streep, scolds her unattractive assistant for imagining that high fashion doesn’t affect her.
2013013016.cn_text: 在2006年的电影《穿普拉达的女王》中，梅丽尔·斯特里普饰演的米兰达·普里斯特利斥责她那位毫不起眼的助手，因其以为高级时尚与自己无关。

2013013017.en_text: Priestly explains how the deep blue color of the assistant’s sweater descended over the years from fashion shows to department stores and to the bargain bin in which the poor girl doubtless found her garment.
2013013017.cn_text: 普里斯特利解释了助手毛衣上的深蓝色是如何在多年间从时装秀流向百货商店，最后到达这个可怜女孩无疑淘得这件衣服的打折货架。

2013013018.en_text: This top-down conception of the fashion business couldn’t be more out of date or at odds with the feverish world described in Overdressed, Elizabeth Cline’s three-year indictment of “fast fashion.”
2013013018.cn_text: 这种自上而下的时尚商业观念已完全过时,与伊丽莎白·克莱恩在《过度着装》中描绘的狂热世界格格不入,该书是她对「快时尚」长达三年的控诉。

2013013019.en_text: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely.
2013013019.cn_text: 在过去十年左右的时间里,技术进步使得Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众市场品牌能够更快速地应对潮流趋势,更精准地预测需求。

2013013020.en_text: Quicker turnarounds mean less wasted inventory, more frequent releases, and more profit.
2013013020.cn_text: 更快的周转意味着更少的库存积压、更频繁的产品发布和更高的利润。

2013013021.en_text: These labels encourage styleconscious consumers to see clothes as disposable — meant to last only a wash or two, although they don’t advertise that — and to renew their wardrobe every few weeks.
2013013021.cn_text: 这些品牌鼓励注重风格的消费者将服装视为一次性物品——虽然它们不会明说,但这些衣服只能洗一两次——并每隔几周就更新衣橱。

2013013022.en_text: By offering on-trend items at dirt-cheap prices, Cline argues, these brands have hijacked fashion cycles, shaking an industry long accustomed to a seasonal pace.
2013013022.cn_text: 克莱恩认为,通过以极低价格提供流行单品,这些品牌劫持了时尚周期,撼动了长期习惯于季节性节奏的产业。

2013013023.en_text: The victims of this revolution, of course, are not limited to designers.
2013013023.cn_text: 当然,这场变革的受害者不仅限于设计师。

2013013024.en_text: For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
2013013024.cn_text: 为了让H&M能够在其全球2300多家门店中销售售价5.95美元的针织迷你裙,它必须依赖低工资的海外劳工,下达消耗自然资源的大额订单,并使用大量有害化学品。

2013013025.en_text: Overdressed is the fashion world’s answer to consumer-activist bestsellers like Michael Pollan’s The Omnivore’s Dilemma. “Mass-produced clothing, like fast food, fills a hunger and need, yet is non-durable and wasteful,” Cline argues.
2013013025.cn_text: 《过度着装》是时尚界对迈克尔·波伦的《杂食者的困境》等消费维权畅销书的回应。克莱恩认为:「大规模生产的服装与快餐一样,满足了饥饿和需求,但却不耐久且造成浪费。」

2013013026.en_text: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year — about 64 items per person — and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
2013013026.cn_text: 她发现,美国人每年购买约200亿件服装——人均约64件——无论他们捐出多少,这种过量最终都导致浪费。

2013013027.en_text: Towards the end of Overdressed, Cline introduced her ideal, a Brooklyn woman named Sarah Kate Beaumont, who since 2008 has made all of her own clothes — and beautifully.
2013013027.cn_text: 在《过度着装》接近尾声时,克莱恩介绍了她的理想典范,一位名叫萨拉·凯特·博蒙特的布鲁克林女性,自2008年以来她自己制作所有衣服——而且做得非常漂亮。

2013013028.en_text: But as Cline is the first to note, it took Beaumont decades to perfect her craft; her example can’t be knocked off.
2013013028.cn_text: 但正如克莱恩首先指出的,博蒙特花了数十年才完善自己的手艺;她的榜样无法被轻易复制。

2013013029.en_text: Though several fast-fashion companies have made efforts to curb their impact on labor and the environment — including H&M, with its green Conscious Collection line — Cline believes lasting change can only be effected by the customer.
2013013029.cn_text: 尽管包括H&M在内的几家快时尚公司已采取措施遏制其对劳工和环境的影响——如推出绿色环保系列——克莱恩相信持久改变只能由消费者促成。

2013013030.en_text: She exhibits the idealism common to many advocates of sustainability, be it in food or in energy.
2013013030.cn_text: 她展现出许多可持续发展倡导者共有的理想主义,无论是在食品还是能源领域。

2013013031.en_text: Vanity is a constant; people will only start shopping more sustainably when they can’t afford not to.
2013013031.cn_text: 虚荣心是恒定的;只有当人们无力承担不可持续消费的代价时,才会开始更可持续地购物。

2013013032.en_text: Priestly criticizes her assistant for her ____
2013013032.cn_text: 普里斯特利批评她的助手是因为____

2013013037.en_text: According to Cline, mass-market labels urge consumers to ____
2013013037.cn_text: 根据克莱恩的观点,大众市场品牌催促消费者____

2013013039.en_text: shut out the feverish fashion world.

2013013041.en_text: shop for their garments more frequently.

2013013042.en_text: The word “indictment” (Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ____
2013013042.cn_text: 第2段中的indictment一词含义最接近____

2013013047.en_text: Which of the following can be inferred from the last paragraph?
2013013047.cn_text: 从最后一段可以推断出以下哪一项?

2013013048.en_text: Vanity has more often been found in idealists.
2013013048.cn_text: 虚荣心在理想主义者身上更常见。

2013013049.cn_text: 快时尚行业忽视可持续性。

2013013050.en_text: People are more interested in unaffordable garments.
2013013050.cn_text: 人们对买不起的服装更感兴趣。

2013013051.en_text: Pricing is vital to environment-friendly purchasing.
2013013051.cn_text: 定价对环保购物至关重要。

2013013052.en_text: What is the subject of the text?

2013013053.cn_text: 对奢侈生活方式的讽刺。

2013013054.cn_text: 对高级时尚神话的挑战。

2013013057.en_text: An old saying has it that half of all advertising budgets are wasted — the trouble is, no one knows which half.
2013013057.cn_text: 有句老话说，所有广告预算中有一半被浪费了——问题在于，没人知道是哪一半。

2013013058.en_text: In the internet age, at least in theory, this fraction can be much reduced.
2013013058.cn_text: 在互联网时代，至少在理论上，这一比例可以大幅降低。

2013013059.en_text: By watching what people search for, click on and say online, companies can aim “behavioural” ads at those most likely to buy.
2013013059.cn_text: 通过观察人们在网上搜索、点击和发表的内容，公司可以将「行为」广告投放给最有可能购买的人群。

2013013060.en_text: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads?
2013013060.cn_text: 过去几周的一场争论凸显了此类精细信息对广告商的价值：广告商是否应该假定人们乐意被追踪并接收行为广告？

2013013061.en_text: Or should they have explicit permission?
2013013061.cn_text: 还是应该获得明确许可？

2013013062.en_text: In December 2010 America’s Federal Trade Commission (FTC) proposed adding a “do not track” (DNT) option to internet browsers, so that users could tell advertisers that they did not want to be followed.
2013013062.cn_text: 2010年12月，美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）提议在互联网浏览器中增加「禁止追踪」（DNT）选项，以便用户可以告知广告商他们不希望被追踪。

2013013063.en_text: Microsoft’s Internet Explorer and Apple’s Safari both offer DNT; Google’s Chrome is due to do so this year.
2013013063.cn_text: 微软的 Internet Explorer 和苹果的 Safari 都提供 DNT 功能；谷歌的 Chrome 预计今年推出该功能。

2013013064.en_text: In February the FTC and Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA) agreed that the industry would get cracking on responding to DNT requests.
2013013064.cn_text: 2月，FTC 和数字广告联盟（DAA）达成一致，行业将着手响应 DNT 请求。

2013013065.en_text: On May 31st Microsoft set off the row.

2013013066.en_text: It said that Internet Explorer 10, the version due to appear with Windows 8, would have DNT as a default.
2013013066.cn_text: 它表示，计划随 Windows 8 推出的 Internet Explorer 10 版本将默认启用 DNT。

2013013068.en_text: Human nature being what it is, most people stick with default settings.
2013013068.cn_text: 鉴于人性如此，大多数人会沿用默认设置。

2013013069.en_text: Few switch DNT on now, but if tracking is off it will stay off.
2013013069.cn_text: 现在很少有人开启 DNT，但如果追踪默认关闭，它就会保持关闭状态。

2013013070.en_text: Bob Liodice, the chief executive of the Association of National Advertisers, says consumers will be worse off if the industry cannot collect information about their preferences.
2013013070.cn_text: 美国全国广告商协会首席执行官鲍勃·利奥迪斯表示，如果行业无法收集消费者偏好信息，消费者的境况会更糟。

2013013071.en_text: People will not get fewer ads, he says. “They’ll get less meaningful, less targeted ads.”
2013013071.cn_text: 他说，人们不会收到更少的广告。「他们会收到意义更少、针对性更差的广告。」

2013013072.en_text: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
2013013072.cn_text: 广告商将如何应对尚不明朗。

2013013073.en_text: Getting a DNT signal does not oblige anyone to stop tracking, although some companies have promised to do so.
2013013073.cn_text: 收到 DNT 信号并不意味着必须停止追踪，尽管一些公司承诺会这样做。

2013013074.en_text: Unable to tell whether someone really objects to behavioural ads or whether they are sticking with Microsoft’s default, some may ignore a DNT signal and press on anyway.
2013013074.cn_text: 由于无法判断某人是真正反对行为广告，还是只是沿用了微软的默认设置，一些广告商可能会无视 DNT 信号继续追踪。

2013013075.en_text: Also unclear is why Microsoft has gone it alone.
2013013075.cn_text: 微软为何单独行动同样不明朗。

2013013076.en_text: After all, it has an ad business too, which it says will comply with DNT requests, though it is still working out how.
2013013076.cn_text: 毕竟，它也有广告业务，并表示将遵守 DNT 请求，尽管还在研究具体如何实现。

2013013077.en_text: If it is trying to upset Google, which relies almost wholly on advertising, it has chosen an indirect method: there is no guarantee that DNT by default will become the norm.
2013013077.cn_text: 如果它试图对几乎完全依赖广告的谷歌造成困扰，那么它选择了一种间接的方式：默认启用 DNT 能否成为行业规范尚无保证。

2013013078.en_text: DNT does not seem an obviously huge selling point for Windows 8 — though the firm has compared some of its other products favourably with Google’s on that count before.
2013013078.cn_text: DNT 似乎并非 Windows 8 的一个明显重要卖点——尽管该公司此前曾在这方面将其某些产品与谷歌产品进行有利比较。

2013013079.en_text: Brendon Lynch, Microsoft’s chief privacy officer, blogged: “We believe consumers should have more control.”
2013013079.cn_text: 微软首席隐私官布伦登·林奇在博客中写道：「我们认为消费者应该拥有更多控制权。」

2013013080.en_text: Could it really be that simple?

2013013106.en_text: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely — though by no means uniformly — glowingly positive.
2013013106.cn_text: 直到几十年前，我们对未来的憧憬在很大程度上——尽管绝非一致——都是光辉灿烂的。

2013013107.en_text: Science and technology would cure all the ills of humanity, leading to lives of fulfilment and opportunity for all.
2013013107.cn_text: 科学与技术将治愈人类的一切弊病，为所有人带来充实而充满机遇的生活。

2013013108.en_text: Now utopia has grown unfashionable, as we have gained a deeper appreciation of the range of threats facing us, from asteroid strike to epidemic flu and to climate change.
2013013108.cn_text: 如今，乌托邦已经不再流行，因为我们对所面临威胁的范围有了更深刻的认识，从小行星撞击到流行性流感再到气候变化。

2013013109.en_text: You might even be tempted to assume that humanity has little future to look forward to.
2013013109.cn_text: 你甚至可能会倾向于认为人类几乎没有什么未来可以期待。

2013013110.cn_text: 但这种悲观情绪是不当的。

2013013111.en_text: The fossil record shows that many species have endured for millions of years — so why shouldn’t we?
2013013111.cn_text: 化石记录显示许多物种已经存续了数百万年——那么我们为什么不能呢？

2013013112.en_text: Take a broader look at our species’ place in the universe, and it becomes clear that we have an excellent chance of surviving for tens, if not hundreds, of thousands of years.
2013013112.cn_text: 从更广阔的视角看待我们物种在宇宙中的位置，就会清楚地发现，我们极有可能存续数万年，甚至数十万年。

2013013113.en_text: Look up Homo sapiens in the “Red List” of threatened species of the International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN) and you will read: “Listed as Least Concern as the species is very widely distributed, adaptable, currently increasing, and there are no major threats resulting in an overall population decline.”
2013013113.cn_text: 在国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）的濒危物种「红色名录」中查找智人，你会看到：「被列为无危物种，因为该物种分布极为广泛，适应性强，目前数量正在增加，并且没有导致整体种群数量下降的主要威胁。」

2013013114.en_text: So what does our deep future hold?
2013013114.cn_text: 那么我们的深远未来将会怎样呢？

2013013115.en_text: A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question.
2013013115.cn_text: 越来越多的研究人员和组织现在正在认真思考这个问题。

2013013116.en_text: For example, the Long Now Foundation has as its flagship project a mechanical clock that is designed to still be marking time thousands of years hence.
2013013116.cn_text: 例如，「长远现在基金会」的旗舰项目是一座机械钟，它被设计成在数千年后依然能够报时。

2013013117.en_text: Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future.
2013013117.cn_text: 也许是有意为之，思考如此漫长的时间跨度可能比思考更为紧迫的未来要容易些。

2013013118.en_text: The potential evolution of today’s technology, and its social consequences, is dazzlingly complicated, and it’s perhaps best left to science fiction writers and futurologists to explore the many possibilities we can envisage.
2013013118.cn_text: 当今技术的潜在演变及其社会后果极其复杂，或许最好留给科幻作家和未来学家去探索我们能够设想的诸多可能性。

2013013119.en_text: That’s one reason why we have launched Arc, a new publication dedicated to the near future.
2013013119.cn_text: 这就是我们推出《Arc》这本致力于近期未来的新刊物的原因之一。

2013013120.en_text: But take a longer view and there is a surprising amount that we can say with considerable assurance.
2013013120.cn_text: 但从更长远的角度来看，有许多事情我们可以相当有把握地断言。

2013013121.en_text: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
2013013121.cn_text: 正如常见的那样，过去是通往未来的钥匙：我们现在已经识别出足够多塑造地球及我们物种历史的长期模式，从而能够基于证据对我们的后代所处的境况做出预测。

2013013122.en_text: This long perspective makes the pessimistic view of our prospects seem more likely to be a passing fad.
2013013122.cn_text: 这种长远的视角使得对我们前景的悲观看法更可能只是一时的风潮。

2013013123.en_text: To be sure, the future is not all rosy.
2013013123.cn_text: 可以肯定的是，未来并非一片玫瑰色。

2013013124.en_text: But we are now knowledgeable enough to reduce many of the risks that threatened the existence of earlier humans, and to improve the lot of those to come.
2013013124.cn_text: 但我们现在已经足够有知识，可以减少许多威胁早期人类生存的风险，并改善后代的境遇。

2013013150.en_text: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona’s immigration law Monday — a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
2013013150.cn_text: 周一,最高法院以五比三的投票结果推翻了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分条款——这对奥巴马政府而言是一场温和的政策胜利。

2013013151.en_text: But on the more important matter of the Constitution, the decision was an 8-0 defeat for the Administration’s effort to upset the balance of power between the federal government and the states.
2013013151.cn_text: 但在更为重要的宪法问题上,该裁决却是政府试图打破联邦与州之间权力平衡的一次8比0的完败。

2013013152.en_text: In Arizona v. United States, the majority overturned three of the four contested provisions of Arizona’s controversial plan to have state and local police enforce federal immigration law.
2013013152.cn_text: 在亚利桑那州诉美国案中,多数派推翻了亚利桑那州争议性计划中四项受争议条款中的三项,该计划旨在由州及地方警察执行联邦移民法。

2013013154.en_text: The Constitutional principles that Washington alone has the power to “establish a uniform Rule of Naturalization” and that federal laws precede state laws are noncontroversial.
2013013154.cn_text: 宪法原则规定,只有华盛顿拥有「制定统一归化规则」的权力,且联邦法律优先于州法律,这些原则并无争议。

2013013155.en_text: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
2013013155.cn_text: 亚利桑那州试图制定与现有联邦政策并行的州政策。

2013013156.en_text: Justice Anthony Kennedy, joined by Chief Justice John Roberts and the Court’s liberals, ruled that the state flew too close to the federal sun.
2013013156.cn_text: 安东尼·肯尼迪大法官与首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨及法院的自由派大法官共同裁定,该州过度逼近联邦权力范畴。

2013013157.en_text: On the overturned provisions the majority held that Congress had deliberately “occupied the field,” and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal’s privileged powers.
2013013157.cn_text: 对于被推翻的条款,多数派认为国会已经刻意「占据了该领域」,因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦的专属权力。

2013013158.en_text: However, the Justices said that Arizona police would be allowed to verify the legal status of people who come in contact with law enforcement.
2013013158.cn_text: 然而,大法官们表示,亚利桑那州警察将被允许核查与执法部门接触人员的合法身份。

2013013159.en_text: That’s because Congress has always envisioned joint federal-state immigration enforcement and explicitly encourages state officers to share information and cooperate with federal colleagues.
2013013159.cn_text: 这是因为国会一向设想联邦与州联合执行移民法,并明确鼓励州执法人员与联邦同事共享信息并相互配合。

2013013160.en_text: Two of the three objecting Justices — Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas — agreed with this Constitutional logic but disagreed about which Arizona rules conflicted with the federal statute.
2013013160.cn_text: 三位持反对意见的大法官中有两位——塞缪尔·阿利托和克拉伦斯·托马斯——认同这一宪法逻辑,但对亚利桑那州哪些法规与联邦法规相冲突存在分歧。

2013013161.en_text: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
2013013161.cn_text: 唯一的重大反对意见来自安东宁·斯卡利亚大法官,他对州权利进行了更为有力的辩护,追溯至《外国人和煽动叛乱法》。

2013013162.en_text: The 8-0 objection to President Obama turns on what Justice Samuel Alito describes in his objection as “a shocking assertion of federal executive power.”
2013013162.cn_text: 对奥巴马总统8比0的反对意见,基于塞缪尔·阿利托大法官在其反对意见中所称的「联邦行政权的惊人主张」。

2013013163.en_text: The White House argued that Arizona’s laws conflicted with its enforcement priorities, even if state laws complied with federal statutes to the letter.
2013013163.cn_text: 白宫辩称,即使州法律在字面上完全符合联邦法规,亚利桑那州的法律仍与其执法优先事项相冲突。

2013013164.en_text: In effect, the White House claimed that it could invalidate any otherwise legitimate state law that it disagrees with.
2013013164.cn_text: 实质上,白宫声称它可以废除任何本来合法但其不认同的州法律。

2013013165.en_text: Some powers do belong exclusively to the federal government, and control of citizenship and the borders is among them.
2013013165.cn_text: 某些权力确实专属于联邦政府,对公民身份和边界的管控便在其中。

2013013166.en_text: But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could.
2013013166.cn_text: 但如果国会想阻止各州利用自身资源检查移民身份,它本可以做到。

2013013168.en_text: The Administration was in essence asserting that because it didn’t want to carry out Congress’s immigration wishes, no state should be allowed to do so either.
2013013168.cn_text: 政府实质上是在主张,由于它不愿执行国会的移民意愿,因此任何州也都不应被允许这样做。

2013013169.en_text: Every Justice rightly rejected this remarkable claim.
2013013169.cn_text: 所有大法官都正确地驳回了这一异乎寻常的主张。

2013013170.en_text: Three provisions of Arizona’s plan were overturned because they ____
2013013170.cn_text: 亚利桑那州计划中的三项条款被推翻,是因为它们____

2013013171.en_text: deprived the federal police of Constitutional powers
2013013171.cn_text: 剥夺了联邦警察的宪法权力

2013013172.en_text: disturbed the power balance between different states
2013013172.cn_text: 扰乱了不同州之间的权力平衡

2013013173.en_text: overstepped the authority of federal immigration law
2013013173.cn_text: 超越了联邦移民法的权限

2013013174.en_text: contradicted both the federal and state policies
2013013174.cn_text: 与联邦和州政策均相矛盾

2013013175.cn_text: 根据第4段,大法官们在以下哪一点上达成了一致?

2013013176.en_text: Federal officers’ duty to withhold immigrants’ information.
2013013176.cn_text: 联邦官员有义务保留移民信息。

2013013177.en_text: States’ independence from federal immigration law.
2013013177.cn_text: 各州独立于联邦移民法。

2013013178.en_text: States’ legitimate role in immigration enforcement.
2013013178.cn_text: 各州在移民执法中的合法角色。

2013013179.cn_text: 国会对移民执法的介入。

2013013180.en_text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 5 that the Alien and Sedition Acts ____
2013013180.cn_text: 从第5段可以推断,《外国人和煽动叛乱法》____

2013013184.en_text: stood in favor of the states

2013013185.en_text: The White House claims that its power of enforcement ____

2013013186.en_text: outweighs that held by the states

2013013187.en_text: is dependent on the states’ support

2013013190.en_text: What can be learned from the last paragraph?
2013013190.cn_text: 从最后一段可以得出什么?

2013013191.en_text: Immigration issues are usually decided by Congress.
2013013191.cn_text: 移民问题通常由国会决定。

2013013192.en_text: Justices intended to check the power of the Administration.
2013013192.cn_text: 大法官们意在制约政府权力。

2013013193.en_text: Justices wanted to strengthen its coordination with Congress.
2013013193.cn_text: 大法官们希望加强与国会的协调。

2013013194.en_text: The Administration is dominant over immigration issues.
2013013194.cn_text: 政府在移民问题上占主导地位。

2013013196.en_text: As of 2005, there were almost half a million professional social scientists from all fields in the world, working both inside and outside academia.
2013013196.cn_text: 截至2005年，全球各领域的专业社会科学家人数接近50万，他们既在学术界内工作，也在学术界外工作。

2013013197.en_text: According to the World Social Science Report 2010, the number of socialscience students worldwide has swollen by about 11% every year since 2000.
2013013197.cn_text: 根据《2010年世界社会科学报告》，自2000年以来，全球社会科学专业学生人数每年增长约11%。

2013013198.en_text: Yet this enormous resource is not contributing enough to today’s global challenges, including climate change, security, sustainable development and health.
2013013198.cn_text: 然而，这一庞大的资源对当今全球性挑战的贡献不足，包括气候变化、安全、可持续发展和健康等问题。

2013013200.en_text: Humanity has the necessary agro-technological tools to eradicate hunger, from genetically engineered crops to artificial fertilizers.
2013013200.cn_text: 人类拥有必要的农业技术工具来消除饥饿，从转基因作物到人工肥料。

2013013201.en_text: Here, too, the problems are social: the organization and distribution of food, wealth and prosperity.
2013013201.cn_text: 在这里，问题同样是社会性的：食物、财富和繁荣的组织与分配。

2013013203.en_text: This is a shame — the community should be grasping the opportunity to raise its influence in the real world.
2013013203.cn_text: 这令人遗憾——该群体本应抓住机会提升其在现实世界中的影响力。

2013013204.en_text: To paraphrase the great social scientist Joseph Schumpeter: there is no radical innovation without creative destruction.
2013013204.cn_text: 套用伟大的社会科学家约瑟夫·熊彼特的话：没有创造性破坏，就没有根本性创新。

2013013205.en_text: Today, the social sciences are largely focused on disciplinary problems and internal scholarly debates, rather than on topics with external impact.
2013013205.cn_text: 如今，社会科学主要聚焦于学科问题和内部学术争论，而非具有外部影响的议题。

2013013206.en_text: Analyses reveal that the number of papers including the keywords “environmental change” or “climate change” has increased rapidly since 2004.
2013013206.cn_text: 分析显示，自2004年以来，包含「环境变化」或「气候变化」关键词的论文数量迅速增加。

2013013208.en_text: When social scientists do tackle practical issues, their scope is often local: Belgium is interested mainly in the effects of poverty on Belgium, for example.
2013013208.cn_text: 当社会科学家确实处理实际问题时，其研究范围往往是局部的：例如，比利时主要关注贫困对比利时的影响。

2013013209.en_text: And whether the community’s work contributes much to an overall accumulation of knowledge is doubtful.
2013013209.cn_text: 而该群体的工作是否对知识的整体积累有多大贡献，尚存疑问。

2013013210.en_text: The problem is not necessarily the amount of available funding.
2013013210.cn_text: 问题不一定在于可用资金的数量。

2013013212.en_text: This is an adequate amount so long as it is aimed in the right direction.
2013013212.cn_text: 只要方向正确，这一数额便已足够。

2013013213.en_text: Social scientists who complain about a lack of funding should not expect more in today’s economic climate.
2013013213.cn_text: 抱怨资金不足的社会科学家不应在当前的经济环境下期待获得更多资助。

2013013214.en_text: The trick is to direct these funds better.
2013013214.cn_text: 关键在于更好地引导这些资金。

2013013215.en_text: The European Union Framework funding programs have long had a category specifically targeted at social scientists.
2013013215.cn_text: 欧盟框架资助计划长期以来一直设有专门针对社会科学家的类别。

2013013216.en_text: This year, it was proposed that the system be changed: Horizon 2020, a new program to be enacted in 2014, would not have such a category.
2013013216.cn_text: 今年，有人提议改变这一体系：将于2014年实施的新计划「地平线2020」将不再设有此类别。

2013013217.en_text: This has resulted in protests from social scientists.
2013013217.cn_text: 这引发了社会科学家的抗议。

2013013218.en_text: But the intention is not to neglect social science; rather, the complete opposite.
2013013218.cn_text: 但其意图并非忽视社会科学；恰恰相反。

2013013220.en_text: That should create more collaborative endeavors and help to develop projects aimed directly at solving global problems.
2013013220.cn_text: 这应该能创造更多合作机会，并有助于开发直接解决全球性问题的项目。

2013013221.en_text: It could be that we are evolving two communities of social scientists: one that is discipline-oriented and publishing in highly specialized journals, and one that is problem-oriented and publishing elsewhere, such as policy briefs.
2013013221.cn_text: 可能我们正在演化出两类社会科学家群体：一类以学科为导向，在高度专业化的期刊上发表文章；另一类以问题为导向，在其他渠道发表文章，如政策简报。

2013013222.en_text: However, the numbers are still small: in 2010, about 1,600 of the 100,000 social- sciences papers published globally included one of these keywords.
2013013222.cn_text: 然而，数量仍然很少：2010年，全球发表的10万篇社会科学论文中，约有1600篇包含这些关键词之一。

2013013223.en_text: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio- economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
2013013223.cn_text: 其理念是促使社会科学家将其工作与其他领域整合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源，以及包容、创新和安全的社会。

2013013224.en_text: The solution is to change the mindset of the academic community, and what it considers to be its main goal.
2013013224.cn_text: 解决方案是改变学术界的思维模式，以及它对自身主要目标的认知。

2013013225.en_text: Global challenges and social innovation ought to receive much more attention from scientists, especially the young ones.
2013013225.cn_text: 全球性挑战和社会创新应该受到科学家，尤其是年轻科学家的更多关注。

2013013226.en_text: These issues all have root causes in human behavior: all require behavioral change and social innovations, as well as technological development.
2013013226.cn_text: 这些问题都根植于人类行为：所有问题都需要行为改变和社会创新，以及技术发展。

2013013227.en_text: Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
2013013227.cn_text: 例如，遏制气候变化既涉及改变消费模式和促进税收认可，也涉及开发清洁能源。

2013013228.en_text: Despite these factors, many social scientists seem reluctant to tackle such problems.
2013013228.cn_text: 尽管存在这些因素，许多社会科学家似乎仍不愿解决此类问题。

2013013229.en_text: And in Europe, some are up in arms over a proposal to drop a specific funding category for social-science research and to integrate it within cross-cutting topics of sustainable development.
2013013229.cn_text: 在欧洲，一些人对一项提议强烈反对，该提议建议取消社会科学研究的专项资助类别，并将其整合到可持续发展的跨学科议题中。

2013013230.en_text: During the late 1990s, national spending on social sciences and the humanities as a percentage of all research and development funds — including government, higher education, non-profit and corporate — varied from around 4% to 25%; in most European nations, it is about 15%.
2013013230.cn_text: 20世纪90年代末，社会科学和人文学科的国家支出占全部研究与开发资金（包括政府、高等教育、非营利和企业）的比例从约4%到25%不等；在大多数欧洲国家，这一比例约为15%。

2013013236.en_text: It is speculated that gardens arise from a basic human need in the individuals who made them: the need for creative expression.
2013013236.cn_text: 有人推测，花园源于创造者的一种基本人类需求：对创造性表达的需求。

2013013237.en_text: There is no doubt that the gardens evidence an irrepressible urge to create, express, fashion, and beautify and that self-expression is a basic human urge; yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression.
2013013237.cn_text: 毫无疑问，这些花园证明了一种不可抑制的创造、表达、塑造和美化的冲动，而自我表达正是一种基本的人类冲动；然而，当人们审视无家可归者所造花园的照片时，会注意到，尽管这些花园风格各异，它们却诉说着超越装饰和创造性表达之外的其他各种根本需求。

2013013238.en_text: One of these urges has to do with creating a state of peace in the midst of turbulence, a “still point of the turning world,” to borrow a phrase from T. S. Eliot.
2013013238.cn_text: 这些需求之一与在动荡中创造一种平静状态有关，借用T.S.艾略特的话说，即「旋转世界中的静止点」。

2013013239.en_text: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need.
2013013239.cn_text: 一个神圣的和平之所，无论多么简陋，都是一种明显的人类需求，与之相对的是庇护所，后者则是明显的动物需求。

2013013240.en_text: This distinction is so much so that where the latter is lacking, as it is for these unlikely gardeners, the former becomes all the more urgent.
2013013240.cn_text: 这种区别是如此显著，以至于当后者缺失时——正如这些不太可能成为园丁的人所面临的情况——前者变得愈发紧迫。

2013013241.en_text: Composure is a state of mind made possible by the structuring of one’s relation to one’s environment.
2013013241.cn_text: 平静是一种通过构建个人与环境的关系而得以实现的心理状态。

2013013242.en_text: The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environment where it either didn’t exist or was not discernible as such.
2013013242.cn_text: 无家可归者的花园——实际上是无家的花园——在城市环境中引入了形式，而这种形式要么原本不存在，要么无法被如此辨识。

2013013243.en_text: In so doing they give composure to a segment of the inarticulate environment in which they take their stand.
2013013243.cn_text: 通过这样做，它们为自己所立足的那部分混沌环境带来了平静。

2013013244.en_text: Another urge or need that these gardens appear to respond to, or to arise from, is so intrinsic that we are barely ever conscious of its abiding claims on us.
2013013244.cn_text: 这些花园似乎回应或源于的另一种冲动或需求是如此内在，以至于我们几乎从未意识到它对我们持续的要求。

2013013245.en_text: When we are deprived of green, of plants, of trees, most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic.
2013013245.cn_text: 当我们被剥夺绿色、植物和树木时,我们大多数人会陷入精神上的沮丧，并通常将其归咎于某种心理状况，直到有一天我们身处花园中，感到压抑如魔法般消散。

2013013246.en_text: In most of the homeless gardens of New York City the actual cultivation of plants is unfeasible, yet even so the compositions often seem to represent attempts to call forth the spirit of plant and animal life, if only symbolically, through a clumplike arrangement of materials, an introduction of colors, small pools of water, and a frequent presence of petals or leaves as well as of stuffed animals.
2013013246.cn_text: 在纽约市的大多数无家可归者花园中，实际栽培植物并不可行，但即便如此，这些布置似乎往往试图通过材料的簇状排列、色彩的引入、小水池，以及花瓣或树叶和毛绒动物的频繁出现，来象征性地唤起植物和动物生命的精神。

2013013247.en_text: On display here are various fantasy elements whose reference, at some basic level, seems to be the natural world.
2013013247.cn_text: 这里展示的各种幻想元素，在某种基本层面上，其指向似乎是自然世界。

2013013248.en_text: It is this implicit or explicit reference to nature that fully justifies the use of the word garden, though in a “liberated” sense, to describe these synthetic constructions.
2013013248.cn_text: 正是这种对自然的隐性或显性指涉，充分证明了用「花园」一词——尽管是在「解放的」意义上——来描述这些人工构造物的合理性。

2013013249.en_text: In them we can see biophilia — a yearning for contact with nonhuman life — assuming uncanny representational forms.
2013013249.cn_text: 在其中我们可以看到生命亲和性——一种与非人类生命接触的渴望——呈现出不可思议的表征形式。

2014013001.en_text: As many people hit middle age, they often start to notice that their memory and mental clarity are not what they used to be.
2014013001.cn_text: 当许多人步入中年时，他们往往开始注意到自己的记忆力和思维清晰度已大不如前。

2014013002.en_text: We suddenly can’t remember where we put the keys just a moment ago, or an old acquaintance’s name, or the name of an old band we used to love.
2014013002.cn_text: 我们会突然想不起刚才把钥匙放在哪里，或是一位老熟人的名字，抑或是我们曾经喜爱的某个老乐队的名字。

2014013003.en_text: As the brain fades, we refer to these occurrences as “senior moments.” While seemingly innocent, this loss of mental focus can potentially have a(n) damaging impact on our professional, social, and personal wellbeing.
2014013003.cn_text: 随着大脑功能衰退，我们将这些现象称为「老年时刻」。这种心智专注力的丧失看似无害，实则可能对我们的职业、社交和个人福祉造成破坏性影响。

2014013004.en_text: Neuroscientists, experts who study the nervous system, are increasingly showing that there’s actually a lot that can be done.
2014013004.cn_text: 研究神经系统的专家——神经科学家们，正越来越多地证明实际上有许多应对之策。

2014013005.en_text: It turns out that the brain needs exercise in much the same way our muscles do, and the right mental workouts can significantly improve our basic cognitive functions.
2014013005.cn_text: 事实证明，大脑同肌肉一样需要锻炼，而恰当的心智训练能够显著改善我们的基本认知功能。

2014013006.en_text: Thinking is essentially a process of making connections in the brain.
2014013006.cn_text: 思维本质上是一个在大脑中建立联结的过程。

2014013007.en_text: To a certain extent, our ability to excel in making the connections that drive intelligence is inherited.
2014013007.cn_text: 在某种程度上，我们在建立驱动智力的联结方面的卓越能力是由遗传决定的。

2014013008.en_text: However, because these connections are made through effort and practice, scientists believe that intelligence can expand and fluctuate according to mental effort.
2014013008.cn_text: 然而，由于这些联结是通过努力和练习建立的，科学家认为智力能够随着心智投入而扩展和波动。

2014013009.en_text: Now, a new Web-based company has taken it a step further and developed the first “brain training program” designed to actually help people improve and regain their mental sharpness.
2014013009.cn_text: 如今，一家新兴的互联网公司将此理念推进了一步，开发出首个旨在切实帮助人们提升和恢复思维敏锐度的「大脑训练项目」。

2014013010.en_text: The Web-based program allows you to systematically improve your memory and attention skills.
2014013010.cn_text: 该网络程序能够让你系统性地提升记忆力和注意力技能。

2014013011.en_text: The program keeps track of your progress and provides detailed feedback on your performance and improvement.
2014013011.cn_text: 该程序会追踪你的进展情况，并就你的表现和提升提供详细反馈。

2014013012.en_text: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing — much like a(n) effective exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.
2014013012.cn_text: 最重要的是,它会持续调整和强化你所进行的游戏训练,以你正在培养的优势为基础——正如一套有效的锻炼计划要求你增加阻力并变换肌肉使用方式。

2014013013.en_text: In order to “change lives for the better” and reduce “dependency”, George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the “upfront work search” scheme.
2014013013.cn_text: 为了「改善生活」并减少「依赖」，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本推出了「预先求职」计划。

2014013014.en_text: Only if the jobless arrive at the jobcentre with a CV, register for online job search, and start looking for work will they be eligible for benefit — and then they should report weekly rather than fortnightly.
2014013014.cn_text: 只有失业者携带简历来到就业中心、注册在线求职并开始寻找工作，才有资格领取福利——而且应每周报告而非每两周报告。

2014013015.cn_text: 还有什么能比这更合理呢？

2014013016.cn_text: 更多表面上的合理性紧随其后。

2014013017.en_text: There will now be a seven-day wait for the jobseeker’s allowance.
2014013017.cn_text: 现在领取求职者津贴需要等待七天。

2014013018.en_text: “Those first few days should be spent looking for work, not looking to sign on,” he claimed.
2014013018.cn_text: 「最初的几天应该用来找工作，而不是去登记领取福利，」他声称。

2014013019.en_text: “We’re doing these things because we know they help people stay off benefits and help those on benefits get into work faster.” Help?
2014013019.cn_text: 「我们做这些事情是因为我们知道它们能帮助人们避免依赖福利，并帮助那些领取福利的人更快找到工作。」帮助？

2014013021.en_text: On first hearing, this was the socially concerned chancellor, trying to change lives for the better, complete with “reforms” to an obviously indulgent system that demands too little effort from the newly unemployed to find work, and subsidises laziness.
2014013021.cn_text: 初听之下，这是一位关心社会的财政大臣，试图通过「改革」一个明显过于宽松的制度来改善生活，该制度对新失业者找工作的要求太低，并且补贴懒惰。

2014013022.en_text: What motivated him, we were to understand, was his zeal for “fundamental fairness” — protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending and ensuring that only the most deserving claimants received their benefits.
2014013022.cn_text: 我们应当理解，驱动他的是对「根本公平」的热情——保护纳税人、控制支出、确保只有最值得的申请者才能获得福利。

2014013023.en_text: Losing a job is hurting: you don’t skip down to the jobcentre with a song in your heart, delighted at the prospect of doubling your income from the generous state.
2014013023.cn_text: 失业是痛苦的：你不会心里哼着歌蹦蹦跳跳地去就业中心，兴高采烈地期待通过慷慨的国家让收入翻倍。

2014013024.en_text: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get.
2014013024.cn_text: 这在经济上令人恐惧，在心理上令人难堪，而且你知道支持微乎其微且极其难以获得。

2014013025.en_text: You are now not wanted; you are now excluded from the work environment that offers purpose and structure in your life.
2014013025.cn_text: 你现在不被需要了；你现在被排除在为你的生活提供目标和结构的工作环境之外。

2014013026.en_text: Worse, the crucial income to feed yourself and your family and pay the bills has disappeared.
2014013026.cn_text: 更糟的是，用来养活自己和家人并支付账单的关键收入已经消失。

2014013027.en_text: Ask anyone newly unemployed what they want and the answer is always: a job.
2014013027.cn_text: 问任何一个刚失业的人他们想要什么，答案总是：一份工作。

2014013028.en_text: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency — permanent dependency if you can get it — supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood.
2014013028.cn_text: 但在奥斯本的世界里，你的第一反应是陷入依赖——如果可能的话，永久依赖——而国家非常乐意纵容你的虚假。

2014013029.en_text: It is as though 20 years of ever-tougher reforms of the job search and benefit administration system never happened.
2014013029.cn_text: 就好像过去20年对求职和福利管理系统日益严格的改革从未发生过一样。

2014013030.en_text: The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens.
2014013030.cn_text: 英国福利的原则不再是你可以为失业风险投保，并在灾难发生时获得无条件的支付。

2014013031.en_text: Even the very phrase “jobseeker’s allowance” is about redefining the unemployed as a “jobseeker” who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
2014013031.cn_text: 甚至「求职者津贴」这个短语本身就在重新定义失业者为「求职者」，他们没有通过缴纳国民保险而获得福利的基本权利。

2014013032.en_text: Instead, the claimant receives a time-limited “allowance”, conditional on actively seeking a job; no entitlement and no insurance, at £71.70 a week, one of the least generous in the EU.
2014013032.cn_text: 相反，申请者获得的是有时限的「津贴」，条件是积极寻找工作；没有权利，也没有保险，每周71.70英镑，是欧盟中最不慷慨的之一。

2014013033.en_text: George Osborne’s scheme was intended to ____
2014013033.cn_text: 乔治·奥斯本的计划旨在____

2014013034.en_text: provide the unemployed with easier access to benefits.
2014013034.cn_text: 为失业者提供更便捷的福利获取途径。

2014013035.en_text: encourage jobseekers’ active engagement in job seeking.
2014013035.cn_text: 鼓励求职者积极参与求职。

2014013036.en_text: motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily.

2014013037.en_text: guarantee jobseekers’ legitimate right to benefits.
2014013037.cn_text: 保障求职者获得福利的合法权利。

2014013038.en_text: The phrase “to sign on” (Para. 2) most probably means ____
2014013038.cn_text: 短语「to sign on」（第2段）最可能的意思是____

2014013039.en_text: to check on the availability of jobs at the jobcentre.
2014013039.cn_text: 在就业中心查看可获得的工作机会。

2014013040.en_text: to accept the government’s restrictions on the allowance.
2014013040.cn_text: 接受政府对津贴的限制。

2014013041.en_text: to register for an allowance from the government.

2014013042.en_text: to attend a governmental job-training program.
2014013042.cn_text: 参加政府的就业培训项目。

2014013043.en_text: What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme?
2014013043.cn_text: 是什么促使财政大臣制定他的计划？

2014013044.en_text: A desire to secure a better life for all.
2014013044.cn_text: 为所有人争取更好生活的愿望。

2014013045.en_text: An eagerness to protect the unemployed.
2014013045.cn_text: 保护失业者的热切愿望。

2014013046.en_text: An urge to be generous to the claimants.
2014013046.cn_text: 对申请者慷慨相待的冲动。

2014013047.en_text: A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers.
2014013047.cn_text: 确保纳税人公平的热情。

2014013048.en_text: According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ____

2014013053.en_text: To which of the following would the author most probably agree?
2014013053.cn_text: 作者最可能同意以下哪项？

2014013054.en_text: The British welfare system indulges jobseekers’ laziness.
2014013054.cn_text: 英国福利制度纵容求职者的懒惰。

2014013055.en_text: Osborne’s reforms will reduce the risk of unemployment.
2014013055.cn_text: 奥斯本的改革将降低失业风险。

2014013056.en_text: The jobseekers’ allowance has met their actual needs.
2014013056.cn_text: 求职者津贴满足了他们的实际需求。

2014013057.en_text: Unemployment benefits should not be made conditional.
2014013057.cn_text: 失业救济金不应附加条件。

2014013058.en_text: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession — with the possible exception of journalism.
2014013058.cn_text: 在世界各地，律师比其他任何职业的从业者都更容易招致敌意——新闻业或许是唯一的例外。

2014013059.en_text: But there are few places where clients have more grounds for complaint than America.
2014013059.cn_text: 但几乎没有哪个地方的客户比美国的客户更有理由抱怨。

2014013060.en_text: During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation.
2014013060.cn_text: 在经济危机前的十年里，美国用于法律服务的支出增速是通货膨胀率的两倍。

2014013061.en_text: The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools.
2014013061.cn_text: 顶尖律师赚得盆满钵满，吸引越来越多的学生涌入法学院。

2014013062.en_text: But most law graduates never get a big-firm job.
2014013062.cn_text: 但大多数法学院毕业生从未能进入大律所工作。

2014013063.en_text: Many of them instead become the kind of nuisance-lawsuit filer that makes the tort system a costly nightmare.
2014013063.cn_text: 他们中的许多人反而成了那种提起无理诉讼的麻烦制造者，使侵权制度成为代价高昂的噩梦。

2014013064.en_text: There are many reasons for this.
2014013064.cn_text: 造成这种情况的原因有很多。

2014013065.en_text: One is the excessive costs of a legal education.
2014013065.cn_text: 原因之一是法律教育的成本过高。

2014013066.en_text: There is just one path for a lawyer in most American states: a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject, then a three-year law degree at one of 200 law schools authorized by the American Bar Association and an expensive preparation for the bar exam.
2014013066.cn_text: 在美国大多数州，成为律师只有一条路径：先获得某个非相关专业为期四年的本科学位，再在美国律师协会认证的200所法学院之一取得为期三年的法律学位，然后进行费用高昂的律师资格考试备考。

2014013067.en_text: This leaves today’s average law-school graduate with $100,000 of debt on top of undergraduate debts.
2014013067.cn_text: 这使得如今的普通法学院毕业生在本科债务之外还背负着10万美元的债务。

2014013068.en_text: Lawschool debt means that they have to work fearsomely hard.
2014013068.cn_text: 法学院债务意味着他们必须拼命工作。

2014013069.en_text: Reforming the system would help both lawyers and their customers.
2014013069.cn_text: 改革这一体系既有利于律师，也有利于他们的客户。

2014013070.en_text: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
2014013070.cn_text: 合理的改革思路早已存在，但管理该行业的州级机构过于保守，未能将其付诸实施。

2014013071.en_text: One idea is to allow people to study law as an undergraduate degree.
2014013071.cn_text: 其中一个思路是允许人们在本科阶段学习法律。

2014013072.en_text: Another is to let students sit for the bar after only two years of law school.
2014013072.cn_text: 另一个思路是允许学生在法学院学习两年后就参加律师资格考试。

2014013073.en_text: If the bar exam is truly a stern enough test for a would-be lawyer, those who can sit it earlier should be allowed to do so.
2014013073.cn_text: 如果律师资格考试确实是对准律师足够严格的测试，那么应该允许能够提前参加考试的人这样做。

2014013074.en_text: Students who do not need the extra training could cut their debt mountain by a third.
2014013074.cn_text: 不需要额外培训的学生可以将债务负担减少三分之一。

2014013075.en_text: The other reason why costs are so high is the restrictive guild-like ownership structure of the business.
2014013075.cn_text: 成本居高不下的另一个原因是该行业限制性的行会式所有权结构。

2014013076.en_text: Except in the District of Columbia, non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm.
2014013076.cn_text: 除哥伦比亚特区外，非律师不得持有律师事务所的任何股份。

2014013077.en_text: This keeps fees high and innovation slow.
2014013077.cn_text: 这导致收费居高不下，创新步伐缓慢。

2014013078.en_text: There is pressure for change from within the profession, but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
2014013078.cn_text: 法律界内部存在变革的压力，但监管机构中的变革反对者坚称，将外部人士排除在律师事务所之外，可以使律师免受赚钱压力的影响，从而更符合职业伦理地服务客户。

2014013079.en_text: In fact, allowing non-lawyers to own shares in law firms would reduce costs and improve services to customers, by encouraging law firms to use technology and to employ professional managers to focus on improving firms’ efficiency.
2014013079.cn_text: 事实上，允许非律师持有律师事务所股份将降低成本并改善客户服务，因为这会鼓励律师事务所使用技术并聘用专业管理人员，专注于提高事务所效率。

2014013080.en_text: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions.
2014013080.cn_text: 毕竟，澳大利亚和英国等其他国家已经开始推动其法律行业自由化。

2014013107.en_text: The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year’s award in March.
2014013107.cn_text: 正如亚历山大·波利亚科夫在今年三月接受这一奖项时所说，这项奖金为300万美元的基础物理学奖的确是一个有趣的实验。

2014013108.en_text: And it is far from the only one of its type.
2014013108.cn_text: 而且它远非此类奖项中的唯一一个。

2014013109.en_text: As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years.
2014013109.cn_text: 正如《自然》杂志一篇新闻特写文章所讨论的，近年来一系列面向研究人员的丰厚奖项已加入诺贝尔奖的行列。

2014013110.en_text: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.
2014013110.cn_text: 许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，都由互联网企业家以其天文数字般的银行账户提供资助。

2014013111.en_text: These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.
2014013111.cn_text: 这些捐助者表示，他们在各自选择的领域已获得成功，希望用自己的财富将人们的注意力引向那些在科学领域取得成功的人。

2014013113.en_text: Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature.
2014013113.cn_text: 据新闻特写中引述的几位科学家所说，问题相当多。

2014013114.en_text: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.
2014013114.cn_text: 正如古语所云，品位无法用金钱购买，而这些新贵企业家也无法为其奖项买到诺贝尔奖的声望。

2014013115.en_text: The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists.
2014013115.cn_text: 科学家们认为，这些新奖项是幕后人士进行自我宣传的手段。

2014013116.en_text: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.
2014013116.cn_text: 它们可能扭曲以成就为基础、由同行评审主导的研究体系。

2014013117.en_text: They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research.
2014013117.cn_text: 它们可能固化同行评审研究的现状。

2014013118.en_text: They do not fund peer-reviewed research.
2014013118.cn_text: 它们不为同行评审研究提供资助。

2014013119.en_text: They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.
2014013119.cn_text: 它们使孤独天才的神话长久延续。

2014013120.en_text: The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism.
2014013120.cn_text: 颁奖者的目标似乎与批评声一样分散。

2014013121.en_text: Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.
2014013121.cn_text: 有人想要制造轰动效应，有人则想吸引人们投身科学，或更好地奖励那些以研究为职业的人。

2014013122.en_text: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes — both new and old — are distributed.
2014013122.cn_text: 正如《自然》此前所指出的，对于科学奖项——无论新旧——的分配方式，存在一些合理的担忧。

2014013123.en_text: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.
2014013123.cn_text: 今年设立的生命科学突破奖对生命科学范畴的界定缺乏代表性。

2014013124.en_text: But the Nobel Foundation’s limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research — as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
2014013124.cn_text: 但诺贝尔基金会每项奖励最多三位获奖者且必须在世的限制，早已不能适应现代研究的协作性质——这一点将在关于谁在希格斯玻色子发现的认定中被忽略的不可避免的争论中得到体现。

2014013125.en_text: The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money.
2014013125.cn_text: 当然，诺贝尔奖本身也是由一位极为富有的个人设立的，由他决定如何使用自己的资金。

2014013126.en_text: Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.
2014013126.cn_text: 是时间而非意图赋予了诺贝尔奖合法性。

2014013127.en_text: As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear.
2014013127.cn_text: 尽管一些科学家可能对这些新奖项颇有微词，但有两点似乎是明确的。

2014013128.en_text: First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one.
2014013128.cn_text: 首先，大多数研究人员若被授予此类奖项，都会接受。

2014013129.en_text: Second, it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere.
2014013129.cn_text: 其次，资金和关注流向科学而非其他领域，这无疑是一件好事。

2014013130.en_text: It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism — that is the culture of research, after all — but it is the prize-givers’ money to do with as they please.
2014013130.cn_text: 批评和质疑这种机制是合理的——毕竟这是研究文化的一部分——但这笔资金归颁奖者所有，他们有权随意支配。

2014013131.en_text: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
2014013131.cn_text: 明智之举是怀着感激和优雅接受这样的馈赠。

2014013133.en_text: a symbol of the entrepreneurs’ wealth.

2014013134.en_text: a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes.
2014013134.cn_text: 诺贝尔奖的可能替代者。

2014013135.cn_text: 银行家投资的一个范例。

2014013136.cn_text: 对研究人员的丰厚回报。

2014013138.cn_text: 以利益为导向的科学家。

2014013139.en_text: the founders of the new awards.

2014013141.cn_text: 由同行评审主导的研究。

2014013142.en_text: The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ____
2014013142.cn_text: 希格斯玻色子的发现是一个典型案例，它涉及____

2014013143.cn_text: 关于获奖者资格的争议。

2014013144.en_text: the joint effort of modern researchers.
2014013144.cn_text: 现代研究人员的共同努力。

2014013145.en_text: legitimate concerns over the new prizes.

2014013147.en_text: According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?
2014013147.cn_text: 根据第4段，关于诺贝尔奖，下列哪项表述正确？

2014013148.en_text: Their endurance has done justice to them.
2014013148.cn_text: 它们的持久性证明了其价值。

2014013149.en_text: Their legitimacy has long been in dispute.
2014013149.cn_text: 它们的合法性长期以来一直受到质疑。

2014013150.en_text: They are the most representative honor.
2014013150.cn_text: 它们是最具代表性的荣誉。

2014013151.en_text: History has never cast doubt on them.
2014013151.cn_text: 历史从未对它们提出质疑。

2014013152.en_text: The author believes that the new awards are ____

2014013153.cn_text: 尽管遭受批评，但仍可接受。

2014013154.en_text: harmful to the culture of research.

2014013157.en_text: “The Heart of the Matter,” the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
2014013157.cn_text: 美国艺术与科学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》，因肯定了人文学科和社会科学对美国自由民主之繁荣与安全的重要性而值得赞扬。

2014013158.en_text: Regrettably, however, the report’s failure to address the true nature of the crisis facing liberal education may cause more harm than good.
2014013158.cn_text: 然而遗憾的是，该报告未能触及自由教育所面临危机的真正本质，这可能弊大于利。

2014013159.en_text: In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by “federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations, educators, individual benefactors and others” to “maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education.” In response, the American Academy formed the Commission on the Humanities and Social Sciences.
2014013159.cn_text: 2010年，国会主要民主党和共和党议员致信美国艺术与科学院，要求其明确「联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基金会、教育工作者、个人捐助者及其他机构」可以采取的行动，以「维持人文学科和社会科学学术研究与教育的国家卓越水平」。作为回应，美国艺术与科学院成立了人文与社会科学委员会。

2014013160.en_text: Among the commission’s 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars, lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.
2014013160.cn_text: 该委员会的51名成员包括顶尖大学校长、学者、律师、法官和企业高管，以及来自外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻界的杰出人物。

2014013161.en_text: The goals identified in the report are generally admirable.
2014013161.cn_text: 报告中确立的目标总体而言值得赞赏。

2014013162.en_text: Because representative government presupposes an informed citizenry, the report supports full literacy; stresses the study of history and government, particularly American history and American government; and encourages the use of new digital technologies.
2014013162.cn_text: 由于代议制政府以知情公民为前提，报告支持全面提升读写能力；强调历史和政府研究，尤其是美国历史和美国政府研究；并鼓励运用新的数字技术。

2014013163.en_text: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students’ ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
2014013163.cn_text: 为鼓励创新和竞争，报告呼吁加大对研究的投资，制定连贯的课程以提升学生在21世纪解决问题和有效沟通的能力，增加对教师的资助，并鼓励学者将其学识用于应对当代重大挑战。

2014013164.en_text: The report also advocates greater study of foreign languages, international affairs and the expansion of study abroad programs.
2014013164.cn_text: 报告还倡导加强外语、国际事务的学习，并扩大海外留学项目。

2014013165.en_text: Unfortunately, despite 2½ years in the making, “The Heart of the Matter” never gets to the heart of the matter: the illiberal nature of liberal education at our leading colleges and universities.
2014013165.cn_text: 不幸的是，尽管历时两年半完成，《问题的核心》却始终未能触及问题的核心：我国顶尖高校自由教育的不自由本质。

2014013166.en_text: The commission ignores that for several decades America’s colleges and universities have produced graduates who don’t know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
2014013166.cn_text: 委员会忽视了这一事实：数十年来，美国高校培养的毕业生不了解自由教育的内容和特征，因而无法享有其益处。

2014013167.en_text: Sadly, the spirit of inquiry once at home on campus has been replaced by the use of the humanities and social sciences as vehicles for publicizing “progressive,” or left-liberal propaganda.
2014013167.cn_text: 令人遗憾的是，曾经扎根于校园的探究精神，已被人文学科和社会科学沦为宣扬「进步」或左翼自由主义宣传工具的现状所取代。

2014013168.en_text: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas — such as free markets and self-reliance — as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
2014013168.cn_text: 如今，教授们习惯性地将历史和公共政策的进步主义解读视为正当的研究对象，同时将保守或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自力更生——描绘为超出常规甚至合法学术研究范畴的内容。

2014013169.en_text: The AAAS displays great enthusiasm for liberal education.
2014013169.cn_text: 美国艺术与科学院对自由教育表现出极大的热情。

2014013170.en_text: Yet its report may well set back reform by obscuring the depth and breadth of the challenge that Congress asked it to illuminate.
2014013170.cn_text: 然而，其报告很可能因掩盖了国会要求其阐明的挑战之深度与广度，而阻碍改革进程。

2014013171.en_text: According to Paragraph 1, what is the author’s attitude toward the AAAS’s report?
2014013171.cn_text: 根据第1段，作者对美国艺术与科学院报告持何种态度？

2014013176.en_text: Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ____
2014013176.cn_text: 国会有影响力的人物要求美国艺术与科学院就如何____提交报告。

2014013177.en_text: retain people’s interest in liberal education.
2014013177.cn_text: 保持人们对自由教育的兴趣。

2014013178.en_text: define the government’s role in education.
2014013178.cn_text: 界定政府在教育中的角色。

2014013179.en_text: keep a leading position in liberal education.
2014013179.cn_text: 保持在自由教育中的领先地位。

2014013182.en_text: an exclusive study of American history.
2014013182.cn_text: 对美国历史进行专门研究。

2014013183.en_text: a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.

2014013185.en_text: funding for the study of foreign languages.

2014013186.cn_text: 作者在第5段暗示教授们____。
