2014013191.en_text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
2014013191.cn_text: 以下哪项是本文的最佳标题？

2014013192.en_text: Ways to Grasp “The Heart of the Matter”.

2014013193.en_text: Illiberal Education and “The Heart of the Matter”.
2014013193.cn_text: 不自由的教育与「问题核心」。

2014013194.en_text: The AAAS’s Contribution to Liberal Education.
2014013194.cn_text: 美国艺术与科学院对自由教育的贡献。

2014013196.en_text: Some archaeological sites have always been easily observable — for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England.
2014013196.cn_text: 有些考古遗址历来都很容易观察到，例如希腊雅典的帕特农神庙、埃及吉萨的金字塔群以及英格兰南部的巨石阵。

2014013197.en_text: But these sites are exceptions to the norm.
2014013197.cn_text: 但这些遗址只是例外情况。

2014013198.en_text: Most archaeological sites have been located by means of careful searching, while many others have been discovered by accident.
2014013198.cn_text: 大多数考古遗址是通过细致搜寻而定位的,而许多其他遗址则是偶然发现的。

2014013199.en_text: Olduvai Gorge, an early hominid site in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911.Thousands of Aztec artifacts came to light during the digging of the Mexico City subway in the 1970s.
2014013199.cn_text: 坦桑尼亚的早期原始人类遗址奥杜威峡谷,是由一位蝴蝶采集者于1911年意外跌入其深谷时发现的。20世纪70年代墨西哥城地铁施工期间,成千上万件阿兹特克文物重见天日。

2014013200.en_text: In another case, American archaeologists René Million and George Cowgill spent years systematically mapping the entire city of Teotihuacan in the Valley of Mexico near what is now Mexico City.
2014013200.cn_text: 在另一个案例中,美国考古学家雷内·米利翁和乔治·考吉尔花费数年时间系统地绘制了位于墨西哥谷地、靠近现今墨西哥城的整座特奥蒂瓦坎古城的地图。

2014013201.en_text: At its peak around AD 600, this city was one of the largest human settlements in the world.
2014013201.cn_text: 在公元600年左右的鼎盛时期,这座城市是世界上最大的人类聚居地之一。

2014013202.en_text: The researchers mapped not only the city’s vast and ornate ceremonial areas, but also hundreds of simpler apartment complexes where common people lived.
2014013202.cn_text: 研究人员不仅绘制了该城广袤而华美的祭祀区域,还绘制了数百处普通民众居住的简朴公寓建筑群。

2014013203.en_text: How do archaeologists know where to find what they are looking for when there is nothing visible on the surface of the ground?
2014013203.cn_text: 当地表没有任何可见物时,考古学家如何知道要在哪里寻找他们的目标?

2014013204.en_text: Typically, they survey and sample (make test excavations on) large areas of terrain to determine where excavation will yield useful information.
2014013204.cn_text: 通常,他们会对大面积地形进行勘测和取样(进行试探性发掘),以确定在哪里挖掘能够获取有用信息。

2014013205.en_text: Surveys and test samples have also become important for understanding the larger landscapes that contain archaeological sites.
2014013205.cn_text: 勘测和试探性取样对于理解包含考古遗址的更广阔地貌环境也变得越来越重要。

2014013206.en_text: Surveys can cover a single large settlement or entire landscapes.
2014013206.cn_text: 勘测范围可以是单个大型聚落,也可以是整片地域景观。

2014013207.en_text: In one case, many researchers working around the ancient Maya city of Copán, Honduras, have located hundreds of small rural villages and individual dwellings by using aerial photographs and by making surveys on foot.
2014013207.cn_text: 在一个案例中,众多研究人员在洪都拉斯古玛雅城市科潘周边开展工作,通过使用航空照片和徒步勘测,定位了数百个小型乡村聚落和单独的住宅遗迹。

2014013208.en_text: The resulting settlement maps show how the distribution and density of the rural population around the city changed dramatically between AD 500 and 850, when Copán collapsed.
2014013208.cn_text: 由此绘制的聚落地图显示,在公元500年至850年科潘走向衰亡期间,该城周边乡村人口的分布和密度发生了显著变化。

2014013209.en_text: To find their sites, archaeologists today rely heavily on systematic survey methods and a variety of high-technology tools and techniques.
2014013209.cn_text: 为了找到遗址,当今的考古学家在很大程度上依赖系统的勘测方法以及各种高科技工具和技术。

2014013210.en_text: Airborne technologies, such as different types of radar and photographic equipment carried by airplanes or spacecraft, allow archaeologists to learn about what lies beneath the ground without digging.
2014013210.cn_text: 机载技术,如飞机或航天器搭载的各类雷达和摄影设备,使考古学家能够在不进行挖掘的情况下了解地下情况。

2014013211.en_text: Aerial surveys locate general areas of interest or larger buried features, such as ancient buildings or fields.
2014013211.cn_text: 航空勘测可定位一般性关注区域或较大型的埋藏遗迹,例如古代建筑或农田。

2014013212.en_text: Most archaeological sites, however, are discovered by archaeologists who have set out to look for them.
2014013212.cn_text: 然而,大多数考古遗址是由专门前往寻找它们的考古学家所发现的。

2014013213.cn_text: 这样的搜寻可能耗时数年。

2014013214.en_text: British archaeologist Howard Carter knew that the tomb of the Egyptian pharaoh Tutankhamun existed from information found in other sites.
2014013214.cn_text: 英国考古学家霍华德·卡特从其他遗址所获信息中得知埃及法老图坦卡蒙陵墓的存在。

2014013215.en_text: Carter sifted through rubble in the Valley of the Kings for seven years before he located the tomb in 1922.
2014013215.cn_text: 卡特在帝王谷的废墟中筛选了七年,最终于1922年找到了该陵墓。

2014013216.en_text: In the late 1800s British archaeologist Sir Arthur Evans combed antique dealers’ stores in Athens, Greece.
2014013216.cn_text: 19世纪末,英国考古学家阿瑟·埃文斯爵士在希腊雅典的古董商店中反复搜寻。

2014013217.en_text: He was searching for tiny engraved seals attributed to the ancient Mycenaean culture that dominated Greece from the 1400s to 1200s BC.
2014013217.cn_text: 他在寻找那些被认为属于古代迈锡尼文化的微型雕刻印章,该文化在公元前1400年至1200年间统治着希腊。

2014013218.en_text: Evans’s interpretations of these engravings eventually led him to find the Minoan palace at Knossos (Knosós), on the island of Crete, in 1900.
2014013218.cn_text: 埃文斯对这些雕刻的解读最终使他于1900年在克里特岛发现了克诺索斯的米诺斯王宫。

2014013219.en_text: Ground surveys allow archaeologists to pinpoint the places where digs will be successful.
2014013219.cn_text: 地面勘测使考古学家能够精确定位挖掘成功率高的地点。

2014013220.en_text: Most ground surveys involve a lot of walking, looking for surface clues such as small fragments of pottery.
2014013220.cn_text: 大多数地面勘测需要大量步行,寻找诸如陶器小碎片之类的地表线索。

2014013221.en_text: They often include a certain amount of digging to test for buried materials at selected points across a landscape.
2014013221.cn_text: 这些勘测通常还包括一定量的挖掘工作,以在地貌景观的选定点位检测埋藏物。

2014013222.en_text: Archaeologists also may locate buried remains by using such technologies as ground radar, magnetic-field recording, and metal detectors.
2014013222.cn_text: 考古学家还可以使用地面雷达、磁场记录仪和金属探测器等技术手段来定位埋藏的遗迹。

2014013223.en_text: Archaeologists commonly use computers to map sites and the landscapes around sites.
2014013223.cn_text: 考古学家通常使用计算机绘制遗址及其周边地貌景观的地图。

2014013224.en_text: Two- and three-dimensional maps are helpful tools in planning excavations, illustrating how sites look, and presenting the results of archaeological research.
2014013224.cn_text: 二维和三维地图是规划发掘工作、呈现遗址面貌以及展示考古研究成果的有用工具。

2014013230.en_text: Music means different things to different people and sometimes even different things to the same person at different moments of his life.
2014013230.cn_text: 音乐对不同的人意味着不同的东西，有时甚至对同一个人在其生命的不同时刻也意味着不同的东西。

2014013231.en_text: It might be poetic, philosophical, sensual, or mathematical, but in any case it must, in my view, have something to do with the soul of the human being.
2014013231.cn_text: 它可能是诗意的、哲学的、感性的或数学的,但无论如何,在我看来,它必须与人类的灵魂有某种关联。

2014013232.en_text: Hence it is metaphysical; but the means of expression is purely and exclusively physical: sound.
2014013232.cn_text: 因此它是形而上的;但其表达手段却是纯粹且完全物理的:声音。

2014013233.en_text: I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music.
2014013233.cn_text: 我相信,正是形而上信息通过物理手段传递的这种永久共存构成了音乐的力量所在。

2014013234.en_text: It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself.
2014013234.cn_text: 这也是为什么当我们试图用语言描述音乐时,我们所能做的只是阐述我们对它的反应,而无法把握音乐本身。

2014013235.en_text: Beethoven’s importance in music has been principally defined by the revolutionary nature of his compositions.
2014013235.cn_text: 贝多芬在音乐中的重要性主要体现在其作品的革命性特质。

2014013236.en_text: He freed music from hitherto prevailing conventions of harmony and structure.
2014013236.cn_text: 他将音乐从迄今为止盛行的和声与结构惯例中解放出来。

2014013237.en_text: Sometimes I feel in his late works a will to break all signs of continuity.
2014013237.cn_text: 有时我在他的晚期作品中感受到一种打破所有连续性迹象的意志。

2014013238.en_text: The music is abrupt and seemingly disconnected, as in the last piano sonata.
2014013238.cn_text: 音乐是突兀的,似乎是断裂的,如同最后一首钢琴奏鸣曲那样。

2014013239.en_text: In musical expression, he did not feel restrained by the weight of convention.
2014013239.cn_text: 在音乐表达上,他并未感到受传统重负的束缚。

2014013240.en_text: By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works.
2014013240.cn_text: 据各方说法,他是一个思想自由的人,也是一个勇敢的人,而我认为勇气是理解其作品的必要品质,更不用说演奏其作品了。

2014013241.en_text: This courageous attitude in fact becomes a requirement for the performers of Beethoven’s music.
2014013241.cn_text: 事实上,这种勇敢的态度成为了贝多芬音乐演奏者的必备条件。

2014013242.en_text: His compositions demand the performer to show courage, for example in the use of dynamics.
2014013242.cn_text: 他的作品要求演奏者表现出勇气,例如在力度运用方面。

2014013243.en_text: Beethoven’s habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him.
2014013243.cn_text: 贝多芬以极强的力度增大音量,然后突然转入柔和乐段的习惯,在他之前的作曲家中极少被采用。

2014013244.en_text: Beethoven was a deeply political man in the broadest sense of the word.
2014013244.cn_text: 从广义上说,贝多芬是一个深具政治性的人。

2014013245.en_text: He was not interested in daily politics, but concerned with questions of moral behavior and the larger questions of right and wrong affecting the entire society.
2014013245.cn_text: 他对日常政治不感兴趣,而是关注道德行为问题以及影响整个社会的是非大问题。

2014013246.en_text: Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression.
2014013246.cn_text: 尤为重要的是他对自由的看法,对他而言,自由与个人的权利和责任相关联:他主张思想自由和个人表达自由。

2014013247.en_text: Beethoven’s music tends to move from chaos to order as if order were an imperative of human existence.
2014013247.cn_text: 贝多芬的音乐倾向于从混乱走向秩序,仿佛秩序是人类存在的必然要求。

2014013248.en_text: For him, order does not result from forgetting or ignoring the disorders that plague our existence; order is a necessary development, an improvement that may lead to the Greek ideal of spiritual elevation.
2014013248.cn_text: 对他而言,秩序并非源于遗忘或忽视困扰我们生存的混乱;秩序是一种必要的发展,是一种可能通向希腊精神升华理想的改善。

2014013249.en_text: It is not by chance that the Funeral March is not the last movement of the Eroica Symphony, but the second, so that suffering does not have the last word.
2014013249.cn_text: 「英雄交响曲」的葬礼进行曲不是最后乐章而是第二乐章,这并非偶然,这样痛苦就不会成为最终结论。

2014013250.en_text: One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life worth living.
2014013250.cn_text: 人们可以这样解读贝多芬的许多作品:痛苦是不可避免的,但与之抗争的勇气使生活值得一过。

2015013001.en_text: Though not biologically related, friends are as “related” as fourth cousins, sharing about 1% of genes.
2015013001.cn_text: 尽管不存在生物学上的血缘关系，朋友之间的「相关性」相当于四代表亲，共享约1%的基因。

2015013002.en_text: That is what a study, published from the University of California and Yale University in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, has concluded.
2015013002.cn_text: 这是加州大学和耶鲁大学在《美国国家科学院院刊》上发表的一项研究得出的结论。

2015013003.en_text: The study is a genome-wide analysis conducted on 1,932 unique subjects which compared pairs of unrelated friends and unrelated strangers.
2015013003.cn_text: 该研究是一项针对1932名不同个体进行的全基因组分析,比较了非亲缘朋友配对与非亲缘陌生人配对。

2015013004.en_text: The same people were used in both samples.
2015013004.cn_text: 两组样本使用了相同的受试者。

2015013005.en_text: While 1% may seem insignificant, it is not so to a geneticist.
2015013005.cn_text: 虽然1%看似微不足道,但对遗传学家而言却并非如此。

2015013006.en_text: As James Fowler, professor of medical genetics at UC San Diego, says, “Most people do not even know their fourth cousins but somehow manage to select as friends the people who resemble our kin.”
2015013006.cn_text: 正如加州大学圣迭戈分校医学遗传学教授詹姆斯·福勒所言:「大多数人甚至不认识自己的四代表亲,却能以某种方式选择与我们亲属相似的人作为朋友。」

2015013007.en_text: The study also found that the genes for smell were something shared in friends but not genes for immunity.
2015013007.cn_text: 研究还发现,朋友之间共享嗅觉相关基因,而非免疫相关基因。

2015013008.en_text: Why this similarity exists in smell genes is difficult to explain, for now.
2015013008.cn_text: 嗅觉基因中为何存在这种相似性,目前尚难以解释。

2015013009.en_text: Perhaps, as the team suggests, it draws us to similar environments but there is more to it.
2015013009.cn_text: 也许正如研究团队所提出的,这种相似性会吸引我们进入相似的环境,但其中还有更深层的原因。

2015013010.en_text: There could be many mechanisms working together that drive us in choosing genetically similar friends rather than “functional kinship” of being friends with benefits!
2015013010.cn_text: 可能有多种机制共同作用,驱使我们选择基因相似的朋友,而非基于「功能性亲缘关系」的互利性友谊。

2015013011.en_text: One of the remarkable findings of the study was that the similar genes seem to be evolving faster than other genes.
2015013011.cn_text: 该研究的一个重要发现是,这些相似基因的进化速度似乎快于其他基因。

2015013012.en_text: Studying this could help understand why human evolution picked pace in the last 30,000 years, with social environment being a major contributory factor.
2015013012.cn_text: 对此进行研究有助于理解为何人类进化在过去三万年间加速,而社会环境正是主要的促进因素。

2015013013.en_text: The findings do not simply explain people’s tendency to befriend those of similar ethnic backgrounds, say the researchers.
2015013013.cn_text: 研究人员表示,这些发现并不能简单地解释人们倾向于与相似种族背景者交友的现象。

2015013014.en_text: Though all the subjects were drawn from a population of European extraction, care was taken to see that all subjects, friends and strangers, were taken from the same population.
2015013014.cn_text: 尽管所有受试者均来自欧洲血统人群,但研究特别注意确保所有对象——无论朋友还是陌生人——均来自同一人群。

2015013015.en_text: King Juan Carlos of Spain once insisted “kings don’t abdicate, they die in their sleep”.
2015013015.cn_text: 西班牙国王胡安·卡洛斯曾坚称：「国王不会退位,他们会在睡梦中离世。」

2015013016.en_text: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euroelections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.
2015013016.cn_text: 但令人尴尬的丑闻以及共和左派在最近欧洲选举中的声势,迫使他收回前言并宣布退位。

2015013017.en_text: So, does the Spanish crisis suggest that monarchy is seeing its last days?
2015013017.cn_text: 那么,西班牙危机是否意味着君主制正在走向末日?

2015013018.en_text: Does that mean the writing is on the wall for all European royals, with their magnificent uniforms and majestic lifestyles?
2015013018.cn_text: 这是否预示着所有欧洲王室连同其华丽制服和尊贵生活方式都将走向衰亡?

2015013019.en_text: The Spanish case provides arguments both for and against monarchy.
2015013019.cn_text: 西班牙案例为支持和反对君主制提供了双重论据。

2015013020.en_text: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above “mere” politics and “embody” a spirit of national unity.
2015013020.cn_text: 当民意严重对立时,如弗朗哥政权终结后的情形,君主能够超越「纯粹」的政治并「体现」民族团结精神。

2015013021.en_text: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs’ continuing popularity as heads of state.
2015013021.cn_text: 正是这种超越政治的表象,解释了君主作为国家元首持续受欢迎的原因。

2015013022.en_text: And so, the Middle East excepted, Europe is the most monarchinfested region in the world, with 10 kingdoms (not counting Vatican City and Andorra).
2015013022.cn_text: 因此,中东除外,欧洲是世界上君主制最密集的地区,拥有10个王国（不包括梵蒂冈城和安道尔）。

2015013023.en_text: But unlike their absolutist counterparts in the Gulf and Asia, most royal families have survived because they allow voters to avoid the difficult search for a non-controversial but respected public figure.
2015013023.cn_text: 但与海湾和亚洲的专制君主不同,多数王室家族之所以存续至今,是因为他们使选民无需费力寻找既无争议又受人尊敬的公众人物。

2015013024.en_text: Even so, kings and queens undoubtedly have a downside.
2015013024.cn_text: 即便如此,国王和王后无疑也存在弊端。

2015013025.en_text: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history — and sometimes the way they behave today — embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
2015013025.cn_text: 尽管他们声称象征民族团结,但其历史本身——有时还包括他们今日的行为方式——却体现着过时且站不住脚的特权和不平等。

2015013026.en_text: At a time when Thomas Piketty and other economists are warning of rising inequality and the increasing power of inherited wealth, it is bizarre that wealthy aristocratic families should still be the symbolic heart of modern democratic states.
2015013026.cn_text: 当托马斯·皮凯蒂等经济学家警告不平等加剧和继承财富力量增强之际,富有的贵族家庭仍是现代民主国家的象征核心,这一现象令人费解。

2015013027.en_text: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
2015013027.cn_text: 最成功的君主制致力于摒弃或隐藏其旧贵族作风。

2015013028.en_text: Princes and princesses have day-jobs and ride bicycles, not horses (or helicopters).
2015013028.cn_text: 王子和公主有日常工作并骑自行车出行,而非骑马（或乘坐直升机）。

2015013029.en_text: Even so, these are wealthy families who party with the international 1%, and media intrusiveness makes it increasingly difficult to maintain the right image.
2015013029.cn_text: 即便如此,这些富裕家族仍与国际顶层1%阶层交往,而媒体的侵扰使其维持恰当形象愈发困难。

2015013030.en_text: While Europe’s monarchies will no doubt be smart enough to survive for some time to come, it is the British royals who have most to fear from the Spanish example.
2015013030.cn_text: 尽管欧洲君主制无疑足够明智可在未来一段时间继续存续,但英国王室最应从西班牙案例中吸取教训。

2015013031.en_text: It is only the Queen who has preserved the monarchy’s reputation with her rather ordinary (if well-heeled) granny style.
2015013031.cn_text: 唯有女王凭借其相当平实（尽管富有）的祖母风范维护了君主制的声誉。

2015013032.en_text: The danger will come with Charles, who has both an expensive taste of lifestyle and a pretty hierarchical view of the world.
2015013032.cn_text: 危机将来自查尔斯,他既有奢华的生活品味,又持有相当等级森严的世界观。

2015013033.en_text: He has failed to understand that monarchies have largely survived because they provide a service — as noncontroversial and non-political heads of state.
2015013033.cn_text: 他未能理解君主制之所以在很大程度上存续至今,是因为它们提供了一种服务——作为无争议且非政治化的国家元首。

2015013034.en_text: Charles ought to know that as English history shows, it is kings, not republicans, who are the monarchy’s worst enemies.
2015013034.cn_text: 查尔斯应当明白,正如英国历史所示,君主制最大的敌人是国王自身,而非共和派。

2015013060.en_text: Just how much does the Constitution protect your digital data?
2015013060.cn_text: 宪法究竟在多大程度上保护你的数字数据？

2015013061.en_text: The Supreme Court will now consider whether police can search the contents of a mobile phone without a warrant if the phone is on or around a person during an arrest.
2015013061.cn_text: 最高法院现将审议，若手机在逮捕时处于被捕者身上或附近，警方是否可在无搜查令的情况下搜查手机内容。

2015013062.en_text: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumption that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest.
2015013062.cn_text: 加利福尼亚州要求法官避免作出全面性裁决，尤其是那些推翻既有假定的裁决，即执法机构可在逮捕时搜查嫌疑人的随身物品。

2015013063.en_text: It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.
2015013063.cn_text: 该州辩称，法官难以评估新兴且快速演变的技术所产生的影响。

2015013064.en_text: The court would be recklessly modest if it followed California’s advice.
2015013064.cn_text: 如果法院听从加州的建议，将显得过分谨慎而不负责任。

2015013065.en_text: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.
2015013065.cn_text: 足够多的影响是可以辨别的，甚至是显而易见的，因此法官能够并且应当为警察、律师和被告提供更新的指导原则。

2015013066.en_text: They should start by discarding California’s lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone — a vast storehouse of digital information — is similar to, say, going through a suspect’s purse.
2015013066.cn_text: 他们应当首先摒弃加州那站不住脚的论点，即探查智能手机的内容——一个庞大的数字信息储存库——类似于翻查嫌疑人的手袋。

2015013067.en_text: The court has ruled that police don’t violate the Fourth Amendment when they go through the wallet or pocketbook of an arrestee without a warrant.
2015013067.cn_text: 法院已裁定，警察在无搜查令的情况下翻查被捕者的钱包或皮夹并不违反第四修正案。

2015013068.en_text: But exploring one’s smartphone is more like entering his or her home.
2015013068.cn_text: 但探查一个人的智能手机更像是进入其住宅。

2015013069.en_text: A smartphone may contain an arrestee’s reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
2015013069.cn_text: 智能手机可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、医疗记录以及近期通信的综合档案。

2015013070.en_text: The development of “cloud computing,” meanwhile, has made that exploration so much the easier.
2015013070.cn_text: 与此同时,「云计算」的发展使这种探查变得容易得多。

2015013071.en_text: Americans should take steps to protect their digital privacy.
2015013071.cn_text: 美国人应当采取措施保护其数字隐私。

2015013072.en_text: But keeping sensitive information on these devices is increasingly a requirement of normal life.
2015013072.cn_text: 但在这些设备上存储敏感信息日益成为正常生活的必然要求。

2015013073.en_text: Citizens still have a right to expect private documents to remain private and protected by the Constitution’s prohibition on unreasonable searches.
2015013073.cn_text: 公民仍有权期待私人文件保持私密性，并受到宪法对不合理搜查之禁止的保护。

2015013074.en_text: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn’t ease the challenge of linedrawing.
2015013074.cn_text: 一如既往，阐明这一原则并不能减轻划定界限的挑战。

2015013075.en_text: In many cases, it would not be overly burdensome for authorities to obtain a warrant to search through phone contents.
2015013075.cn_text: 在许多情况下，执法机构获得搜查手机内容的搜查令并不会过于繁琐。

2015013076.en_text: They could still invalidate Fourth Amendment protections when facing severe, urgent circumstances, and they could take reasonable measures to ensure that phone data are not erased or altered while waiting for a warrant.
2015013076.cn_text: 他们仍可在面临严重紧急情况时突破第四修正案的保护，并可采取合理措施确保在等待搜查令期间手机数据不被删除或篡改。

2015013077.en_text: The court, though, may want to allow room for police to cite situations where they are entitled to more freedom.
2015013077.cn_text: 然而，法院可能希望为警方保留余地，以便他们能够援引有权享有更多自由裁量权的情形。

2015013078.en_text: But the justices should not swallow California’s argument whole.
2015013078.cn_text: 但法官不应全盘接受加州的论点。

2015013079.en_text: New, disruptive technology sometimes demands novel applications of the Constitution’s protections.
2015013079.cn_text: 新的、颠覆性的技术有时要求对宪法保护进行创新性应用。

2015013080.en_text: Orin Kerr, a law professor, compares the explosion and accessibility of digital information in the 21st century with the establishment of automobile use as a virtual necessity of life in the 20th: The justices had to specify novel rules for the new personal domain of the passenger car then; they must sort out how the Fourth Amendment applies to digital information now.
2015013080.cn_text: 法学教授奥林·克尔将21世纪数字信息的爆炸性增长和可获取性与20世纪汽车使用成为生活实质必需品的确立相比较：当时法官必须为乘用车这一新的个人领域明确新规则；如今他们必须厘清第四修正案如何适用于数字信息。

2015013106.en_text: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
2015013106.cn_text: 《科学》杂志主编玛西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该刊正在其同行评审流程中增加一轮额外的统计审查。

2015013107.en_text: The policy follows similar efforts from other journals, after widespread concern that basic mistakes in data analysis are contributing to the irreproducibility of many published research findings.
2015013107.cn_text: 在各界广泛担忧数据分析中的基本错误正导致众多已发表研究成果无法重现之后，该政策效仿了其他期刊的类似举措。

2015013108.en_text: “Readers must have confidence in the conclusions published in our journal,” writes McNutt in an editorial.
2015013108.cn_text: 麦克纳特在一篇社论中写道：「读者必须对我们期刊发表的结论充满信心。」

2015013109.en_text: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
2015013109.cn_text: 该刊与美国统计学会合作，任命七位专家组成统计审稿编辑委员会（SBoRE）。

2015013110.en_text: Manuscript will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal’s internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
2015013110.cn_text: 稿件将由期刊内部编辑、现有审稿编辑委员会或外部同行评审员标记出来，接受额外审查。

2015013111.en_text: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
2015013111.cn_text: 随后，SBoRE 委员会将邀请外部统计学家对这些稿件进行审查。

2015013112.en_text: Asked whether any particular papers had impelled the change, McNutt said: “The creation of the ‘statistics board’ was motivated by concerns broadly with the application of statistics and data analysis in scientific research and is part of Science’s overall drive to increase reproducibility in the research we publish.”
2015013112.cn_text: 当被问及是否有特定论文促成了这一变革时，麦克纳特表示：「统计委员会的设立源于对科学研究中统计与数据分析应用的广泛担忧，也是《科学》杂志提升我们所发表研究可重现性这一整体努力的一部分。」

2015013113.en_text: Giovanni Parmigiani, a biostatistician at the Harvard School of Public Health, a member of the SBoRE group, says he expects the board to “play primarily an advisory role”.
2015013113.cn_text: 哈佛大学公共卫生学院生物统计学家、SBoRE 委员会成员乔瓦尼·帕米吉亚尼表示，他预计该委员会将「主要发挥咨询作用」。

2015013114.en_text: He agreed to join because he “found the foresight behind the establishment of the SBoRE to be novel, unique and likely to have a lasting impact.
2015013114.cn_text: 他之所以同意加入，是因为他「发现设立 SBoRE 背后的远见具有新颖性和独特性，并可能产生持久影响」。

2015013115.en_text: This impact will not only be through the publications in Science itself, but hopefully through a larger group of publishing places that may want to model their approach after Science.”
2015013115.cn_text: 这种影响不仅将通过《科学》杂志自身的出版物得以体现，而且有望通过更多可能希望效仿《科学》做法的出版机构实现。

2015013116.en_text: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is “a most welcome step forward” and “long overdue”. “Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish.
2015013116.cn_text: 研究方法学的医生约翰·伊奥尼迪斯称，该政策是「极受欢迎的进步」且「早就该实施了」。「大多数期刊在统计审查方面很薄弱，这损害了它们所发表内容的质量。」

2015013117.en_text: I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review,” he says.
2015013117.cn_text: 他表示：「我认为，对于当今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家审查更为关键。」

2015013118.en_text: But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
2015013118.cn_text: 但他也指出，《内科医学年鉴》《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊都高度重视统计审查。

2015013119.en_text: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
2015013119.cn_text: 细胞生物学家戴维·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应具备数据分析能力，但统计错误在已发表研究中却惊人地常见。

2015013120.en_text: Researchers should improve their standards, he wrote in 2012, but journals should also take a tougher line, “engaging reviewers who are statistically literate and editors who can verify the process”.
2015013120.cn_text: 他在 2012 年写道，研究人员应当提高自身标准，但期刊也应采取更严格的措施，「聘用精通统计的审稿人以及能够核实流程的编辑」。

2015013121.en_text: Vaux says that Science’s idea to pass some papers to statisticians “has some merit, but a weakness is that it relies on the board of reviewing editors to identify ‘the papers that need scrutiny’ in the first place”
2015013121.cn_text: 沃克斯表示，《科学》杂志将部分论文交由统计学家审查的做法「有一定价值，但其弱点在于它首先依赖审稿编辑委员会来识别需要审查的论文」。

2015013147.en_text: Two years ago, Rupert Murdoch’s daughter, Elisabeth, spoke of the “unsettling dearth of integrity across so many of our institutions”.
2015013147.cn_text: 两年前,鲁珀特·默多克的女儿伊丽莎白谈到「我们诸多机构中令人不安的诚信匮乏」。

2015013148.en_text: Integrity had collapsed, she argued, because of a collective acceptance that the only “sorting mechanism” in society should be profit and the market.
2015013148.cn_text: 她认为,诚信的崩塌源于社会集体接受了唯一的「筛选机制」应该是利润和市场。

2015013149.en_text: But “it’s us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit.”
2015013149.cn_text: 但「是我们,是人类,是我们这些人创造我们想要的社会,而非利润」。

2015013150.en_text: Driving her point home, she continued: “It’s increasingly apparent that the absence of purpose, of a moral language within government, media or business could become one of the most dangerous goals for capitalism and freedom.”
2015013150.cn_text: 为了阐明她的观点,她接着说:「越来越明显的是,政府、媒体或商界缺乏目标、缺乏道德语言,可能成为资本主义和自由最危险的目标之一」。

2015013151.en_text: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
2015013151.cn_text: 她认为,同样的道德目标缺失正在损害新闻国际这样的公司,使其更有可能像在广泛非法电话窃听事件中那样迷失方向。

2015013152.en_text: As the hacking trial concludes — finding guilty one ex-editor of the News of the World, Andy Coulson, for conspiring to hack phones, and finding his predecessor, Rebekah Brooks, innocent of the same charge — the wider issue of dearth of integrity still stands.
2015013152.cn_text: 随着窃听案审判结束——裁定《世界新闻报》前编辑安迪·库尔森共谋窃听电话罪名成立,而其前任丽贝卡·布鲁克斯同一指控不成立——更广泛的诚信缺失问题依然存在。

2015013153.en_text: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people.
2015013153.cn_text: 已知记者曾窃听多达5500人的电话。

2015013154.en_text: This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.
2015013154.cn_text: 这是工业规模的窃听行为,正如格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的,他是《世界新闻报》2001年雇佣的电话窃听事务负责人。

2015013156.cn_text: 这一漫长的事件仍在持续展开。

2015013157.en_text: In many respects, the dearth of moral purpose frames not only the fact of such widespread phone hacking but the terms on which the trial took place.
2015013157.cn_text: 在许多方面,道德目标的缺失不仅构成了如此广泛电话窃听的事实框架,还界定了审判进行的条件。

2015013158.en_text: One of the astonishing revelations was how little Rebekah Brooks knew of what went on in her newsroom, how little she thought to ask and the fact that she never inquired how the stories arrived.
2015013158.cn_text: 令人震惊的揭露之一是,丽贝卡·布鲁克斯对其新闻编辑室所发生之事知之甚少,她几乎不曾想到要询问,也从未追问过这些报道是如何获得的。

2015013159.en_text: The core of her successful defence was that she knew nothing.
2015013159.cn_text: 她成功辩护的核心在于她对此一无所知。

2015013160.en_text: In today’s world, it has become normal that well-paid executives should not be accountable for what happens in the organisations that they run.
2015013160.cn_text: 在当今世界,高薪管理者无须为其所管理组织中发生的事情承担责任,已成为常态。

2015013161.en_text: Perhaps we should not be so surprised.
2015013161.cn_text: 或许我们不应如此惊讶。

2015013162.en_text: For a generation, the collective doctrine has been that the sorting mechanism of society should be profit.
2015013162.cn_text: 一代人以来,集体信条一直认为社会的筛选机制应该是利润。

2015013163.en_text: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility, shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
2015013163.cn_text: 受到重视的词语是效率、灵活性、股东价值、商业友好、财富创造、销售、影响力,以及在报业中的发行量。

2015013164.en_text: Words degraded to the margin have been justice, fairness, tolerance, proportionality and accountability.
2015013164.cn_text: 被边缘化的词语则是正义、公平、宽容、相称性和问责制。

2015013165.en_text: The purpose of editing the News of the World was not to promote reader understanding, to be fair in what was written or to betray any common humanity.
2015013165.cn_text: 编辑《世界新闻报》的目的不是促进读者理解、秉持写作公正或展现任何共同人性。

2015013166.en_text: It was to ruin lives in the quest for circulation and impact.
2015013166.cn_text: 而是为了追求发行量和影响力不惜毁人前程。

2015013167.en_text: Ms Brooks may or may not have had suspicions about how her journalists got their stories, but she asked no questions, gave no instructions — nor received traceable, recorded answers.
2015013167.cn_text: 布鲁克斯女士或许对其记者如何获取报道存有疑虑,也或许没有,但她未曾提出任何问题,未曾给出任何指示——也未曾收到任何可追踪、有记录的答复。

2015013168.en_text: According to the first two paragraphs, Elisabeth was upset by ____
2015013168.cn_text: 根据前两段,伊丽莎白对____感到不安

2015013169.en_text: the consequences of the current sorting mechanism.

2015013170.en_text: companies’ financial loss due to immoral practices.
2015013170.cn_text: 不道德行为导致的公司财务损失

2015013171.cn_text: 政府在道德问题上的无能

2015013172.en_text: the wide misuse of integrity among institutions.
2015013172.cn_text: 机构间诚信的广泛滥用

2015013173.en_text: It can be inferred from Paragraph 3 that ____

2015013174.en_text: Glenn Mulcaire may deny phone hacking as a crime.
2015013174.cn_text: 格伦·穆尔凯尔可能否认电话窃听是犯罪

2015013175.en_text: more journalists may be found guilty of phone hacking.
2015013175.cn_text: 更多记者可能被判定犯有电话窃听罪

2015013176.en_text: Andy Coulson should be held innocent of the charge.
2015013176.cn_text: 安迪·库尔森应该被判该项指控无罪

2015013177.en_text: phone hacking will be accepted on certain occasions.
2015013177.cn_text: 电话窃听在某些情况下将被接受

2015013178.en_text: The author believes that Rebekah Brooks’s defence ____
2015013178.cn_text: 作者认为丽贝卡·布鲁克斯的辩护____

2015013183.en_text: The author holds that the current collective doctrine shows ____
2015013183.cn_text: 作者认为当前的集体信条显示出____

2015013188.en_text: Which of the following is suggested in the last paragraph?
2015013188.cn_text: 最后一段暗示了以下哪一项?

2015013189.en_text: The quality of writings is of primary importance.

2015013190.en_text: Common humanity is central to news reporting.
2015013190.cn_text: 共同人性是新闻报道的核心

2015013191.en_text: Moral awareness matters in editing a newspaper.
2015013191.cn_text: 道德意识在编辑报纸时至关重要

2015013192.cn_text: 记者需要更严格的行业监管

2015013194.en_text: Clearly you try to comprehend, in the sense of identifying meanings for individual words and working out relationships between them, drawing on your implicit knowledge of English grammar.
2015013194.cn_text: 显然，你会努力理解文本，即识别单个词汇的含义并理清它们之间的关系，同时调用你对英语语法的隐性知识。

2015013196.en_text: You begin to infer a context for the text, for instance, by making decisions about what kind of speech event is involved: who is making the utterance, to whom, when and where.
2015013196.cn_text: 你开始为文本推断语境，例如，通过判断涉及何种言语事件：谁在说话，对谁说话，何时何地说话。

2015013197.en_text: The ways of reading indicated here are without doubt kinds of comprehension.
2015013197.cn_text: 这里所指的阅读方式无疑都属于理解的范畴。

2015013198.en_text: But they show comprehension to consist not just of passive assimilation but of active engagement in inference and problem-solving.
2015013198.cn_text: 但它们表明，理解不仅包括被动的吸收，还包括积极参与推理和解决问题。

2015013199.en_text: You infer information you feel the writer has invited you to grasp by presenting you with specific evidence and clues.
2015013199.cn_text: 你推断出的信息，是你认为作者通过提供具体证据和线索而邀请你领会的。

2015013201.en_text: Conceived in this way, comprehension will not follow exactly the same track for each reader.
2015013201.cn_text: 如此理解，阅读理解对每个读者而言不会遵循完全相同的路径。

2015013202.en_text: What is in question is not the retrieval of an absolute, fixed or “true” meaning that can be read off and checked for accuracy, or some timeless relation of the text to the world.
2015013202.cn_text: 问题的关键不在于检索某个可以读取并核查准确性的绝对的、固定的或「真实」的意义，也不在于文本与世界之间某种永恒不变的关系。

2015013204.en_text: Such background material inevitably reflects who we are.
2015013204.cn_text: 这种背景材料不可避免地反映出我们的身份。

2015013206.en_text: This doesn’t, however, make interpretation merely relative or even pointless.
2015013206.cn_text: 然而，这并不意味着解读仅仅是相对的，甚至是毫无意义的。

2015013207.en_text: Precisely because readers from different historical periods, places and social experiences produce different but overlapping readings of the same words on the page — including for texts that engage with fundamental human concerns — debates about texts can play an important role in social discussion of beliefs and values.
2015013207.cn_text: 正因为来自不同历史时期、地点和社会经历的读者对页面上相同的文字产生不同但又相互重叠的解读——包括对那些涉及人类基本关切的文本——围绕文本的辩论能够在社会对信仰和价值观的讨论中发挥重要作用。

2015013208.en_text: How we read a given text also depends to some extent on our particular interest in reading it.
2015013208.cn_text: 我们如何阅读某一特定文本，在一定程度上也取决于我们阅读它的特定兴趣。

2015013210.en_text: Such dimensions of reading suggest — as others introduced later in the book will also do — that we bring an implicit (often unacknowledged) agenda to any act of reading.
2015013210.cn_text: 阅读的这些维度表明——正如本书后面介绍的其他维度也将表明——我们在任何阅读行为中都带有隐含的（往往未被承认的）预设立场。

2015013211.en_text: It doesn’t then necessarily follow that one kind of reading is fuller, more advanced and more worthwhile than another.
2015013211.cn_text: 由此并不必然得出结论：某种阅读方式比另一种更全面、更高级或更有价值。

2015013212.en_text: Ideally, different kinds of reading inform each other, and act as useful reference points for and counterbalances to one another.
2015013212.cn_text: 理想状态下，不同类型的阅读相互启发，并作为有益的参照点和彼此的平衡力量。

2015013213.en_text: Together, they make up the reading component of your overall literacy, or relationship to your surrounding textual environment.
2015013213.cn_text: 它们共同构成你整体读写能力中的阅读部分，或者说构成你与周围文本环境的关系。

2015013214.en_text: Are we studying that text and trying to respond in a way that fulfils the requirement of a given course?
2015013214.cn_text: 我们是在研习该文本并试图以满足某门课程要求的方式作出回应吗？

2015013215.cn_text: 纯粹为了消遣而阅读它？

2015013217.en_text: Ways of reading on a train or in bed are likely to differ considerably from reading in a seminar room.
2015013217.cn_text: 在火车上或床上的阅读方式很可能与在研讨室中的阅读方式大相径庭。

2015013218.en_text: Factors such as the place and period in which we are reading, our gender, ethnicity, age and social class will encourage us towards certain interpretations but at the same time obscure or even close off others.
2015013218.cn_text: 诸如我们阅读的地点和时期、我们的性别、种族、年龄和社会阶层等因素，会引导我们倾向于某些解读，但同时也会使其他解读变得模糊甚至完全封闭。

2015013219.en_text: If you are unfamiliar with words or idioms, you guess at their meaning, using clues presented in the context.
2015013219.cn_text: 如果你不熟悉某些词汇或习语，你会利用上下文提供的线索猜测其含义。

2015013220.en_text: On the assumption that they will become relevant later, you make a mental note of discourse entities as well as possible links between them.
2015013220.cn_text: 基于它们以后会变得相关的假设，你会在脑海中记下话语实体以及它们之间可能存在的联系。

2015013221.en_text: In effect, you try to reconstruct the likely meanings or effects that any given sentence, image or reference might have had: These might be the ones the author intended.
2015013221.cn_text: 实际上，你试图重构任何特定句子、意象或引用可能具有的意义或效果：这些可能是作者意图传达的。

2015013222.en_text: You make further inferences, for instance, about how the text may be significant to you, or about its validity — inferences that form the basis of a personal response for which the author will inevitably be far less responsible.
2015013222.cn_text: 你作出进一步的推断，例如关于文本对你可能具有的意义，或关于其有效性的推断——这些推断构成个人回应的基础，而作者对此不可避免地承担更少的责任。

2015013223.en_text: In plays, novels and narrative poems, characters speak as constructs created by the author, not necessarily as mouthpieces for the author’s own thoughts.
2015013223.cn_text: 在戏剧、小说和叙事诗中，人物作为作者创造的构造物在说话，未必是作者自身思想的传声筒。

2015013224.en_text: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text’s formal structures (so especially its language structures) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
2015013224.cn_text: 相反，我们基于所谓文本材料与语境材料之间的互动来赋予文本以意义：这种互动发生在我们对文本形式结构（尤其是其语言结构）中感知到的各种组织或模式，与我们带入文本的各种背景、社会知识、信念和态度之间。

2015013230.en_text: Within the span of a hundred years, in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, a tide of emigration — one of the great folk wanderings of history — swept from Europe to America.
2015013230.cn_text: 在十七世纪和十八世纪初的一百年间,一股移民浪潮——历史上最伟大的民族迁徙之一——从欧洲涌向美洲。

2015013231.en_text: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent.
2015013231.cn_text: 这场运动由强大而多样的动机驱动,从荒野中建立起一个国家,并因其本质特性,塑造了一块未知大陆的性格和命运。

2015013232.en_text: The United States is the product of two principal forces — the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits.
2015013232.cn_text: 美国是两股主要力量的产物——欧洲各民族移民带来的各种思想、习俗和民族特性,以及新国家对这些特性的改造影响。

2015013233.en_text: Of necessity, colonial America was a projection of Europe.
2015013233.cn_text: 殖民时期的美国必然是欧洲的投影。

2015013234.en_text: Across the Atlantic came successive groups of Englishmen, Frenchmen, Germans, Scots, Irishmen, Dutchmen, Swedes, and many others who attempted to transplant their habits and traditions to the new world.
2015013234.cn_text: 跨越大西洋而来的,是一批批英格兰人、法兰西人、德意志人、苏格兰人、爱尔兰人、荷兰人、瑞典人以及其他许多民族,他们试图将自己的习惯和传统移植到新世界。

2015013235.en_text: But the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes.
2015013235.cn_text: 但美国特有的地理条件的影响、各民族群体之间的相互作用,以及在这块原始的新大陆上维持旧世界生活方式的巨大困难,导致了显著的变化。

2015013236.en_text: These changes were gradual and at first scarcely visible.
2015013236.cn_text: 这些变化是渐进的,起初几乎难以察觉。

2015013237.en_text: But the result was a new social pattern which, although it resembled European society in many ways, had a character that was distinctly American.
2015013237.cn_text: 但其结果是形成了一种新的社会模式,尽管在许多方面与欧洲社会相似,却具有鲜明的美国特征。

2015013238.en_text: The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic more than a hundred years after the 15th-and-16th-century explorations of North America.
2015013238.cn_text: 第一批驶往现今美国领土的移民船队横渡大西洋的时间,比十五至十六世纪的北美探险活动晚了一百多年。

2015013239.en_text: In the meantime, thriving Spanish colonies had been established in Mexico, the West Indies, and South America.
2015013239.cn_text: 与此同时,繁荣的西班牙殖民地已在墨西哥、西印度群岛和南美洲建立起来。

2015013240.en_text: These travelers to North America came in small, unmercifully overcrowded craft.
2015013240.cn_text: 这些前往北美的旅客乘坐的是狭小而极度拥挤的船只。

2015013241.en_text: During their six- to twelve-week voyage, they survived on barely enough food allotted to them.
2015013241.cn_text: 在六至十二周的航程中,他们靠分配给他们的勉强够用的食物维生。

2015013242.en_text: Many of the ships were lost in storms, many passengers died of disease, and infants rarely survived the journey.
2015013242.cn_text: 许多船只在风暴中失事,许多乘客死于疾病,婴儿几乎难以在旅程中存活。

2015013243.en_text: Sometimes storms blew the vessels far off their course, and often calm brought unbearably long delay.
2015013243.cn_text: 有时风暴将船只吹离航线,而平静的海况往往带来难以忍受的长时间延误。

2015013244.en_text: To the anxious travelers the sight of the American shore brought almost inexpressible relief.
2015013244.cn_text: 对焦急的旅客而言,美国海岸的出现带来了几乎无法言喻的宽慰。

2015013245.en_text: Said one recorder of events, “The air at twelve leagues’ distance smelt as sweet as a new-blown garden.”
2015013245.cn_text: 一位事件记录者说:「在十二里格远的距离,空气闻起来就像新开的花园一样芬芳。」

2015013246.en_text: The colonists’ first glimpse of the new land was a sight of dense woods.
2015013246.cn_text: 殖民者初见新大陆,映入眼帘的是茂密的森林。

2015013247.en_text: The virgin forest with its richness and variety of trees was a real treasure-house which extended from Maine all the way down to Georgia.
2015013247.cn_text: 这片原始森林树木丰富多样,堪称真正的宝库,从缅因州一直延伸至乔治亚州。

2015013248.en_text: Here was abundant fuel and lumber.
2015013248.cn_text: 这里有充足的燃料和木材。

2015013249.en_text: Here was the raw material of houses and furniture, ships and potash, dyes and naval stores.
2015013249.cn_text: 这里有建造房屋和家具、船只和碳酸钾、染料和海军用品的原材料。

2016013001.en_text: In Cambodia, the choice of a spouse is a complex one for the young male.
2016013001.cn_text: 在柬埔寨，对年轻男子而言，择偶是一个复杂的问题。

2016013002.en_text: It may involve not only his parents and his friends, as well as those of the young woman, but also a matchmaker.
2016013002.cn_text: 这不仅可能涉及他本人的父母和朋友，也涉及女方的父母和朋友，甚至还包括媒人。

2016013003.en_text: A young man can decide on a likely spouse on his own and then ask his parents to arrange the marriage negotiations, or the young man’s parents may make the choice of a spouse, giving the child little to say in the selection.
2016013003.cn_text: 年轻男子可以自己选定可能的配偶人选，然后请父母安排婚事协商；或者由父母决定配偶人选，子女在选择过程中几乎没有发言权。

2016013004.en_text: In theory, a girl may veto the spouse her parents have chosen.
2016013004.cn_text: 理论上，女孩可以否决父母选定的配偶。

2016013005.en_text: After a spouse has been selected, each family investigates the other to make sure its child is marrying into a good family.
2016013005.cn_text: 配偶选定后，双方家庭会相互调查，以确保自己的子女嫁娶的是良好家庭。

2016013006.en_text: The traditional wedding is a long and colorful affair.
2016013006.cn_text: 传统婚礼是一场漫长而隆重的仪式。

2016013007.en_text: Formerly it lasted three days, but by the 1980s it more commonly lasted a day and a half.
2016013007.cn_text: 过去婚礼持续三天,但到了20世纪80年代,通常持续一天半。

2016013008.en_text: Buddhist priests offer a short sermon and recite prayers of blessing.
2016013008.cn_text: 佛教僧侣会做简短的布道并诵读祝福经文。

2016013009.en_text: Parts of the ceremony involve ritual hair cutting, tying cotton threads soaked in holy water around the bride’s and groom’s wrists, and passing a candle around a circle of happily married and respected couples to bless the union.
2016013009.cn_text: 仪式的部分环节包括仪式性剪发、将浸过圣水的棉线系在新娘新郎手腕上,以及在一圈婚姻幸福且受人尊敬的夫妇中传递蜡烛以祝福这桩婚姻。

2016013010.en_text: Newlyweds traditionally move in with the wife’s parents and may live with them up to a year, until they can build a new house nearby.
2016013010.cn_text: 按照传统,新婚夫妇会搬到妻子父母家居住,可能与他们同住长达一年,直到能在附近建起新房。

2016013011.en_text: Divorce is legal and easy to obtain, but not common.
2016013011.cn_text: 离婚是合法的且容易办理,但并不常见。

2016013012.en_text: Divorced persons are viewed with some disapproval.
2016013012.cn_text: 离婚者会遭到一定程度的非议。

2016013013.en_text: Each spouse retains whatever property he or she brought into the marriage, and jointly-acquired property is divided equally.
2016013013.cn_text: 配偶双方各自保留婚前带入的财产,共同获得的财产则平均分配。

2016013014.en_text: Divorced persons may remarry, but a gender prejudice shows up: The divorced male doesn’t have a waiting period before he can remarry while the woman must wait ten months.
2016013014.cn_text: 离婚者可以再婚,但性别偏见由此显露:离婚男性无需等待即可再婚,而女性则必须等待十个月。

2016013015.en_text: France, which prides itself as the global innovator of fashion, has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women.
2016013015.cn_text: 法国以全球时尚创新者自居，但其时尚产业已决定放弃定义女性身体美的绝对权利。

2016013016.en_text: Its lawmakers gave preliminary approval last week to a law that would make it a crime to employ ultra-thin models on runways.
2016013016.cn_text: 其立法机构上周初步批准了一项法律，该法律将雇用超瘦模特走秀定为犯罪行为。

2016013017.en_text: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that “incite excessive thinness” by promoting extreme dieting.
2016013017.cn_text: 议会还同意禁止通过宣扬极端节食来「煽动过度瘦弱」的网站。

2016013018.en_text: Such measures have a couple of uplifting motives.
2016013018.cn_text: 这些措施背后有几个积极的动机。

2016013019.en_text: They suggest beauty should not be defined by looks that end up impinging on health.
2016013019.cn_text: 它们表明美不应由最终损害健康的外表来定义。

2016013021.en_text: And the ban on ultra-thin models seems to go beyond protecting models from starving themselves to death — as some have done.
2016013021.cn_text: 而对超瘦模特的禁令似乎不仅仅是为了保护模特免于饿死——确有人曾这样做。

2016013022.en_text: It tells the fashion industry that it must take responsibility for the signal it sends women, especially teenage girls, about the social tape-measure they must use to determine their individual worth.
2016013022.cn_text: 它告诉时尚行业，必须对其向女性，尤其是少女，传递的关于她们用以衡量自身价值的社会标准负责。

2016013023.en_text: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.
2016013023.cn_text: 如果这些禁令得到全面执行，将向女性（以及许多男性）表明，不应让他人成为自己美丽标准的仲裁者。

2016013024.en_text: And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
2016013024.cn_text: 也许隐约地，它们暗示人们应该关注品格和智慧等无形品质，而非通过节食追求零号或蜂腰体型。

2016013025.en_text: The French measures, however, rely too much on severe punishment to change a culture that still regards beauty as skin-deep — and bone-showing.
2016013025.cn_text: 然而，法国的措施过于依赖严厉惩罚来改变一种仍然认为美丽只在表面——甚至以显骨为美的文化。

2016013026.en_text: Under the law, using a fashion model that does not meet a government-defined index of body mass could result in a $85,000 fine and six months in prison.
2016013026.cn_text: 根据该法律，使用不符合政府规定体重指数的时装模特可能导致85,000美元罚款和六个月监禁。

2016013027.en_text: The fashion industry knows it has an inherent problem in focusing on material adornment and idealized body types.
2016013027.cn_text: 时尚行业深知其专注于物质装饰和理想化身体类型存在固有问题。

2016013028.en_text: In Denmark, the United States, and a few other countries, it is trying to set voluntary standards for models and fashion images that rely more on peer pressure for enforcement.
2016013028.cn_text: 在丹麦、美国和其他一些国家，该行业正尝试为模特和时尚形象制定自愿标准，更多依赖同侪压力来实现执行。

2016013029.en_text: In contrast to France’s actions, Denmark’s fashion industry agreed last month on rules and sanctions regarding the age, health, and other characteristics of models.
2016013029.cn_text: 与法国的举措相比，丹麦时尚行业上月就模特的年龄、健康及其他特征的规则和制裁措施达成共识。

2016013030.en_text: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: “We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals, especially on young people.”
2016013030.cn_text: 新修订的《丹麦时尚伦理宪章》明确声明：「我们意识到并承担时尚行业对身体理想，尤其是对年轻人的影响的责任。」

2016013031.en_text: The charter’s main tool of enforcement is to deny access for designers and modeling agencies to Copenhagen Fashion Week (CFW), which is run by the Danish Fashion Institute.
2016013031.cn_text: 该宪章的主要执行工具是禁止设计师和模特经纪公司参加由丹麦时尚协会主办的哥本哈根时装周。

2016013032.en_text: But in general it relies on a name-and-shame method of compliance.
2016013032.cn_text: 但总体而言，它依赖于点名批评的合规方法。

2016013033.en_text: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
2016013033.cn_text: 依靠道德劝说而非法律来应对身体理想的滥用问题，可能是最佳途径。

2016013034.en_text: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
2016013034.cn_text: 更好的做法是帮助将美的观念提升到超越某一特定行业物质标准的层次。

2016013035.en_text: According to the first paragraph, what would happen in France?
2016013035.cn_text: 根据第一段，法国会发生什么？

2016013038.cn_text: 有关节食的网站将蓬勃发展。

2016013055.en_text: Which of the following may be the best title of the text?
2016013055.cn_text: 以下哪项可能是本文的最佳标题？

2016013056.en_text: A Challenge to the Fashion Industry’s Body Ideals.
2016013056.cn_text: 对时尚产业身体理想的挑战。

2016013057.en_text: A Dilemma for the Starving Models in France.

2016013058.en_text: Just Another Round of Struggle for Beauty.

2016013059.en_text: The Great Threats to the Fashion Industry.
2016013059.cn_text: 时尚产业面临的重大威胁。

2016013060.en_text: For the first time in history more people live in towns than in the country.
2016013060.cn_text: 历史上首次，居住在城镇的人口超过了居住在乡村的人口。

2016013061.en_text: In Britain this has had a curious result.
2016013061.cn_text: 在英国，这产生了一个奇特的结果。

2016013062.en_text: While polls show Britons rate “the countryside” alongside the royal family, Shakespeare and the National Health Service (NHS) as what makes them proudest of their country, this has limited political support.
2016013062.cn_text: 尽管民意调查显示，英国人将「乡村」与王室、莎士比亚和国家医疗服务体系并列为让他们最为国家自豪的象征，但这一情感在政治上却得不到多少支持。

2016013063.en_text: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save “the beauty of natural places for everyone forever.”
2016013063.cn_text: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维娅·希尔创立国家信托基金，并非为了拯救气派的宅邸，而是为了「永远为所有人保存自然美景」。

2016013064.en_text: It was specifically to provide city dwellers with spaces for leisure where they could experience “a refreshing air.”
2016013064.cn_text: 这一举措的具体目的是为城市居民提供休闲空间，让他们能够体验「清新的空气」。

2016013065.en_text: Hill’s pressure later led to the creation of national parks and green belts.
2016013065.cn_text: 希尔的推动后来促成了国家公园和绿化带的建立。

2016013066.en_text: They don’t make countryside any more, and every year concrete consumes more of it.
2016013066.cn_text: 乡村不可再生，而每年混凝土都在吞噬更多乡村土地。

2016013068.en_text: At the next election none of the big parties seem likely to endorse this sentiment.
2016013068.cn_text: 在下一次选举中，各大政党似乎都不太可能支持这一主张。

2016013069.en_text: The Conservatives’ planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising “off-plan” building where local people might object.
2016013069.cn_text: 保守党的规划改革明确将乡村发展置于保护之上，甚至授权在当地人可能反对的情况下进行「规划外」建设。

2016013070.en_text: The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable.
2016013070.cn_text: 可持续发展的概念已被定义为有利可图的发展。

2016013071.en_text: Labour likewise wants to discontinue local planning where councils oppose development.
2016013071.cn_text: 工党同样希望在地方议会反对开发的地区取消地方规划。

2016013072.cn_text: 自由民主党则保持沉默。

2016013073.en_text: Only Ukip, sensing its chance, has sided with those pleading for a more considered approach to using green land.
2016013073.cn_text: 只有英国独立党察觉到机会，站在那些呼吁更审慎使用绿地的人一边。

2016013074.en_text: Its Campaign to Protect Rural England struck terror into many local Conservative parties.
2016013074.cn_text: 该党发起的保护英格兰乡村运动使许多地方保守党组织感到恐慌。

2016013075.en_text: The sensible place to build new houses, factories and offices is where people are, in cities and towns where infrastructure is in place.
2016013075.cn_text: 建造新住宅、工厂和办公楼的合理地点是在人口所在之处，即基础设施已经到位的城市和城镇。

2016013076.en_text: The London agents Stirling Ackroyd recently identified enough sites for half a million houses in the London area alone, with no intrusion on green belt.
2016013076.cn_text: 伦敦地产代理商斯特林·阿克罗伊德最近仅在伦敦地区就确定了足以建造五十万套住房的地块，且不会侵占绿化带。

2016013077.en_text: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces.
2016013077.cn_text: 伦敦的情况如此，外省的情况更是如此。

2016013078.en_text: The idea that “housing crisis” equals “concreted meadows” is pure lobby talk.
2016013078.cn_text: 认为「住房危机」等于「草地被混凝土覆盖」的观点纯属游说宣传。

2016013079.en_text: The issue is not the need for more houses but, as always, where to put them.
2016013079.cn_text: 问题不在于是否需要更多住房，而在于一如既往的问题——在哪里建造它们。

2016013080.en_text: Under lobby pressure, George Osborne favours rural new-build against urban renovation and renewal.
2016013080.cn_text: 在游说压力下,乔治·奥斯本倾向于乡村新建项目而非城市改造和更新。

2016013081.en_text: He favours out-of-town shopping sites against high streets.
2016013081.cn_text: 他倾向于城外购物中心而非繁华商业街。

2016013082.en_text: This is not a free market but a biased one.
2016013082.cn_text: 这并非自由市场,而是一个有偏向性的市场。

2016013083.en_text: Rural towns and villages have grown and will always grow.
2016013083.cn_text: 乡村城镇和村庄一直在发展,也将继续发展。

2016013084.en_text: They do so best where building sticks to their edges and respects their character.
2016013084.cn_text: 当建设活动局限于边缘地带并尊重其特色时,它们发展得最好。

2016013085.en_text: We do not ruin urban conservation areas.
2016013085.cn_text: 我们不会破坏城市保护区。

2016013086.cn_text: 为何要破坏乡村保护区?

2016013087.en_text: Development should be planned, not let rip.
2016013087.cn_text: 发展应当规划进行,而非任其泛滥。

2016013088.en_text: After the Netherlands, Britain is Europe’s most crowded country.
2016013088.cn_text: 仅次于荷兰,英国是欧洲人口最稠密的国家。

2016013089.en_text: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
2016013089.cn_text: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村协调性,同时仍允许低密度的城市居住模式。

2016013090.en_text: There is no doubt of the alternative — the corrupted landscapes of southern Portugal, Spain or Ireland.
2016013090.cn_text: 反面例子不容置疑——葡萄牙南部、西班牙或爱尔兰遭到破坏的景观。

2016013091.en_text: Avoiding this rather than promoting it should unite the left and right of the political spectrum.
2016013091.cn_text: 避免而非推动这种情况,应当成为政治光谱左右两翼的共同立场。

2016013092.cn_text: 英国公众对乡村的情感____

2016013093.en_text: didn’t start till the Shakespearean age.
2016013093.cn_text: 直到莎士比亚时代才开始出现。

2016013094.en_text: has brought much benefit to the NHS.
2016013094.cn_text: 给国家医疗服务体系带来了诸多益处。

2016013095.en_text: is fully backed by the royal family.
2016013095.cn_text: 得到了王室的全力支持。

2016013096.en_text: is not well reflected in politics.
2016013096.cn_text: 在政治上未得到充分体现。

2016013102.en_text: Which of the following can be inferred from Paragraph 3?
2016013102.cn_text: 从第三段可以推断出以下哪一项?

2016013103.en_text: Labour is under attack for opposing development.
2016013103.cn_text: 工党因反对开发而遭到抨击。

2016013104.cn_text: 保守党可能会放弃「规划外」建设。

2016013107.cn_text: 作者认为乔治·奥斯本的偏好____

2016013108.en_text: highlights his firm stand against lobby pressure.
2016013108.cn_text: 彰显了他抵制游说压力的坚定立场。

2016013109.en_text: shows his disregard for the character of rural areas.
2016013109.cn_text: 表明他无视乡村地区的特色。

2016013110.en_text: stresses the necessity of easing the housing crisis.
2016013110.cn_text: 强调了缓解住房危机的必要性。

2016013112.cn_text: 在最后一段,作者表达了对____的赞赏

2016013113.en_text: the size of population in Britain.

2016013114.en_text: the political life in today’s Britain.

2016013115.en_text: the enviable urban lifestyle in Britain.
2016013115.cn_text: 英国令人羡慕的城市生活方式。

2016013117.en_text: “There is one and only one social responsibility of business,” wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel prize-winning economist, “That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits.”
2016013117.cn_text: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主米尔顿·弗里德曼曾写道：「企业有且仅有一项社会责任，那就是运用其资源并从事旨在增加利润的活动。」

2016013118.en_text: But even if you accept Friedman’s premise and regard corporate social responsibility (CSR) policies as a waste of shareholders’ money, things may not be absolutely clear-cut.
2016013118.cn_text: 但即使你接受弗里德曼的前提，认为企业社会责任政策是对股东资金的浪费，事情也未必是非黑即白的。

2016013119.en_text: New research suggests that CSR may create monetary value for companies — at least when they are prosecuted for corruption.
2016013119.cn_text: 新近研究表明，企业社会责任可能为公司创造货币价值——至少在公司因腐败被起诉时是如此。

2016013120.en_text: The largest firms in America and Britain together spend more than $15 billion a year on CSR, according to an estimate by EPG, a consulting firm.
2016013120.cn_text: 据咨询公司EPG估算,美国和英国的最大型企业每年在企业社会责任上的支出总和超过150亿美元。

2016013121.en_text: This could add value to their businesses in three ways.
2016013121.cn_text: 这可能通过三种方式为其业务增值。

2016013122.en_text: First, consumers may take CSR spending as a “signal” that a company’s products are of high quality.
2016013122.cn_text: 首先，消费者可能将企业社会责任支出视为公司产品高质量的「信号」。

2016013123.en_text: Second, customers may be willing to buy a company’s products as an indirect way to donate to the good causes it helps.
2016013123.cn_text: 其次，顾客可能愿意购买某公司的产品，以此作为间接向其支持的公益事业捐款的方式。

2016013124.en_text: And third, through a more diffuse “halo effect,” whereby its good deeds earn it greater consideration from consumers and others.
2016013124.cn_text: 第三，通过一种更为弥散的「光环效应」，公司的善举使其赢得消费者及其他群体更多的青睐。

2016013125.en_text: Previous studies on CSR have had trouble differentiating these effects because consumers can be affected by all three.
2016013125.cn_text: 以往关于企业社会责任的研究难以区分这些效应，因为消费者可能同时受到所有三种效应的影响。

2016013126.en_text: A recent study attempts to separate them by looking at bribery prosecutions under America’s Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA).
2016013126.cn_text: 近期一项研究试图通过考察美国《反海外腐败法》下的贿赂起诉案件来将这些效应分离开来。

2016013127.en_text: It argues that since prosecutors do not consume a company’s products as part of their investigations, they could be influenced only by the halo effect.
2016013127.cn_text: 该研究认为，由于检察官在调查过程中并不消费涉案公司的产品，他们只可能受到光环效应的影响。

2016013128.en_text: The study found that, among prosecuted firms, those with the most comprehensive CSR programmes tended to get more lenient penalties.
2016013128.cn_text: 研究发现，在被起诉的公司中，那些拥有最全面企业社会责任项目的公司往往受到更从轻的处罚。

2016013129.en_text: Their analysis ruled out the possibility that it was firms’ political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency: Companies that contributed more to political campaigns did not receive lower fines.
2016013129.cn_text: 他们的分析排除了是企业的政治影响力而非其企业社会责任立场导致从轻处理的可能性：对政治竞选活动捐款更多的公司并未获得更低的罚金。

2016013130.en_text: In all, the study concludes that whereas prosecutors should only evaluate a case based on its merits, they do seem to be influenced by a company’s record in CSR. “We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials,” says one researcher.
2016013130.cn_text: 总体而言，该研究得出结论：尽管检察官理应仅依据案情本身作出评判，但他们的确似乎会受到公司企业社会责任记录的影响。一位研究人员表示：「我们估算，消除重大劳工权利隐患（如童工问题）或将企业捐赠增加约20%，通常可使罚金比贿赂外国官员的常规处罚低40%左右。」

2016013131.en_text: Researchers admit that their study does not answer the question of how much businesses ought to spend on CSR.
2016013131.cn_text: 研究人员承认，他们的研究未能回答企业应在企业社会责任上投入多少的问题。

2016013132.en_text: Nor does it reveal how much companies are banking on the halo effect, rather than the other possible benefits, when they decide their do-gooding policies.
2016013132.cn_text: 它也未揭示企业在制定其行善政策时，有多大程度上是依赖光环效应而非其他可能的益处。

2016013133.en_text: But at least they have demonstrated that when companies get into trouble with the law, evidence of good character can win them a less costly punishment.
2016013133.cn_text: 但至少他们已经证明，当企业陷入法律纠纷时，良好品行的证据能够为其赢得代价更低的惩罚。

2016013159.en_text: There will eventually come a day when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint.
2016013159.cn_text: 终有一日，《纽约时报》将停止在新闻纸上刊登报道。

2016013160.en_text: Exactly when that day will be is a matter of debate. “Sometime in the future,” the paper’s publisher said back in 2010.
2016013160.cn_text: 具体日期尚无定论。该报出版商在2010年曾表示：「在未来某个时候」。

2016013161.en_text: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside, there’s plenty of incentive to ditch print.
2016013161.cn_text: 抛开对纸墨油香和翻页沙响的怀旧情结，放弃印刷版确有诸多理由。

2016013162.en_text: The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper — printing presses, delivery trucks — isn’t just expensive; it’s excessive at a time when online-only competitors don’t have the same set of financial constraints.
2016013162.cn_text: 制作实体报纸所需的基础设施——印刷机、配送车辆——不仅成本高昂，在纯线上竞争对手无此财务负担的时代更显得过度冗余。

2016013163.en_text: Readers are migrating away from print anyway.
2016013163.cn_text: 读者本就在逐步远离印刷媒体。

2016013164.en_text: And though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts, revenue from print is still declining.
2016013164.cn_text: 虽然印刷广告销售额仍远超线上和移动端，但印刷收入持续下滑。

2016013165.en_text: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake, says BuzzFeed CEO Jonah Peretti.
2016013165.cn_text: BuzzFeed首席执行官乔纳·佩雷蒂表示，尽管成本居高不下、发行量日渐萎缩，但贸然取消印刷版将铸成大错。

2016013166.en_text: Peretti says the Times shouldn’t waste time getting out of the print business, but only if they go about doing it the right way. “Figuring out a way to accelerate that transition would make sense for them,” he said, “but if you discontinue it, you’re going to have your most loyal customers really upset with you.”
2016013166.cn_text: 佩雷蒂认为《纽约时报》不应在退出印刷业务上浪费时间，但前提是方法得当。他说：「找到加速这一转型的办法对他们而言是明智之举，但如果直接停刊，会让最忠实的客户极度不满。」

2016013167.en_text: Sometimes that’s worth making a change anyway.
2016013167.cn_text: 有时这种代价仍值得为变革付出。

2016013168.en_text: Peretti gives the example of Netflix discontinuing its DVD-mailing service to focus on streaming. “It was seen as a blunder,” he said.
2016013168.cn_text: 佩雷蒂举例说Netflix停止DVD邮寄服务转向流媒体，「当时被视为失策」，他说。

2016013169.en_text: The move turned out to be foresighted.
2016013169.cn_text: 事后证明此举颇具远见。

2016013170.en_text: And if Peretti were in charge at the Times? “I wouldn’t pick a year to end print,” he said. “I would raise prices and make it into more of a legacy product.”
2016013170.cn_text: 若由佩雷蒂执掌《纽约时报》？「我不会设定停印年限」，他说，「我会提价，将其打造成更具传承价值的产品。」

2016013171.en_text: The most loyal customers would still get the product they favor, the idea goes, and they’d feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in. “So if you’re overpaying for print, you could feel like you were helping,” Peretti said. “Then increase it at a higher rate each year and essentially try to generate additional revenue.”
2016013171.cn_text: 按此思路，最忠实的客户仍能获得心仪的产品,并感到自己在维护所信奉事物的品质。「若你为印刷版多付费，会觉得是在提供帮助」，佩雷蒂说，「然后每年以更高幅度提价，实质上尝试创造额外收入。」

2016013172.en_text: In other words, if you’re going to make a print product, make it for the people who are already obsessed with it.
2016013172.cn_text: 换言之,若要制作印刷产品，就应面向那些对其痴迷的人群。

2016013173.en_text: Which may be what the Times is doing already.
2016013173.cn_text: 这或许正是《纽约时报》的现行策略。

2016013174.en_text: Getting the print edition seven days a week costs nearly $500 a year — more than twice as much as a digital-only subscription.
2016013174.cn_text: 全周七天订阅印刷版年费近500美元——是纯数字订阅的两倍有余。

2016013175.en_text: “It’s a really hard thing to do and it’s a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn’t have a legacy business,” Peretti remarked. “But we’re going to have questions like that where we have things we’re doing that don’t make sense when the market changes and the world changes.
2016013175.cn_text: 「这是极其艰难的抉择，BuzzFeed没有传统业务包袱是巨大优势」，佩雷蒂评论道，「但我们也会面临类似问题，即当市场和世界变化时，我们所做之事可能不再合理。」

2016013176.en_text: In those situations, it’s better to be more aggressive than less aggressive.”
2016013176.cn_text: 在此类情形下，宁可激进，不可保守。
