2016013202.en_text: No matter how formal or informal the work environment, the way you present yourself has an impact.
2016013202.cn_text: 无论工作环境是正式还是非正式，你呈现自己的方式都会产生影响。

2016013203.en_text: This is especially true in first impressions.
2016013203.cn_text: 在第一印象中，这一点尤为明显。

2016013204.en_text: According to research from Princeton University, people assess your competence, trustworthiness, and likeability in just a tenth of a second, solely based on the way you look.
2016013204.cn_text: 普林斯顿大学的研究表明，人们仅凭外表，便能在十分之一秒内评估你的能力、可信度和亲和力。

2016013205.en_text: The difference between today’s workplace and the “dress for success” era is that the range of options is so much broader.
2016013205.cn_text: 当今职场与「为成功而着装」时代的区别在于，可选范围宽泛得多。

2016013206.cn_text: 规范已经演变并呈现分化。

2016013207.en_text: In some settings, red sneakers or dress T-shirts can convey status; in others not so much.
2016013207.cn_text: 在某些场合，红色运动鞋或休闲T恤能够传达地位；而在另一些场合则未必如此。

2016013208.en_text: Plus, whatever image we present is magnified by social-media services like LinkedIn.
2016013208.cn_text: 此外，我们呈现的任何形象都会被LinkedIn等社交媒体服务放大。

2016013209.en_text: Chances are, your headshots are seen much more often now than a decade or two ago.
2016013209.cn_text: 如今你的头像被看到的频率很可能比一二十年前高得多。

2016013210.en_text: Millennials, it seems, face the paradox of being the least formal generation yet the most conscious of style and personal branding.
2016013210.cn_text: 千禧一代似乎面临着一个悖论：他们是最不拘礼节的一代，却也是最注重风格与个人品牌的一代。

2016013212.en_text: So how do we navigate this?

2016013213.en_text: How do we know when to invest in an upgrade?
2016013213.cn_text: 我们如何判断何时该投入升级？

2016013214.en_text: And what’s the best way to pull off one that enhances our goals?
2016013214.cn_text: 而实现一次能够促进我们目标的升级，最佳方式又是什么？

2016013217.en_text: As an executive coach, I’ve seen image upgrades be particularly helpful during transitions — when looking for a new job, stepping into a new or more public role, or changing work environments.
2016013217.cn_text: 作为一名高管教练，我发现形象升级在过渡期尤其有帮助——例如求职、进入新岗位或更公开的角色，或是转换工作环境时。

2016013218.en_text: If you’re in a period of change or just feeling stuck and in a rut, now may be a good time.
2016013218.cn_text: 如果你正处于变革期，或只是感到停滞不前、陷入窠臼，现在或许是一个好时机。

2016013219.en_text: If you’re not sure, ask for honest feedback from trusted friends, colleagues and professionals.
2016013219.cn_text: 如果你不确定，不妨向值得信赖的朋友、同事和专业人士征求诚恳的反馈。

2016013220.en_text: Look for cues about how others perceive you.
2016013220.cn_text: 留意他人如何看待你的线索。

2016013221.en_text: Maybe there’s no need for an upgrade and that’s OK.
2016013221.cn_text: 或许根本无需升级，这也无妨。

2016013223.en_text: Get clear on what impact you’re hoping to have.
2016013223.cn_text: 明确你希望产生何种影响。

2016013224.en_text: Are you looking to refresh your image or pivot it?
2016013224.cn_text: 你是想焕新形象，还是想转变形象？

2016013225.en_text: For one person, the goal may be to be taken more seriously and enhance their professional image.
2016013225.cn_text: 对某些人而言，目标可能是让人更加认真对待自己，并提升职业形象。

2016013226.en_text: For another, it may be to be perceived as more approachable, or more modern and stylish.
2016013226.cn_text: 对另一些人来说，目标可能是显得更平易近人，或更现代、更时尚。

2016013227.en_text: For someone moving from finance to advertising, maybe they want to look more “SoHo.”
2016013227.cn_text: 对于从金融业转向广告业的人来说，他们或许希望看起来更有「苏荷风」。

2016013228.en_text: (It’s OK to use characterizations like that.)
2016013228.cn_text: （使用这样的特征描述是可以的。）

2016013230.en_text: Look at your work environment like an anthropologist.
2016013230.cn_text: 以人类学家的视角观察你的工作环境。

2016013231.en_text: What are the norms of your environment?
2016013231.cn_text: 你所处环境的规范是什么？

2016013233.en_text: Who are your most important audiences?

2016013234.en_text: How do the people you respect and look up to present themselves?
2016013234.cn_text: 你所尊敬和景仰的人如何呈现自己？

2016013235.en_text: The better you understand the cultural context, the more control you can have over your impact.
2016013235.cn_text: 你对文化背景理解得越深入，就越能掌控自己的影响力。

2016013237.en_text: Enlist the support of professionals and share with them your goals and context.
2016013237.cn_text: 寻求专业人士的支持，并与他们分享你的目标和所处背景。

2016013238.en_text: Hire a personal stylist, or use the free styling service of a store like J. Crew.
2016013238.cn_text: 聘请一位私人造型师，或使用J. Crew等商店提供的免费造型服务。

2016013239.en_text: Try a hair stylist instead of a barber.
2016013239.cn_text: 尝试去发型师那里，而不是理发店。

2016013240.en_text: Work with a professional photographer instead of your spouse or friend.
2016013240.cn_text: 与专业摄影师合作，而非让配偶或朋友代劳。

2016013241.en_text: It’s not as expensive as you might think.
2016013241.cn_text: 费用并不像你想象的那么高。

2016013243.en_text: The point of a style upgrade isn’t to become more vain or to spend more time fussing over what to wear.
2016013243.cn_text: 风格升级的目的不在于变得更爱慕虚荣，或者在穿什么上花费更多时间。

2016013244.en_text: Instead, use it as an opportunity to reduce decision fatigue.
2016013244.cn_text: 相反，应将其视为减少决策疲劳的契机。

2016013245.en_text: Pick a standard work uniform or a few go-to options.
2016013245.cn_text: 选定一套标准工作装，或几个常用搭配方案。

2016013246.en_text: Buy all your clothes at once with a stylist instead of shopping alone, one article of clothing at a time.
2016013246.cn_text: 与造型师一次性购齐所有衣物，而不是独自购物，每次只买一件。

2016013247.en_text: Create a new image of yourself
2016013247.cn_text: 塑造一个全新的自我形象

2016013249.en_text: Decide if the time is right

2016013259.cn_text: 心理健康是我们与生俱来的权利。

2016013260.en_text: We don’t have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the same way that our bodies know how to heal a cut or mend a broken bone.
2016013260.cn_text: 我们无需学习如何保持心理健康；它内置于我们体内，就如同我们的身体天然知道如何愈合伤口或修复骨折一样。

2016013261.en_text: Mental health can’t be learned, only reawakened.
2016013261.cn_text: 心理健康无法通过学习获得，只能被重新唤醒。

2016013262.en_text: It is like the immune system of the body, which under stress or through lack of nutrition or exercise can be weakened, but which never leaves us.
2016013262.cn_text: 它就像身体的免疫系统，在压力之下或因缺乏营养或锻炼而可能被削弱,但它从未离开我们。

2016013263.en_text: When we don’t understand the value of mental health and we don’t know how to gain access to it, mental health will remain hidden from us.
2016013263.cn_text: 当我们不理解心理健康的价值,也不知道如何获取它时,心理健康就会对我们保持隐匿。

2016013264.en_text: Our mental health doesn’t really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant.
2016013264.cn_text: 我们的心理健康其实并未消失;就像乌云遮蔽的太阳,它可能暂时从视野中隐去,但完全能够在瞬间得以恢复。

2016013265.en_text: Mental health is the seed that contains self-esteem — confidence in ourselves and an ability to trust in our common sense.
2016013265.cn_text: 心理健康是孕育自尊的种子——既是对自己的信心,也是信任自己常识的能力。

2016013266.en_text: It allows us to have perspective on our lives — the ability to not take ourselves too seriously, to laugh at ourselves, to see the bigger picture, and to see that things will work out.
2016013266.cn_text: 它让我们能够以正确视角看待自己的生活——不把自己看得过重,能够自我解嘲,看到更宏大的图景,并相信事情终会顺利解决。

2016013267.en_text: It’s a form of innate or unlearned optimism.
2016013267.cn_text: 这是一种与生俱来或无需习得的乐观主义。

2016013268.en_text: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are.
2016013268.cn_text: 心理健康使我们能够在他人遇到困难时报以同情,在他人感到痛苦时施以善意,并无论对方是谁都给予无条件的爱。

2016013269.en_text: Mental health is the source of creativity for solving problems, resolving conflict, making our surroundings more beautiful, managing our home life, or coming up with a creative business idea or invention to make our lives easier.
2016013269.cn_text: 心理健康是创造力的源泉,它用于解决问题、化解冲突、美化周遭环境、经营家庭生活,或想出富有创意的商业点子或发明以简化我们的生活。

2016013270.en_text: It gives us patience for ourselves and toward others as well as patience while driving, catching a fish, working on our car, or raising a child.
2016013270.cn_text: 它赋予我们对自己和他人的耐心,也让我们在开车、钓鱼、修车或抚育孩子时能够保持耐心。

2016013271.en_text: It allows us to see the beauty that surrounds us each moment in nature, in culture, in the flow of our daily lives.
2016013271.cn_text: 它让我们能够看到每时每刻环绕在我们周围的美——自然之美、文化之美以及日常生活流转之美。

2016013272.en_text: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions.
2016013272.cn_text: 尽管心理健康是生活的万能良方,但它极为寻常,你会发现它一直在那里指引你渡过所有艰难的抉择。

2016013273.en_text: It has been available even in the most mundane of life situations to show you right from wrong, good from bad, friend from foe.
2016013273.cn_text: 即使在最平凡的生活情境中,它也随时可用,帮助你辨别是非对错、善恶好坏、友敌亲疏。

2016013274.en_text: Mental health has commonly been called conscience, instinct, wisdom, common sense, or the inner voice.
2016013274.cn_text: 心理健康通常被称为良知、本能、智慧、常识或内在之声。

2016013275.en_text: We think of it simply as a healthy and helpful flow of intelligent thought.
2016013275.cn_text: 我们将其简单地理解为一种健康而有益的智慧思维流动。

2016013276.en_text: As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and knowing to trust it allow us to slow down to the moment and live life happily.
2016013276.cn_text: 正如你将会明白的,认识到心理健康始终可得并懂得信任它,能够让我们放慢节奏、活在当下、幸福地生活。

2017013001.en_text: Could a hug a day keep the doctor away?
2017013001.cn_text: 每天一个拥抱能让医生远离吗？

2017013002.en_text: The answer may be a resounding “yes!” Besides helping you feel close and connected to people you care about, it turns out that hugs can bring a host of health benefits to your body and mind.
2017013002.cn_text: 答案可能是响亮的「是」！除了帮助你与关心的人感到更加亲近和联系之外，事实证明，拥抱还能给你的身心带来诸多健康益处。

2017013003.en_text: Believe it or not, a warm embrace might even help you avoid getting sick this winter.
2017013003.cn_text: 信不信由你，一个温暖的拥抱甚至可能帮助你避免在这个冬天生病。

2017013004.en_text: In a recent study involving over 400 healthy adults, researchers from Carnegie Mellon University in Pennsylvania examined the effects of perceived social support and the receipt of hugs on the participants’ susceptibility to developing the common cold after being exposed to the virus.
2017013004.cn_text: 在最近一项涉及400多名健康成年人的研究中，宾夕法尼亚州卡内基梅隆大学的研究人员考察了感知到的社会支持和接受拥抱对参与者在接触病毒后罹患普通感冒易感性的影响。

2017013005.en_text: People who perceived greater social support were less likely to come down with a cold, and the researchers calculated that the stress-reducing effects of hugging explained about 32 percent of that beneficial effect.
2017013005.cn_text: 感知到更多社会支持的人不太容易患感冒，研究人员计算出拥抱的减压效应对该有益影响的贡献约为32%。

2017013006.en_text: Even among those who got a cold, the ones who felt greater social support and received more frequent hugs had less severe symptoms.
2017013006.cn_text: 即使在那些患感冒的人中，感受到更多社会支持并接受更频繁拥抱的人症状也较轻。

2017013007.en_text: “Hugging protects people who are under stress from the increased risk for colds that’s usually associated with stress,” notes Sheldon Cohen, a professor of psychology at Carnegie.
2017013007.cn_text: 卡内基大学心理学教授谢尔顿·科恩指出，拥抱能保护处于压力下的人免受通常与压力相关的感冒风险增加的影响。

2017013008.en_text: Hugging “is a marker of intimacy and helps generate the feeling that others are there to help in the face of difficulty.”
2017013008.cn_text: 拥抱是亲密关系的标志，有助于产生这样一种感受：他人会在困难面前提供帮助。

2017013009.en_text: Some experts attribute the stress-reducing, health-related benefits of hugging to the release of oxytocin, often called “the bonding hormone” because it promotes attachment in relationships, including that between mothers and their newborn babies.
2017013009.cn_text: 一些专家将拥抱的减压和健康益处归因于催产素的释放，这种激素常被称为「纽带激素」，因为它促进人际关系中的依附感，包括母亲与新生儿之间的依附。

2017013010.en_text: Oxytocin is made primarily in the central lower part of the brain, and some of it is released into the bloodstream.
2017013010.cn_text: 催产素主要在大脑中央下部产生，其中部分释放到血液中。

2017013011.en_text: But some of it remains in the brain, where it influences mood, behavior and physiology.
2017013011.cn_text: 但其中一部分留在大脑中，在那里影响情绪、行为和生理机能。

2017013012.en_text: First two hours, now three hours — this is how far in advance authorities are recommending people show up to catch a domestic flight, at least at some major U.S. airports with increasingly massive security lines.
2017013012.cn_text: 先是两小时，现在是三小时——这就是当局建议人们为搭乘国内航班应提前抵达的时间，至少在一些安检队伍日益庞大的美国主要机场是如此。

2017013013.en_text: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
2017013013.cn_text: 美国人愿意容忍耗时的安检程序，以换取更高的安全保障。

2017013014.en_text: The crash of EgyptAir Flight 804, which terrorists may have downed over the Mediterranean Sea, provides another tragic reminder of why.
2017013014.cn_text: 埃及航空804航班的坠毁——该航班可能是被恐怖分子在地中海上空击落的——再次以悲剧形式提醒人们这样做的原因。

2017013015.en_text: But demanding too much of air travelers or providing too little security in return undermines public support for the process.
2017013015.cn_text: 但对航空旅客要求过多或提供的安全保障过少，都会削弱公众对这一流程的支持。

2017013016.en_text: And it should: Wasted time is a drag on Americans’ economic and private lives, not to mention infuriating.
2017013016.cn_text: 这种削弱是应该的：时间的浪费不仅拖累了美国人的经济和私人生活，更令人恼火。

2017013017.en_text: Last year, the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) found in a secret check that undercover investigators were able to sneak weapons — both fake and real — past airport security nearly every time they tried.
2017013017.cn_text: 去年，运输安全管理局（TSA）在一次秘密检查中发现,卧底调查人员几乎每次尝试都能将武器——无论真假——偷偷带过机场安检。

2017013018.en_text: Enhanced security measures since then, combined with a rise in airline travel due to the improving economy and low oil prices, have resulted in long waits at major airports such as Chicago’s O’Hare International.
2017013018.cn_text: 自那以后实施的加强安检措施，加上经济改善和低油价导致的航空旅行增长，已使芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场等主要机场出现长时间等待。

2017013019.en_text: It is not yet clear how much more effective airline security has become — but the lines are obvious.
2017013019.cn_text: 航空安检的有效性究竟提高了多少目前尚不清楚——但排队现象却显而易见。

2017013020.en_text: Part of the issue is that the government did not anticipate the steep increase in airline travel, so the TSA is now rushing to get new screeners on the line.
2017013020.cn_text: 问题的一部分在于政府未能预见航空旅行的急剧增长，因此运输安全管理局目前正急于让新的安检人员上岗。

2017013021.en_text: Part of the issue is that airports have only so much room for screening lanes.
2017013021.cn_text: 问题的另一部分在于机场用于安检通道的空间有限。

2017013022.en_text: Another factor may be that more people are trying to overpack their carry-on bags to avoid checked-baggage fees, though the airlines strongly dispute this.
2017013022.cn_text: 另一个因素可能是更多人试图将随身行李塞得过满以避免托运行李费用，尽管航空公司对此强烈否认。

2017013023.en_text: There is one step the TSA could take that would not require remodeling airports or rushing to hire: Enroll more people in the PreCheck program.
2017013023.cn_text: 运输安全管理局可以采取一项既不需要改造机场也不需要急于招聘的措施：让更多人加入预检计划。

2017013024.en_text: PreCheck is supposed to be a win-win for travelers and the TSA.
2017013024.cn_text: 预检计划本应是旅客和运输安全管理局的双赢方案。

2017013025.en_text: Passengers who pass a background check are eligible to use expedited screening lanes.
2017013025.cn_text: 通过背景审查的乘客有资格使用快速安检通道。

2017013026.en_text: This allows the TSA to focus on travelers who are higher risk, saving time for everyone involved.
2017013026.cn_text: 这使运输安全管理局能够将注意力集中在风险较高的旅客身上，从而为所有相关人员节省时间。

2017013027.en_text: The TSA wants to enroll 25 million people in PreCheck.
2017013027.cn_text: 运输安全管理局希望在预检计划中登记2500万人。

2017013028.en_text: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock: Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
2017013028.cn_text: 该计划远未达到这一目标，一个重要原因是价格冲击：乘客必须每五年支付85美元来处理其背景审查。

2017013029.en_text: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck’s fatal flaw.
2017013029.cn_text: 从一开始，这个价格就是预检计划的致命缺陷。

2017013030.en_text: Upcoming reforms might bring the price to a more reasonable level.
2017013030.cn_text: 即将进行的改革可能会将价格降至更合理的水平。

2017013031.en_text: But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.
2017013031.cn_text: 但国会应考虑直接介入此事，通过帮助资助预检登记或以其他方式降低成本来实现这一目标。

2017013032.en_text: The TSA cannot continue diverting resources into underused PreCheck lanes while most of the traveling public suffers in unnecessary lines.
2017013032.cn_text: 运输安全管理局不能在大多数旅行公众在不必要的队伍中受苦的同时，继续将资源转移到使用率不足的预检通道。

2017013033.en_text: It is long past time to make the program work.
2017013033.cn_text: 早就该让这个计划发挥作用了。

2017013059.en_text: “The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers,” wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii’s last reigning monarch, in 1897.
2017013059.cn_text: 夏威夷末代君主莉莉乌欧卡拉尼女王于1897年写道：「古代夏威夷人是天文学家。」

2017013060.en_text: Star watchers were among the most esteemed members of Hawaiian society.
2017013060.cn_text: 观星者曾是夏威夷社会最受尊崇的群体之一。

2017013061.en_text: Sadly, all is not well with astronomy in Hawaii today.
2017013061.cn_text: 遗憾的是，如今夏威夷的天文学发展并不顺利。

2017013062.en_text: Protests have erupted over construction of the Thirty Meter Telescope (TMT), a giant observatory that promises to revolutionize humanity’s view of the cosmos.
2017013062.cn_text: 围绕三十米望远镜（TMT）的建造爆发了抗议活动，这座巨型天文台有望彻底改变人类对宇宙的认知。

2017013063.en_text: At issue is the TMT’s planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
2017013063.cn_text: 争议焦点在于TMT计划选址莫纳克亚山，这座休眠火山被部分夏威夷人奉为「piko」（脐带），象征着夏威夷群岛与天界的连接。

2017013064.en_text: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world’s most powerful telescopes.
2017013064.cn_text: 但莫纳克亚山同时也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。

2017013065.en_text: Rested in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea’s peak rises above the bulk of our planet’s dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
2017013065.cn_text: 坐落于太平洋中的莫纳克亚山峰高耸于地球稠密大气层的大部分之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得无与伦比的清晰图像。

2017013066.en_text: Opposition to telescopes on Mauna Kea is nothing new.
2017013066.cn_text: 反对在莫纳克亚山建造望远镜并非新鲜事。

2017013067.en_text: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
2017013067.cn_text: 一小群但声音响亮的夏威夷人和环保人士长期以来一直将望远镜的存在视为对神圣土地的不敬，以及对这片曾经主权独立国土被占领历史的痛苦提醒。

2017013068.en_text: Some blame for the current controversy belongs to astronomers.
2017013068.cn_text: 当前争议的部分责任应归咎于天文学家。

2017013069.en_text: In their eagerness to build bigger telescopes, they forgot that science is not the only way of understanding the world.
2017013069.cn_text: 在急于建造更大望远镜的过程中，他们忽略了科学并非理解世界的唯一途径。

2017013070.en_text: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea’s fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the islands’ inhabitants.
2017013070.cn_text: 他们并未始终将保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统或其对岛屿居民的神圣性放在首位。

2017013071.en_text: Hawaiian culture is not a relic of the past; it is a living culture undergoing a renaissance today.
2017013071.cn_text: 夏威夷文化并非历史遗存，而是一种正在经历复兴的鲜活文化。

2017013072.en_text: Yet science has a cultural history, too, with roots going back to the dawn of civilization.
2017013072.cn_text: 然而，科学同样有其文化史，其根源可追溯至文明之初。

2017013073.en_text: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii’s shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
2017013073.cn_text: 正是那种探寻地平线之外世界的好奇心，当初将早期波利尼西亚人带到夏威夷海岸，如今同样激励着天文学家探索天宇。

2017013074.en_text: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
2017013074.cn_text: 要求拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或禁止未来开发的呼声，忽视了这样一个现实：天文学与夏威夷文化都在追问我们是谁、我们从何而来、我们将去往何方这类根本性问题。

2017013075.en_text: Perhaps that is why we explore the starry skies, as if answering a primal calling to know ourselves and our true ancestral homes.
2017013075.cn_text: 这或许正是我们探索星空的原因，仿佛在回应某种原始召唤，以认识我们自己和我们真正的祖源之地。

2017013076.en_text: The astronomy community is making compromises to change its use of Mauna Kea.
2017013076.cn_text: 天文学界正在作出妥协，以改变其对莫纳克亚山的使用方式。

2017013077.en_text: The TMT site was chosen to minimize the telescope’s visibility around the island and to avoid archaeological and environmental impact.
2017013077.cn_text: TMT选址经过精心考量，旨在最大限度减少望远镜在岛上的可见度，并避免对考古遗址和环境造成影响。

2017013078.en_text: To limit the number of telescopes on Mauna Kea, old ones will be removed at the end of their lifetimes and their sites returned to a natural state.
2017013078.cn_text: 为限制莫纳克亚山上的望远镜数量，老旧望远镜将在其使用寿命结束后拆除，其场地将恢复为自然状态。

2017013079.en_text: There is no reason why everyone cannot be welcomed on Mauna Kea to embrace their cultural heritage and to study the stars.
2017013079.cn_text: 没有理由不欢迎所有人来到莫纳克亚山，既拥抱自己的文化遗产，又研究星辰。

2017013096.cn_text: 正在实现古代夏威夷人的梦想

2017013105.en_text: Robert F. Kennedy once said that a country’s GDP measures “everything except that which makes life worthwhile.” With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
2017013105.cn_text: 罗伯特·F·肯尼迪曾说过，一国的GDP衡量「除了使生活有价值的东西之外的一切」。随着英国投票决定脱离欧盟，且GDP已被预测将因此放缓，现在正是评估他所指何物的恰当时机。

2017013107.en_text: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
2017013107.cn_text: GDP及其实用性问题已困扰政策制定者超过半个世纪。

2017013108.en_text: Many argue that it is a flawed concept.
2017013108.cn_text: 许多人认为它是一个有缺陷的概念。

2017013109.en_text: It measures things that do not matter and misses things that do.
2017013109.cn_text: 它衡量了无关紧要之事，却遗漏了真正重要之事。

2017013110.en_text: By most recent measures, the UK’s GDP has been the envy of the Western world, with record low unemployment and high growth figures.
2017013110.cn_text: 根据最新衡量标准，英国的GDP一直是西方世界艳羡的对象，失业率创历史新低，增长数据亮眼。

2017013111.en_text: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country’s economic prospects?
2017013111.cn_text: 如果一切进展顺利，那为何还有超过1700万人投票支持脱欧，尽管有警告称这可能对本国经济前景造成何种影响？

2017013112.en_text: A recent annual study of countries and their ability to convert growth into well-being sheds some light on that question.
2017013112.cn_text: 最近一项关于各国及其将增长转化为福祉能力的年度研究为这一问题提供了一些启示。

2017013113.en_text: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
2017013113.cn_text: 在所衡量的163个国家中，英国在确保经济增长转化为对国民有意义的改善方面表现最差。

2017013114.en_text: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
2017013114.cn_text: 为更全面地评估各国表现，研究不仅关注GDP，还衡量了来自健康、教育和公民社会参与等领域的40多组不同标准。

2017013115.en_text: While all of these countries face their own challenges, there are a number of consistent themes.
2017013115.cn_text: 尽管所有这些国家都面临各自的挑战，但存在一些共同主题。

2017013116.en_text: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
2017013116.cn_text: 诚然，自2008年全球崩溃以来经济复苏已初现端倪，但在健康和教育等领域的关键指标上，主要经济体却持续下滑。

2017013117.en_text: Yet this isn’t the case with all countries.
2017013117.cn_text: 然而并非所有国家皆是如此。

2017013118.en_text: Some relatively poor European countries have seen huge improvements across measures including civil society, income equality and environment.
2017013118.cn_text: 一些相对贫穷的欧洲国家在包括公民社会、收入平等和环境在内的各项指标上都取得了巨大进步。

2017013119.en_text: This is a lesson that rich countries can learn: When GDP is no longer regarded as the sole measure of a country’s success, the world looks very different.
2017013119.cn_text: 这是富裕国家可以汲取的教训：当GDP不再被视为衡量国家成功的唯一标准时，世界呈现出截然不同的面貌。

2017013120.en_text: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.
2017013120.cn_text: 因此，肯尼迪所指的是，尽管GDP一直是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不再充分。

2017013121.en_text: It does not include important factors such as environmental quality or education outcomes — all things that contribute to a person’s sense of well-being.
2017013121.cn_text: 它未能涵盖诸如环境质量或教育成果等重要因素——而所有这些都对个人幸福感有所贡献。

2017013122.en_text: The sharp hit to growth predicted around the world and in the UK could lead to a decline in the everyday services we depend on for our well-being and for growth.
2017013122.cn_text: 全球及英国预测的增长急剧下滑可能导致我们赖以维系福祉和增长的日常服务出现衰退。

2017013123.en_text: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
2017013123.cn_text: 但如果政策制定者将工作重心转向改善福祉，而非仅仅担忧GDP数据，便可能避免预测中的厄运，甚至实现进步。

2017013149.en_text: In a rare unanimous ruling, the US Supreme Court has overturned the corruption conviction of a former Virginia governor, Robert McDonnell.
2017013149.cn_text: 在一次罕见的一致裁决中，美国最高法院推翻了前弗吉尼亚州州长罗伯特·麦克唐奈的腐败定罪。

2017013150.en_text: But it did so while holding its nose at the ethics of his conduct, which included accepting gifts such as a Rolex watch and a Ferrari automobile from a company seeking access to government.
2017013150.cn_text: 但法院在作出裁决的同时对其行为的道德操守表示不齿，这些行为包括接受一家寻求政府准入的公司赠送的劳力士手表和法拉利汽车等礼物。

2017013151.en_text: The high court’s decision said the judge in Mr. McDonnell’s trial failed to tell a jury that it must look only at his “official acts,” or the former governor’s decisions on “specific” and “unsettled” issues related to his duties.
2017013151.cn_text: 最高法院的裁决称，麦克唐奈案的审判法官未能告知陪审团，他们必须仅审查其「官方行为」，即前州长就与其职责相关的「具体」且「未决」问题所作的决定。

2017013153.en_text: Merely helping a gift-giver gain access to other officials, unless done with clear intent to pressure those officials, is not corruption, the justices found.
2017013153.cn_text: 法官们认为，仅仅帮助送礼者获得接触其他官员的机会，除非有明确意图向这些官员施压，否则不构成腐败。

2017013154.en_text: The court did suggest that accepting favors in return for opening doors is “distasteful” and “nasty.” But under anti-bribery laws, proof must be made of concrete benefits, such as approval of a contract or regulation.
2017013154.cn_text: 法院确实指出，接受好处以换取开门便利是「令人反感」和「卑劣」的。但根据反贿赂法，必须证明存在具体利益，如合同或法规的批准。

2017013155.en_text: Simply arranging a meeting, making a phone call, or hosting an event is not an “official act.”
2017013155.cn_text: 仅仅安排会面、打电话或举办活动并不是「官方行为」。

2017013156.en_text: The court’s ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.
2017013156.cn_text: 法院的裁决在法律上合理地界定了一种不构成犯罪的偏袒行为。

2017013157.en_text: Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery.
2017013157.cn_text: 民选领导人必须被允许帮助支持者解决官僚体系的问题，而无需担心因贿赂而遭到起诉。

2017013158.en_text: “The basic compact underlying representative government,” wrote Chief Justice John Roberts for the court, “assumes that public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns.”
2017013158.cn_text: 首席大法官约翰·罗伯茨在判决书中写道：「代议制政府的基本契约假定，公职人员会倾听其选民的声音并针对他们的关切采取行动。」

2017013159.en_text: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
2017013159.cn_text: 但该裁决强化了这样一种必要性：确保政府准入平等的责任在于公民及其民选代表，而非法院。

2017013160.en_text: Officials must not be allowed to play favorites in providing information or in arranging meetings simply because an individual or group provides a campaign donation or a personal gift.
2017013160.cn_text: 不得允许官员仅仅因为个人或团体提供竞选捐款或个人礼物，就在提供信息或安排会面时给予优待。

2017013161.en_text: This type of integrity requires wellenforced laws in government transparency, such as records of official meetings, rules on lobbying, and information about each elected leader’s source of wealth.
2017013161.cn_text: 这种廉洁性要求在政府透明度方面制定并严格执行相关法律,如官方会议记录、游说规则以及每位民选领导人财富来源的信息。

2017013162.en_text: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.
2017013162.cn_text: 官方准入中的偏袒可能加剧公众对腐败的认知。

2017013163.en_text: But it is not always corruption.

2017013164.en_text: Rather officials must avoid double standards, or different types of access for average people and the wealthy.
2017013164.cn_text: 官员必须避免双重标准，即对普通民众和富人提供不同类型的准入途径。

2017013165.en_text: If connections can be bought, a basic premise of democratic society — that all are equal in treatment by government — is undermined.
2017013165.cn_text: 如果关系可以被收买，民主社会的基本前提——所有人在政府对待下一律平等——将被削弱。

2017013166.en_text: Good government rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
2017013166.cn_text: 良好的政府建立在对每个人内在价值的理解之上。

2017013167.en_text: The court’s ruling is a step forward in the struggle against both corruption and official favoritism.
2017013167.cn_text: 法院的裁决是反腐败和反官方偏袒斗争中向前迈出的一步。

2017013193.en_text: The first published sketch, “A Dinner at Poplar Walk” brought tears to Dickens’s eyes when he discovered it in the pages of The Monthly Magazine.
2017013193.cn_text: 第一篇发表的素描作品《杨树步道的晚宴》让狄更斯在《每月杂志》的页面上发现它时热泪盈眶。

2017013194.en_text: From then on his sketches, which appeared under the pen name “Boz” in The Evening Chronicle, earned him a modest reputation.
2017013194.cn_text: 从那时起,他以笔名「博兹」在《晚间纪事报》上发表的素描作品为他赢得了一定的声誉。

2017013195.en_text: The runaway success of The Pickwick Papers, as it is generally known today, secured Dickens’s fame.
2017013195.cn_text: 《匹克威克外传》的巨大成功确立了狄更斯的声名。

2017013196.en_text: There were Pickwick coats and Pickwick cigars, and the plump, spectacled hero, Samuel Pickwick, became a national figure.
2017013196.cn_text: 市面上出现了匹克威克外套和匹克威克雪茄,那位体态丰腴、戴着眼镜的主人公塞缪尔·匹克威克成为了家喻户晓的人物。

2017013197.en_text: Soon after Sketches by Boz appeared, a publishing firm approached Dickens to write a story in monthly installments, as a backdrop for a series of woodcuts by the then-famous artist Robert Seymour, who had originated the idea for the story.
2017013197.cn_text: 《博兹札记》出版后不久,一家出版公司找到狄更斯,请他按月分期创作一个故事,作为当时著名画家罗伯特·西摩原创构思的系列木刻画的配文。

2017013198.en_text: With characteristic confidence, Dickens successfully insisted that Seymour’s pictures illustrate his own story instead.
2017013198.cn_text: 凭借一贯的自信,狄更斯成功坚持让西摩的画作转而为自己的故事配图。

2017013199.en_text: After the first installment, Dickens wrote to the artist and asked him to correct a drawing Dickens felt was not faithful enough to his prose.
2017013199.cn_text: 第一期出版后,狄更斯致信这位画家,要求他修改一幅狄更斯认为不够忠实于自己文字的画作。

2017013200.en_text: Seymour made the change, went into his backyard, and expressed his displeasure by committing suicide.
2017013200.cn_text: 西摩做出了修改,随后走进自家后院,以自杀方式表达了不满。

2017013201.en_text: Dickens and his publishers simply pressed on with a new artist.
2017013201.cn_text: 狄更斯和他的出版商只是换了一位新画家继续推进。

2017013202.en_text: The comic novel, The Posthumous Papers of the Pickwick Club, appeared serially in 1836 and 1837, and was first published in book form in 1837.
2017013202.cn_text: 这部喜剧小说《匹克威克俱乐部遗稿》于1836年和1837年连载出版,并于1837年首次以单行本形式出版。

2017013203.en_text: Charles Dickens is probably the best-known and, to many people, the greatest English novelist of the 19th century.
2017013203.cn_text: 查尔斯·狄更斯可能是19世纪最著名的英国小说家,也被许多人视为最伟大的英国小说家。

2017013204.en_text: A moralist, satirist, and social reformer, Dickens crafted complex plots and striking characters that capture the panorama of English society.
2017013204.cn_text: 作为一位道德家、讽刺作家和社会改革家,狄更斯创作出复杂的情节和鲜明的人物,捕捉了英国社会的全貌。

2017013205.en_text: Soon after his father’s release from prison, Dickens got a better job as errand boy in law offices.
2017013205.cn_text: 父亲出狱后不久,狄更斯在律师事务所找到了一份更好的工作,担任勤杂员。

2017013206.en_text: He taught himself shorthand to get an even better job later as a court stenographer and as a reporter in Parliament.
2017013206.cn_text: 他自学速记,以便日后获得更好的职位,担任法庭速记员和议会记者。

2017013207.en_text: At the same time, Dickens, who had a reporter’s eye for transcribing the life around him especially anything comic or odd, submitted short sketches to obscure magazines.
2017013207.cn_text: 与此同时,狄更斯凭借记者般敏锐的观察力记录周围的生活,尤其是那些滑稽或古怪的事物,并向一些不知名的杂志投稿短篇素描。

2017013208.en_text: Dickens was born in Portsmouth, on England’s southern coast.
2017013208.cn_text: 狄更斯出生于英格兰南部海岸的朴茨茅斯。

2017013209.en_text: His father was a clerk in the British Navy Pay Office — a respectable position, but with little social status.
2017013209.cn_text: 他的父亲是英国海军薪资办公室的一名职员——职位体面,但社会地位不高。

2017013210.en_text: His paternal grandparents, a steward and a housekeeper, possessed even less status, having been servants, and Dickens later concealed their background.
2017013210.cn_text: 他的祖父母分别担任男管家和女管家,地位更低,曾是仆人,狄更斯后来隐瞒了他们的身份。

2017013211.en_text: Dickens’s mother supposedly came from a more respectable family.
2017013211.cn_text: 据称狄更斯的母亲出身于一个更体面的家庭。

2017013212.en_text: Yet two years before Dickens’s birth, his mother’s father was caught stealing and fled to Europe, never to return.
2017013212.cn_text: 然而在狄更斯出生前两年,他的外祖父因偷窃被抓,逃往欧洲,再也没有回来。

2017013213.en_text: The family’s increasing poverty forced Dickens out of school at age 12 to work in Warren’s Blacking Warehouse, a shoe-polish factory, where the other working boys mocked him as “the young gentleman.” His father was then imprisoned for debt.
2017013213.cn_text: 家庭日益贫困迫使狄更斯12岁时辍学,到沃伦鞋油厂工作,那里的其他工人男孩嘲笑他是「小少爷」。他的父亲后来因债务入狱。

2017013214.en_text: The humiliations of his father’s imprisonment and his labor in the blacking factory formed Dickens’s greatest wound and became his deepest secret.
2017013214.cn_text: 父亲入狱的屈辱以及在鞋油厂劳作的经历构成了狄更斯最深的创伤,成为他埋藏最深的秘密。

2017013215.en_text: He could not confide them even to his wife, although they provide the unacknowledged foundation of his fiction.
2017013215.cn_text: 他甚至无法向妻子倾诉这些秘密,尽管它们构成了他小说创作未曾公开的基础。

2017013216.en_text: After Pickwick, Dickens plunged into a bleaker world.
2017013216.cn_text: 《匹克威克外传》之后,狄更斯投入到一个更加阴暗的世界。

2017013217.en_text: In Oliver Twist, he traces an orphan’s progress from the workhouse to the criminal slums of London.
2017013217.cn_text: 在《雾都孤儿》中,他追溯了一个孤儿从济贫院到伦敦犯罪贫民窟的成长历程。

2017013218.en_text: Nicholas Nickleby, his next novel, combines the darkness of Oliver Twist with the sunlight of Pickwick.
2017013218.cn_text: 他的下一部小说《尼古拉斯·尼克尔贝》将《雾都孤儿》的阴暗与《匹克威克外传》的明快结合在一起。

2017013219.en_text: The popularity of these novels consolidated Dickens as a nationally and internationally celebrated man of letters.
2017013219.cn_text: 这些小说的流行巩固了狄更斯作为国内外公认的文坛巨匠的地位。

2017013225.en_text: The growth of the use of English as the world’s primary language for international communication has obviously been continuing for several decades.
2017013225.cn_text: 英语作为世界主要国际交流语言的使用增长显然已持续数十年。

2017013226.en_text: But even as the number of English speakers expands further there are signs that the global predominance of the language may fade within the foreseeable future.
2017013226.cn_text: 但即便英语使用者数量进一步扩大,也有迹象表明该语言的全球主导地位可能在可预见的未来消退。

2017013227.en_text: Complex international, economic, technological and cultural changes could start to diminish the leading position of English as the language of the world market, and UK interests which enjoy advantage from the breadth of English usage would consequently face new pressures.
2017013227.cn_text: 复杂的国际、经济、技术和文化变革可能开始削弱英语作为世界市场语言的领先地位,而因英语使用广泛而获益的英国利益方将因此面临新的压力。

2017013228.en_text: Those realistic possibilities are highlighted in the study presented by David Graddol.
2017013228.cn_text: 大卫·格拉多尔提出的研究强调了这些现实可能性。

2017013229.en_text: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities.
2017013229.cn_text: 因此,他的分析应当终结那些认为英语全球地位稳固、英国年轻一代无需掌握其他语言能力者的自满情绪。

2017013230.en_text: David Graddol concludes that monoglot English graduates face a bleak economic future as qualified multilingual youngsters from other countries are proving to have a competitive advantage over their British counterparts in global companies and organisations.
2017013230.cn_text: 大卫·格拉多尔得出结论认为,单一英语毕业生面临黯淡的经济前景,因为来自其他国家具备资质的多语言年轻人正在全球性公司和组织中证明其相对于英国同行具有竞争优势。

2017013231.en_text: Alongside that, many countries are introducing English into the primary-school curriculum but British schoolchildren and students do not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages.
2017013231.cn_text: 与此同时,许多国家正将英语纳入小学课程,但英国学童和学生似乎并未获得更多鼓励以流利掌握其他语言。

2017013232.en_text: If left to themselves, such trends will diminish the relative strength of the English language in international education markets as the demand for educational resources in languages, such as Spanish, Arabic or Mandarin grows and international business process outsourcing in other language such as Japanese, French and German, spreads.
2017013232.cn_text: 若任其自然发展,随着对西班牙语、阿拉伯语或汉语普通话等语言教育资源的需求增长,以及日语、法语和德语等其他语言国际业务流程外包的扩展,这些趋势将削弱英语在国际教育市场中的相对实力。

2017013233.en_text: The changes identified by David Graddol all present clear and major challenges to the UK’s providers of English language teaching to people of other countries and to broader education business sectors.
2017013233.cn_text: 大卫·格拉多尔指出的这些变化对英国面向他国的英语教学提供者及更广泛的教育产业部门均构成明确而重大的挑战。

2017013234.en_text: The English language teaching sector directly earns nearly £1.3 billion for the UK in invisible exports and our other education related exports earn up to £10 billion a year more.
2017013234.cn_text: 英语教学行业通过无形出口直接为英国创收近13亿英镑,而其他教育相关出口每年还可再创收高达100亿英镑。

2017013235.en_text: As the international education market expands, the recent slowdown in the number of international students studying in the main English-speaking countries is likely to continue, especially if there are no effective strategic policies to prevent such slippage.
2017013235.cn_text: 随着国际教育市场扩大,近期在主要英语国家学习的国际学生数量放缓的态势可能持续,尤其是在缺乏有效战略政策阻止这种下滑的情况下。

2017013236.en_text: The anticipation of possible shifts in demand provided by this study is significant: It gives a basis to all organisations which seek to promote the learning and use of English, a basis for planning to meet the possibilities of what could be a very different operating environment.
2017013236.cn_text: 本研究对需求可能变化的预判意义重大:它为所有致力于推广英语学习和使用的组织提供了基础,以便规划应对可能截然不同的运营环境。

2017013237.en_text: That is a necessary and practical approach.
2017013237.cn_text: 这是一种必要且务实的方法。

2017013238.en_text: In this as in much else, those who wish to influence the future must prepare for it.
2017013238.cn_text: 在这一点上如同在诸多其他方面,欲影响未来者必须为之预作准备。

2018013001.cn_text: 信任是一件棘手的事情。

2018013002.en_text: On the one hand, it’s a necessary condition for many worthwhile things: child care, friendships, etc.
2018013002.cn_text: 一方面，它是许多有价值之事的必要条件：如儿童照料、友谊等。

2018013003.en_text: On the other hand, putting your faith in the wrong place often carries a high price.
2018013003.cn_text: 另一方面，将信任寄予错误的对象往往会付出高昂代价。

2018013004.en_text: Then, why do we trust at all?
2018013004.cn_text: 那么，我们为何还要信任他人？

2018013006.en_text: When people place their trust in an individual or an institution, their brains release oxytocin, a hormone that produces pleasurable feelings and triggers the herding instinct that prompts humans to connect with one another.
2018013006.cn_text: 当人们将信任寄托于某个人或某个机构时，他们的大脑会释放催产素，这是一种能产生愉悦感并激发群体本能的激素，促使人类彼此建立联系。

2018013007.en_text: Scientists have found that exposure to this hormone puts us in a trusting mood: In a Swiss study, researchers sprayed oxytocin into the noses of half the subjects; those subjects were ready to lend significantly higher amounts of money to strangers than were their counterparts who inhaled something else.
2018013007.cn_text: 科学家发现，接触这种激素会使我们进入信任的情绪状态：在一项瑞士研究中,研究人员向一半受试者的鼻腔喷入催产素；这些受试者愿意借给陌生人的金额远高于吸入其他物质的对照组。

2018013008.en_text: Lucky for us, we also have a sixth sense for dishonesty that may protect us.
2018013008.cn_text: 幸运的是，我们还拥有一种对不诚实行为的第六感，这可能会保护我们。

2018013009.en_text: A Canadian study found that children as young as 14 months can differentiate between a credible person and a dishonest one.
2018013009.cn_text: 一项加拿大研究发现，年仅14个月的儿童就能区分可信之人与不诚实之人。

2018013010.en_text: Sixty toddlers were each introduced to an adult tester holding a plastic container.
2018013010.cn_text: 六十名幼儿分别被引见给一名手持塑料容器的成人测试者。

2018013011.en_text: The tester would ask, “What’s in here?” before looking into the container, smiling, and exclaiming, “Wow!” Each subject was then invited to look inside.
2018013011.cn_text: 测试者会先问「这里面是什么」，然后朝容器内看去，微笑着惊叹道「哇」，接着邀请每个受试者向里面看。

2018013012.en_text: Half of them found a toy; the other half discovered the container was empty — and realized the tester had fooled them.
2018013012.cn_text: 其中一半发现了一个玩具；另一半发现容器是空的——并意识到测试者欺骗了他们。

2018013013.en_text: Among the children who had not been tricked, the majority were willing to cooperate with the tester in learning a new skill, demonstrating that they trusted his leadership.
2018013013.cn_text: 在那些未被欺骗的儿童中，大多数愿意与测试者合作学习一项新技能，这表明他们信任其引导能力。

2018013014.en_text: In contrast, only five of the 30 children paired with the “unreliable” tester participated in a follow-up activity.
2018013014.cn_text: 相比之下，与「不可靠」测试者配对的30名儿童中仅有5名参与了后续活动。

2018013015.en_text: Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs?
2018013015.cn_text: 中产阶级面临的诸多恼人挑战中,有一个在下届总统竞选中恐怕不会被提及:当机器人夺走他们的工作时会发生什么?

2018013016.cn_text: 不要完全否定这种可能性。

2018013017.en_text: About half of U.S. jobs are at high risk of being automated, according to a University of Oxford study, with the middle class disproportionately squeezed.
2018013017.cn_text: 牛津大学的一项研究显示,美国约一半的工作岗位面临被自动化取代的高风险,中产阶级受到的冲击尤为严重。

2018013018.en_text: Lower-income jobs like gardening or day care don’t appeal to robots.
2018013018.cn_text: 园艺或日托之类的低收入工作对机器人缺乏吸引力。

2018013019.en_text: But many middle-class occupations — trucking, financial advice, software engineering — have aroused their interest, or soon will.
2018013019.cn_text: 但许多中产阶级职业——如卡车运输、财务咨询、软件工程——已经或即将引起机器人的兴趣。

2018013020.en_text: The rich own the robots, so they will be fine.
2018013020.cn_text: 富人拥有机器人,所以他们会安然无恙。

2018013022.en_text: Optimists point out that technological upheaval has benefited workers in the past.
2018013022.cn_text: 乐观主义者指出,技术变革在过去曾令劳动者受益。

2018013023.en_text: The Industrial Revolution didn’t go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
2018013023.cn_text: 工业革命对那些因机械织机而失业的卢德派人士并不友好,但最终它提高了生活水平,创造的就业岗位多于摧毁的岗位。

2018013024.en_text: Likewise, automation should eventually boost productivity, stimulate demand by driving down prices, and free workers from hard, boring work.
2018013024.cn_text: 同样,自动化最终应会提高生产率,通过降低价格刺激需求,并使劳动者从艰苦、乏味的工作中解放出来。

2018013025.en_text: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
2018013025.cn_text: 但在中期内,中产阶级劳动者可能需要大量帮助以适应变化。

2018013026.en_text: The first step, as Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue in The Second Machine Age, should be rethinking education and job training.
2018013026.cn_text: 正如埃里克·布林约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲在《第二次机器时代》中所主张的,第一步应该是重新思考教育和职业培训。

2018013027.en_text: Curriculums — from grammar school to college — should evolve to focus less on memorizing facts and more on creativity and complex communication.
2018013027.cn_text: 从文法学校到大学的课程设置应该演进,减少对记忆事实的侧重,更多强调创造力和复杂沟通能力。

2018013028.en_text: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problemsolving skills and helping students work alongside robots.
2018013028.cn_text: 职业学校应在培养解决问题的能力以及帮助学生与机器人协同工作方面做得更好。

2018013029.en_text: Online education can supplement the traditional kind.
2018013029.cn_text: 在线教育可以补充传统教育。

2018013030.en_text: It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
2018013030.cn_text: 它可以使额外的培训和教学变得经济实惠。

2018013031.en_text: Professionals trying to acquire new skills will be able to do so without going into debt.
2018013031.cn_text: 试图习得新技能的专业人士将能够在不负债的情况下做到这一点。

2018013032.en_text: The challenge of coping with automation underlines the need for the U.S. to revive its fading business dynamism: Starting new companies must be made easier.
2018013032.cn_text: 应对自动化挑战凸显出美国需要重振其日渐衰退的商业活力:必须让创办新企业变得更容易。

2018013033.en_text: In previous eras of drastic technological change, entrepreneurs smoothed the transition by dreaming up ways to combine labor and machines.
2018013033.cn_text: 在以往技术剧变的时代,企业家通过构想将劳动力与机器结合的方式来平滑过渡。

2018013034.en_text: The best uses of 3D printers and virtual reality haven’t been invented yet.
2018013034.cn_text: 3D打印机和虚拟现实的最佳应用尚未被发明出来。

2018013035.en_text: The U.S. needs the new companies that will invent them.
2018013035.cn_text: 美国需要那些将发明这些应用的新企业。

2018013036.en_text: Finally, because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
2018013036.cn_text: 最后,由于自动化有可能扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距,税收和社会保障网络将不得不重新考量。

2018013037.en_text: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality.
2018013037.cn_text: 低工资劳动的税负需要削减,劳动所得税抵免等工资补贴应该扩大:这将提高收入,鼓励就业,奖励企业创造就业岗位,并缩小不平等。

2018013038.en_text: Technology will improve society in ways big and small over the next few years, yet this will be little comfort to those who find their lives and careers upended by automation.
2018013038.cn_text: 技术将在未来几年以大大小小的方式改善社会,但这对那些因自动化而生活和职业生涯被颠覆的人来说,几乎起不到安慰作用。

2018013039.en_text: Destroying the machines that are coming for our jobs would be nuts.
2018013039.cn_text: 摧毁那些将夺走我们工作的机器是愚蠢的行为。

2018013040.en_text: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.
2018013040.cn_text: 但帮助劳动者适应的政策将是不可或缺的。

2018013066.en_text: A new survey by Harvard University finds more than two-thirds of young Americans disapprove of President Trump’s use of Twitter.
2018013066.cn_text: 哈佛大学一项新调查发现，超过三分之二的美国年轻人不认同特朗普总统使用推特的做法。

2018013067.en_text: The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president’s social media platform.
2018013067.cn_text: 这表明千禧一代更倾向于通过其他渠道获取白宫新闻，而非总统的社交媒体平台。

2018013068.en_text: Most Americans rely on social media to check daily headlines.
2018013068.cn_text: 大多数美国人依赖社交媒体查看每日头条新闻。

2018013069.en_text: Yet as distrust has risen toward all media, people may be starting to beef up their media literacy skills.
2018013069.cn_text: 然而，随着对所有媒体的不信任感上升,人们可能开始提升其媒体素养技能。

2018013070.en_text: Such a trend is badly needed.

2018013071.en_text: During the 2016 presidential campaign, nearly a quarter of web content shared by Twitter users in the politically critical state of Michigan was fake news, according to the University of Oxford.
2018013071.cn_text: 牛津大学研究显示，在2016年总统竞选期间，政治关键州密歇根州的推特用户分享的网络内容中，近四分之一为虚假新闻。

2018013072.en_text: And a survey conducted for BuzzFeed News found 44 percent of Facebook users rarely or never trust news from the media giant.
2018013072.cn_text: 为BuzzFeed新闻开展的一项调查发现，44%的脸书用户很少或从不信任来自这家媒体巨头的新闻。

2018013073.en_text: Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at separating fact from fiction in cyberspace.
2018013073.cn_text: 作为数字原住民的年轻人确实在网络空间中更加善于区分事实与虚构。

2018013074.en_text: A Knight Foundation focus-group survey of young people between ages 14 and 24 found they use “distributed trust” to verify stories.
2018013074.cn_text: 骑士基金会对14至24岁年轻人的焦点小组调查发现，他们使用「分布式信任」来验证信息的真实性。

2018013075.en_text: They cross-check sources and prefer news from different perspectives — especially those that are open about any bias.
2018013075.cn_text: 他们交叉核对信息来源，更青睐来自不同视角的新闻——尤其是那些对任何偏见开诚布公的新闻。

2018013076.en_text: “Many young people assume a great deal of personal responsibility for educating themselves and actively seeking out opposing viewpoints,” the survey concluded.
2018013076.cn_text: 调查总结道：「许多年轻人认为自己对自我教育负有很大的个人责任，并积极寻求对立观点。」

2018013077.en_text: Such active research can have another effect.
2018013077.cn_text: 这种主动探究可能会产生另一种影响。

2018013078.en_text: A 2014 survey conducted in Australia, Britain, and the United States by the University of Wisconsin-Madison found that young people’s reliance on social media led to greater political engagement.
2018013078.cn_text: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校2014年在澳大利亚、英国和美国开展的一项调查发现，年轻人对社交媒体的依赖促进了更高的政治参与度。

2018013079.en_text: Social media allows users to experience news events more intimately and immediately while also permitting them to re-share news as a projection of their values and interests.
2018013079.cn_text: 社交媒体使用户能够更亲近、更即时地体验新闻事件，同时也允许他们转发新闻以展示自己的价值观和兴趣。

2018013080.en_text: This forces users to be more conscious of their role in passing along information.
2018013080.cn_text: 这促使用户更加意识到自己在传播信息中的角色。

2018013081.en_text: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is “reader error,” more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
2018013081.cn_text: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人认为假新闻现象的首要原因是「读者错误」，而非虚构报道或报道中的事实错误。

2018013082.en_text: About a third say the problem of fake news lies in “misinterpretation or exaggeration of actual news” via social media.
2018013082.cn_text: 约三分之一的人认为假新闻问题在于通过社交媒体对真实新闻的「曲解或夸大」。

2018013083.en_text: In other words, the choice to share news on social media may be the heart of the issue.
2018013083.cn_text: 换言之，在社交媒体上分享新闻的选择可能是问题的核心。

2018013084.en_text: “This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem,” says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
2018013084.cn_text: 巴纳集团主编罗克珊·斯通表示：「这表明在应对这一问题上确实存在真实的个人责任。」

2018013085.en_text: So when young people are critical of an over-tweeting president, they reveal a mental discipline in thinking skills — and in their choices on when to share on social media.
2018013085.cn_text: 因此，当年轻人批评一位过度发推的总统时，他们展现出思维能力上的心智自律——以及他们在社交媒体分享时机选择上的自律。

2018013111.en_text: Any fair-minded assessment of the dangers of the deal between Britain’s National Health Service (NHS) and DeepMind must start by acknowledging that both sides mean well.
2018013111.cn_text: 对英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）与DeepMind之间交易危险性的任何公正评估，都必须首先承认双方用意良善。

2018013112.en_text: DeepMind is one of the leading artificial intelligence (AI) companies in the world.
2018013112.cn_text: DeepMind是全球领先的人工智能（AI）公司之一。

2018013113.en_text: The potential of this work applied to healthcare is very great, but it could also lead to further concentration of power in the tech giants.
2018013113.cn_text: 这项工作应用于医疗保健领域的潜力极为巨大，但它也可能导致权力进一步集中于科技巨头手中。

2018013114.en_text: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients’ rights and their expectations of privacy.
2018013114.cn_text: 正是在这一背景下，信息专员伊丽莎白·德纳姆对NHS下属的皇家自由医院信托做出了严厉裁决，该医院在2015年根据一项模糊协议，将160万名患者的记录交给了DeepMind，而该协议对患者权利和隐私期望考虑严重不足。

2018013116.en_text: The NHS trust has mended its ways.

2018013117.en_text: Further arrangements — and there may be many — between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.
2018013117.cn_text: NHS与DeepMind之间未来的进一步安排——可能会有很多——将受到严格审查，以确保已获得患者的所有必要许可，并清除所有不必要的数据。

2018013118.en_text: There are lessons about informed patient consent to learn.
2018013118.cn_text: 关于知情患者同意，仍有许多教训需要汲取。

2018013119.en_text: But privacy is not the only angle in this case and not even the most important.
2018013119.cn_text: 但隐私并非本案中的唯一角度，甚至不是最重要的角度。

2018013120.en_text: Ms Denham chose to concentrate the blame on the NHS trust, since under existing law it “controlled” the data and DeepMind merely “processed” it.
2018013120.cn_text: 德纳姆女士选择将责任集中归咎于NHS信托，因为根据现行法律，它「控制」数据，而DeepMind仅仅「处理」数据。

2018013121.en_text: But this distinction misses the point that it is processing and aggregation, not the mere possession of bits, that gives the data value.
2018013121.cn_text: 但这一区分忽略了一个关键点：赋予数据价值的是处理和聚合，而非仅仅拥有数据片段。

2018013122.en_text: The great question is who should benefit from the analysis of all the data that our lives now generate.
2018013122.cn_text: 关键问题在于，谁应该从我们生活所产生的所有数据的分析中获益。

2018013123.en_text: Privacy law builds on the concept of damage to an individual from identifiable knowledge about them.
2018013123.cn_text: 隐私法建立在这样的概念之上：个人因关于其自身的可识别信息而遭受损害。

2018013124.en_text: That misses the way the surveillance economy works.
2018013124.cn_text: 这忽视了监控经济的运作方式。

2018013125.en_text: The data of an individual there gains its value only when it is compared with the data of countless millions more.
2018013125.cn_text: 个人数据只有在与无数其他人的数据进行比对时，才具备价值。

2018013126.en_text: The use of privacy law to curb the tech giants in this instance feels slightly maladapted.
2018013126.cn_text: 在此情况下，运用隐私法来约束科技巨头的做法显得略微不合时宜。

2018013127.en_text: This practice does not address the real worry.
2018013127.cn_text: 这种做法并未触及真正的忧虑所在。

2018013128.en_text: It is not enough to say that the algorithms DeepMind develops will benefit patients and save lives.
2018013128.cn_text: 仅仅说DeepMind开发的算法将造福患者并挽救生命是不够的。

2018013129.en_text: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
2018013129.cn_text: 关键在于，这些算法将归属于一家利用公共资源开发它们的私人垄断企业。

2018013130.en_text: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.
2018013130.cn_text: 如果软件有望像药物现在所能达到的那样大规模拯救生命，那么大数据可能会如同大型制药公司那样行事。

2018013131.en_text: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
2018013131.cn_text: 我们仍处于这场变革的起点，如今的微小抉择可能在未来造成巨大后果。

2018013132.en_text: A long struggle will be needed to avoid a future of digital feudalism.
2018013132.cn_text: 为避免数字封建主义的未来，需要进行长期抗争。

2018013133.en_text: Ms Denham’s report is a welcome start.
2018013133.cn_text: 德纳姆女士的报告是一个令人欣慰的开端。

2018013134.en_text: What is true of the agreement between the NHS and DeepMind?
2018013134.cn_text: 关于NHS与DeepMind之间的协议，下列哪项正确？

2018013135.en_text: It caused conflicts among tech giants.
2018013135.cn_text: 它在科技巨头间引发了冲突。

2018013136.en_text: It failed to pay due attention to patients’ rights.
2018013136.cn_text: 它未能对患者权利给予应有的关注。

2018013137.en_text: It fell short of the latter’s expectations.
2018013137.cn_text: 它未能达到后者的期望。

2018013138.en_text: It put both sides into a dangerous situation.
2018013138.cn_text: 它使双方陷入危险境地。

2018013159.en_text: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.
2018013159.cn_text: 美国邮政服务（USPS）持续出现巨额亏损。

2018013161.en_text: It reported a net loss of $5.6 billion for fiscal 2016, the 10th straight year its expenses have exceeded revenue.
2018013161.cn_text: 该机构报告称2016财年净亏损56亿美元，这是其支出超过收入的连续第10年。

2018013162.en_text: Meanwhile, it has more than $120 billion in unfunded liabilities, mostly for employee health and retirement costs.
2018013162.cn_text: 与此同时，该机构拥有超过1200亿美元的无资金来源负债，主要用于员工医疗保健和退休费用。

2018013163.en_text: There are many reasons this formerly stable federal institution finds itself on the verge of bankruptcy.
2018013163.cn_text: 这家曾经稳定的联邦机构濒临破产，原因众多。

2018013164.en_text: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
2018013164.cn_text: 从根本上说，美国邮政服务正处于一个历史性的两难困境：一方面，技术变革永久性地降低了其核心产品——一类邮件的需求；另一方面，监管结构使管理层无法灵活调整运营以适应新现实。

2018013165.en_text: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert selfinterested pressure on the USPS’s ultimate overseer — Congress — insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.
2018013165.cn_text: 从邮政工会到贺卡制造商等利益集团对美国邮政服务的最终监管者——国会——施加了基于自身利益的压力，坚持要求无论邮政服务发生何种变化，他们所依赖的现状必须得到保护。

2018013166.en_text: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
2018013166.cn_text: 这正是近年来多次改革立法尝试均告失败的原因，致使邮政服务只能通过推迟关键的现代化改造来支付账单。

2018013167.en_text: Now comes word that everyone involved — Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system’s heaviest users — has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
2018013167.cn_text: 现在传来消息称，所有相关方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政服务、工会以及该系统的最大用户——终于就修复该系统的计划达成了一致。

2018013168.en_text: Legislation is moving through the House that would save USPS an estimated $28.6 billion over five years, which could help pay for new vehicles, among other survival measures.
2018013168.cn_text: 一项正在众议院推进的立法预计将在五年内为美国邮政服务节省约286亿美元，这些资金可用于购置新车辆及其他维持运营的措施。

2018013169.en_text: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
2018013169.cn_text: 大部分资金将来自每封信件永久性增加一美分的费率上涨，以及将邮政退休人员纳入联邦医疗保险。

2018013170.en_text: The latter step would largely offset the financial burden of annually pre-funding retiree health care, thus addressing a long-standing complaint by the USPS and its unions.
2018013170.cn_text: 后一措施将在很大程度上抵消每年预付退休人员医疗保健费用的财政负担，从而解决美国邮政服务及其工会长期以来的不满。

2018013171.en_text: If it clears the House, this measure would still have to get through the Senate — where someone is bound to point out that it amounts to the bare, bare minimum necessary to keep the Postal Service afloat, not comprehensive reform.
2018013171.cn_text: 如果该法案在众议院获得通过，仍需经参议院审议——届时必然会有人指出，这仅是维持邮政服务运转所需的最低限度措施，而非全面改革。

2018013172.en_text: There’s no change to collective bargaining at the USPS, a major omission considering that personnel accounts for 80 percent of the agency’s costs.
2018013172.cn_text: 美国邮政服务的集体谈判制度没有任何变化，考虑到人员成本占该机构成本的80%，这是一项重大缺失。

2018013173.en_text: Also missing is any discussion of eliminating Saturday letter delivery.
2018013173.cn_text: 同样缺失的是关于取消周六信件投递的任何讨论。

2018013174.en_text: That common-sense change enjoys wide public support and would save the USPS $2 billion per year.
2018013174.cn_text: 这一符合常识的改革获得了公众的广泛支持，并可为美国邮政服务每年节省20亿美元。

2018013175.en_text: But postal special-interest groups seem to have killed it, at least in the House.
2018013175.cn_text: 但邮政特殊利益集团似乎已扼杀了该提议，至少在众议院如此。

2018013176.en_text: The emerging consensus around the bill is a sign that legislators are getting frightened about a politically embarrassing short-term collapse at the USPS.
2018013176.cn_text: 围绕该法案形成的共识表明，立法者对美国邮政服务可能出现的政治上令人难堪的短期崩溃感到忧虑。

2018013177.en_text: It is not, however, a sign that they’re getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.
2018013177.cn_text: 然而，这并不表明他们正在认真推动邮政系统的21世纪转型。

2018013203.en_text: In December of 1869, Congress appointed a commission to select a site and prepare plans and cost estimates for a new State Department Building.
2018013203.cn_text: 1869年12月，国会任命了一个委员会，负责选址并为新国务院大楼编制设计方案和成本预算。

2018013204.en_text: The commission was also to consider possible arrangements for the War and Navy Departments.
2018013204.cn_text: 该委员会还需考虑战争部和海军部的可能布局安排。

2018013205.en_text: To the horror of some who expected a Greek Revival twin of the Treasury Building to be erected on the other side of the White House, the elaborate French Second Empire style design by Alfred Mullett was selected, and construction of a building to house all three departments began in June of 1871.
2018013205.cn_text: 一些人原本期待在白宫另一侧建造一座希腊复兴风格的财政部姊妹楼，但最终采用的是阿尔弗雷德·穆莱特设计的华丽法国第二帝国风格方案，令他们大感意外。1871年6月，一座容纳三个部门的大楼开始动工。

2018013206.en_text: Completed in 1875, the State Department’s south wing was the first to be occupied, with its elegant four-story library (completed in 1876), Diplomatic Reception Room, and Secretary’s office decorated with carved wood, oriental rugs, and stenciled wall patterns.
2018013206.cn_text: 国务院南翼于1875年竣工，是最先启用的部分，内有精美的四层图书馆（1876年竣工）、外交接待室，以及装饰有雕花木饰、东方地毯和模版墙面图案的部长办公室。

2018013207.en_text: The Navy Department moved into the east wing in 1879, where elaborate wall and ceiling stenciling and marquetry floors decorated the office of the Secretary.
2018013207.cn_text: 海军部于1879年迁入东翼，部长办公室装饰有精细的墙面和天花板模版图案以及镶木拼花地板。

2018013208.en_text: The State, War, and Navy Building, as it was originally known, housed the three Executive Branch Departments most intimately associated with formulating and conducting the nation’s foreign policy in the last quarter of the nineteenth century and the first quarter of the twentieth century — the period when the United States emerged as an international power.
2018013208.cn_text: 国务、战争与海军大楼（其原名）容纳了三个行政部门，这些部门在19世纪最后25年和20世纪前25年期间与制定和执行国家外交政策关系最为密切——这正是美国崛起为国际强国的时期。

2018013209.en_text: The building has housed some of the nation’s most significant diplomats and politicians and has been the scene of many historic events.
2018013209.cn_text: 该建筑曾接纳过国家一些最重要的外交官和政治家，并见证了诸多历史事件。

2018013210.en_text: Many of the most celebrated national figures have participated in historical events that have taken place within the EEOB’s granite walls.
2018013210.cn_text: 许多最负盛名的国家人物都曾参与在EEOB花岗岩墙内发生的历史事件。

2018013211.en_text: Theodore and Franklin D. Roosevelt, William Howard Taft, Dwight D. Eisenhower, Lyndon B. Johnson, Gerald Ford, and George H. W. Bush all had offices in this building before becoming President.
2018013211.cn_text: 西奥多·罗斯福、富兰克林·D·罗斯福、威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱、德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔、林登·B·约翰逊、杰拉尔德·福特和乔治·H·W·布什在成为总统之前，都曾在这座建筑内设有办公室。

2018013217.en_text: It has housed 16 Secretaries of the Navy, 21 Secretaries of War, and 24 Secretaries of State.
2018013217.cn_text: 它曾容纳过16位海军部长、21位战争部长和24位国务卿。

2018013218.en_text: Winston Churchill once walked its corridors and Japanese emissaries met here with Secretary of State Cordell Hull after the bombing of Pearl Harbor.
2018013218.cn_text: 温斯顿·丘吉尔曾在其走廊中漫步，珍珠港事件后日本使节也曾在此与国务卿科德尔·赫尔会晤。

2018013219.en_text: The Eisenhower Executive Office Building (EEOB) commands a unique position in both the national history and the architectural heritage of the United States.
2018013219.cn_text: 艾森豪威尔行政办公楼（EEOB）在美国国家历史和建筑遗产中占据着独特地位。

2018013220.en_text: Designed by Supervising Architect of the Treasury, Alfred B. Mullett, it was built from 1871 to 1888 to house the growing staffs of the State, War, and Navy Departments, and is considered one of the best examples of French Second Empire architecture in the country.
2018013220.cn_text: 它由财政部监理建筑师阿尔弗雷德·B·穆莱特设计，于1871年至1888年间建造，用于容纳不断扩充的国务院、战争部和海军部工作人员，被视为美国法国第二帝国建筑风格的典范之一。

2018013222.en_text: Construction took 17 years as the building slowly rose wing by wing.
2018013222.cn_text: 建造历时17年，大楼逐翼逐翼缓慢升起。

2018013223.en_text: When the EEOB was finished, it was the largest office building in Washington, with nearly 2 miles of black and white tiled corridors.
2018013223.cn_text: EEOB建成时是华盛顿最大的办公楼，拥有近两英里长的黑白瓷砖走廊。

2018013224.en_text: Almost all of the interior detail is of cast iron or plaster; the use of wood was minimized to insure fire safety.
2018013224.cn_text: 几乎所有内部装饰均采用铸铁或石膏制作；木材用量被降至最低以确保防火安全。

2018013225.en_text: Eight monumental curving staircases of granite with over 4,000 individually cast bronze balusters are capped by four skylight domes and two stained glass rotundas.
2018013225.cn_text: 八座宏伟的花岗岩弧形楼梯配有超过4000根单独铸造的青铜栏杆，顶部由四个天窗圆顶和两个彩色玻璃圆厅覆盖。

2018013226.en_text: The history of the EEOB began long before its foundations were laid.
2018013226.cn_text: EEOB的历史早在其地基奠定之前便已开始。

2018013227.en_text: The first executive offices were constructed between 1799 and 1820.
2018013227.cn_text: 最早的行政办公楼建于1799年至1820年间。

2018013228.en_text: A series of fires (including those set by the British in 1814) and overcrowded conditions led to the construction of the existing Treasury Building.
2018013228.cn_text: 一系列火灾（包括1814年英军纵火）以及过度拥挤的状况促使现有财政部大楼的修建。

2018013229.en_text: In 1866, the construction of the North Wing of the Treasury Building necessitated the demolition of the State Department building.
2018013229.cn_text: 1866年，财政部大楼北翼的施工需要拆除国务院大楼。

2018013235.en_text: Shakespeare’s lifetime was coincident with a period of extraordinary activity and achievement in the drama.
2018013235.cn_text: 莎士比亚的生平恰逢戏剧领域异常活跃和成就卓著的时期。

2018013236.en_text: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
2018013236.cn_text: 在他出生之时,欧洲正目睹宗教戏剧的衰落,以及在古典悲剧和喜剧的激励下新形式的诞生。

2018013237.en_text: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
2018013237.cn_text: 这些新形式起初主要由学者创作并由业余爱好者演出,但在英国以及西欧各地,职业演员阶层的兴起正使戏剧有走向大众化的趋势,无论其是新是旧、是古典还是中世纪、是文学性的还是闹剧性的。

2018013238.en_text: Court, school, organizations of amateurs, and the traveling actors were all rivals in supplying a widespread desire for dramatic entertainment; and no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
2018013238.cn_text: 宫廷、学校、业余爱好者组织以及巡回演员都在竞相满足人们对戏剧娱乐的广泛需求;而任何一个上过文法学校的男孩都不可能不知道,戏剧是一种文学形式,它曾为希腊和罗马带来荣耀,也可能为英国带来荣誉。

2018013239.en_text: When Shakespeare was twelve years old the first public playhouse was built in London.
2018013239.cn_text: 莎士比亚十二岁时,伦敦建起了第一座公共剧院。

2018013240.en_text: For a time literature showed no interest in this public stage.
2018013240.cn_text: 文学界一度对这一公共舞台毫无兴趣。

2018013241.en_text: Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court, or for the choir boys of St. Paul’s and the royal chapel, who, however, gave plays in public as well as at court.
2018013241.cn_text: 追求文学成就的戏剧是为学校或宫廷创作的,或是为圣保罗教堂和皇家礼拜堂的唱诗班男孩创作的,不过这些男孩既在宫廷也在公众场合演出戏剧。

2018013243.en_text: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood.
2018013243.cn_text: 但职业剧团在其固定剧院中蓬勃发展,而有文学抱负的大学学子很快便转向这些剧院,将其视为谋生之道。

2018013244.en_text: By the time that Shakespeare was twenty-five, Lyly, Peele, and Greene had made comedies that were at once popular and literary; Kyd had written a tragedy that crowded the pit; and Marlowe had brought poetry and genius to triumph on the common stage — where they had played no part since the death of Euripides.
2018013244.cn_text: 到莎士比亚二十五岁时,黎里、皮尔和格林已创作出既流行又具文学性的喜剧;基德写就了一部令剧场爆满的悲剧;而马洛则将诗歌和天才带到了大众舞台并获得成功——自欧里庇得斯去世后,诗歌和天才就不曾在舞台上扮演任何角色。

2018013245.en_text: A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouses established, and at least some of its great traditions had been begun.
2018013245.cn_text: 一种本土文学戏剧已然形成,其与公共剧院的联盟业已确立,而且至少它的一些伟大传统已经开启。

2018013246.en_text: The development of the Elizabethan drama for the next twenty-five years is of exceptional interest to students of literary history, for in this brief period we may trace the beginning, growth, blossoming, and decay of many kinds of plays, and of many great careers.
2018013246.cn_text: 此后二十五年伊丽莎白时期戏剧的发展对于文学史研究者而言具有非凡的意义,因为在这短暂的时期里,我们可以追溯多种类型戏剧以及众多伟大事业的萌芽、成长、鼎盛与衰落。

2018013247.en_text: We are amazed today at the mere number of plays produced, as well as by the number of dramatists writing at the same time for this London of two hundred thousand inhabitants.
2018013247.cn_text: 今天我们既惊叹于当时创作的戏剧数量之巨,也惊叹于同时期为这座仅有二十万居民的伦敦城创作的剧作家人数之众。

2018013248.en_text: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
2018013248.cn_text: 要认识到当时戏剧活动何其繁盛,我们还须记住,大量戏剧已经散佚,而且可能没有任何一位知名作家的全部作品流传至今。

2019013001.en_text: Today, we live in a world where GPS systems, digital maps, and other navigation apps are all available on our smart phones.
2019013001.cn_text: 如今，我们生活在一个GPS系统、数字地图和其他导航应用程序均可在智能手机上使用的世界。

2019013002.en_text: Few of us just walk straight into the woods without a phone.
2019013002.cn_text: 我们当中很少有人会不带手机就径直走进树林。

2019013003.en_text: But phones run on batteries, and batteries can die faster than we realize.
2019013003.cn_text: 但手机依靠电池运行，而电池的耗尽速度可能比我们意识到的更快。

2019013004.en_text: If you get lost without a phone or a compass, and you literally can’t find north, a few tricks may help you navigate back to civilization, one of which is to follow the land.
2019013004.cn_text: 如果你在没有手机或指南针的情况下迷路，而且确实无法辨别方向，一些技巧或许能帮助你导航回到文明世界，其中之一便是依循地形地势。

2019013005.en_text: When you find yourself well off a trail, but not in a completely unfamiliar area of land, you have to answer two questions: Which way is downhill, in this particular area?
2019013005.cn_text: 当你发现自己远离了小径，但又并非置身于完全陌生的区域时,你必须回答两个问题：在这一特定区域,哪个方向是下坡？

2019013006.en_text: And where is the nearest water source?

2019013007.en_text: Humans overwhelmingly live in valleys, and on supplies of fresh water.
2019013007.cn_text: 人类绝大多数居住在山谷中，并依赖淡水供应。

2019013008.en_text: So, if you head downhill, and follow any H₂O you find, you should eventually see signs of people.
2019013008.cn_text: 因此，如果你向下坡行进，并跟随所发现的任何水源，你最终应当会看到人类活动的迹象。

2019013009.en_text: If you’ve explored the area before, keep an eye out for familiar sights — you may be surprised how quickly identifying a distinctive rock or tree can restore your bearings.
2019013009.cn_text: 如果你之前曾探索过该区域，请留意熟悉的景象——你可能会惊讶于识别出一块独特的岩石或一棵树能多么迅速地帮你重新确定方位。

2019013010.en_text: Another option: Climb high and look for signs of human habitation.
2019013010.cn_text: 另一个选择：攀至高处寻找人类聚居的迹象。

2019013011.en_text: For example, even in dense forest, you should be able to spot gaps in the tree line due to roads, train tracks, and other paths people carve through the woods.
2019013011.cn_text: 例如，即使在茂密的森林中，你也应该能够发现因道路、铁路轨道及其他人们在林中开辟的路径而形成的林线空隙。

2019013012.en_text: Head toward these breaks to find a way out.
2019013012.cn_text: 朝这些空隙前进以找到出路。

2019013013.en_text: At night, scan the horizon for artificial light sources, such as fires and streetlights, then walk toward the glow of light pollution.
2019013013.cn_text: 夜间，扫视地平线寻找人造光源，如火光和街灯，然后朝着光污染的辉光方向前进。

2019013014.en_text: Finally, assuming you’re lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the marks we leave on the landscape.
2019013014.cn_text: 最后，假定你迷失在人类常去的区域，寻找我们在地貌上留下的痕迹。

2019013015.en_text: Trail blazes, tire tracks, and other features can lead you to civilization.
2019013015.cn_text: 路径标记、车辙痕迹及其他特征都能引导你找到文明所在。

2019013016.en_text: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks.
2019013016.cn_text: 英国金融监管机构对大型银行的负责人施加了一项相当不同寻常的规定。

2019013017.en_text: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
2019013017.cn_text: 从明年开始,如果银行因不当行为受到调查,高管的保证奖金可能会被延迟10年发放。

2019013018.en_text: The main purpose of this “clawback” rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions.
2019013018.cn_text: 这一「追回」规则的主要目的是让银行家为有害的冒险行为负责,并恢复公众对金融机构的信任。

2019013019.en_text: Yet officials also hope for a much larger benefit: more long-term decisionmaking, not only by banks but by all corporations, to build a stronger economy for future generations.
2019013019.cn_text: 然而,官员们也期待获得更大的收益:不仅银行,所有公司都能做出更多长期决策,以为子孙后代构建更强大的经济。

2019013020.en_text: “Short-termism” or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England’s top economist, Andrew Haldane.
2019013020.cn_text: 英国央行首席经济学家安德鲁·霍尔丹表示,「短期主义」或对快速利润的追求,在上市公司中愈演愈烈。

2019013021.en_text: He quotes a giant of classical economics, Alfred Marshall, in describing this financial impatience as acting like “children who pick the plums out of their pudding to eat them at once” rather than putting them aside to be eaten last.
2019013021.cn_text: 他引用古典经济学巨擘阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的话,将这种金融上的急功近利比作「孩子们从布丁里挑出李子立刻吃掉」,而不是留到最后再吃。

2019013022.en_text: The average time for holding a stock in both the United States and Britain, he notes, has dropped from seven years to seven months in recent decades.
2019013022.cn_text: 他指出,近几十年来,美国和英国的股票持有平均时长已从七年降至七个月。

2019013023.en_text: Transient investors, who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm’s efforts to invest in longterm research or to build up customer loyalty.
2019013023.cn_text: 要求公司实现高季度利润的短期投资者,可能会妨碍企业在长期研发或建立客户忠诚度方面的投入。

2019013024.cn_text: 这被称为「季度资本主义」。

2019013025.en_text: In addition, new digital technologies have allowed more rapid trading of equities, quicker use of information, and thus shorter attention spans in financial markets.
2019013025.cn_text: 此外,新兴数字技术使股票交易更加迅速,信息利用更加快捷,从而缩短了金融市场的注意力持续时间。

2019013026.en_text: “There seems to be a predominance of short-term thinking at the expense of long-term investing,” said Commissioner Daniel Gallagher of the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a speech this week.
2019013026.cn_text: 美国证券交易委员会委员丹尼尔·加拉格在本周的一次演讲中表示:「短期思维似乎占据主导地位,而长期投资却被牺牲了。」

2019013027.en_text: In the US, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year, slightly helping reduce “shorttermism.” In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that “a substantial part” of executive pay is now tied to performance.
2019013027.cn_text: 在美国,2002年的《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》促使大多数上市公司将高管绩效奖金推迟约一年发放,在一定程度上有助于减少「短期主义」。《华尔街日报》在其最新的CEO薪酬调查中发现,「相当大比例」的高管薪酬现已与绩效挂钩。

2019013028.en_text: Much more could be done to encourage “long-termism,” such as changes in the tax code and quicker disclosure of stock acquisitions.
2019013028.cn_text: 可以采取更多措施来鼓励「长期主义」,例如修改税法和加快股票收购信息的披露。

2019013029.en_text: In France, shareholders who hold onto a company investment for at least two years can sometimes earn more voting rights in a company.
2019013029.cn_text: 在法国,持有公司股权至少两年的股东有时可以获得更多投票权。

2019013030.en_text: Within companies, the right compensation design can provide incentives for executives to think beyond their own time at the company and on behalf of all stakeholders.
2019013030.cn_text: 在公司内部,合理的薪酬设计可以激励高管超越自身任期考虑问题,并代表所有利益相关者行事。

2019013031.en_text: Britain’s new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance, not just for the short term but for the long term.
2019013031.cn_text: 英国的新规提醒银行家,社会关注的不仅是他们的短期表现,也包括长期表现。

2019013052.en_text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
2019013052.cn_text: 以下哪项是本文的最佳标题?

2019013057.en_text: Grade inflation — the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades — is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased.
2019013057.cn_text: 成绩膨胀——即过去几十年间平均绩点（GPA）的逐步提高——通常被视为高等教育消费时代的产物，在这一时代，学生被当作需要取悦的客户对待。

2019013058.en_text: But another, related force — a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called “grade forgiveness” is helping raise GPAs.
2019013058.cn_text: 但另一股相关力量——一项通常深埋于课程目录中、名为「成绩宽恕」的政策——也在助推绩点提高。

2019013059.en_text: Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student’s overall GPA.
2019013059.cn_text: 成绩宽恕允许学生重修获得低分的课程，而最近一次成绩或最高成绩是计入学生总体绩点的唯一成绩。

2019013060.en_text: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.
2019013060.cn_text: 近年来，随着高校继续竭尽全力挽留学生（并收取学费）以及提高毕业率，这种鲜为人知的做法使用速度加快。

2019013061.en_text: When this practice first started decades ago, it was usually limited to freshmen, to give them a second chance to take a class in their first year if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses.
2019013061.cn_text: 这一做法几十年前首次实施时，通常仅限于大一新生，目的是让他们在适应大学课程过程中遇到困难时，有第二次机会在第一学年重修课程。

2019013062.en_text: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.
2019013062.cn_text: 但如今，除少数录取门槛较高的院校外，大多数高校允许所有本科生、甚至研究生享受成绩宽恕政策。

2019013063.en_text: College officials also tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.
2019013063.cn_text: 高校官员也倾向于强调，成绩宽恕的目标与其说在于成绩本身，不如说在于鼓励学生重修对其学位项目和毕业至关重要的课程，而不必承受重大惩罚。

2019013064.en_text: “Ultimately,” said Jack Miner, Ohio State University’s registrar, “we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time.”
2019013064.cn_text: 俄亥俄州立大学教务长杰克·迈纳表示：「最终，我们看到学生取得了更大的成功，因为他们重修课程后，在后续课程中表现更好，或掌握了能够使其按时毕业的内容。」

2019013065.en_text: That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges’ own needs as well.
2019013065.cn_text: 话虽如此，成绩宽恕在某种程度上也满足了高校自身的需求。

2019013066.en_text: For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention — so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money.
2019013066.cn_text: 对于公立院校而言，州政府拨款有时部分取决于其在毕业率和学生保留率等指标上的表现——因此更高的成绩可以通过提升这些数字而带来更多资金。

2019013067.en_text: And anything that raises GPAs will likely make students — who, at the end of the day, are paying the bill — feel they’ve gotten a better value for their tuition dollars, which is another big concern for colleges.
2019013067.cn_text: 任何提高绩点的做法都可能让学生——归根结底是付费方——觉得学费物有所值，而这也是高校的另一重大关切。

2019013068.en_text: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers’ expectations for higher education.
2019013068.cn_text: 实际上，成绩宽恕只是高校回应消费者对高等教育期望的又一方式。

2019013069.en_text: Since students and parents expect a colleges degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible — or at least appear to be.
2019013069.cn_text: 既然学生和家长期望大学学位能带来就业机会，那么培养尽可能合格的毕业生——或至少让他们看起来合格——就符合学校的最大利益。

2019013070.en_text: On this, students’ and colleges’ incentives seem to be aligned.
2019013070.cn_text: 在这一点上，学生与高校的利益诉求似乎是一致的。
