2019013096.en_text: This year marks exactly two centuries since the publication of Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, by Mary Shelley.
2019013096.cn_text: 今年恰逢玛丽·雪莱的《弗兰肯斯坦；或现代普罗米修斯》出版两百周年。

2019013097.en_text: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
2019013097.cn_text: 甚至在电灯泡发明之前,作者就创作了一部非凡的推测性小说,预示了许多尚未出现的技术将引发的伦理问题。

2019013098.en_text: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: “What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness?
2019013098.cn_text: 如今,人工智能(AI)的快速发展提出了根本性问题:「什么是智能、身份或意识?」

2019013100.en_text: What is being called artificial general intelligence, machines that would imitate the way humans think, continues to evade scientists.
2019013100.cn_text: 所谓的人工通用智能,即能够模仿人类思维方式的机器,仍然令科学家们无法企及。

2019013101.en_text: Yet humans remain fascinated by the idea of robots that would look, move, and respond like humans, similar to those recently depicted on popular sci-fi TV series such as “Westworld” and “Humans.”
2019013101.cn_text: 然而,人类仍然对机器人能够像人类一样外观、移动和反应的想法深感着迷,这些机器人类似于最近在《西部世界》和《真实的人类》等热门科幻电视剧中描绘的那样。

2019013102.en_text: Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist.
2019013102.cn_text: 斯坦福大学神经科学家大卫·伊格尔曼表示,人们究竟如何思考仍然过于复杂,无法理解,更不用说复制了。

2019013103.en_text: “We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there.”
2019013103.cn_text: 「我们只是处于一种没有好的理论来解释意识究竟是什么,以及如何能够制造出能够达到这一点的机器的境地。」

2019013104.en_text: But that doesn’t mean crucial ethical issues involving AI aren’t at hand.
2019013104.cn_text: 但这并不意味着涉及人工智能的关键伦理问题不在眼前。

2019013105.en_text: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
2019013105.cn_text: 例如,即将使用的自动驾驶汽车就提出了棘手的伦理问题。

2019013106.en_text: Human drivers sometimes must make split-second decisions.
2019013106.cn_text: 人类驾驶员有时必须做出瞬间决策。

2019013107.en_text: Their reactions may be a complex combination of instant reflexes, input from past driving experiences, and what their eyes and ears tell them in that moment.
2019013107.cn_text: 他们的反应可能是即时反射、过去驾驶经验的输入以及那一刻眼睛和耳朵告诉他们的信息的复杂组合。

2019013108.en_text: AI “vision” today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.
2019013108.cn_text: 如今,人工智能的「视觉」远不如人类的视觉精密。

2019013109.en_text: And to anticipate every imaginable driving situation is a difficult programming problem.
2019013109.cn_text: 预测每一种可以想象的驾驶情况是一个困难的编程问题。

2019013110.en_text: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, “you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions,” notes Tan Kiat How, chief executive of a Singapore-based agency that is helping the government develop a voluntary code for the ethical use of AI.
2019013110.cn_text: 新加坡一家帮助政府制定人工智能伦理使用自愿守则的机构首席执行官陈杰豪指出,每当决策基于大量数据时,「你很快就会遇到许多伦理问题」。

2019013111.en_text: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
2019013111.cn_text: 与新加坡一样,其他政府和大型企业也开始制定各自的指导方针。

2019013112.en_text: Britain is setting up a data ethics center.
2019013112.cn_text: 英国正在建立一个数据伦理中心。

2019013113.en_text: India released its AI ethics strategy this spring.
2019013113.cn_text: 印度在今年春天发布了其人工智能伦理战略。

2019013114.en_text: On June 7 Google pledged not to “design or deploy AI” that would cause “overall harm,” or to develop AI-directed weapons or use AI for surveillance that would violate international norms.
2019013114.cn_text: 6月7日,谷歌承诺不会「设计或部署」会造成「整体伤害」的人工智能,也不会开发人工智能制导武器或使用人工智能进行违反国际规范的监控。

2019013115.en_text: It also pledged not to deploy AI whose use would violate international laws or human rights.
2019013115.cn_text: 它还承诺不会部署使用时会违反国际法律或人权的人工智能。

2019013116.en_text: While the statement is vague, it represents one starting point.
2019013116.cn_text: 虽然这一声明较为模糊,但它代表了一个起点。

2019013117.en_text: So does the idea that decisions made by AI systems should be explainable, transparent, and fair.
2019013117.cn_text: 人工智能系统所做的决策应该是可解释的、透明的和公平的,这一理念也是如此。

2019013118.en_text: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity’s highest values?
2019013118.cn_text: 换句话说:我们如何确保智能机器的思维反映人类的最高价值观?

2019013119.en_text: Only then will they be useful servants and not Frankenstein’s out-of-control monster.
2019013119.cn_text: 只有这样,它们才会成为有用的仆人,而不是弗兰肯斯坦式的失控怪物。

2019013145.en_text: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
2019013145.cn_text: 根据最高法院周四作出的一项裁决，各州将能够强制更多人在网购时缴纳销售税，这将使购物者的钱包缩水，但对各州而言却是一次重大的财政胜利。

2019013146.en_text: The Supreme Court’s opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually.
2019013146.cn_text: 最高法院周四的意见推翻了两项已有数十年历史的裁决，各州称这些裁决每年令其损失数十亿美元的税收收入。

2019013147.en_text: The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
2019013147.cn_text: 这些裁决使各州更难就某些网络购物行为征收销售税。

2019013148.en_text: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer’s purchase to a state where the business didn’t have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn’t have to collect sales tax for the state.
2019013148.cn_text: 法院推翻的案件规定，如果企业将客户购买的商品运往该企业在当地没有实体机构（如仓库或办公室）的州，该企业就无需为该州代收销售税。

2019013149.en_text: Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren’t charged it, but most didn’t realize they owed it and few paid.
2019013149.cn_text: 如果客户未被收取销售税，通常需要自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数人并未意识到自己负有此义务，实际缴纳者寥寥无几。

2019013150.en_text: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.
2019013150.cn_text: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪写道，先前的裁决存在缺陷。

2019013151.en_text: “Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States,” he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.
2019013151.cn_text: 他在一份由另外四位大法官共同署名的意见书中写道：「实体存在规则每年都与经济现实越发脱节,并导致各州蒙受巨额税收损失。」

2019013152.en_text: Kennedy wrote that the rule “limited states’ ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field.”
2019013152.cn_text: 肯尼迪写道，该规则「限制了各州谋求长期繁荣的能力，并妨碍了市场参与者在公平环境中竞争」。

2019013153.en_text: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
2019013153.cn_text: 这一裁决对在多个州设有机构的大型连锁企业来说是一次胜利，因为它们通常已经在网购环节征收销售税。

2019013154.en_text: Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn’t before.
2019013154.cn_text: 如今，竞争对手也将在此前未征税的地方开始征收销售税。

2019013155.en_text: Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.
2019013155.cn_text: 大型连锁企业一直在全国范围内征收销售税，因为它们通常在商品运往的州内拥有实体店。

2019013156.en_text: Amazon.com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don’t have to.
2019013156.cn_text: 亚马逊公司凭借其遍布各地的仓库网络，也在每个征收销售税的州代收此税，但使用该平台的第三方卖家则无此义务。

2019013157.en_text: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
2019013157.cn_text: 此前，许多仅在一个州或少数几个州设有实体机构的卖家，在向这些州以外的地址发货时能够规避征收销售税。

2019013158.en_text: Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven’t been collecting sales tax nationwide.
2019013158.cn_text: 使用eBay和Etsy等为小型卖家提供平台的服务商的卖家，同样未在全国范围内征收销售税。

2019013159.en_text: Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state’s sales tax from customers and send it to the state.
2019013159.cn_text: 根据周四的裁决，各州可以通过法律要求州外卖家向客户征收该州的销售税并上缴州政府。

2019013160.en_text: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
2019013160.cn_text: 零售业贸易团体对该裁决表示赞赏，称其为本地企业与网络企业营造了公平的竞争环境。

2019013161.en_text: The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
2019013161.cn_text: 零售分析师尼尔·桑德斯表示，输家是纯线上零售商，尤其是规模较小的那些。

2019013162.en_text: Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.
2019013162.cn_text: 这些零售商可能会因遵守各州不同的销售税法而头疼不已。

2019013163.en_text: The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, “Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision.”
2019013163.cn_text: 小企业与创业委员会倡导组织在一份声明中表示：「小企业和互联网创业者完全未能从这一裁决中获益。」

2019013184.en_text: In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author ______
2019013184.cn_text: 在处理最高法院周四的裁决时，作者______

2019013185.en_text: gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences.
2019013185.cn_text: 对其进行了事实陈述并讨论了其后果

2019013186.en_text: describes the long and complicated process of its making.
2019013186.cn_text: 描述了该裁决形成的漫长而复杂的过程

2019013187.en_text: presents its main points with conflicting views on them.
2019013187.cn_text: 陈述了其要点并呈现了针对这些要点的不同观点

2019013188.en_text: cites some cases related to it and analyzes their implications.
2019013188.cn_text: 引用了一些相关案例并分析了其含义

2019013189.en_text: These tools can help you win every argument — not in the unhelpful sense of beating your opponents but in the better sense of learning about the issues that divide people, learning why they disagree with us and learning to talk and work together with them.
2019013189.cn_text: 这些工具能够帮助你赢得每一场争论——不是以击败对手这种无益的方式,而是以更好的方式去了解分歧所在,了解他们为何与我们持不同意见,并学会如何与他们对话和协作。

2019013190.en_text: If we readjust our view of arguments — from a verbal fight or tennis game to a reasoned exchange through which we all gain mutual respect and understanding — then we change the very nature of what it means to “win” an argument.
2019013190.cn_text: 如果我们重新审视对争论的看法——从口头争斗或网球比赛转变为一种理性交流,通过这种交流我们都能获得相互尊重和理解——那么我们就改变了「赢得」争论的本质含义。

2019013191.en_text: Of course, many discussions are not so successful.
2019013191.cn_text: 当然,许多讨论并非都如此成功。

2019013192.en_text: Still, we need to be careful not to accuse opponents of bad arguments too quickly.
2019013192.cn_text: 尽管如此,我们仍需谨慎,不要过快地指责对手提出了糟糕的论点。

2019013193.en_text: We need to learn how to evaluate them properly.
2019013193.cn_text: 我们需要学会如何正确评估这些论点。

2019013194.en_text: A large part of evaluation is calling out bad arguments, but we also need to admit good arguments by opponents and to apply the same critical standards to ourselves.
2019013194.cn_text: 评估的很大一部分工作是指出糟糕的论点,但我们也需要承认对手的优秀论点,并对自己适用同样的批判性标准。

2019013195.en_text: Humility requires you to recognize weaknesses in your own arguments and sometimes also to accept reasons on the opposite side.
2019013195.cn_text: 谦逊要求你认识到自己论点中的弱点,有时也要接受对立面的理由。

2019013196.en_text: None of this will be easy, but you can start even if others refuse to.
2019013196.cn_text: 这一切都并非易事,但即使他人拒绝,你也可以开始行动。

2019013197.en_text: Next time you state your position, formulate an argument for what you claim and honestly ask yourself whether your argument is any good.
2019013197.cn_text: 下次你陈述自己的立场时,为你的主张构建一个论证,并诚实地问自己这个论证是否站得住脚。

2019013198.en_text: Next time you talk with someone who takes a stand, ask them to give you a reason for their view.
2019013198.cn_text: 下次你与持有某种立场的人交谈时,请他们为自己的观点提供理由。

2019013199.en_text: Spell out their argument fully and charitably.
2019013199.cn_text: 完整而善意地阐述他们的论证。

2019013201.en_text: Raise objections and listen carefully to their replies.
2019013201.cn_text: 提出反对意见并认真倾听他们的回应。

2019013202.en_text: Carnegie would be right if arguments were fights, which is how we often think of them.
2019013202.cn_text: 如果争论是战斗,卡内基的说法就是对的,而我们通常也正是这样看待争论的。

2019013203.en_text: Like physical fights, verbal fights can leave both sides bloodied.
2019013203.cn_text: 就像身体上的打斗一样,言语上的争斗也会让双方都伤痕累累。

2019013204.en_text: Even when you win, you end up no better off.
2019013204.cn_text: 即使你赢了,你的境况也不会变得更好。

2019013205.en_text: Your prospects would be almost as dismal if arguments were even just competitions — like, say, tennis games.
2019013205.cn_text: 如果争论仅仅是竞赛——比如说网球比赛——你的前景也几乎同样黯淡。

2019013206.en_text: Pairs of opponents hit the ball back and forth until one winner emerges from all who entered.
2019013206.cn_text: 对手双方将球来回击打,直到从所有参与者中产生一位胜者。

2019013207.cn_text: 其他所有人都是失败者。

2019013208.en_text: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion.
2019013208.cn_text: 正是这种思维方式导致许多人试图回避争论,尤其是关于政治和宗教的争论。

2019013209.en_text: In his 1936 work How to Win Friends and Influence People, Dale Carnegie wrote: “There is only one way... to get the best of an argument — and that is to avoid it.” This aversion to arguments is common, but it depends on a mistaken view of arguments that causes profound problems for our personal and social lives — and in many ways misses the point of arguing in the first place.
2019013209.cn_text: 戴尔·卡内基在1936年的著作《人性的弱点》中写道:「只有一种方法能在争论中获得最佳结果——那就是避免争论。」这种对争论的反感很常见,但它建立在对争论的错误认识之上,这种认识给我们的个人和社会生活带来了深刻的问题——并且在许多方面背离了争论的初衷。

2019013210.en_text: These views of arguments also undermine reason.
2019013210.cn_text: 这些关于争论的看法也削弱了理性。

2019013211.en_text: If you see a conversation as a fight or competition, you can win by cheating as long as you don’t get caught.
2019013211.cn_text: 如果你把对话视为一场战斗或竞赛,只要不被发现,你就可以通过作弊获胜。

2019013212.en_text: You will be happy to convince people with bad arguments.
2019013212.cn_text: 你会乐于用糟糕的论点去说服他人。

2019013213.en_text: You can call their views stupid, or joke about how ignorant they are.
2019013213.cn_text: 你可以称他们的观点愚蠢,或拿他们的无知开玩笑。

2019013214.en_text: None of these tricks will help you understand them, their positions or the issues that divide you, but they can help you win — in one way.
2019013214.cn_text: 这些伎俩都无助于你理解他们、他们的立场或你们之间的分歧,但它们确实能在某种意义上帮你获胜。

2019013215.en_text: There is a better way to win arguments.
2019013215.cn_text: 有一种更好的方式来赢得争论。

2019013216.en_text: Imagine that you favor increasing the minimum wage in our state, and I do not.
2019013216.cn_text: 假设你支持提高本州的最低工资,而我反对。

2019013217.en_text: If you yell, “Yes,” and I yell, “No,” neither of us learns anything.
2019013217.cn_text: 如果你大喊「赞成」,而我大喊「反对」,我们谁都学不到任何东西。

2019013218.en_text: We neither understand nor respect each other, and we have no basis for compromise or cooperation.
2019013218.cn_text: 我们既不理解也不尊重对方,也没有妥协或合作的基础。

2019013219.en_text: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty.
2019013219.cn_text: 相反,假设你提出一个合理的论证:全职工作者不应该生活在贫困之中。

2019013220.en_text: Then I counter with another reasonable argument: that a higher minimum wage will force businesses to employ fewer people for less time.
2019013220.cn_text: 然后我提出另一个合理的论证:更高的最低工资会迫使企业雇佣更少的员工并缩短工作时间。

2019013221.en_text: Now we can understand each other’s positions and recognize our shared values, since we both care about needy workers.
2019013221.cn_text: 现在我们可以理解彼此的立场并认识到我们共同的价值观,因为我们都关心困难的劳动者。

2019013227.en_text: It was only after I started to write a weekly column about the medical journals, and began to read scientific papers from beginning to end, that I realised just how bad much of the medical literature frequently was.
2019013227.cn_text: 直到我开始撰写关于医学期刊的每周专栏，并开始从头到尾阅读科学论文时，我才意识到许多医学文献的质量之低下。

2019013228.en_text: I came to recognise various signs of a bad paper: the kind of paper that purports to show that people who eat more than one kilo of broccoli a week were 1.17 times more likely than those who eat less to suffer late in life from pernicious anaemia.
2019013228.cn_text: 我逐渐能够识别出糟糕论文的各种特征：例如那种声称每周食用超过一公斤西兰花的人比食用较少者在晚年罹患恶性贫血的可能性高出1.17倍的论文。

2019013229.en_text: There is a great deal of this kind of nonsense in the medical journals which, when taken up by broadcasters and the lay press, generates both health scares and short-lived dietary enthusiasms.
2019013229.cn_text: 医学期刊中充斥着大量此类荒谬内容，一旦被广播媒体和大众媒体采纳，便会引发健康恐慌和短暂的饮食热潮。

2019013230.en_text: Why is so much bad science published?
2019013230.cn_text: 为何会有如此多劣质科学研究被发表？

2019013231.en_text: A recent paper, titled “The Natural Selection of Bad Science”, published on the Royal Society’s open science website, attempts to answer this intriguing and important question.
2019013231.cn_text: 最近一篇题为「坏科学的自然选择」的论文发表在皇家学会开放科学网站上,试图回答这个引人入胜且重要的问题。

2019013232.en_text: It says that the problem is not merely that people do bad science, but that our current system of career advancement positively encourages it.
2019013232.cn_text: 该论文指出，问题不仅在于人们从事劣质科学研究，更在于我们当前的职业晋升体系实际上在积极鼓励这种行为。

2019013233.en_text: What is important is not truth, but publication, which has become almost an end in itself.
2019013233.cn_text: 重要的不是真理，而是发表，而发表本身几乎已成为目的。

2019013234.en_text: There has been a kind of inflationary process at work: nowadays anyone applying for a research post has to have published twice the number of papers that would have been required for the same post only 10 years ago.
2019013234.cn_text: 某种通货膨胀式的机制正在发挥作用：如今任何申请研究职位的人所需发表的论文数量是十年前同一职位要求的两倍。

2019013235.en_text: Never mind the quality, then, count the number.
2019013235.cn_text: 那么，质量无关紧要，只需计算数量。

2019013236.en_text: Attempts have been made to curb this tendency, for example, by trying to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant’s papers.
2019013236.cn_text: 人们已尝试遏制这一趋势，例如在评估申请者论文时试图将某些质量衡量标准与数量相结合。

2019013237.en_text: This is the famed citation index, that is to say the number of times a paper has been quoted elsewhere in the scientific literature, the assumption being that an important paper will be cited more often than one of small account.
2019013237.cn_text: 这便是著名的引文索引，即一篇论文在其他科学文献中被引用的次数，其假设前提是重要论文会比无足轻重的论文被更频繁地引用。

2019013238.en_text: This would be reasonable if it were not for the fact that scientists can easily arrange to cite themselves in their future publications, or get associates to do so for them in return for similar favours.
2019013238.cn_text: 这本应是合理的做法，若非科学家可以轻易安排在其未来出版物中引用自己的论文，或让同事为其这样做以换取类似回报。

2019013239.en_text: Boiling down an individual’s output to simple metrics, such as number of publications or journal impacts, entails considerable savings in time, energy and ambiguity.
2019013239.cn_text: 将个人成果简化为简单的量化指标，如论文发表数量或期刊影响力，可以大幅节省时间、精力并减少模糊性。

2019013240.en_text: Unfortunately, the long-term costs of using simple quantitative metrics to assess researcher merit are likely to be quite great.
2019013240.cn_text: 然而，使用简单量化指标评估研究人员价值的长期代价很可能相当高昂。

2019013241.en_text: If we are serious about ensuring that our science is both meaningful and reproducible, we must ensure that our institutions encourage that kind of science.
2019013241.cn_text: 如果我们真正致力于确保科学研究既有意义又具可重复性，就必须确保我们的机构鼓励这类科学研究。

2020013001.en_text: Even if families don’t sit down to eat together as frequently as before, millions of Britons will nonetheless have got a share this weekend of one of the nation’s great traditions: the Sunday roast.
2020013001.cn_text: 尽管如今家庭不再像过去那样频繁地围坐共餐，数百万英国人仍将在本周末分享这一国家传统盛事：周日烤肉大餐。

2020013002.en_text: On a cold winter’s day, few culinary pleasures can match it.
2020013002.cn_text: 在寒冬时节，鲜有美食能与之媲美。

2020013003.en_text: Yet as we report now, the food police are determined that this enjoyment should be rendered yet another guilty pleasure guaranteed to damage our health.
2020013003.cn_text: 然而正如我们此刻报道的，食品监管机构决意将这一享受归入又一项必然损害健康的「罪恶快感」。

2020013004.en_text: The Food Standards Authority (FSA) has issued a public warning about the risks of a compound called acrylamide that forms in some foods cooked at high temperatures.
2020013004.cn_text: 食品标准局（FSA）发布公众警告，指出一种名为丙烯酰胺的化合物存在风险，该物质会在某些高温烹调的食品中生成。

2020013005.en_text: This means that people should avoid crisping their roast potatoes, reject thin-crust pizzas and only partially toast their bread.
2020013005.cn_text: 这意味着人们应避免把烤土豆烤得焦脆，拒绝食用薄底披萨，且面包仅可轻度烘烤。

2020013006.en_text: But where is the evidence to support such alarmist advice?
2020013006.cn_text: 但支持这种危言耸听建议的证据究竟何在？

2020013007.en_text: While studies have shown that acrylamide can cause neurological damage in mice, there is no conclusive evidence that it causes cancer in humans.
2020013007.cn_text: 尽管研究显示丙烯酰胺可对小鼠造成神经损伤，但并无确凿证据表明其会导致人类罹患癌症。

2020013008.en_text: Scientists say the compound is likely to cause cancer but have no hard scientific proof.
2020013008.cn_text: 科学家称该化合物有致癌可能，但缺乏确凿的科学证明。

2020013009.en_text: On the basis of the precautionary principle, it could be argued that it is advisable to follow the FSA advice.
2020013009.cn_text: 基于预防原则，可以认为遵循食品标准局的建议是审慎之举。

2020013010.en_text: After all, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a connection.
2020013010.cn_text: 毕竟，吸烟致癌的传言流传多年后，才最终发现证据证实二者关联。

2020013011.en_text: Doubtless a piece of boiled beef can always be served up on Sunday alongside some steamed vegetables, without the Yorkshire pudding and no wine.
2020013011.cn_text: 毫无疑问，周日总可以端上一块水煮牛肉配些清蒸蔬菜，不要约克郡布丁，也不配葡萄酒。

2020013012.en_text: But would life be worth living?
2020013012.cn_text: 但这样的生活还值得过吗？

2020013013.en_text: To be fair, the FSA says it is not telling people to cut out roast foods entirely, but to reduce their lifetime intake.
2020013013.cn_text: 公允地说，食品标准局表示并非要求人们彻底戒除烤制食品，而是减少终生摄入量。

2020013014.en_text: However, its campaign risks coming across as being pushy and overprotective.
2020013014.cn_text: 然而，其宣传活动有显得过于强势和过度保护之虞。

2020013015.en_text: Constant health scares just end up with no one listening.
2020013015.cn_text: 持续不断的健康恐慌最终只会导致无人理睬。

2020013016.en_text: A group of Labour MPs, among them Yvette Cooper, are bringing in the new year with a call to institute a UK “town of culture” award.
2020013016.cn_text: 一群工党议员,其中包括伊薇特·库珀,在新年之际呼吁设立英国「文化小镇」奖项。

2020013017.en_text: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
2020013017.cn_text: 该提议是让这一奖项与现有的「文化之城」称号并列,后者曾于2017年由赫尔市获得,并已授予考文垂市用于2021年。

2020013018.en_text: Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.
2020013018.cn_text: 库珀及其同事认为,赫尔市获此殊荣所取得的成功——带来了2.2亿英镑的投资和艺术活动的蓬勃发展——不应仅限于城市。

2020013019.en_text: Britain’s towns, it is true, are not prevented from applying, but they generally lack the resources to put together a bid to beat their bigger competitors.
2020013019.cn_text: 英国的小镇确实并未被禁止申请,但它们通常缺乏资源来组织一份能够击败更大竞争对手的申请方案。

2020013020.en_text: A town of culture award could, it is argued, become an annual event, attracting funding and creating jobs.
2020013020.cn_text: 据称,文化小镇奖可以成为年度活动,吸引资金并创造就业机会。

2020013021.en_text: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a soughtafter award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008.
2020013021.cn_text: 有人可能将这一提议视为一种安慰奖,因为英国已无法再申请更具声望的欧洲文化之都头衔——这一备受追捧的奖项曾被格拉斯哥(1990年)和利物浦(2008年)摘得。

2020013022.en_text: A cynic might speculate that the UK is on the verge of disappearing into an endless fever of self-celebration in its desperation to reinvent itself for the post-Brexit world: after town of culture, who knows what will follow — village of culture?
2020013022.cn_text: 悲观者可能会推测,英国正处于陷入无休止的自我庆祝狂热之中的边缘,急于在后脱欧时代重塑自我:继文化小镇之后,谁知道接下来会是什么——文化村庄?

2020013025.en_text: It is also wise to recall that such titles are not a cure-all.
2020013025.cn_text: 同样明智的是要记住,此类头衔并非万能良方。

2020013026.en_text: A badly run “year of culture” washes in and out of a place like the tide, bringing prominence for a spell but leaving no lasting benefits to the community.
2020013026.cn_text: 一个管理不善的「文化年」如潮水般涌入又退出一个地方,带来短暂的知名度,却未能为社区留下任何持久的益处。

2020013027.en_text: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
2020013027.cn_text: 真正成功获得此类头衔的,是那些所作所为远不止填满酒店客房、引入高端艺术活动以及赢得一年好评的地方。

2020013028.en_text: They transform the aspirations of the people who live there; they nudge the self-image of the city into a bolder and more optimistic light.
2020013028.cn_text: 它们改变了当地居民的愿景;它们将城市的自我形象推向更加大胆和乐观的境地。

2020013029.en_text: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector, community groups and cultural organisations.
2020013029.cn_text: 这很难做到,需要非凡的远见,以及市政当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的通力合作。

2020013030.en_text: But it can be done: Glasgow’s year as European capital of culture can certainly be seen as one of a complex series of factors that have turned the city into the powerhouse of art, music and theatre that it remains today.
2020013030.cn_text: 但这是可以做到的:格拉斯哥作为欧洲文化之都的那一年,无疑可以被视为一系列复杂因素之一,这些因素使该市成为至今仍然是艺术、音乐和戏剧重镇的动力源泉。

2020013031.en_text: A “town of culture” could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town’s peculiarities — helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
2020013031.cn_text: 「文化小镇」不仅可以关乎艺术,还可以关乎尊重小镇的独特性——帮助维持其商业街,支持当地设施,最重要的是赞颂其居民。

2020013032.en_text: Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive hope-filled proposal, and turn it into action.
2020013032.cn_text: 文化大臣杰里米·赖特应欢迎这一充满希望的积极提议,并将其付诸行动。

2020013033.en_text: Cooper and her colleagues argue that a “town of culture” award could ____
2020013033.cn_text: 库珀及其同事认为,「文化小镇」奖可以____

2020013034.en_text: consolidate the town-city ties in Britain.
2020013034.cn_text: 巩固英国城镇与城市之间的联系。

2020013035.cn_text: 促进英国城镇之间的合作。

2020013036.en_text: increase the economic strength of Britain’s towns.
2020013036.cn_text: 增强英国城镇的经济实力。

2020013037.en_text: focus Britain’s limited resources on cultural events.
2020013037.cn_text: 将英国有限的资源集中于文化活动。

2020013038.en_text: According to Paragraph 2, the proposal might be regarded by some as ____
2020013038.cn_text: 根据第二段,该提议可能会被一些人视为____

2020013041.cn_text: 一种引人注目的额外奖赏。

2020013043.en_text: The author suggests that a title holder is successful only if it ____
2020013043.cn_text: 作者认为,头衔获得者只有在____时才算成功。

2020013045.en_text: meets the aspirations of its people.

2020013046.en_text: brings its local arts to prominence.
2020013046.cn_text: 使其地方艺术获得突出地位。

2020013048.en_text: Glasgow is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to present ____
2020013048.cn_text: 第三段提到格拉斯哥是为了呈现____

2020013053.en_text: What is the author’s attitude towards the proposal?
2020013053.cn_text: 作者对该提议持何态度?

2020013058.en_text: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money.
2020013058.cn_text: 科学出版长期以来一直是一种印钞许可证。

2020013059.en_text: Scientists need journals in which to publish their research, so they will supply the articles without monetary reward.
2020013059.cn_text: 科学家需要期刊来发表研究成果，因此他们会无偿提供文章。

2020013060.en_text: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
2020013060.cn_text: 其他科学家也免费进行同行评审这一专业工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心环节。

2020013061.en_text: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only to find a market for its journal.
2020013061.cn_text: 由于论文内容可免费获取，出版商只需为其期刊寻找市场。

2020013062.en_text: Until this century, university libraries were not very price sensitive.
2020013062.cn_text: 直到本世纪，大学图书馆对价格都不太敏感。

2020013063.en_text: Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations, at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.
2020013063.cn_text: 科学出版商常规性地报告其运营利润率接近40%，而此时出版业的其他领域正处于生存危机之中。

2020013064.en_text: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
2020013064.cn_text: 荷兰巨头爱思唯尔声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年盈利超过9亿英镑，而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，使研究人员能够访问他们自己由公共资金资助的研究成果；尽管各方越来越迫切地试图改变这种状况,这两个数字似乎仍在不可阻挡地上升。

2020013065.en_text: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of SciHub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
2020013065.cn_text: 最激烈且完全非法的反应是Sci-Hub的出现，这是一个全球性的科学论文复制平台，成立于2012年，目前声称可以提供自2015年以来发表的所有付费墙文章的访问权限。

2020013066.en_text: The success of Sci-Hub, which relies on researchers passing on copies they have themselves legally accessed, shows the legal ecosystem has lost legitimacy among its users and must be transformed so that it works for all participants.
2020013066.cn_text: Sci-Hub的成功依赖于研究人员传递他们自己合法获取的论文副本，这表明现有法律生态系统在其用户中已失去合法性，必须进行变革以使其服务于所有参与者。

2020013067.en_text: In Britain the move towards open access publishing has been driven by funding bodies.
2020013067.cn_text: 在英国，向开放获取出版转型的举措是由资助机构推动的。

2020013068.en_text: In some ways it has been very successful.
2020013068.cn_text: 在某些方面它取得了很大成功。

2020013069.en_text: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.
2020013069.cn_text: 目前超过半数的英国科学研究是以开放获取条款发表的：要么从发表之时起即可免费获取，要么设置一年或更长时间的付费墙，以便出版商在公开发布前获取利润。

2020013070.en_text: Yet the new system has not worked out any cheaper for the universities.
2020013070.cn_text: 然而，新系统对大学而言并未降低成本。

2020013071.en_text: Publishers have responded to the demand that they make their product free to readers by charging their writers fees to cover the costs of preparing an article.
2020013071.cn_text: 出版商通过向作者收取费用以支付文章准备成本，来回应让其产品对读者免费的要求。

2020013072.cn_text: 这些费用从约500英镑到5000美元不等。

2020013073.en_text: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these “article preparation costs” had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation.
2020013073.cn_text: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费用和这些「文章准备费用」都在以高于通货膨胀率的速度稳步上涨。

2020013074.en_text: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
2020013074.cn_text: 在某些方面,科学出版模式类似于社交互联网经济：劳动免费提供以换取获得地位的希望，而巨额利润则由少数几家经营市场平台的大型公司获取。

2020013075.en_text: In both cases, we need a rebalancing of power.
2020013075.cn_text: 在这两种情况下，我们都需要权力的重新平衡。

2020013076.cn_text: 科学出版被视为「印钞许可证」，部分原因是____

2020013077.en_text: its funding has enjoyed a steady increase.
2020013077.cn_text: 其资金获得了稳定增长。

2020013078.en_text: its marketing strategy has been successful.

2020013079.en_text: its payment for peer review is reduced.
2020013079.cn_text: 其对同行评审的支付减少了。

2020013081.en_text: According to Paragraphs 2 and 3, scientific publishers like Elsevier have ____
2020013081.cn_text: 根据第2段和第3段，像爱思唯尔这样的科学出版商____

2020013082.cn_text: 主要依靠大学图书馆而兴旺发展。

2020013085.cn_text: 慷慨地资助了研究人员。

2020013086.cn_text: 作者对Sci-Hub的成功持何态度？

2020013091.cn_text: 从第5段和第6段可以得知，开放获取条款____

2020013092.en_text: allow publishers some room to make money.
2020013092.cn_text: 给出版商留出了一定的盈利空间。

2020013093.cn_text: 使科学家发表论文更加容易。

2020013095.cn_text: 使大学摆脱了财政负担。

2020013096.en_text: Which of the following characterises the scientific publishing model?
2020013096.cn_text: 以下哪项是科学出版模式的特征？

2020013100.en_text: The few feed on the many.

2020013101.en_text: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
2020013101.cn_text: 进步主义者通常支持多样性强制规定，将其视为通往平等和公平竞争环境的途径。

2020013102.en_text: But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
2020013102.cn_text: 但此类政策往往只是一种虚伪的美德信号展示，仅惠及最具特权的阶层，对普通民众几无帮助。

2020013103.en_text: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure “gender parity” on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.
2020013103.cn_text: 马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德共同提出的两项法案，旨在确保董事会和委员会的「性别均等」，正是一个典型例证。

2020013104.en_text: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female.
2020013104.cn_text: 哈达德和刘易斯担忧的是，超过半数的州政府董事会女性比例不足40%。

2020013105.en_text: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
2020013105.cn_text: 为确保精英女性获得更多此类机会,他们提议实施政府配额制度。

2020013106.en_text: If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
2020013106.cn_text: 若该法案获得通过，州政府董事会和委员会将被要求在2022年前为女性预留50%的席位。

2020013107.en_text: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
2020013107.cn_text: 该法案与加利福尼亚州近期通过的一项措施相似，后者于去年成为首个要求私营企业实行性别配额的州。

2020013108.en_text: In signing the measure, California’s Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
2020013108.cn_text: 在签署该措施时，加州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确以性别为依据对人员进行分类的法律可能违宪。

2020013109.en_text: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an “important” policy interest.
2020013109.cn_text: 美国最高法院对基于性别的分类持反对态度，除非此类分类旨在服务于「重要的」政策利益。

2020013110.en_text: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of “equal protection”.
2020013110.cn_text: 由于加州法律适用于所有董事会，即便在没有既往歧视历史的情况下，法院很可能裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的「平等保护」原则。

2020013111.en_text: But are such government mandates even necessary?
2020013111.cn_text: 但此类政府强制措施真有必要吗？

2020013112.en_text: Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
2020013112.cn_text: 企业董事会中女性的参与度或许目前尚未反映出女性在总人口中的比例，但那又如何？

2020013113.en_text: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference.
2020013113.cn_text: 在没有政府干预的情况下，企业董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步增长。

2020013114.en_text: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
2020013114.cn_text: 根据Catalyst的一项研究，2010年至2015年间，全球企业董事会中女性所占比例增长了54%。

2020013115.en_text: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
2020013115.cn_text: 要求企业将性别作为董事会成员资格的首要条件，必然会导致私营部门董事会经验匮乏。

2020013116.en_text: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
2020013116.cn_text: 挪威实施全国性企业性别配额制时正是如此。

2020013117.en_text: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a “golden skirt” phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
2020013117.cn_text: 艾丽斯·李在《新共和》杂志撰文指出，在不扩大合格女性人才库的情况下增加董事会席位机会，导致了「金色裙装」现象，即同一批精英女性在多个董事会中占据多个席位。

2020013118.en_text: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
2020013118.cn_text: 下次有人将企业配额作为促进性别平等的手段加以推动时，请记住，此类政策主要是自利性措施，虽能让发起者感觉良好，却对普通女性几无裨益。

2020013144.en_text: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
2020013144.cn_text: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税法案，该法案将对在法国向消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收一种全新的税种。

2020013145.en_text: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
2020013145.cn_text: 数字服务涵盖从提供在线商品和服务销售平台到基于用户数据进行精准广告投放的所有内容，该税种适用于此类服务产生的总收入。

2020013146.en_text: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a “GAFA tax,” meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon — in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
2020013146.cn_text: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将其称为「GAFA税」，意指该税主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司——换言之，即总部设在美国的跨国科技企业。

2020013147.en_text: The digital services tax now awaits the signature of President Emmanuel Macron, who has expressed support for the measure, and it could go into effect within the next few weeks.
2020013147.cn_text: 数字服务税目前正等待总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙签署，他已表示支持该措施，该税可能在未来几周内生效。

2020013148.en_text: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
2020013148.cn_text: 但该税已引发重大争议，美国贸易代表正在调查该税是否歧视美国企业，这反过来可能导致对法国实施贸易制裁。

2020013149.en_text: The French tax is not just a unilateral move by one country in need of revenue.
2020013149.cn_text: 法国此次征税并非一个急需收入的国家采取的单边行动。

2020013150.en_text: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
2020013150.cn_text: 相反，数字服务税是更大趋势的一部分，过去几年各国提出或实施了名目繁多的新国际税收条款。

2020013151.en_text: These have included Britain’s DPT (diverted profits tax), Australia’s MAAL (multinational antiavoidance law), and India’s SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.
2020013151.cn_text: 这些包括英国的DPT（利润转移税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国反避税法）以及印度的SEP（重大经济存在）测试等，不一而足。

2020013152.en_text: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
2020013152.cn_text: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国和其他几个国家也都在认真考虑开征数字服务税。

2020013153.en_text: These unilateral developments differ in their specifics, but they are all designed to tax multinationals on income and revenue that countries believe they should have a right to tax, even if international tax rules do not grant them that right.
2020013153.cn_text: 这些单边举措在具体细节上各有不同，但其共同目的都是对跨国公司在各国认为有权征税的收入和收益征税，即便国际税收规则并未赋予它们这一权利。

2020013154.en_text: In other words, they all share a view that the international tax system has failed to keep up with the current economy.
2020013154.cn_text: 换言之，它们都认为国际税收体系未能跟上当前经济的发展步伐。

2020013155.en_text: In response to these many unilateral measures, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) is currently working with 131 countries to reach a consensus by the end of 2020 on an international solution.
2020013155.cn_text: 为应对这些众多的单边措施，经济合作与发展组织（OECD）目前正与131个国家合作，力争在2020年底前就国际解决方案达成共识。

2020013156.en_text: Both France and the United States are involved in the organization’s work, but France’s digital services tax and the American response raise questions about what the future holds for the international tax system.
2020013156.cn_text: 法国和美国均参与了该组织的工作，但法国的数字服务税及美国的反应引发了关于国际税收体系未来走向的疑问。

2020013157.en_text: France’s planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit, and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
2020013157.cn_text: 法国拟征的税收是一个明确警示：除非在改革国际税收体系方面达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能效仿，美国企业将面临来自数十个国家的各种税收，这将是繁重且代价高昂的。

2020013183.en_text: In a social situation, eye contact with another person can show that you are paying attention in a friendly way.
2020013183.cn_text: 在社交场合中，与他人进行眼神接触可以表明你正以友好的方式关注对方。

2020013184.en_text: But it can also be antagonistic, such as when a political candidate turns toward their competitor during a debate and makes eye contact that signals hostility.
2020013184.cn_text: 但眼神接触也可能带有对抗性，比如政治候选人在辩论中转向对手，用眼神传递出敌意。

2020013185.en_text: Here’s what hard science reveals about eye contact:
2020013185.cn_text: 以下是严谨的科学研究揭示的关于眼神接触的事实：

2020013187.en_text: We know that a typical infant will instinctively gaze into its mother’s eyes, and she will look back.
2020013187.cn_text: 我们知道，典型的婴儿会本能地凝视母亲的眼睛，而母亲也会回望婴儿。

2020013188.en_text: This mutual gaze is a major part of the attachment between mother and child.
2020013188.cn_text: 这种相互凝视是母子依附关系的重要组成部分。

2020013189.en_text: In adulthood, looking at someone else in a pleasant way can be a complimentary sign of paying attention.
2020013189.cn_text: 成年后，以愉悦的方式注视他人可以是一种表示关注的赞许信号。

2020013190.en_text: It can catch someone’s attention in a crowded room. “Eye contact and smiles” can signal availability and confidence, a common-sense notion supported in studies by psychologist Monica Moore.
2020013190.cn_text: 它能在拥挤的房间里吸引某人的注意。心理学家莫妮卡·摩尔的研究支持了这样一种常识性观点：「眼神接触与微笑」可以传递出可接近性与自信。

2020013192.en_text: Neuroscientist Bonnie Auyeung found that the hormone oxytocin increased the amount of eye contact from men toward the interviewer during a brief interview when the direction of their gaze was recorded.
2020013192.cn_text: 神经科学家邦妮·奥扬发现，在一次简短的面试中，通过记录受试者的注视方向证实，催产素激素增加了男性对面试官的眼神接触量。

2020013193.en_text: This was also found in high-functioning men with some autistic spectrum symptoms, who may tend to avoid eye contact.
2020013193.cn_text: 这一现象在一些具有自闭症谱系症状、可能倾向于回避眼神接触的高功能男性中同样得到证实。

2020013194.en_text: Specific brain regions that respond during direct gaze are being explored by other researchers, using advanced methods of brain scanning.
2020013194.cn_text: 其他研究人员正利用先进的脑部扫描方法，探索在直接注视时做出反应的特定脑区。

2020013196.en_text: With the use of eye-tracking technology, Julia Minson of the Harvard Kennedy School of Government concluded that eye contact can signal very different kinds of messages, depending on the situation.
2020013196.cn_text: 借助眼动追踪技术，哈佛大学肯尼迪政府学院的朱莉娅·明森得出结论：眼神接触可能传递出截然不同的信息，这取决于具体情境。

2020013197.en_text: While eye contact may be a sign of connection or trust in friendly situations, it’s more likely to be associated with dominance or intimidation in adversarial situations. “Whether you’re a politician or a parent, it might be helpful to keep in mind that trying to maintain eye contact may backfire if you’re trying to convince someone who has a different set of beliefs than you,” said Minson.
2020013197.cn_text: 在友好情境中，眼神接触或许是联系与信任的标志，但在对抗性情境中，它更可能与支配或恐吓相关联。明森说：「无论你是政治家还是父母，都应记住，若想说服一个信念与你不同的人，一味保持眼神接触可能会适得其反。」

2020013199.en_text: When we look at a face or a picture, our eyes pause on one spot at a time, often on the eyes or mouth.
2020013199.cn_text: 当我们注视一张脸或一幅图像时，视线每次只会停留在一个点上，通常是眼睛或嘴巴。

2020013200.en_text: These pauses typically occur at about three per second, and the eyes then jump to another spot, until several important points in the image are registered like a series of snapshots.
2020013200.cn_text: 这种停顿通常每秒发生约三次，随后视线跳向另一个点，直至图像中若干重要部位如同一系列快照般被依次捕捉。

2020013201.en_text: How the whole image is then assembled and perceived is still a mystery although it is the subject of current research.
2020013201.cn_text: 尽管这是当前研究的热门课题，但整幅图像究竟如何被整合与感知，至今仍是未解之谜。

2020013203.en_text: In people who score high in a test of neuroticism, a personality dimension associated with self-consciousness and anxiety, eye contact triggered more activity associated with avoidance, according to the Finnish researcher Jari Hietanen and colleagues. “Our findings indicate that people do not only feel different when they are the centre of attention but that their brain reactions also differ.”
2020013203.cn_text: 芬兰研究者贾里·希耶塔宁及其同事发现，在神经质测试中得分较高的人——神经质是一种与自我意识和焦虑相关的人格维度——眼神接触会触发更多与回避相关的脑部活动。「我们的研究结果表明，当人们成为关注焦点时，不仅主观感受不同，其大脑反应也存在差异。」

2020013204.en_text: A more direct finding is that people who scored high for negative emotions like anxiety looked at others for shorter periods of time and reported more comfortable feelings when others did not look directly at them.
2020013204.cn_text: 一项更为直接的发现是，那些在焦虑等负面情绪维度上得分较高的人，注视他人的时间更短，而当他人未直视自己时，他们反而感到更为舒适。

2020013206.en_text: Too much eye contact is instinctively felt to be rude.
2020013206.cn_text: 人们本能地认为过多的眼神接触是无礼的。

2020013207.en_text: Eye contact can be a friendly social signal.
2020013207.cn_text: 眼神接触可以是一种友好的社交信号。

2020013208.en_text: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact.
2020013208.cn_text: 人格特质会影响一个人对眼神接触的反应方式。

2020013209.en_text: Biological factors behind eye contact are being investigated.
2020013209.cn_text: 眼神接触背后的生物学因素正在被深入研究。

2020013210.en_text: Most people are not comfortable holding eye contact with strangers.
2020013210.cn_text: 大多数人并不习惯与陌生人长时间保持眼神接触。

2020013211.cn_text: 眼神接触也可能带有攻击性。

2020013217.en_text: Following the explosion of creativity in Florence during the 14th century Known as the Renaissance, the modem world saw a departure from what it had once known.
2020013217.cn_text: 随着14世纪佛罗伦萨被称为文艺复兴的创造力迸发，现代世界开始脱离其曾经熟知的一切。

2020013218.en_text: It turned from God and the authority of the Roman Catholic Church and instead favoured a more humanistic approach to being.
2020013218.cn_text: 它不再信奉上帝和罗马天主教会的权威，转而倾向于一种更加人文主义的存在方式。

2020013219.en_text: Renaissance ideas had spread throughout Europe well into the 17th century, with the arts and sciences flourishing extraordinarily among those with a more logical disposition.
2020013219.cn_text: 文艺复兴思想在整个欧洲传播开来，一直延续到17世纪，艺术和科学在那些更具逻辑倾向的人群中呈现出异常繁荣的景象。

2020013220.en_text: With the Church’s teachings and ways of thinking being eclipsed by the Renaissance, the gap between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged, leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories.
2020013220.cn_text: 随着教会的教义和思维方式被文艺复兴所取代，中世纪与现代时期之间的鸿沟得以弥合，从而通向了新的、未经探索的知识领域。

2020013221.en_text: During the Renaissance, the great minds of Nicolaus Copernicus, Johannes Kepler and Galileo Galilei demonstrated the power of scientific study and discovery.
2020013221.cn_text: 在文艺复兴时期,尼古拉·哥白尼、约翰内斯·开普勒和伽利略·伽利莱等伟大的思想家展示了科学研究和发现的力量。

2020013222.en_text: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.
2020013222.cn_text: 在他们每次揭示真相之前，当时的许多思想家仍秉持更为古老的思维方式，包括认为地球位于宇宙中心的地心说。

2020013223.en_text: Copernicus theorized in 1543 that in actual fact, all of the planets that we knew of revolved not around the Earth, but the Sun, a system that was later upheld by Galileo at his own expense.
2020013223.cn_text: 哥白尼在1543年提出理论，认为实际上我们所知的所有行星并非围绕地球旋转，而是围绕太阳旋转，这一体系后来由伽利略不惜代价予以支持。

2020013224.en_text: Offering up such a theory during a time of high tension between scientific and religious minds was branded as heresy, and any such heretics that continued to spread these lies were to be punished by imprisonment or even death.
2020013224.cn_text: 在科学与宗教思想高度紧张的时期提出这样的理论被斥为异端，任何继续传播这些「谎言」的异端分子都将受到监禁甚至处死的惩罚。

2020013225.en_text: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore.
2020013225.cn_text: 尽管教会试图压制这一代新的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙如何运行的更多解释正以人们无法再忽视的速度涌现。

2020013226.en_text: It was with these great revelations that a new kind of philosophy founded in reason was born.
2020013226.cn_text: 正是伴随这些伟大的发现，一种建立在理性基础上的新型哲学诞生了。

2020013227.en_text: The Church’s long-standing dogma was losing the great battle for truth to rationalists and scientists.
2020013227.cn_text: 教会长期坚守的教条正在关于真理的伟大较量中败给理性主义者和科学家。

2020013228.en_text: This very fact embodied the new ways of thinking that swept through Europe during most of the 17th century.
2020013228.cn_text: 这一事实本身体现了17世纪大部分时期席卷欧洲的新思维方式。

2020013229.en_text: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era — the Age of Reason.
2020013229.cn_text: 随着许多人承担起将理性和科学哲学融入世界的使命，文艺复兴结束了，一个新的时代——理性时代——到来了。

2020013230.en_text: The 17th and 18th centuries were times of radical change and curiosity.
2020013230.cn_text: 17世纪和18世纪是充满剧变和好奇心的时代。

2020013231.en_text: Scientific method, reductionism and the questioning of Church ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance and progress.
2020013231.cn_text: 科学方法、还原论以及对教会理念的质疑应当受到鼓励，自由、宽容和进步的思想也应如此。

2020013232.en_text: Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already knew were captured by the Latin phrase “sapere aude” or “dare to know”, after Immanuel Kant used it in his essay “An Answer to the Question: What is Enlightenment?”.
2020013232.cn_text: 这些寻求知识并理解我们已知信息的行为被拉丁短语「sapere aude」即「敢于求知」所概括，这一短语由伊曼努尔·康德在其论文《何谓启蒙》中使用。

2020013233.en_text: It was the purpose and responsibility of great minds to go forth and seek out the truth, which they believed to be founded in knowledge.
2020013233.cn_text: 伟大思想家的使命和责任是去探求真理，他们相信真理根植于知识之中。

2021013001.en_text: Fluid intelligence is the type of intelligence that has to do with short-term memory and the ability to think quickly, logically, and abstractly in order to solve new problems.
2021013001.cn_text: 流体智力是一种与短期记忆以及快速、逻辑性和抽象性思维能力相关的智力类型，用于解决新问题。

2021013002.en_text: It peaks in young adulthood, levels out for a period of time, and then generally starts to slowly decline as we age.
2021013002.cn_text: 它在成年早期达到顶峰,在一段时间内保持平稳,然后通常随着年龄增长而开始缓慢下降。

2021013003.en_text: But while aging is inevitable, scientists are finding out that certain changes in brain function may not be.
2021013003.cn_text: 但是,尽管衰老不可避免,科学家们发现大脑功能的某些变化可能并非不可避免。

2021013004.en_text: One study found that muscle loss and the accumulation of body fat around the abdomen are associated with a decline in fluid intelligence.
2021013004.cn_text: 一项研究发现,肌肉流失和腹部脂肪堆积与流体智力下降相关。

2021013005.en_text: This suggests the possibility that lifestyle factors might help prevent or delay this type of decline.
2021013005.cn_text: 这表明生活方式因素可能有助于预防或延缓这种衰退。

2021013006.en_text: The researchers looked at data that included measurements of lean muscle and abdominal fat from more than 4,000 middle-to-older-aged men and women and compared that data to reported changes in fluid intelligence over a six-year period.
2021013006.cn_text: 研究人员查看了包含4000多名中老年男性和女性的瘦肌肉量和腹部脂肪测量数据,并将这些数据与六年期间流体智力变化的报告进行了比较。

2021013007.en_text: They found that middle-aged people with higher measures of abdominal fat scored worse on measures of fluid intelligence as the years went by.
2021013007.cn_text: 他们发现,腹部脂肪测量值较高的中年人在流体智力测量中的得分随着时间推移而变差。

2021013008.en_text: For women, the association may be attributable to changes in immunity that resulted from excess abdominal fat; in men, the immune system did not appear to be involved.
2021013008.cn_text: 对于女性,这种关联可能归因于过量腹部脂肪导致的免疫变化;对于男性,免疫系统似乎并未参与其中。

2021013009.en_text: It is hoped that future studies could explain these differences and perhaps lead to different treatments for men and women.
2021013009.cn_text: 希望未来的研究能够解释这些差异,并可能为男性和女性制定不同的治疗方案。

2021013010.en_text: Meanwhile, there are steps you can take to help reduce abdominal fat and maintain lean muscle mass as you age in order to protect both your physical and mental wellbeing.
2021013010.cn_text: 与此同时,你可以采取一些措施来帮助减少腹部脂肪并在衰老过程中保持瘦肌肉量,从而保护你的身心健康。

2021013011.en_text: The two highly recommended lifestyle approaches are maintaining or increasing your level of aerobic exercise and following a Mediterranean-style diet that is high in fiber and eliminates highly processed foods.
2021013011.cn_text: 两种强烈推荐的生活方式是保持或增加有氧运动水平,以及遵循富含纤维且剔除高度加工食品的地中海式饮食。

2021013012.en_text: How can Britain’s train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
2021013012.cn_text: 英国的铁路运营商如何能为再次上调铁路客运票价找到合理依据？

2021013013.en_text: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
2021013013.cn_text: 这已成为一项令人沮丧却又极为可靠的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择只能依靠铁路网络上班或出行的人群增添了沉重的额外负担。

2021013014.en_text: This year’s rise, an average of 2.7 percent, may be a fraction lower than last year’s, but it is still well above the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) measure of inflation.
2021013014.cn_text: 今年平均2.7%的涨幅虽略低于去年，但仍远高于官方消费者价格指数（CPI）所衡量的通胀水平。

2021013015.en_text: Successive governments have permitted such increases on the grounds that the cost of investing in and running the rail network should be borne by those who use it, rather than the general taxpayer.
2021013015.cn_text: 历届政府允许此类涨价的理由是，铁路网络的投资和运营成本应由使用者承担，而非全体纳税人负担。

2021013016.en_text: Why, the argument goes, should a car-driving pensioner from Lincolnshire have to subsidise the daily commute of a stockbroker from Surrey?
2021013016.cn_text: 按照这种论调，为什么一位来自林肯郡的开车退休老人要为一位来自萨里郡的股票经纪人的日常通勤买单？

2021013017.en_text: Equally, there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
2021013017.cn_text: 同样，人们也认为，东南部通勤者的困境——其中许多人将面临最大幅度的涨价——相比那些必须忍受中部和北部地区相对落后基础设施的人，得到了过多的关注。

2021013018.en_text: However, over the past 12 months, those commuters have also experienced some of the worst rail strikes in years.
2021013018.cn_text: 然而，在过去12个月中，这些通勤者也经历了多年来最为严重的铁路罢工。

2021013019.en_text: It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.
2021013019.cn_text: 铁路运营商大肆宣扬其对铁路网络的改进固然不错，但乘客理应期待获得基本水平的服务，因为他们如今为出行支付了可观的费用。

2021013020.en_text: The responsibility for the latest wave of strikes rests on the unions.
2021013020.cn_text: 最近这波罢工的责任在于工会。

2021013021.en_text: However, there is a strong case that those who have been worst affected by industrial action should receive compensation for the disruption they have suffered.
2021013021.cn_text: 然而，有充分理由表明，那些受罢工影响最严重的人应就其所遭受的干扰获得补偿。

2021013022.en_text: The Government has pledged to change the law to introduce a minimum service requirement so that, even when strikes occur, services can continue to operate.
2021013022.cn_text: 政府已承诺修改法律以引入最低服务要求，以便即便发生罢工，服务也能继续运转。

2021013023.en_text: This should form part of a wider package of measures to address the long-running problems on Britain’s railways.
2021013023.cn_text: 这应当成为解决英国铁路长期问题的更广泛一揽子措施的组成部分。

2021013024.en_text: Yes, more investment is needed, but passengers will not be willing to pay more indefinitely if they must also endure cramped, unreliable services, interrupted by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently.
2021013024.cn_text: 诚然，需要更多投资，但如果乘客还必须忍受拥挤、不可靠的服务，以及时刻表变更时的频繁混乱，或计划维护管理不善带来的问题，他们就不会无限期地愿意支付更多费用。

2021013025.en_text: The threat of nationalisation may have been seen off for now, but it will return with a vengeance if the justified anger of passengers is not addressed in short order.
2021013025.cn_text: 国有化的威胁目前或许已被化解，但若不尽快解决乘客的合理愤怒，它将以更猛烈的方式卷土重来。

2021013046.en_text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
2021013046.cn_text: 以下哪项最适合作为本文的标题？

2021013047.en_text: Who Are to Blame for the Strikes?

2021013050.cn_text: 票价持续上涨难以为继

2021013051.en_text: Last year marked the third year in a row that Indonesia’s bleak rate of deforestation has slowed in pace.
2021013051.cn_text: 去年是印度尼西亚严峻的森林砍伐速度连续第三年放缓。

2021013052.en_text: One reason for the turnaround may be the country’s antipoverty program.
2021013052.cn_text: 这一转变的一个原因可能是该国的扶贫计划。

2021013053.en_text: In 2007, Indonesia started phasing in a program that gives money to its poorest residents under certain conditions, such as requiring people to keep kids in school or get regular medical care.
2021013053.cn_text: 2007年，印度尼西亚开始逐步实施一项计划，在特定条件下向最贫困的居民提供资金，例如要求人们让孩子上学或定期接受医疗护理。

2021013054.en_text: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
2021013054.cn_text: 这些被称为有条件现金转移支付或CCT的社会援助计划旨在减少不平等并打破贫困循环。

2021013055.en_text: They’re already used in dozens of countries worldwide.
2021013055.cn_text: 它们已在全球数十个国家得到使用。

2021013056.en_text: In Indonesia, the program has provided enough food and medicine to substantially reduce severe growth problems among children.
2021013056.cn_text: 在印度尼西亚，该计划提供了足够的食物和药品，从而显著减少了儿童的严重生长问题。

2021013057.en_text: But CCT programs don’t generally consider effects on the environment.
2021013057.cn_text: 但是，CCT计划通常不考虑对环境的影响。

2021013058.en_text: In fact, poverty alleviation and environmental protection are often viewed as conflicting goals, says Paul Ferraro, an economist at Johns Hopkins University.
2021013058.cn_text: 事实上，约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的经济学家保罗·费拉罗表示，扶贫与环境保护通常被视为相互冲突的目标。

2021013059.en_text: That’s because economic growth can be correlated with environmental degradation, while protecting the environment is sometimes correlated with greater poverty.
2021013059.cn_text: 这是因为经济增长可能与环境恶化相关联，而保护环境有时与更严重的贫困相关联。

2021013060.en_text: However, those correlations don’t prove cause and effect.
2021013060.cn_text: 然而，这些相关性并不能证明因果关系。

2021013061.en_text: The only previous study analyzing causality, based on an area in Mexico that had instituted CCTs, supported the traditional view.
2021013061.cn_text: 此前唯一一项分析因果关系的研究基于墨西哥一个实施了CCT的地区，该研究支持传统观点。

2021013062.en_text: There, as people got more money, some of them may have more cleared land for cattle to raise for meat, Ferraro says.
2021013062.cn_text: 费拉罗说，在那里，随着人们获得更多收入，他们中的一些人可能清理了更多土地来养牛以生产肉类。

2021013063.en_text: Such programs do not have to negatively affect the environment, though.
2021013063.cn_text: 然而，此类计划并不一定会对环境产生负面影响。

2021013064.en_text: Ferraro wanted to see if Indonesia’s poverty-alleviation program was affecting deforestation.
2021013064.cn_text: 费拉罗想了解印度尼西亚的扶贫计划是否正在影响森林砍伐。

2021013065.en_text: Indonesia has the third-largest area of tropical forest in the world and one of the highest deforestation rates.
2021013065.cn_text: 印度尼西亚拥有世界第三大热带森林面积，也是森林砍伐率最高的国家之一。

2021013066.en_text: Ferraro analyzed satellite data showing annual forest loss from 2008 to 2012 — including during Indonesia’s phase-in of the antipoverty program — in 7,468 forested villages across 15 provinces.
2021013066.cn_text: 费拉罗分析了显示2008年至2012年年度森林损失的卫星数据——包括印度尼西亚逐步实施扶贫计划期间——覆盖了15个省份的7468个森林村庄。

2021013067.en_text: “We see that the program is associated with a 30 percent reduction in deforestation,” Ferraro says.
2021013067.cn_text: 费拉罗说：「我们发现该计划与森林砍伐减少30%相关联。」

2021013068.en_text: That’s likely because the rural poor are using the money as makeshift insurance policies against inclement weather, Ferraro says.
2021013068.cn_text: 费拉罗说，这很可能是因为农村贫困人口将这笔钱用作应对恶劣天气的临时保险。

2021013069.en_text: Typically, if rains are delayed, people may clear land to plant more rice to supplement their harvests.
2021013069.cn_text: 通常情况下，如果降雨延迟，人们可能会清理土地以种植更多水稻来补充收成。

2021013070.en_text: With the CCTs, individuals instead can use the money to supplement their harvests.
2021013070.cn_text: 有了CCT，个人可以用这笔钱来补充他们的收成。

2021013071.en_text: Whether this research translates elsewhere is anybody’s guess.
2021013071.cn_text: 这项研究是否能在其他地方推广，尚无定论。

2021013072.en_text: Ferraro suggests the results may transfer to other parts of Asia, due to commonalities such as the importance of growing rice and market access.
2021013072.cn_text: 费拉罗认为，由于种植水稻和市场准入的重要性等共同点，研究结果可能适用于亚洲其他地区。

2021013073.en_text: And regardless of transferability, the study shows that what’s good for people may also be good for the environment.
2021013073.cn_text: 无论可转移性如何，该研究表明，对人类有益的事物也可能对环境有益。

2021013074.en_text: Even if this program didn’t reduce poverty, Ferraro says, “the value of the avoided deforestation just for carbon dioxide emissions alone is more than the program costs.”
2021013074.cn_text: 费拉罗说，即使该计划没有减少贫困，「仅就二氧化碳排放而言，避免森林砍伐的价值就超过了计划成本。」

2021013100.en_text: As a historian who’s always searching for the text or the image that makes us reevaluate the past, I’ve become preoccupied with looking for photographs that show our Victorian ancestors smiling (what better way to shatter the image of 19th-century prudery?).
2021013100.cn_text: 作为一名历史学家，我始终在寻找能够让我们重新审视过去的文本或图像，我已经开始专注于寻找那些展示维多利亚时代祖先微笑的照片（还有什么比这更能打破19世纪拘谨形象呢？）。

2021013101.en_text: I’ve found quite a few, and — since I started posting them on Twitter — they have been causing quite a stir.
2021013101.cn_text: 我找到了不少这样的照片，并且自从我开始在推特上发布它们以来，它们引起了相当大的轰动。

2021013102.en_text: People have been surprised to see evidence that Victorians had fun and could, and did, laugh.
2021013102.cn_text: 人们惊讶地看到有证据表明维多利亚时代的人有乐趣，并且能够笑，也确实会笑。

2021013103.en_text: They are noting that the Victorians suddenly seem to become more human as the hundred-or-so years that separate us fade away through our common experience of laughter.
2021013103.cn_text: 他们注意到，随着将我们分隔开来的百年光阴通过共同的笑声体验而逐渐消逝，维多利亚时代的人似乎突然变得更加人性化了。

2021013104.en_text: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of “Smiling Victorians” makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.
2021013104.cn_text: 当然，我需要承认，我收藏的「微笑的维多利亚人」照片仅占1840年至1900年间创作的大量摄影肖像中的极小一部分，其中大多数展示的是被摄者在画布背景前痛苦而僵硬地摆姿势，或者茫然地凝视着中距处。

2021013105.en_text: How do we explain this trend?
2021013105.cn_text: 我们如何解释这一现象？

2021013106.en_text: During the 1840s and 1850s, in the early days of photography, exposure times were notoriously long: the daguerreotype photographic method (producing an image on a silvered copper plate) could take several minutes to complete, resulting in blurred images as sitters shifted position or adjusted their limbs.
2021013106.cn_text: 在19世纪40年代和50年代摄影的早期阶段，曝光时间以极其漫长而著称：银版摄影法（在镀银铜板上生成图像）可能需要几分钟才能完成，导致被摄者移动位置或调整肢体时图像变得模糊。

2021013107.en_text: The thought of holding a fixed grin as the camera performed its magical duties was too much to contemplate, and so a noncommittal blank stare became the norm.
2021013107.cn_text: 想到在相机执行其神奇职责时要保持固定的笑容实在太难以想象，因此一种不置可否的茫然凝视成为了常态。

2021013108.en_text: But exposure times were much quicker by the 1880s, and the introduction of the Box Brownie and other portable cameras meant that, though slow by today’s digital standards, the exposure was almost instantaneous.
2021013108.cn_text: 但到了19世纪80年代，曝光时间已经快得多了，而Box Brownie及其他便携式相机的引入意味着，虽然按今天的数字标准仍显缓慢，但曝光几乎是瞬间完成的。

2021013109.en_text: Spontaneous smiles were relatively easy to capture by the 1890s, so we must look elsewhere for an explanation of why Victorians still hesitated to smile.
2021013109.cn_text: 到了19世纪90年代，捕捉自然的微笑相对容易了，因此我们必须从其他方面寻找维多利亚人仍然不愿微笑的原因。

2021013110.en_text: One explanation might be the loss of dignity displayed through a cheesy grin.
2021013110.cn_text: 一个解释可能是通过夸张的笑容所表现出的尊严丧失。

2021013111.en_text: “Nature gave us lips to conceal our teeth,” ran one popular Victorian saying, alluding to the fact that before the birth of proper dentistry, mouths were often in a shocking state of hygiene.
2021013111.cn_text: 「自然赋予我们嘴唇来遮盖牙齿」，一条流行的维多利亚时代谚语如此说道，暗指在专业牙科诞生之前，口腔的卫生状况往往令人震惊。

2021013112.en_text: A flashing set of healthy and clean, regular “pearly whites” was a rare sight in Victorian society, the preserve of the super-rich (and even then, dental hygiene was not guaranteed).
2021013112.cn_text: 一口健康洁白、整齐的「珍珠白」牙齿在维多利亚社会中是罕见的景象，是超级富豪的专属（即便如此，牙齿卫生也无法得到保证）。

2021013113.en_text: A toothy grin (especially when there were gaps or blackened teeth) lacked class: drunks, tramps, and music hall performers might gurn and grin with a smile as wide as Lewis Carroll’s gum-exposing Cheshire Cat, but it was not a becoming look for properly bred persons.
2021013113.cn_text: 露齿的笑容（尤其是当牙齿有缺口或变黑时）缺乏品位：醉汉、流浪汉和音乐厅表演者可能会像刘易斯·卡罗尔笔下露牙龈的柴郡猫那样龇牙咧嘴地笑，但这对于受过良好教养的人来说并不是一种得体的表情。

2021013114.en_text: Even Mark Twain, a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh, said that when it came to photographic portraits there could be “nothing more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever”.
2021013114.cn_text: 即使是喜欢开怀大笑的马克·吐温也说过，在摄影肖像方面，「没有什么比一个愚蠢、傻气的笑容永远定格更具破坏性的了」。

2021013140.en_text: From the early days of broadband, advocates for consumers and web-based companies worried that the cable and phone companies selling broadband connections had the power and incentive to favor affiliated websites over their rivals’.
2021013140.cn_text: 从宽带发展初期开始,消费者权益倡导者和网络公司就担心,销售宽带连接的有线电视和电话公司有能力也有动机优待其关联网站而非竞争对手的网站。

2021013141.en_text: That’s why there has been such a strong demand for rules that would prevent broadband providers from picking winners and losers online, preserving the freedom and innovation that have been the lifeblood of the Internet.
2021013141.cn_text: 正因如此,人们一直强烈要求制定规则,防止宽带提供商在网上任意选择赢家和输家,以维护作为互联网生命线的自由与创新。

2021013142.en_text: Yet that demand has been almost impossible to fill — in part because of pushback from broadband providers, anti-regulatory conservatives and the courts.
2021013142.cn_text: 然而这一需求几乎不可能得到满足——部分原因在于宽带提供商、反监管保守派以及法院的抵制。

2021013143.en_text: A federal appeals court weighed in again Tuesday, but instead of providing a badly needed resolution, it only prolonged the fight.
2021013143.cn_text: 联邦上诉法院周二再次介入此事,但并未提供迫切需要的解决方案,反而只是延长了这场争斗。

2021013144.en_text: At issue before the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit was the latest take of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on net neutrality, adopted on a party-line vote in 2017.
2021013144.cn_text: 美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院审理的争议焦点是联邦通信委员会关于网络中立性的最新立场,该立场于2017年以党派划线投票方式通过。

2021013145.en_text: The Republican penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission’s authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.
2021013145.cn_text: 这项由共和党起草的命令不仅废除了联邦通信委员会在2015年民主党占多数时通过的严格网络中立规则,还否定了该委员会要求宽带提供商履行任何职责的权力。

2021013146.en_text: The order also declared that state and local governments couldn’t regulate broadband providers either.
2021013146.cn_text: 该命令还宣布,州政府和地方政府同样不得监管宽带提供商。

2021013147.en_text: The commission argued that other agencies would protect against anti-competitive behavior, such as a broadband-providing conglomerate like AT&T favoring its own video- streaming service at the expense of Netflix and Apple TV.
2021013147.cn_text: 委员会辩称,其他机构将防范反竞争行为,例如AT&T这样兼具宽带提供商身份的企业集团以牺牲Netflix和Apple TV为代价优待自家视频流媒体服务。

2021013148.en_text: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals’ streaming services but not their own.
2021013148.cn_text: 然而联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带提供商的调查,这些提供商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置数据上限,却对自家服务不加限制。

2021013149.en_text: On Tuesday, the appeals court unanimously upheld the 2017 order deregulating broadband providers, citing a Supreme Court ruling from 2005 that upheld a similarly deregulatory move.
2021013149.cn_text: 周二,上诉法院一致维持了2017年放松宽带提供商监管的命令,援引了最高法院2005年支持类似放松监管举措的裁决。

2021013150.en_text: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that “the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service,” and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to “avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism.”
2021013150.cn_text: 但法官帕特里夏·米莱特在协同意见中正确地指出,「这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的现实」,并表示国会或最高法院可以介入以「避免互联网监管陷入技术落伍的困境」。

2021013151.en_text: In the meantime, the court threw out the FCC’s attempt to block all state rules on net neutrality, while preserving the commission’s power to preempt individual state laws that undermine its order.
2021013151.cn_text: 与此同时,法院驳回了联邦通信委员会试图阻止所有州制定网络中立规则的做法,但保留了该委员会废止破坏其命令的个别州法律的权力。

2021013152.en_text: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC’s abdication.
2021013152.cn_text: 这意味着将出现更多类似司法部与加州之间的争斗——加州在联邦通信委员会放弃监管后制定了一部严格的网络中立法。

2021013153.en_text: The endless legal battles and back-and-forth at the FCC cry out for Congress to act.
2021013153.cn_text: 联邦通信委员会内部无休止的法律争斗和反复摇摆迫切呼唤国会采取行动。

2021013154.en_text: It needs to give the commission explicit authority once and for all to bar broadband providers from meddling in the traffic on their network and to create clear rules protecting openness and innovation online.
2021013154.cn_text: 国会需要一劳永逸地赋予委员会明确权力,禁止宽带提供商干预其网络流量,并制定保护网络开放性和创新的明确规则。
