2021013180.en_text: In the movies and on television, artificial intelligence (AI) is typically depicted as something sinister that will upend our way of life.
2021013180.cn_text: 在电影和电视中，人工智能通常被描绘成一种将颠覆我们生活方式的险恶事物。

2021013181.en_text: When it comes to AI in business, we often hear about it in relation to automation and the impending loss of jobs, but in what ways is AI changing companies and the larger economy that don’t involve doom-andgloom mass unemployment predictions?
2021013181.cn_text: 在商业领域谈到人工智能时，我们经常听到它与自动化和即将到来的失业潮有关，但人工智能正在以哪些方式改变公司和更广泛的经济，而这些方式并不涉及关于大规模失业的悲观预测？

2021013182.en_text: A recent survey of manufacturing and service industries from Tata Consultancy Services found that companies currently use AI more often in computer-to-computer activities than in automating human activities.
2021013182.cn_text: 塔塔咨询服务公司最近对制造业和服务业进行的一项调查发现，公司目前更多地在计算机与计算机之间的活动中使用人工智能，而不是在人类活动自动化中使用。

2021013183.en_text: Here are a few ways AI is aiding companies without replacing employees:
2021013183.cn_text: 以下是人工智能在不取代员工的情况下帮助公司的几种方式：

2021013185.en_text: Companies are using artificial intelligence to remove some of the unconscious bias from hiring decisions.
2021013185.cn_text: 公司正在利用人工智能消除招聘决策中的部分无意识偏见。

2021013186.en_text: “There are experiments that show that, naturally, the results of interviews are much more biased than what AI does,” says Pedro Domingos, author of The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World and a computer science professor at the University of Washington.
2021013186.cn_text: 「终极算法：终极学习机器的探索将如何重塑我们的世界」一书的作者、华盛顿大学计算机科学教授佩德罗·多明戈斯说：「有实验表明，自然情况下，面试结果比人工智能的结果更具偏见性。」

2021013187.cn_text: 此外，「人工智能能够审阅比人类更多数量的简历，并筛选出更有潜力的候选人。」

2021013188.en_text: One company that’s doing this is called Blendoor.
2021013188.cn_text: 一家正在这样做的公司叫作Blendoor。

2021013189.en_text: It uses analytics to help identify where there may be bias in the hiring process.
2021013189.cn_text: 它使用分析工具帮助识别招聘流程中可能存在偏见的环节。

2021013191.en_text: Some AI software can analyze and optimize marketing email subject lines to increase open rates.
2021013191.cn_text: 一些人工智能软件可以分析并优化营销邮件的主题行以提高打开率。

2021013192.en_text: One company in the UK, Phrasee, claims their software can outperform humans by up to 10 percent when it comes to email open rates.
2021013192.cn_text: 英国的一家公司Phrasee声称，其软件在邮件打开率方面的表现可以超越人类最多达10%。

2021013193.en_text: This can mean millions more in revenue.
2021013193.cn_text: 这可能意味着数百万的收入增长。

2021013195.en_text: These are “tools that help people use data, not a replacement for people,” says Patrick H. Winston, a professor of artificial intelligence and computer science at MIT.
2021013195.cn_text: 麻省理工学院人工智能和计算机科学教授帕特里克·H·温斯顿说，这些是「帮助人们使用数据的工具，而不是人的替代品」。

2021013197.en_text: Energy companies can use AI to help customers reduce their electricity bills, saving them money while helping the environment.
2021013197.cn_text: 能源公司可以利用人工智能帮助客户降低电费，从而为客户节省开支，同时有益于环境保护。

2021013198.en_text: Companies can also optimize their own energy use and cut down on the cost of electricity.
2021013198.cn_text: 公司还可以优化自身的能源使用并削减电力成本。

2021013199.en_text: Insurance companies, meanwhile, can base their premiums on AI models that more accurately assess risk.
2021013199.cn_text: 与此同时，保险公司可以基于能够更准确评估风险的人工智能模型来制定保费。

2021013200.cn_text: 多明戈斯说：「以前，他们可能不会为那些看起来风险较高的人提供保险，或者向他们收取过高的费用，或者收费过低导致公司亏损。」

2021013202.en_text: “Machine learning often provides a more reliable form of statistics, which makes data more valuable,” says Winston.
2021013202.cn_text: 温斯顿说：「机器学习通常提供一种更可靠的统计形式，这使得数据更具价值。」

2021013203.cn_text: 它「帮助人们做出更明智的决策」。

2021013206.en_text: A number of companies, particularly in energy and transportation, use AI image processing technology to inspect infrastructure and prevent equipment failure or leaks before they happen.
2021013206.cn_text: 许多公司，尤其是能源和交通领域的公司，使用人工智能图像处理技术来检查基础设施，并在设备故障或泄漏发生之前进行预防。

2021013207.en_text: “If they fail first and then you fix them, it’s very expensive,” says Domingos.
2021013207.cn_text: 多明戈斯说：「如果它们先发生故障然后再修理，那就非常昂贵。」

2021013208.cn_text: 「你希望预测某事是否需要立即关注，并指出对员工有用的位置。」

2021013209.en_text: AI replaces the boring parts of your job.
2021013209.cn_text: 人工智能取代了你工作中乏味的部分。

2021013210.en_text: If you’re doing research, you can have AI go out and look for relevant sources and information that otherwise you just wouldn’t have time for.
2021013210.cn_text: 如果你正在做研究，你可以让人工智能去查找相关的资料和信息，否则你根本没有时间去做。

2021013211.en_text: There are also companies like Acquisio, which analyzes advertising performance across multiple channels like Adwords, Bing and social media and makes adjustments or suggestions about where advertising funds will yield best results.
2021013211.cn_text: 还有像Acquisio这样的公司，它分析Adwords、Bing和社交媒体等多个渠道的广告表现，并就广告资金的最佳投放位置进行调整或提出建议。

2021013212.en_text: One accounting firm, EY, uses an AI system that helps review contracts during an audit.
2021013212.cn_text: 一家会计师事务所安永使用一种人工智能系统来帮助在审计期间审查合同。

2021013213.en_text: This process, along with employees reviewing the contracts, is faster and more accurate.
2021013213.cn_text: 这个流程，加上员工审查合同，更快且更准确。

2021013214.en_text: We’re also giving our customers better channels versus picking up the phone to accomplish something beyond human scale.
2021013214.cn_text: 我们还为客户提供了更好的渠道，而非通过电话来完成超出人类能力范围的事情。

2021013215.en_text: You want to predict if something needs attention now and point to where it’s useful for employees to go to.
2021013215.cn_text: 你希望预测是否有需要立即关注的事情，并指出对员工有用的位置。

2021013216.en_text: AI looks at resumes in greater numbers than humans would be able to, and selects the more promising candidates.
2021013216.cn_text: 人工智能能够审阅比人类更多数量的简历，并筛选出更有潜力的候选人。

2021013217.en_text: Before, they might not insure the ones who felt like a high risk or charge them too much, or they would charge them too little and then it would cost the company money.
2021013217.cn_text: 以前，他们可能不会为那些看起来风险较高的人提供保险，或者向他们收取过高的费用，或者收费过低导致公司亏损。

2021013223.en_text: World War II was the watershed event for higher education in modern Western societies.
2021013223.cn_text: 第二次世界大战是现代西方社会高等教育发展的分水岭。

2021013224.en_text: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3%-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war.
2021013224.cn_text: 战后这些社会的高等教育入学率水平与战前数十年大致相同，一直保持在相关年龄组的3%-5%左右。

2021013225.en_text: But after the war, great social and political changes arising out of the successful war against Fascism created a growing demand in European and American economies for increasing numbers of graduates with more than a secondary school education.
2021013225.cn_text: 但战后，成功战胜法西斯主义所引发的重大社会和政治变革使得欧美经济体对具有中等教育以上学历的毕业生需求日益增长。

2021013226.en_text: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war.
2021013226.cn_text: 而且，这些社会对接受高等教育的需求扩展到了战前从未考虑过上大学的群体和社会阶层。

2021013227.en_text: These demands resulted in a very rapid expansion of the systems of higher education, beginning in the 1960s and developing very rapidly (though unevenly) during the 1970s and 1980s.
2021013227.cn_text: 这些需求导致高等教育体系从20世纪60年代开始迅速扩张，并在70年代和80年代快速发展（尽管发展并不均衡）。

2021013228.en_text: The growth of higher education manifests itself in at least three quite different ways, and these in turn have given rise to different sets of problems.
2021013228.cn_text: 高等教育的增长至少以三种截然不同的方式表现出来，这些方式又分别引发了不同的问题。

2021013229.en_text: There was first the rate of growth: in many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven, eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s.
2021013229.cn_text: 首先是增长速度：在西欧许多国家，高等教育学生人数在20世纪60年代的五年内翻了一番，到70年代中期又在七年、八年或十年内再次翻番。

2021013230.en_text: Second, growth obviously affected the absolute size both of systems and individual institutions.
2021013230.cn_text: 其次，增长显然影响了整个教育体系和各个院校的绝对规模。

2021013231.en_text: And third, growth was reflected in changes in the proportion of the relevant age group enrolled in institutions of higher education.
2021013231.cn_text: 第三，增长体现在相关年龄组中进入高等教育机构就读的比例变化上。

2021013232.en_text: Each of these manifestations of growth carried its own peculiar problems in its wake.
2021013232.cn_text: 这些增长表现形式各自带来了其特有的问题。

2021013233.en_text: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
2021013233.cn_text: 例如，高增长率对现有的治理结构、管理结构，尤其是社会化结构造成了巨大压力。

2021013234.en_text: When a faculty or department grows from, say, five to 20 members within three or four years, and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty.
2021013234.cn_text: 当一个学院或系在三四年内从五名成员增长到二十名成员，而新加入的教职员工主要是刚完成研究生学习的年轻男女时，他们在很大程度上就会定义该学院的学术生活规范。

2021013235.en_text: And if the postgraduate student population also grows rapidly and there is loss of a close apprenticeship relationship between faculty members and students, the student culture becomes the chief socializing force for new postgraduate students, with consequences for the intellectual and academic life of the institution — this was seen in America as well as in France, Italy, West Germany, and Japan.
2021013235.cn_text: 如果研究生群体也快速增长，而教师与学生之间紧密的师徒关系不复存在，那么学生文化就会成为新研究生社会化的主要力量，从而对院校的学术和知识生活产生影响——这种现象在美国以及法国、意大利、西德和日本都曾出现过。

2021013236.en_text: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth.
2021013236.cn_text: 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会，但同时也削弱了在稳定或缓慢增长时期教师和学生被纳入学术共同体的形式和过程。

2021013237.en_text: In the 1960s and 1970s, European universities saw marked changes in their governance arrangements, with the empowerment of junior faculty and to some degree of students as well.
2021013237.cn_text: 在20世纪60年代和70年代，欧洲大学的治理安排发生了显著变化，初级教员以及在一定程度上学生也获得了权力。

2022013001.en_text: The idea that plants have some degree of consciousness first took root in the early 2000s; the term “plant neurobiology” was coined around the notion that some aspects of plant behavior could be compared to intelligence in animals.
2022013001.cn_text: 植物具有某种程度意识的观点最早于2000年代初萌生；「植物神经生物学」一词正是围绕植物行为的某些方面可与动物智能相比拟这一概念而提出的。

2022013002.en_text: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
2022013002.cn_text: 研究人员此前报道称，尽管植物缺乏大脑，但其茎叶中电信号的发射仍触发了暗示意识存在的反应。

2022013003.en_text: But such an idea is untrue, according to a new opinion article.
2022013003.cn_text: 但根据一篇新发表的观点文章，这一观点并不成立。

2022013004.en_text: Plant biology is complex and fascinating, but it differs so greatly from that of animals that so-called evidence of plants’ intelligence is inconclusive, the authors wrote.
2022013004.cn_text: 作者指出，植物生物学虽复杂而迷人,但与动物生物学差异极大，以至于所谓植物智能的证据尚不足以定论。

2022013005.en_text: Beginning in 2006, some scientists have argued that plants possess neuron-like cells that interact with hormones and neurotransmitters, forming “a plant nervous system, analogous to that in animals,” said lead study author Lincoln Taiz, “They even claimed that plants have ‘brain-like command centers’ at their root tips.”
2022013005.cn_text: 首席研究作者林肯·泰兹表示，自2006年起，一些科学家提出植物拥有类似神经元的细胞，这些细胞与激素和神经递质相互作用，形成「类似于动物的植物神经系统」，「他们甚至声称植物根尖处存在「类似大脑的指挥中心」。」

2022013006.en_text: This perspective makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, reducing it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals.
2022013006.cn_text: 如果将复杂大脑的运作简化为一系列电脉冲，这种观点似乎讲得通；植物细胞同样通过电信号进行交流。

2022013007.en_text: However, the signaling in a plant is only superficially similar to the firing in a complex animal brain, which is more than “a mass of cells that communicate by electricity,” Taiz said.
2022013007.cn_text: 然而，泰兹指出，植物中的信号传导仅在表面上类似于复杂动物大脑中的放电活动，而后者远非「一团通过电流交流的细胞」那么简单。

2022013008.en_text: “For consciousness to evolve, a brain with a threshold level of complexity and capacity is required,” he added.
2022013008.cn_text: 「意识的进化需要大脑达到一定的复杂性和能力阈值，」他补充道。

2022013009.en_text: “Since plants don’t have nervous systems, the chances that they have consciousness are effectively zero.”
2022013009.cn_text: 「既然植物不具备神经系统，它们拥有意识的可能性实际上为零。」

2022013010.en_text: And what’s so great about consciousness, anyway?
2022013010.cn_text: 况且，意识究竟有何了不起之处？

2022013011.en_text: Plants can’t run away from danger, so investing energy in a body system which recognizes a threat and can feel pain would be a very poor evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
2022013011.cn_text: 文章指出，植物无法逃避危险，因此将能量投入到能够识别威胁并感受疼痛的身体系统中，将是一种极为糟糕的进化策略。

2022013012.en_text: People often complain that plastics are too durable.
2022013012.cn_text: 人们常常抱怨塑料过于耐用。

2022013013.en_text: Water bottles, shopping bags, and other trash litter the planet, from Mount Everest to the Mariana Trench, because plastics are everywhere and don’t break down easily.
2022013013.cn_text: 从珠穆朗玛峰到马里亚纳海沟，水瓶、购物袋和其他垃圾遍布地球各处，因为塑料无处不在且难以分解。

2022013014.en_text: But some plastic materials change over time.
2022013014.cn_text: 但有些塑料材料会随时间发生变化。

2022013018.en_text: All of which creates huge headaches for institutions, such as museums, trying to preserve culturally important objects.
2022013018.cn_text: 所有这些都给试图保存重要文化物品的机构（如博物馆）带来了巨大难题。

2022013019.en_text: The variety of plastic objects at risk is dizzying: early radios, avant-garde sculptures, celluloid animation stills from Disney films, the first artificial heart.
2022013019.cn_text: 面临风险的塑料物品种类繁多，令人眼花缭乱：早期收音机、前卫雕塑、迪士尼电影的赛璐珞动画静帧、第一颗人造心脏。

2022013020.en_text: Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn’t always know how to mix ingredients properly, says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands.
2022013020.cn_text: 某些文物尤其脆弱，因为一些塑料艺术先驱并不总是知道如何正确配制成分，聚合物化学家西娅·范奥斯滕说道，她在几年前退休前曾在荷兰文化遗产局工作数十年。

2022013021.en_text: “It’s like baking a cake: If you don’t have exact amounts, it goes wrong.” she says.
2022013021.cn_text: 「这就像烤蛋糕：如果没有准确的配比，就会失败。」她说。

2022013022.en_text: “The object you make is already a time bomb.”
2022013022.cn_text: 「你制作的物品本身就已经是一颗定时炸弹。」

2022013023.en_text: And sometimes, it’s not the artist’s fault.
2022013023.cn_text: 而有时，这并非艺术家的过错。

2022013024.en_text: In the 1960s, the Italian artist Piero Gilardi began to create hundreds of bright, colorful foam pieces.
2022013024.cn_text: 20世纪60年代，意大利艺术家皮耶罗·吉拉尔迪开始创作数百件鲜艳多彩的泡沫作品。

2022013025.en_text: Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen “nature carpets” — large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins, cabbages, and watermelons.
2022013025.cn_text: 这些作品包括小型玫瑰花床等物件，以及数十件「自然地毯」——用泡沫南瓜、卷心菜和西瓜装饰的大型矩形作品。

2022013026.en_text: He wanted viewers to walk around on the carpets — which meant they had to be durable.
2022013026.cn_text: 他希望观众能在地毯上走动——这意味着它们必须足够耐用。

2022013027.en_text: Unfortunately, the polyurethane foam he used is inherently unstable.
2022013027.cn_text: 不幸的是，他所使用的聚氨酯泡沫本质上并不稳定。

2022013028.en_text: It’s especially vulnerable to light damage, and by the mid-1990s, Gilardi’s pumpkins, roses, and other figures were splitting and crumbling.
2022013028.cn_text: 它特别容易受光损害，到20世纪90年代中期，吉拉尔迪的南瓜、玫瑰和其他造型开始开裂并破碎。

2022013029.en_text: Museums locked some of them away in the dark.
2022013029.cn_text: 博物馆将其中一些作品锁存在暗处。

2022013030.en_text: So van Oosten and her colleagues worked to preserve Gilardi’s sculptures.
2022013030.cn_text: 于是范奥斯滕和同事们着手保护吉拉尔迪的雕塑。

2022013031.en_text: They infused some with stabilizing and consolidating chemicals.
2022013031.cn_text: 他们为部分作品注入了稳定剂和固化剂。

2022013032.en_text: Van Oosten calls those chemicals “sunscreens” because their goal was to prevent further light damage and rebuild worn polymer fibers.
2022013032.cn_text: 范奥斯滕将这些化学物质称为「防晒剂」，因为其目的是防止进一步的光损害并修复受损的聚合物纤维。

2022013033.en_text: She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases.
2022013033.cn_text: 她感到自豪的是，数件雕塑甚至再次得以展出，尽管有时需要放置在保护罩下。

2022013034.en_text: Despite success stories like van Oosten’s, preservation of plastics will likely get harder.
2022013034.cn_text: 尽管有范奥斯滕这样的成功案例，塑料保存工作很可能会变得更加困难。

2022013036.en_text: Worse, biodegradable plastics designed to disintegrate, are increasingly common.
2022013036.cn_text: 更糟的是，专为分解而设计的可生物降解塑料正变得越来越普遍。

2022013037.en_text: And more is at stake here than individual objects.
2022013037.cn_text: 而这里所关乎的不仅仅是单个物品。

2022013038.en_text: Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history — Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on — after examining artifacts in museums.
2022013038.cn_text: 新里斯本科技大学保护与修复助理教授乔安娜·利亚·费雷拉指出，考古学家是在博物馆研究文物之后，才首次界定了人类历史上的重要材料时代——石器时代、铁器时代等等。

2022013039.en_text: We now live in an age of plastic, she says, “and what we decide to collect today, what we decide to preserve...will have a strong impact on how in the future we’ll be seen.”
2022013039.cn_text: 我们如今生活在塑料时代，她说，「我们今天决定收藏什么、决定保存什么……将对未来人们如何看待我们产生重大影响。」

2022013040.cn_text: 根据第一段，博物馆在____方面面临困难

2022013044.cn_text: 对其塑料藏品进行分类。

2022013045.en_text: Van Oosten believes that certain plastic objects are ____
2022013045.cn_text: 范奥斯滕认为某些塑料物品____

2022013050.en_text: Museums stopped exhibiting some of Gilardi’s artworks to ____
2022013050.cn_text: 博物馆停止展出吉拉尔迪的部分艺术作品以____

2022013052.cn_text: 复制它们以供日后展出。

2022013055.en_text: The author thinks that preservation of plastics is ____

2022013060.en_text: In Ferreira’s opinion, preservation of plastic artifacts ____
2022013060.cn_text: 在费雷拉看来，塑料文物的保存____

2022013061.cn_text: 将激发未来的科学研究。

2022013063.en_text: will help us separate the material ages.
2022013063.cn_text: 将帮助我们划分不同的材料时代。

2022013064.en_text: has an impact on today’s cultural life.
2022013064.cn_text: 对当今文化生活产生影响。

2022013065.en_text: As the latest crop of students pen their undergraduate application form and weigh up their options, it may be worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed and what Generation Z need to consider as they start the third stage of their educational journey.
2022013065.cn_text: 随着最新一批学生填写本科申请表并权衡各种选择，或许值得思考学位的意义、目的和价值发生了怎样的变化，以及Z世代在开启教育旅程第三阶段之际需要考虑哪些问题。

2022013066.en_text: Millennials were told that if you did well in school, got a decent degree, you would be set up for life.
2022013066.cn_text: 千禧一代曾被告知，只要在校表现优异、拿到一个体面的学位，就能一生无忧。

2022013067.en_text: But that promise has been found wanting.
2022013067.cn_text: 但这一承诺已被证明并不可靠。

2022013068.en_text: As degrees became universal, they became devalued.
2022013068.cn_text: 随着学位日益普及，其含金量也随之下降。

2022013069.en_text: Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility.
2022013069.cn_text: 教育不再是实现社会流动的可靠途径。

2022013070.en_text: Today, 28 percent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among OECD countries.
2022013070.cn_text: 如今，英国有28%的毕业生从事无需学位的工作，这一比例是经合组织国家平均水平的两倍。

2022013071.en_text: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.
2022013071.cn_text: 这并不是说获得学位毫无意义，而是强调学位并非适合所有人，从教室到讲堂的转变并非不可避免的必然选择，此外还有其他路径可供选择。

2022013072.en_text: Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening, with Generation Z seeking to learn from their millennial predecessors, even if parents and teachers tend to be still set in the degree mindset.
2022013072.cn_text: 值得庆幸的是，已有迹象表明这种转变正在发生：Z世代正努力汲取千禧一代前辈的经验教训，尽管父母和教师往往仍固守学位思维。

2022013073.en_text: Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers who often prove themselves to be more committed and loyal employees than graduates.
2022013073.cn_text: 雇主们早已看到雇用中学毕业生的优势：这些人往往比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚。

2022013074.en_text: Many too are seeing the advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles.
2022013074.cn_text: 许多雇主也逐渐意识到，取消某些职位的学位要求同样具有优势。

2022013075.en_text: For those for whom a degree is the desired route, consider that this may well be the first of many.
2022013075.cn_text: 对于那些将攻读学位视为理想途径的人来说，这或许只是他们将获得的众多学位中的第一个。

2022013076.en_text: In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills.
2022013076.cn_text: 在这个通才辈出的时代，拥有专业知识或技能才更加有利。

2022013077.en_text: Postgraduates now earn 40 percent more than graduates.
2022013077.cn_text: 如今研究生的收入比本科生高出40%。

2022013078.en_text: When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two.
2022013078.cn_text: 当越来越多的人拥有一个学位时，拥有两个学位便显得更为合理。

2022013079.en_text: It is unlikely that Generation Z will be done with education at 18 or 21: they will need to be constantly upskilling throughout their career to stay employable.
2022013079.cn_text: Z世代不太可能在18岁或21岁就结束教育：他们需要在整个职业生涯中不断提升技能，以保持就业竞争力。

2022013080.en_text: It has been estimated that this generation, due to the pressures of technology, the wish for personal fulfillment and desire for diversity will work for 17 different employers over the course of their working life and have five different careers.
2022013080.cn_text: 据估计，由于技术带来的压力、对个人成就感的追求以及对多样化的渴望，这一代人在职业生涯中将为17个不同的雇主工作，并从事五种不同的职业。

2022013081.en_text: Education, and not just knowledge gained on campus, will be a core part of Generation Z’s career trajectory.
2022013081.cn_text: 教育——而不仅仅是校园中获得的知识——将成为Z世代职业发展轨迹的核心组成部分。

2022013082.en_text: Older generations often talk about their degree in the present and personal tense: ‘I am a geographer’ or ‘I am a classist’.
2022013082.cn_text: 老一辈人常以现在时和第一人称谈论自己的学位：「我是地理学家」或「我是古典学家」。

2022013083.en_text: Their sons or daughters would never say such a thing; it’s as if they already know that their degree won’t define them in the same way.
2022013083.cn_text: 他们的子女却绝不会这样说话，似乎早已明白自己的学位不会像从前那样定义他们的身份。

2022013109.cn_text: 富有启发、充满挑战、令人振奋、趣味盎然。

2022013110.en_text: These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers.
2022013110.cn_text: 这些是《自然》杂志读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究人员合作伙伴关系的文章中，用来描述其艺术与科学合作经历的部分词汇。

2022013111.en_text: Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said, they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future.
2022013111.cn_text: 在参与相关调查的约350人中，近40%表示他们曾与艺术家合作过；几乎所有人都表示未来会考虑这样做。

2022013112.en_text: Such an encouraging result is not surprising.
2022013112.cn_text: 如此令人振奋的结果并不令人意外。

2022013113.en_text: Scientists are increasingly seeking out visual artists to help them to communicate their work to new audiences.
2022013113.cn_text: 科学家们越来越多地寻求视觉艺术家的帮助，以便将自己的研究成果传递给新的受众。

2022013114.en_text: “Artists help scientists reach a broader audience and make emotional connections that enhance learning.” One respondent said.
2022013114.cn_text: 一位受访者说：「艺术家帮助科学家接触到更广泛的受众，并建立起增强学习效果的情感联系。」

2022013115.en_text: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the senses came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons.
2022013115.cn_text: 艺术家与科学家携手震撼感官的一个范例发生在上个月，当时悉尼交响乐团演奏了重新改编的安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》。

2022013116.en_text: They reimagined the 300-year-old score by injecting the latest climate prediction data for each season — provided by Monash University’s Climate Change Communication Research Hub.
2022013116.cn_text: 他们通过注入莫纳什大学气候变化传播研究中心提供的每个季节的最新气候预测数据，重新诠释了这部有300年历史的乐谱。

2022013117.en_text: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November’s United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
2022013117.cn_text: 这场演出是为即将在英国格拉斯哥举行的11月联合国气候变化大会发出的创造性行动呼吁。

2022013118.en_text: But a genuine partnership must be a two-way street.
2022013118.cn_text: 但真正的合作伙伴关系必须是双向的。

2022013119.en_text: Fewer artist than scientists responded to the Nature poll; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements.
2022013119.cn_text: 参与《自然》杂志调查的艺术家人数少于科学家；然而，一些受访者指出，艺术家并非仅仅是协助科学家满足其传播需求。

2022013120.en_text: Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study.
2022013120.cn_text: 他们的作品也不应仅仅被当作研究对象。

2022013121.en_text: The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other’s work.
2022013121.cn_text: 当科学家与艺术家在一个项目中拥有共同利益关系、能够共同设计项目并能够批判彼此的工作时，这种联盟才是最有价值的。

2022013122.en_text: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
2022013122.cn_text: 这种方式既能激发新的研究，也能产生有影响力的艺术作品。

2022013123.en_text: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.
2022013123.cn_text: 半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院开设了高级视觉研究中心（CAVS），旨在探索技术在文化中的作用。

2022013124.en_text: The founders deliberately focused their projects around light — hence the “visual studies” in the name.
2022013124.cn_text: 创始人有意将其项目聚焦于光——因此名称中有「视觉研究」一词。

2022013125.en_text: Light was a something that both artists and scientists had an interest in, and therefore could form the basis of collaboration.
2022013125.cn_text: 光是艺术家与科学家均感兴趣的事物，因而可以构成合作的基础。

2022013126.en_text: As science and technology progressed, and divided into more sub-disciplines, the centre was simultaneously looking to a time when leading researchers could also be artists, writers and poets, and vice versa.
2022013126.cn_text: 随着科学技术的发展并分化为更多子学科，该中心同时也在展望这样一个时代：那时的顶尖研究者同样可以是艺术家、作家和诗人，反之亦然。

2022013127.en_text: Nature’s poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time and embrace surprise and challenge.
2022013127.cn_text: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然强劲，但要使合作取得成效，双方都需要投入时间，并愿意接受意外收获与挑战。

2022013128.en_text: The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other.
2022013128.cn_text: 艺术与科学结合的范围需要超越研究传播这一必要目的，参与者必须避免陷入相互刻板印象的陷阱。

2022013129.en_text: Artists and scientists alike are immersed in discovery and invention, and challenge and critique are core to both, too.
2022013129.cn_text: 艺术家与科学家都投身于发现与创造，挑战与批判同样是两者的核心。

2022013155.en_text: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand’s Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause.
2022013155.cn_text: 新西兰《2000年雇佣关系法》（ERA）中的个人申诉条款禁止雇主在没有正当理由的情况下解雇员工。

2022013156.cn_text: 相反，解雇必须是有正当理由的。

2022013157.en_text: Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.
2022013157.cn_text: 雇主既必须说明解雇理由，又必须以程序上公平的方式行事。

2022013158.en_text: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from “unjustified dismissals”.
2022013158.cn_text: 个人申诉程序旨在保护普通工人的工作免遭「无理解雇」。

2022013159.en_text: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
2022013159.cn_text: 其前提是，合同普通法缺乏足够的保障措施来保护工人免受管理层的专断行为。

2022013160.en_text: Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice.
2022013160.cn_text: 老板可以简单地向员工发出合同解除通知的日子早已一去不复返。

2022013161.en_text: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.
2022013161.cn_text: 但这些条款在应用于高薪经理和高管时给企业造成了困难。

2022013162.en_text: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance.
2022013162.cn_text: 正如无数董事会和企业主所证实的那样，限制企业解雇表现不佳的高收入经理的能力，对提高生产力和整体绩效构成了阻碍。

2022013163.en_text: The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure.
2022013163.cn_text: C级经理和A级经理之间的差异很可能就是企业成败之间的差异。

2022013164.en_text: Between preserving the jobs of ordinary workers or losing them.
2022013164.cn_text: 关乎能否保住普通工人的工作。

2022013165.en_text: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
2022013165.cn_text: 然而，平庸已不再足以成为解雇的正当理由。

2022013166.en_text: Consequently — and paradoxically — laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
2022013166.cn_text: 因此——并且颇为矛盾的是——旨在保护普通工人工作的法律可能正在使这些工作面临风险。

2022013167.en_text: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers’ wages.
2022013167.cn_text: 即使不是使工作面临风险，就业保护法在限制企业主解雇表现不佳的经理这一层面上，也会对企业生产力乃至工人工资构成制约。

2022013168.en_text: Indeed, in “An International Perspective on New Zealand’s Productivity Paradox” (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country’s poor productivity growth record.
2022013168.cn_text: 确实，在《新西兰生产力悖论的国际视角》（2014年）中，生产力委员会将管理能力低下列为该国生产力增长记录不佳的一个原因。

2022013169.en_text: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA’s unjustified dismissal procedures.
2022013169.cn_text: 高薪经理人本身也无法免受ERA不合理解雇程序所造成的伤害。

2022013170.en_text: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
2022013170.cn_text: 由于就业保护法使解雇员工的成本更高，雇主在雇用新员工时更加谨慎。

2022013171.en_text: This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment.
2022013171.cn_text: 这使得处于边缘地位的经理更难获得工作。

2022013172.en_text: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
2022013172.cn_text: 而且企业支付给员工的薪资更少，因为企业承担了雇佣关系失败的负担。

2022013173.en_text: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections.
2022013173.cn_text: 社会也因过度的就业保护而遭受损害。

2022013174.en_text: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
2022013174.cn_text: 严格的解雇规定对生产力增长产生不利影响，并妨碍繁荣和整体福祉。

2022013175.en_text: Across the Tasman, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified “high-income threshold” from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.
2022013175.cn_text: 在塔斯曼海对岸，澳大利亚通过将收入超过指定「高收入门槛」的员工排除在其不公平解雇法的保护范围之外，来应对不合理解雇悖论。

2022013176.en_text: In New Zealand, a 2016 private members’ Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime.
2022013176.cn_text: 在新西兰，2016年的一项议员个人法案试图允许企业和高收入员工退出不合理解雇制度。

2022013177.en_text: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
2022013177.cn_text: 然而，所提议的机制过于繁琐，该法案在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。

2022013203.en_text: I am a zoo and wildlife park employee for years.
2022013203.cn_text: 我是一名在动物园和野生动物园工作多年的员工。

2022013204.en_text: Both the wildlife park and zoo claimed to be operating for the benefit of the animals and for conservation purposes.
2022013204.cn_text: 野生动物园和动物园均声称其运营是为了动物福祉和保护目的。

2022013206.en_text: Neither one of them actually participated in any contributions to animal research or conservation.
2022013206.cn_text: 它们实际上都未参与任何动物研究或保护工作。

2022013207.en_text: They are profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important than the condition of the animals.
2022013207.cn_text: 它们是盈利性机构，其利润底线远比动物状况重要。

2022013208.en_text: Animals despise being captives in zoos.
2022013208.cn_text: 动物厌恶被囚禁在动物园中。

2022013209.en_text: No matter how you “enhance” enclosures, they do not allow for freedom, a natural diet or adequate exercise.
2022013209.cn_text: 无论如何「改善」围栏，它们都无法提供自由、自然饮食或充足的运动。

2022013210.en_text: It’s past time for transparency with these institutions, and it’s past time to eliminate zoos from our culture.
2022013210.cn_text: 这些机构早该实现透明化，动物园也早该从我们的文化中消除。

2022013211.en_text: As a zoology professor, I agree with Emma Marris that zoo displays can be sad and cruel.
2022013211.cn_text: 作为一名动物学教授,我同意艾玛·马里斯的观点,即动物园展示可能令人悲伤且残酷。

2022013212.en_text: But she underestimates the educational value of zoos.
2022013212.cn_text: 但她低估了动物园的教育价值。

2022013213.en_text: The zoology program at my university attracts students for whom zoo visits were the crucial formative experience that led them to major in biological sciences.
2022013213.cn_text: 我所在大学的动物学专业吸引了许多学生,对他们而言,动物园参观是引领他们主修生物科学的关键性成长经历。

2022013214.en_text: These are mostly students who had no opportunity as children to travel to wilderness areas, wildlife refuges or national parks.
2022013214.cn_text: 这些学生大多在孩童时期没有机会前往荒野地区、野生动物保护区或国家公园。

2022013215.en_text: Although good TV shows can help stir children’s interest in conservation, they cannot replace the excitement of a zoo visit as an intense, immersive and interactive experience.
2022013215.cn_text: 虽然优秀的电视节目能够激发孩子对保护工作的兴趣,但它们无法取代动物园参观所带来的那种强烈、沉浸式和互动性的体验。

2022013216.en_text: Surely there must be some middle ground that balances zoos’ treatment of animals with their educational potential.
2022013216.cn_text: 必然存在某种中间立场,能够在动物园对动物的对待与其教育潜力之间取得平衡。

2022013217.en_text: Emma Marris’s article is an insult and a disservice to the thousands of passionate people who work tirelessly to improve the lives of animals and protect our planet.
2022013217.cn_text: 艾玛·马里斯的文章是对成千上万为改善动物生活和保护地球而不懈努力的热忱人士的侮辱和伤害。

2022013218.en_text: She uses outdated research and decades-old examples to undermine the noble mission of organizations committed to connecting children to a world beyond their own.
2022013218.cn_text: 她利用过时的研究和数十年前的案例来削弱那些致力于让儿童接触更广阔世界的组织的崇高使命。

2022013219.en_text: Zoos are at the forefront of conservation and constantly evolving to improve how they care for animals and protect each species in its natural habitat.
2022013219.cn_text: 动物园处于保护工作的前沿,并不断改进照护动物的方式以及保护各物种在其自然栖息地的生存。

2022013222.en_text: But they are the exception, not the norm that Ms. Marris implies.
2022013222.cn_text: 但这些是例外情况,而非马里斯女士所暗示的常态。

2022013224.en_text: A distressed animal in a zoo will get as good or better treatment than most of us at our local hospital.
2022013224.cn_text: 动物园中处于困境的动物所获得的治疗,不亚于甚至优于我们大多数人在当地医院所得到的治疗。

2022013225.en_text: As a fellow environmentalist, animal-protection advocate and longtime vegetarian, I could properly be in the same camp as Emma Marris on the issue of zoos.
2022013225.cn_text: 作为一名环保主义者、动物保护倡导者和长期素食者,我本应在动物园问题上与艾玛·马里斯持相同立场。

2022013226.en_text: But I believe that well-run zoos, and the heroic animals that suffer their captivity, do serve a higher purpose.
2022013226.cn_text: 但我相信,管理良好的动物园以及那些忍受圈养之苦的英勇动物,确实服务于更高的目标。

2022013227.en_text: Were it not for opportunities to observe these beautiful, wild creatures close to home, many more people would be driven by their fascination to travel to wild areas to seek out, disturb and even hunt them down.
2022013227.cn_text: 若非有机会在家附近观察这些美丽的野生生物,更多的人将会在好奇心驱使下前往荒野地区寻找、打扰甚至猎杀它们。

2022013228.en_text: Zoos are, in that sense, similar to natural history and archaeology museums, serving to satisfy our need for contact with these living creatures while leaving the vast majority undisturbed in their natural environments.
2022013228.cn_text: 从这个意义上说,动物园类似于自然历史和考古博物馆,在满足我们与这些生物接触的需求的同时,让绝大多数生物在其自然环境中不受干扰。

2022013229.en_text: Emma Marris selectively describes and misrepresents the findings of our research.
2022013229.cn_text: 艾玛·马里斯选择性地描述并曲解了我们的研究发现。

2022013230.en_text: Our studies focused on the impact of zoo experiences on how people think about themselves and nature, and the data points extracted from our studies do not, in any way, discount what is learned in a zoo visit.
2022013230.cn_text: 我们的研究聚焦于动物园体验对人们如何看待自身与自然的影响,从我们研究中提取的数据点绝不会削弱动物园参观的学习价值。

2022013232.en_text: Our research provides strong support for the value of zoos in connecting people with animals and with nature.
2022013232.cn_text: 我们的研究为动物园在连接人类与动物及自然方面的价值提供了有力支持。

2022013233.en_text: Zoos provide a critical voice for conservation and environmental protection.
2022013233.cn_text: 动物园为保护和环境保护提供了重要的发声平台。

2022013234.en_text: They afford an opportunity for people from all backgrounds to encounter a range of animals, from drone bees to springbok or salmon, to better understand the natural world we live in.
2022013234.cn_text: 它们为来自各种背景的人们提供了接触多种动物的机会,从雄蜂到跳羚或鲑鱼,以更好地理解我们所生活的自然世界。

2022013235.en_text: Zoos which spare no effort to take care of animals should not be subjected to unfair criticism.
2022013235.cn_text: 不遗余力照护动物的动物园不应遭受不公正的批评。

2022013236.en_text: To pressure zoos to spend less on their animals would lead to inhumane outcomes for the precious creatures in their care.
2022013236.cn_text: 迫使动物园减少对动物的投入将导致它们照护的珍贵生物遭受非人道待遇。

2022013237.en_text: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
2022013237.cn_text: 虽然圈养动物值得同情,但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。

2022013238.en_text: Zoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.
2022013238.cn_text: 动物园使人们无需前往荒野地区,从而有助于野生动物保护。

2022013239.en_text: For wild animals that cannot be returned to their natural habitats, zoos offer the best alternative.
2022013239.cn_text: 对于无法回归自然栖息地的野生动物而言,动物园提供了最佳替代方案。

2022013240.en_text: Zoos should have been closed down as they prioritize money making over animals’ wellbeing.
2022013240.cn_text: 动物园本应被关闭,因为它们将营利置于动物福祉之上。

2022013241.en_text: Marris distorts our findings which actually prove that zoos serve as an indispensable link between man and nature.
2022013241.cn_text: 马里斯曲解了我们的研究结果,而这些结果实际上证明动物园是人与自然之间不可或缺的纽带。

2022013242.en_text: Between 1807 and 1814 the Iberian Peninsula (comprising Spain and Portugal) was the scene of a titanic and merciless struggle.
2022013242.cn_text: 1807年至1814年间，伊比利亚半岛（包括西班牙和葡萄牙）成为一场规模空前、残酷无情的斗争的舞台。

2022013243.en_text: It took place on many different planes: between Napoleon’s French army and the angry inhabitants; between the British, ever keen to exacerbate the emperor’s difficulties, and the marshals sent from Paris to try to keep them in check; between new forces of science and meritocracy and old ones of conservatism and birth.
2022013243.cn_text: 这场斗争在多个层面展开：拿破仑的法国军队与愤怒的当地居民之间；英国人（他们总是热衷于加剧皇帝的困境）与从巴黎派来试图遏制他们的元帅之间；新兴的科学与精英制度力量与保守主义和血统的旧势力之间。

2022013244.en_text: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them.
2022013244.cn_text: 这也是一场密码编制者与密码破译者之间的较量——这一点甚至许多对该时期颇有研究的人都不知晓。

2022013245.en_text: I first discovered the Napoleonic cryptographic battle a few years ago when I was reading Sir Charles Oman’s epic History of the Peninsular War.
2022013245.cn_text: 几年前，我在阅读查尔斯·奥曼爵士的史诗巨著《半岛战争史》时，首次发现了拿破仑时期的密码战。

2022013246.en_text: In volume V he had attached an appendix, “The Scovell Ciphers”.
2022013246.cn_text: 在第五卷中，他附上了一篇附录「斯科维尔密码」。

2022013247.en_text: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters.
2022013247.cn_text: 附录列出了许多从西班牙的法国军队中缴获的密码文件，这些文件的秘密被英国总部的一名军官乔治·斯科维尔破译。

2022013248.en_text: Oman rated Scovell’s significance highly, but at the same time, the general nature of his History meant that he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself.
2022013248.cn_text: 奥曼高度评价了斯科维尔的重要性，但与此同时，他的《半岛战争史》的整体性质使他无法仔细分析这位默默无闻的军官对国家间伟大斗争可能做出或未能做出的贡献，也无法向我们详细介绍这个人本身。

2022013249.en_text: I was keen to read more, but was surprised to find that Oman’s appendix, published in 1914, was the only considered thing that had been written about this secret war.
2022013249.cn_text: 我渴望了解更多，但令我惊讶的是，1914年出版的奥曼附录竟是关于这场秘密战争唯一经过深思熟虑的著述。

2022013250.en_text: I became convinced that this story was every bit as exciting and significant as that of Enigma and the breaking of German codes in the Second World War.
2022013250.cn_text: 我逐渐确信，这个故事与二战中的恩尼格玛密码破译事件一样激动人心且意义重大。

2022013251.en_text: The question was, could it be told?
2022013251.cn_text: 问题是，这个故事能否被讲述出来？

2022013252.en_text: Studying Scovell’s papers at the Public Record Office, London, I found that he had left an extensive journal and copious notes about his work in the Peninsula.
2022013252.cn_text: 在伦敦公共档案馆研究斯科维尔的文件时，我发现他留下了一本详尽的日记和大量关于他在半岛工作的笔记。

2022013253.en_text: What was more, many original French dispatches had been preserved in this collection, which I realized was priceless.
2022013253.cn_text: 更重要的是，该收藏中保存了许多法军原始电文，我意识到这些资料价值连城。

2022013254.en_text: There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic Wars, but it is usually extremely difficult to find the material they actually provided or worked on.
2022013254.cn_text: 拿破仑战争期间可能有许多间谍和情报官员，但通常极难找到他们实际提供或处理过的材料。

2022013255.en_text: As I researched Scovell’s story I found far more of interest besides his intelligence work.
2022013255.cn_text: 在研究斯科维尔的故事时，我发现除了他的情报工作之外，还有更多引人入胜的内容。

2022013256.en_text: His status in Lord Wellington’s headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.
2022013256.cn_text: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及他因工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队的阶级政治密切相关。

2022013257.en_text: His tale of selfimprovement and hard work would make a fascinating biography in its own right, but represents something more than that.
2022013257.cn_text: 他关于自我提升和努力工作的故事本身就足以成为一部引人入胜的传记，但其意义远不止于此。

2022013258.en_text: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
2022013258.cn_text: 正如密码破译在西班牙斗争中具有更广泛的意义，他努力攀登晋升阶梯的尝试也深刻反映了英国社会的状况。

2023013001.en_text: Caravanserais were roadside inns that were built along the Silk Road in areas including China, North Africa and the Middle East.
2023013001.cn_text: 驿站是沿丝绸之路建造的路边客栈，分布于中国、北非和中东等地区。

2023013002.en_text: They were typically located outside the walls of a city or village and were usually funded by local governments or privately.
2023013002.cn_text: 它们通常位于城市或村庄的城墙之外，一般由地方政府或私人资助。

2023013003.en_text: This word “Caravanserais” is a combination of the Persian words “Karvan”, which means a group of travellers or a caravan, and “saray”, a palace or enclosed building.
2023013003.cn_text: 「驿站」一词由波斯语「Karvan」（意为旅行者群体或商队）和「Saray」（意为宫殿或封闭式建筑）组合而成。

2023013004.en_text: The term caravan was used to describe groups of people who travelled together across the ancient network for safety reasons, such as merchants, travellers or pilgrims.
2023013004.cn_text: 「商队」一词用于描述出于安全考虑而结伴穿越这一古代网络的人群，如商人、旅行者或朝圣者。

2023013005.en_text: From the 10th century onwards, as merchant and travel routes became more developed, the construction of caravanserais increased and they served as a safe place for people to rest at night.
2023013005.cn_text: 自10世纪起，随着商贸和旅行路线日趋完善，驿站建设不断增加，成为人们夜间休憩的安全场所。

2023013006.en_text: Travellers on the Silk Road faced the possibility of being attacked by thieves or being subjected to extreme weather conditions.
2023013006.cn_text: 丝绸之路上的旅行者面临遭盗贼袭击或极端天气侵袭的风险。

2023013007.en_text: For this reason, caravanserais were strategically placed so that they could be reached in a day’s travel time.
2023013007.cn_text: 因此，驿站被战略性地部署，使旅行者能在一日行程内抵达。

2023013008.en_text: Caravanserais served as an informal meeting point for the various people who travelled the Silk Road.
2023013008.cn_text: 驿站成为丝绸之路上各色人群的非正式聚集点。

2023013009.en_text: As a result, these structures became important centers for cultural exchange and interaction, with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs, as well as taking knowledge with them, greatly influencing the development of several civilisations.
2023013009.cn_text: 因此，这些建筑成为文化交流与互动的重要中心，旅行者在此分享各自的文化、思想和信仰，同时带走知识，对多个文明的发展产生了深远影响。

2023013010.en_text: Caravanserais were also an important marketplace for commodities and aided in the trade of goods along the Silk Road.
2023013010.cn_text: 驿站也是重要的商品交易场所，促进了丝绸之路上的货物贸易。

2023013011.en_text: Indeed, it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and stock up on supplies for their own journeys.
2023013011.cn_text: 实际上，它常常是商人出售货物并为自身旅程补给物资的首站。

2023013012.en_text: It is believed that around 12,000 to 15,000 caravanserais were built along the Silk Road, although only about 3,000 are known to remain today, many of which are in ruins.
2023013012.cn_text: 据信丝绸之路沿线曾建有约12,000至15,000座驿站，但今天已知仅存约3,000座,其中多数已成废墟。

2023013013.en_text: The weather in Texas may have cooled since the recent extreme heat, but the temperature will be high at the State Board of Education meeting in Austin this month as officials debate how climate change is taught in Texas schools.
2023013013.cn_text: 德克萨斯州的天气或许已从近期的极端高温中冷却下来，但本月在奥斯汀召开的州教育委员会会议上，随着官员们就气候变化在德州学校的教学方式展开辩论，气氛将十分火热。

2023013014.en_text: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
2023013014.cn_text: 同情能源行业观点的帕特·哈迪正在抵制针对青春期前学生提出的科学标准修改方案。

2023013015.en_text: “There are as many scientists working against all the panic of global climate change as there are those who are pushing it,” she claims.
2023013015.cn_text: 她声称：「反对全球气候变化恐慌的科学家与推动这种恐慌的科学家数量一样多。」

2023013016.en_text: “Texas is an energy state and we need to recognise that.
2023013016.cn_text: 「德克萨斯是一个能源州，我们需要认识到这一点。」

2023013017.en_text: You need to remember where your bread is buttered.”
2023013017.cn_text: 「你需要记住是谁给你饭碗的。」

2023013018.en_text: Most scientists and experts sharply dispute Hardy’s views.
2023013018.cn_text: 大多数科学家和专家强烈反驳哈迪的观点。

2023013019.en_text: Board members like her “casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion,” says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education.
2023013019.cn_text: 德克萨斯自由网络高级传播战略官丹·奎因表示，像她这样的委员会成员「随意地将学者和科学家的职业研究成果贬为又一种被误导的观点」。该组织是一家监督公共教育的非营利机构。

2023013020.en_text: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers, teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
2023013020.cn_text: 这些辩论反映了美国各地的激烈讨论，研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生纷纷加大呼声，要求学校教学更多地聚焦气候变化的事实。

2023013021.en_text: A study last year by the National Center for Science Education, a non-profit group of scientists and teachers, looking at how state public schools across the country address climate change in science classes, gave barely half of US states a grade B+ or higher.
2023013021.cn_text: 去年由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织国家科学教育中心开展的一项研究调查了全国各州公立学校在科学课程中如何讲授气候变化问题，结果显示仅有不到半数的美国州获得了B+或更高的评级。

2023013022.en_text: Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere.
2023013022.cn_text: 表现最差的10个州中包括一些人口最多的州，其中得克萨斯州获得了最低评级（F），并因其教材在其他地区广泛销售而具有不成比例的影响力。

2023013023.en_text: Glenn Branch, the center’s deputy director, cautions that setting state-level science standards is only one limited benchmark in a country that decentralises decisions to local school boards.
2023013023.cn_text: 该中心副主任格伦·布兰奇提醒说，在一个将决策权下放至地方学校董事会的国家，设定州级科学标准只是一项有限的基准。

2023013024.en_text: Even if a state is considered a high performer in its science standards, “that does not mean it will be taught”, he says.
2023013024.cn_text: 他说，即使一个州在科学标准方面被视为表现优异者，「这并不意味着这些标准会得到实施」。

2023013025.en_text: Another issue is that, while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages — such as earth and space sciences in high schools — it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry.
2023013025.cn_text: 另一个问题是，尽管气候变化在某些学科和某些年龄段——如高中的地球与空间科学——中得到了较好融入，但在低年龄段课程以及更广泛教授的学科（如生物学和化学）中却未得到充分体现。

2023013026.en_text: It is also less prominent in many social studies courses.
2023013026.cn_text: 在许多社会研究课程中，气候变化的地位也不够突出。

2023013027.en_text: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
2023013027.cn_text: 布兰奇指出，即使越来越多的官方指导方针和教科书反映了关于气候变化的科学共识，传递更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师分发。

2023013028.en_text: They include materials sponsored by libertarian think-tanks and energy industry associations.
2023013028.cn_text: 这些材料包括由自由意志主义智库和能源行业协会赞助的材料。

2023013029.cn_text: 第1段提到德克萨斯州的天气是为了____。

2023013030.en_text: forecast a policy shift in Texas schools.
2023013030.cn_text: 预示德克萨斯州学校政策的转变

2023013031.en_text: stress the consequences of climate change.

2023013033.cn_text: 引起公众对能源短缺的关注

2023013034.en_text: What does Quinn think of Hardy?

2023013036.en_text: She denies the value of scientific work.
2023013036.cn_text: 她否定科学工作的价值

2023013037.cn_text: 她对青春期前儿童漠不关心

2023013040.en_text: climate education is insufficient at state public schools.
2023013040.cn_text: 州立公立学校的气候教育不足

2023013041.en_text: policymakers have little drive for science education.
2023013041.cn_text: 政策制定者对科学教育缺乏推动力

2023013042.en_text: Texas is reluctant to rewrite its science textbooks.
2023013042.cn_text: 德克萨斯州不愿重写其科学教材

2023013043.en_text: environmental teaching in some states lacks supervision.
2023013043.cn_text: 部分州的环境教学缺乏监督

2023013049.en_text: It is implied in the last paragraph that climate change teaching in some schools ____
2023013049.cn_text: 最后一段暗示部分学校的气候变化教学____。

2023013053.en_text: can be swayed by external forces.
2023013053.cn_text: 可能受到外部力量的左右

2023013054.en_text: Communities throughout New England have been attempting to regulate short-term rentals since sites like Airbnb took off in the 2010s.
2023013054.cn_text: 自2010年代Airbnb等网站兴起以来,整个新英格兰地区的社区一直在试图规范短期租赁。

2023013055.en_text: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there’s an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
2023013055.cn_text: 如今,在房价创历史新高、库存创历史新低的情况下,这种监管变得更加紧迫,尤其是在那些担心开发商会大量收购住房、在短期租赁市场上牟取暴利的人群中。

2023013056.en_text: In New Hampshire, where the rental vacancy rate has dropped below 1 percent, housing advocates fear unchecked short-term rentals will put further pressure on an already strained market.
2023013056.cn_text: 在新罕布什尔州,租赁空置率已降至1%以下,住房倡导者担心不受监管的短期租赁将进一步加剧本已紧张的市场压力。

2023013057.en_text: The State Legislature recently voted against a bill that would’ve made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
2023013057.cn_text: 州立法机构最近否决了一项法案,该法案原本会禁止城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规。

2023013058.en_text: “We are at a crisis level on the supply of rental housing,” said Nick Taylor, executive director of the Workforce Housing Coalition of the Greater Seacoast.
2023013058.cn_text: 大海岸地区劳动力住房联盟执行董事尼克·泰勒说:「我们在租赁住房供应方面处于危机水平。」

2023013059.en_text: Without enough affordable housing in southern New Hampshire towns, “employers are having a hard time attracting employees, and workers are having a hard time finding a place to live,” Taylor said.
2023013059.cn_text: 泰勒表示,在新罕布什尔州南部城镇缺乏足够经济适用房的情况下,「雇主很难吸引员工,而员工也很难找到住处」。

2023013060.en_text: However, short-term rentals also provide housing for tourists, pointed out Ryan Castle, CEO of a local association of realtors.
2023013060.cn_text: 然而,当地房地产经纪人协会首席执行官瑞安·卡斯尔指出,短期租赁也为游客提供了住房。

2023013061.en_text: “A lot of workers are servicing the tourist industry, and the tourism industry is serviced by those people coming in short term,” Castle said, “and so it’s a cyclical effect.”
2023013061.cn_text: 卡斯尔说:「许多工人为旅游业服务,而旅游业也依赖短期入住的游客,所以这是一个循环效应。」

2023013062.en_text: Short-term rentals themselves are not the crux of the issue, said Keren Horn, an expert on affordable housing policy.
2023013062.cn_text: 经济适用房政策专家凯伦·霍恩表示,短期租赁本身并非问题的关键。

2023013063.en_text: “I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing.
2023013063.cn_text: 「我认为个人能够出租第二套住房是件好事。

2023013064.en_text: If it’s their vacation home anyway, and it’s just empty, why can’t you make money off it?” Horn said.
2023013064.cn_text: 如果它本就是度假屋,而且闲置着,为什么不能用它赚钱呢?」霍恩说道。

2023013065.en_text: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities — de facto hotels — to bypass taxes and regulations.
2023013065.cn_text: 然而,当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和监管时,问题就出现了。

2023013066.en_text: “I think the question is, shouldn’t a developer who’s really building a hotel, but disguising it as not a hotel, be treated and taxed and regulated like a hotel?” Horn said.
2023013066.cn_text: 霍恩说:「我认为问题是,一个实际在建酒店却伪装成非酒店的开发商,难道不应该像酒店一样被对待、征税和监管吗?」

2023013067.en_text: At the end of 2018, Governor Charlie Baker of Massachusetts signed a bill to rein in those potential investor-buyers.
2023013067.cn_text: 2018年底,马萨诸塞州州长查理·贝克签署了一项法案,以遏制这些潜在的投资买家。

2023013068.en_text: The bill requires every rental host to register with the state, mandates they carry insurance, and opens the potential for local taxes on top of a new state levy.
2023013068.cn_text: 该法案要求每位租赁房东在州内注册、强制购买保险,并可能在新州税的基础上征收地方税。

2023013069.en_text: Boston took things even further, requiring renters to register with the city’s Inspectional Services Department.
2023013069.cn_text: 波士顿走得更远,要求租赁者在市检验服务部门注册。

2023013070.en_text: Horn said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but “if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more.”
2023013070.cn_text: 霍恩表示,类似的登记要求可能会使陷入困境的城市和城镇受益,但「如果我们想改变住房市场,最关键的是我们必须建造更多住房」。

2023013096.en_text: If you’re heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones, the biggest book retailer in the UK, in search of the Duchess of Sussex’s new children’s book The Bench, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of The President’s Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson.
2023013096.cn_text: 如果你正前往英国最大图书零售商沃特斯通书店最近的分店，寻找萨塞克斯公爵夫人的新儿童读物《长椅》，可能需要做好四处搜寻的准备；比尔·克林顿和詹姆斯·帕特森合著的新惊悚小说《总统的女儿》情况可能也是如此。

2023013097.en_text: Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House (PRH), a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.
2023013097.cn_text: 这两本书均将于下周由企鹅兰登书屋（PRH）出版，该公司目前正与沃特斯通书店陷入对峙。

2023013098.en_text: The problem began late last year, when PRH confirmed that it had introduced a credit limit with Waterstones “at a very significant level”.
2023013098.cn_text: 问题始于去年年底，当时企鹅兰登书屋证实已对沃特斯通书店实施了「非常高水平」的信用额度限制。

2023013099.en_text: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were “quietly retiring them to their relevant sections”.
2023013099.cn_text: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，沃特斯通书店各分店经理接到指示，将企鹅兰登书屋的图书从书桌、展示区和橱窗等显眼位置撤下，「悄悄地将它们归入相应的分类区域」。

2023013100.en_text: PRH declined to comment on the issue, but a spokesperson for Waterstones told me: “Waterstones are currently operating with reduced credit terms from PRH, the only publisher in the UK to place any limitations on our ability to trade.
2023013100.cn_text: 企鹅兰登书屋拒绝就此事发表评论，但沃特斯通书店的一位发言人告诉我：「沃特斯通书店目前正在企鹅兰登书屋缩减的信用条件下运营，该出版商是英国唯一对我们经营能力施加限制的出版商。」

2023013101.en_text: We are not boycotting PRH titles but we are doing our utmost to ensure that availability for customers remains good despite the lower overall levels of stock.” “We are hopeful with our shops now open again that normality will return and that we will be allowed to buy appropriately.
2023013101.cn_text: 「我们并未抵制企鹅兰登书屋的图书，但我们正在竭尽全力确保尽管整体库存水平降低，顾客仍能获得良好的供应。」「我们希望随着门店重新开业，正常状态能够恢复，我们也能够进行适当的采购。」

2023013102.en_text: Certainly, our shops are exceptionally busy.
2023013102.cn_text: 当然，我们的门店生意异常火爆。

2023013103.en_text: The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018.”
2023013103.cn_text: 我们五月本月推荐图书的销量超过了2018年以来任何一个月份。

2023013104.en_text: In the meantime, PRH authors have been the losers.
2023013104.cn_text: 与此同时，企鹅兰登书屋的作者们成了受损方。

2023013105.en_text: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it’s those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff’s passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.
2023013105.cn_text: 知名的企鹅兰登书屋作者可能会受到一些影响，但那些通常依靠沃特斯通书店员工热情推广不太知名作家作品的中等层级作者，将会祈祷争端早日结束。

2023013106.en_text: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster — the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
2023013106.cn_text: 此事发生之际，作者们已经在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一大出版商西蒙与舒斯特拟议合并的后果——英国非联盟出版商数量的减少可能导致竞价战减少、预付款降低以及出版内容趋于同质化。

2023013107.en_text: “This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power,” says literary agent Andrew Lownie.
2023013107.cn_text: 文学经纪人安德鲁·劳尼表示：「这都是权力集中这一更广泛变革的组成部分。」

2023013108.en_text: “The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
2023013108.cn_text: 「出版行业在谈论作者和员工的多元化，但它同样需要多样化的途径来传递思想内容、提供选择和呈现不同声音。」

2023013109.en_text: After all, many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers.”
2023013109.cn_text: 「毕竟，近年来许多最具趣味的图书都出自小型出版商。」

2023013110.en_text: We shall see whether that plurality is a casualty of the current need among publishers to be big enough to take on all-comers.
2023013110.cn_text: 我们将拭目以待，这种多元化是否会成为出版商当前为应对所有竞争者而必须做大做强的牺牲品。

2023013131.en_text: Which of the following statements best represents Lownie’s view?
2023013131.cn_text: 以下哪项陈述最能代表劳尼的观点？

2023013132.en_text: Small publishers ought to stick together.
2023013132.cn_text: 小型出版商应该团结一致。

2023013133.en_text: Big publishers will lose their dominance.
2023013133.cn_text: 大型出版商将丧失其主导地位。

2023013134.en_text: The publishing industry is having a hard time.
2023013134.cn_text: 出版行业正经历艰难时期。

2023013135.en_text: The merger of publishers is a worrying trend.
2023013135.cn_text: 出版商合并是一个令人担忧的趋势。

2023013136.en_text: Scientific papers are the recordkeepers of progress in research.
2023013136.cn_text: 科学论文是研究进展的记录载体。

2023013137.en_text: Each year researchers publish millions of papers in more than 30,000 journals.
2023013137.cn_text: 研究人员每年在超过30,000种期刊上发表数百万篇论文。

2023013138.en_text: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title’s impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
2023013138.cn_text: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量,包括期刊的公认质量(体现为该期刊的影响因子)以及特定论文所积累的引用次数。

2023013139.en_text: The careers of scientists and the reputation of their institutions depend on the number and prestige of the papers they produce, but even more so on the citations attracted by these papers.
2023013139.cn_text: 科学家的职业发展和所在机构的声誉取决于其发表论文的数量和声望,但更取决于这些论文所获得的引用次数。

2023013140.en_text: Citation cartels, where journals, authors, and institutions conspire to inflate citation numbers, have existed for a long time.
2023013140.cn_text: 引用联盟,即期刊、作者和机构共谋虚增引用数量的行为,已存在很长时间。

2023013141.en_text: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.
2023013141.cn_text: 2016年,研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式,包括作者群体之间的不成比例相互引用,以及期刊群体之间通过频繁相互引用来提高其出版物影响因子的行为。

2023013142.en_text: Recently, another expression of this predatory behavior has emerged: so-called support service consultancies that provide language and other editorial support to individual authors and to journals sometimes advise contributors to add a number of citations to their articles.
2023013142.cn_text: 近来,这种掠夺性行为出现了新的表现形式:所谓的支持服务咨询机构为个别作者和期刊提供语言及其他编辑支持,有时会建议投稿者在其文章中添加若干引用。

2023013143.en_text: The advent of electronic publishing and authors’ need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.
2023013143.cn_text: 电子出版的兴起以及作者寻找论文发表平台的需求催生了数千种新期刊。

2023013144.en_text: The birth of predatory journals wasn’t far behind.
2023013144.cn_text: 掠夺性期刊的出现紧随其后。

2023013145.en_text: These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers.
2023013145.cn_text: 这些期刊可充当引用工具,某一期中的每篇文章都可能引用某篇特定论文或一系列论文。

2023013146.en_text: In some instances, there is absolutely no relationship between the content of the article and the citations.
2023013146.cn_text: 在某些情况下,文章内容与所引文献之间毫无关联。

2023013147.en_text: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all — it is just providing citations to other journals.
2023013147.cn_text: 奇怪之处在于,编辑名义上服务的期刊本身并未从中获利——它只是为其他期刊提供引用。

2023013148.en_text: Such practices can lead an article to accrue more than 150 citations in the same year that it was published.
2023013148.cn_text: 这种做法可使一篇文章在发表当年就累积超过150次引用。

2023013149.en_text: How insidious is this type of citation manipulation?
2023013149.cn_text: 这类引用操纵有多隐蔽?

2023013150.en_text: In one example, an individual — acting as author, editor, and consultant — was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.
2023013150.cn_text: 在一个案例中,某个人同时担任作者、编辑和顾问,能够利用至少15种期刊为三所大学五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。

2023013151.en_text: The problem is rampant in Scopus, a citation database, which includes a high number of the new “international” journals.
2023013151.cn_text: 这一问题在引文数据库Scopus中十分猖獗,该数据库收录了大量新的「国际」期刊。

2023013152.en_text: In fact, a listing in Scopus seems to be a criterion to be targeted in this type of citation manipulation.
2023013152.cn_text: 事实上,被Scopus收录似乎成为这类引用操纵的目标标准。

2023013153.en_text: Scopus itself has all the data necessary to detect this malpractice.
2023013153.cn_text: Scopus本身拥有检测此类不当行为所需的全部数据。

2023013154.en_text: Red flags include a large number of citations to an article within the first year.
2023013154.cn_text: 警示信号包括某篇文章在发表第一年内就获得大量引用。

2023013155.en_text: And for authors who wish to steer clear of citation cartel activities: when an editor, a reviewer, or a support service asks you to add inappropriate references, do not oblige and do report the request to the journal.
2023013155.cn_text: 对于希望避开引用联盟活动的作者而言:当编辑、审稿人或支持服务机构要求您添加不当引用时,切勿照做,并应向期刊举报这一要求。

2023013157.en_text: how many citations their works contain.

2023013158.en_text: how many times their papers are cited.

2023013164.cn_text: 要求作者添加额外引用

2023013167.cn_text: 提升特定作者的引用次数

2023013168.cn_text: 帮助学者低成本发表文章
