2026013193.en_text: And just read a single poem.

2026013194.en_text: In his Oxford lectures, Seamus Heaney argued that a poem draws a picture of reality, a “glimpsed alternative” that sets up a contradiction with your own, in ways little and large.
2026013194.cn_text: 在牛津讲座中，谢默斯·希尼认为，一首诗描绘了现实图景，呈现一种「瞥见的另类可能」，以或大或小的方式与读者自身的现实形成矛盾对照。

2026013195.en_text: The negotiation, between you and it, is the heart of the matter.
2026013195.cn_text: 你与诗之间的协商，正是问题的核心所在。

2026013196.en_text: What does the poet see that you don’t?
2026013196.cn_text: 诗人看到了什么是你未曾看到的？

2026013198.en_text: It could be one of the best conversations you ever have.
2026013198.cn_text: 这可能是你有过的最好的对话之一。

2026013199.en_text: Forget self-help books; reading is self-help in action.
2026013199.cn_text: 忘掉自助类书籍；阅读本身就是实践中的自助。

2026013200.en_text: But for the most part, this isn’t what the business community does.
2026013200.cn_text: 但大多数情况下，商界并非如此。

2026013201.en_text: I have yet to meet a chief executive who reads regularly.
2026013201.cn_text: 我至今未曾遇到一位有规律阅读习惯的首席执行官。

2026013202.en_text: Many skip newspapers, and magazines are a stretch.
2026013202.cn_text: 许多人跳过报纸，而杂志则更难触及。

2026013203.en_text: They don’t have time, they say.

2026013204.en_text: It’s inefficient; they can get the information they need from those around them.
2026013204.cn_text: 阅读效率低下；他们可以从周围的人那里获得所需信息。

2026013205.en_text: At a pinch, they might pick up a business book before a long flight, in the hope that, like a cookbook, it will provide a foolproof recipe.
2026013205.cn_text: 必要时，他们可能会在长途飞行前拿起一本商业书籍，希望它像食谱一样提供万无一失的配方。

2026013206.en_text: Some are drawn to what I think of as “business car crash” books — the stories of Theranos, Purdue, or WeWork.
2026013206.cn_text: 有些人被我称之为「商业车祸」类书籍吸引——讲述Theranos、普渡制药或WeWork的故事。

2026013207.en_text: But outside those narrow pools of interest, a vast ocean awaits, bountiful with simmering ideas, mental adventure and imaginative refreshment.
2026013207.cn_text: 但在这些狭窄的兴趣池之外，还有一片浩瀚的海洋在等待，其中充满了酝酿的思想、精神探险和想象力的更新。

2026013208.en_text: Neuroscientists have been at pains to demonstrate that the pleasure a book provides isn’t indulgence; it’s good for you.
2026013208.cn_text: 神经科学家一直努力证明，书籍带来的愉悦不是放纵，而是对你有益。

2026013209.en_text: Reading will keep you better informed about the world but it can also improve our tech-shattered ability to concentrate.
2026013209.cn_text: 阅读不仅能让你更好地了解世界，还能改善我们被科技侵蚀的专注能力。

2026013210.en_text: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
2026013210.cn_text: 站在他人立场能够微调我们的社会理解能力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时大有裨益。

2026013211.en_text: Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes, characters and mental states.
2026013211.cn_text: 当我们模拟场景、人物和心理状态时，大脑的不同部分会参与其中。

2026013212.cn_text: 我们的想象力——还记得吗？

2026013214.en_text: It is undoubtedly true that all work and no play really does make Jack, or Jill, dull.
2026013214.cn_text: 毫无疑问，只工作不玩耍确实会让杰克或吉尔变得乏味。

2026013215.en_text: The cure is right at hand.

2026013216.en_text: Reading is cheap, easy and, most important, it’s fun.
2026013216.cn_text: 阅读既廉价又简单，最重要的是，它充满乐趣。

2026013217.cn_text: 今年就释放你的想象力吧。

2026013218.en_text: We are living through a golden age of science writing, so lucid and accessible that even lay readers can relish the unpredictability of discovery.
2026013218.cn_text: 我们正处于科学写作的黄金时代，这些作品如此清晰易懂，即便是普通读者也能领略发现的不可预测性之乐。

2026013220.en_text: Stand in the shoes of scientists and witness the degree to which breakthroughs emerge from accidents, conflict and sheer mental stamina.
2026013220.cn_text: 站在科学家的立场上，见证突破在多大程度上源于偶然、冲突和纯粹的精神毅力。

2026013221.en_text: “We are never sure of anything,” says the physicist (and writer) Carlo Rovelli.
2026013221.cn_text: 「我们从未对任何事情确信无疑，」物理学家（兼作家）卡洛·罗韦利说。

2026013222.en_text: You don’t need to get out more.

2026013223.en_text: If, like most business people, you spend your life dashing from office to plane, train to home, boardroom to washroom, what you really need to do is stay in more, sit down — and read a book.
2026013223.cn_text: 如果你像大多数商界人士一样，生活在办公室、飞机、火车、家、会议室和洗手间之间奔波，那么你真正需要做的是多待在室内，坐下来——读一本书。

2026013224.en_text: Reading has also been found to make us more helpful, to reduce bias, and even to increase longevity — something we will enjoy all the more if we have a good book in our hands.
2026013224.cn_text: 研究还发现，阅读能让我们更乐于助人，减少偏见，甚至延长寿命——如果手中有一本好书，我们将更加享受这一切。

2026013225.en_text: (And yes, all these benefits are more closely associated with physical books than digital ones.)
2026013225.cn_text: （是的，所有这些益处与实体书的关联都比电子书更紧密。）

2026013228.en_text: Free yourself from algorithms and choose — anything.
2026013228.cn_text: 摆脱算法束缚，自由选择——任何作品。

2026013229.en_text: You don’t need technology for an immersive experience — just surrender to narratives across time and place.
2026013229.cn_text: 你不需要技术来获得沉浸式体验——只需投身于跨越时空的叙事之中。

2026013230.en_text: Modern (Sebastian Barry or Olga Tokarczuk), classic (Virginia Woolf or James Baldwin) or genre (Stephen King, Margaret Atwood, Georges Simenon) — it doesn’t matter.
2026013230.cn_text: 现代的（塞巴斯蒂安·巴里或奥尔加·托卡尔丘克）、经典的（弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫或詹姆斯·鲍德温）或类型的（斯蒂芬·金、玛格丽特·阿特伍德、乔治·西默农）——都无关紧要。

2026013231.en_text: Fiction invites you to loiter unseen in the lives of others.
2026013231.cn_text: 小说邀请你在他人的生活中不为人知地流连。

2026013232.en_text: We are living through a golden age of translation too, so you can go anywhere in time or place.
2026013232.cn_text: 我们也正处于翻译的黄金时代，因此你可以前往任何时间或地点。

2026013233.en_text: Science education today revolves around the idea of scientific literacy — the base-level knowledge about science that nonscientists require to effectively get on in the world.
2026013233.cn_text: 当今的科学教育围绕科学素养这一理念展开——即非科学家有效应对现实世界所需的基础科学知识。

2026013234.en_text: This concept has served as a central goal for curriculum developers, local school boards, business and community leaders, and policymakers ever since its introduction nearly 80 years ago.
2026013234.cn_text: 自近80年前这一概念被引入以来，它一直是课程开发者、地方学校董事会、商业和社区领袖以及政策制定者的核心目标。

2026013235.en_text: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
2026013235.cn_text: 追溯这一术语的历史，我们可以看到科学素养的定义如何随时间推移而变化，这使得确定科学教育目标变得愈发模糊。

2026013236.en_text: And that’s a shame, because there is much to recommend in the idea of scientific literacy as it was originally articulated in 1945, a time when science appeared to be the key to progress and scientists seemingly held the fate of the world in their hands.
2026013236.cn_text: 这令人遗憾，因为科学素养这一理念在1945年最初提出时确有许多可取之处，彼时科学似乎是进步的关键，科学家似乎将世界的命运掌握在手中。

2026013237.en_text: A return to that version of scientific literacy, which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts, seems like something society today desperately needs.
2026013237.cn_text: 回归那个版本的科学素养——更注重教授科学的本质及其运作方式,而非记忆科学事实——似乎正是当今社会迫切需要的。

2026013238.en_text: In the United States, the desire to provide the public with a general, nontechnical education in science originated as far back as the late 1800s.
2026013238.cn_text: 在美国,为公众提供普遍性、非技术性科学教育的愿望早在19世纪末便已产生。

2026013239.en_text: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.
2026013239.cn_text: 教育工作者提出让学生在高中完成详细实验室练习的主张,认为这类工作的主要益处在于增强逻辑推理和观察能力。

2026013240.en_text: The development in 1915 of the popular new subject “general science” was another effort to train students to apply the principles of science to everyday, nonscience problems.
2026013240.cn_text: 1915年开设的热门新科目「普通科学」是另一项努力,旨在训练学生将科学原理应用于日常非科学问题。

2026013241.en_text: Although these efforts were aimed at the nonscience-bound student, they never really made their way into mainstream thought and public discourse as a means to rally widespread support for the importance of science teaching in schools.
2026013241.cn_text: 尽管这些努力面向非理工科学生,但它们从未真正进入主流思想和公共话语,未能成为号召广泛支持学校科学教学重要性的手段。

2026013242.en_text: It wasn’t until the phrase “scientific literacy” came along in the 1940s that science had the formidable slogan it needed to command public attention and make improving science education an important national goal.
2026013242.cn_text: 直到20世纪40年代「科学素养」这一短语出现,科学才拥有了吸引公众注意所需的有力口号,并使改善科学教育成为重要的国家目标。

2026013243.en_text: The intense focus on scientific literacy in the United States originally grew out of the critical role of science and technology during World War II, as well as the perceived deficiencies of American soldiers.
2026013243.cn_text: 美国对科学素养的高度关注最初源于科学技术在第二次世界大战中的关键作用,以及对美国士兵能力不足的认知。

2026013244.en_text: As the war unfolded, science rapidly assumed a central role.
2026013244.cn_text: 随着战争的展开,科学迅速发挥起核心作用。

2026013245.en_text: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
2026013245.cn_text: 战斗越来越依赖雷达和近炸引信等新型军事技术。

2026013246.en_text: Sciencebased analytical approaches proved remarkably successful in the hunt for German submarines in the Atlantic Ocean.
2026013246.cn_text: 基于科学的分析方法在大西洋搜寻德国潜艇行动中取得了显著成效。

2026013247.en_text: And there was the (then-secret) work building the world’s first atomic bomb.
2026013247.cn_text: 还有建造世界首颗原子弹的工作(当时属于机密)。

2026013248.en_text: As a result, scientists — physicists in particular — found themselves in high demand.
2026013248.cn_text: 因此,科学家——尤其是物理学家——需求量大增。

2026024555.en_text: We are excited to announce that the Postgraduates’ Association is recruiting volunteers for the upcoming international conference on globalization, which will be held next month.
2026024555.cn_text: 研究生协会现为下月举办的全球化国际会议招募志愿者，特此公告。

2026024556.en_text: Applicants are required to possess fluent English listening and speaking skills, a solid understanding of globalization-related academic topics, and excellent interpersonal abilities.
2026024556.cn_text: 申请者须具备流利的英语听说能力、扎实的全球化相关学术知识储备以及良好的人际沟通能力。

2026024557.en_text: Priority will be given to candidates with prior experience in conference volunteering.
2026024557.cn_text: 有会议志愿服务经历者优先考虑。

2026024558.en_text: Selected volunteers will be responsible for tasks such as foreign guest reception, on-site coordination, and document translation.
2026024558.cn_text: 入选志愿者将承担外宾接待、现场协调及文件翻译等工作。

2026024559.en_text: This is a valuable opportunity to gain international exposure and enhance your professional skills.
2026024559.cn_text: 这是拓展国际视野、提升专业素养的宝贵机会。

2026024560.en_text: Please submit your application form to our office no later than October 15th.
2026024560.cn_text: 请于10月15日前将申请表提交至本协会办公室。

2026024561.en_text: For further inquiries, feel free to contact us.

2026024563.en_text: The cartoon vividly depicts a steaming traditional Chinese hot pot, brimming with a variety of cultural symbols.
2026024563.cn_text: 这幅漫画生动描绘了一锅热气腾腾的中式火锅,其中盛满了各种文化符号。

2026024564.en_text: On one side, it features traditional Chinese treasures such as Peking Opera, Confucian ideals of benevolence, kung fu, and the works of writer Lao She.
2026024564.cn_text: 锅的一侧是中国传统文化瑰宝,如京剧、儒家仁爱思想、功夫及作家老舍的作品。

2026024565.en_text: On the other side, it includes Western cultural icons like Shakespeare, Einstein, and postmodern theories.
2026024565.cn_text: 另一侧则包含西方文化标志,如莎士比亚、爱因斯坦和后现代理论。

2026024566.en_text: The caption aptly describes this cultural hot pot as both delicious and nutritious, symbolizing the harmonious blending of diverse cultures.
2026024566.cn_text: 图中文字恰切地将这锅文化火锅形容为既美味又营养,象征着多元文化的和谐交融。

2026024567.en_text: The image conveys a profound message about the beauty and necessity of cultural integration.
2026024567.cn_text: 这幅图像传达了文化融合之美与必要性这一深刻主题。

2026024568.en_text: By combining the essence of fine traditional Chinese culture with the achievements of outstanding foreign civilizations, we can create a richer and more vibrant cultural landscape.
2026024568.cn_text: 通过将中国优秀传统文化的精髓与外国杰出文明的成就相结合,我们能够创造更加丰富生动的文化图景。

2026024569.en_text: This fusion not only promotes mutual understanding but also fosters innovation and progress in various fields.
2026024569.cn_text: 这种融合不仅促进相互理解,还在各领域推动创新与进步。

2026024570.en_text: In my view, it is essential to preserve and cherish our own cultural heritage while remaining open to learning from other cultures.
2026024570.cn_text: 我认为,在保护珍视自身文化遗产的同时,保持学习借鉴他国文化的开放态度至关重要。

2026024571.en_text: Such an inclusive approach can inspire creativity and drive the evolution of a dynamic and diverse cultural system.
2026024571.cn_text: 这种包容态度能够激发创造力,推动形成充满活力的多元文化体系。

2026024572.en_text: By embracing cultural exchange, we can build a more interconnected and harmonious global community, where different traditions coexist and thrive together.
2026024572.cn_text: 通过积极开展文化交流,我们能够构建联系更加紧密、更加和谐的全球共同体,让不同传统共存共荣。

2026024595.en_text: I hope this letter finds you well.

2026024596.en_text: I am writing to recommend one of my favorite movies, *Coco*.
2026024596.cn_text: 我写信想向你推荐我最喜爱的电影之一《寻梦环游记》。

2026024597.en_text: This animated masterpiece is visually stunning and deeply moving, telling a heartwarming story about family affection and the importance of cherishing memories.
2026024597.cn_text: 这部动画佳作画面精美、情感真挚，讲述了一个关于家庭亲情与珍视记忆之重要性的温情故事。

2026024598.en_text: I believe its touching plot and emotional depth will resonate with you.
2026024598.cn_text: 我相信它动人的情节和深刻的情感会引发你的共鸣。

2026024599.en_text: What makes *Coco* truly special is its wonderful music and vivid storytelling.
2026024599.cn_text: 《寻梦环游记》的真正特别之处在于其出色的音乐与生动的叙事。

2026024600.en_text: The movie combines laughter and tears while inspiring thoughts about family bonds.
2026024600.cn_text: 影片在欢笑与泪水中交织，同时引发对家庭纽带的深入思考。

2026024601.en_text: Additionally, its depiction of Mexican culture is both fascinating and educational.
2026024601.cn_text: 此外，它对墨西哥文化的呈现既迷人又富有教益。

2026024602.en_text: I am confident you will enjoy this film as much as I did.
2026024602.cn_text: 我确信你会和我一样喜爱这部影片。

2026024605.en_text: The picture vividly depicts a sightseeing boat sailing on a river surrounded by garbage floating on the water.
2026024605.cn_text: 这幅图生动地描绘了一艘观光船在河上航行，周围水面上漂浮着大量垃圾。

2026024606.en_text: This trash, left by tourists, not only ruins the natural beauty but also serves as a reminder of the consequences of irresponsible travel behavior.
2026024606.cn_text: 这些由游客留下的垃圾不仅破坏了自然美景,还警示着不负责任的旅游行为所带来的后果。

2026024607.en_text: The contrast between the serene environment and the unsightly waste urges viewers to reflect on their actions.
2026024607.cn_text: 宁静的环境与刺眼的垃圾之间形成的鲜明对比,促使观者反思自身行为。

2026024608.en_text: This image highlights the lack of environmental awareness among some travelers.
2026024608.cn_text: 这幅图揭示了部分游客环保意识的缺失。

2026024609.en_text: Carelessly discarding waste during trips harms both the scenery and the ecological balance, causing long-term damage.
2026024609.cn_text: 旅行中随意丢弃垃圾既破坏了自然景观,又打破了生态平衡,造成长期危害。

2026024610.en_text: The joy of travel should not come at the expense of nature.
2026024610.cn_text: 旅行的快乐不应建立在牺牲自然的基础上。

2026024611.en_text: Protecting the environment is a shared responsibility, and neglecting it can lead to irreversible consequences.
2026024611.cn_text: 保护环境是共同的责任,对此视而不见可能导致无法挽回的后果。

2026024612.en_text: To tackle this issue, tourists should adopt eco-friendly habits, such as carrying their trash away and using proper disposal facilities.
2026024612.cn_text: 要解决这一问题,游客应养成环保习惯,如自行带走垃圾、使用正规处理设施等。

2026024613.en_text: Authorities can enforce stricter regulations, provide more waste bins, and raise awareness through educational campaigns.
2026024613.cn_text: 政府部门可以制定更严格的规章制度,增设垃圾箱,并通过教育宣传活动提升公众意识。

2026024614.en_text: Schools, media, and communities should work together to promote sustainable tourism.
2026024614.cn_text: 学校、媒体和社区应携手合作,推广可持续旅游理念。

2026024615.en_text: Only through joint efforts can we preserve the natural beauty of these destinations for future generations to enjoy.
2026024615.cn_text: 唯有通过共同努力,我们才能为子孙后代保留这些旅游目的地的自然美景。

2026024638.en_text: On behalf of the Student Union, we warmly welcome you to our university!
2026024638.cn_text: 我谨代表学生会热烈欢迎你们来到我校！

2026024639.en_text: Your presence adds diversity and vitality to our campus, and we are thrilled to have you here.
2026024639.cn_text: 你们的到来为我们的校园增添了多样性和活力，我们对此深感欣喜。

2026024640.en_text: We hope your time with us will be both fulfilling and enjoyable.
2026024640.cn_text: 我们衷心希望你们在此期间学有所成、生活愉快。

2026024641.en_text: To help you adapt, we recommend attending international student events to meet new friends and share experiences.
2026024641.cn_text: 为帮助你们更好地适应校园生活,我们建议积极参加留学生活动以结识新朋友、分享经验。

2026024642.en_text: The campus service center is available for any administrative support you may need.
2026024642.cn_text: 校园服务中心可为你们提供所需的各类行政支持。

2026024643.en_text: Stay updated on activities through our official WeChat account and bulletin boards.
2026024643.cn_text: 请通过我们的官方微信公众号和宣传栏及时了解校园活动信息。

2026024644.en_text: Exploring local culture and joining extracurricular activities will further enrich your journey.
2026024644.cn_text: 此外,探索当地文化、参与课外活动也将使你们的留学之旅更加丰富多彩。

2026024645.en_text: Feel free to reach out if you need assistance.
2026024645.cn_text: 如有任何需要,请随时与我们联系。

2026024646.en_text: Wishing you a wonderful and successful stay!
2026024646.cn_text: 祝愿你们度过一段充实而成功的时光！

2026024649.en_text: The cartoon vividly portrays two men reacting differently to the same situation: a spilled bottle of liquid.
2026024649.cn_text: 这幅漫画生动地描绘了两个人对同一情境作出的截然不同的反应：一瓶液体被打翻了。

2026024650.en_text: One man looks devastated, exclaiming, "It's all gone!", while the other remains calm and optimistic, saying, "Thank goodness there's still some left." This simple yet profound illustration highlights the significant impact of attitude on how people perceive and respond to challenges.
2026024650.cn_text: 一个人神情沮丧，惊呼道「全没了！」，而另一个人则保持镇定和乐观，说道「谢天谢地还剩一些」。这幅简单却寓意深刻的画面凸显了态度对人们如何看待和应对挑战所产生的重大影响。

2026024651.en_text: The message conveyed by the cartoon is clear: optimism can make a substantial difference in how we handle setbacks.
2026024651.cn_text: 漫画所传达的寓意十分清晰：乐观态度能够显著改变我们应对挫折的方式。

2026024652.en_text: While pessimistic individuals tend to focus solely on what has been lost, optimistic people are more likely to see the remaining opportunities and maintain hope.
2026024652.cn_text: 悲观者往往只关注已经失去的东西，而乐观者则更倾向于看到尚存的机会并保持希望。

2026024653.en_text: This positive mindset enables them to approach problems with resilience and creativity, often leading to better outcomes.
2026024653.cn_text: 这种积极的心态使他们能够以坚韧和创造性的方式应对问题，往往能够取得更好的结果。

2026024654.en_text: In our daily lives, difficulties and setbacks are inevitable.
2026024654.cn_text: 在日常生活中，困难和挫折在所难免。

2026024655.en_text: However, it is our attitude that determines whether we succumb to despair or rise above challenges.
2026024655.cn_text: 然而，决定我们是屈服于绝望还是战胜挑战的正是我们的态度。

2026024656.en_text: By adopting an optimistic perspective, we can not only alleviate stress but also discover new possibilities and solutions.
2026024656.cn_text: 通过采取乐观的态度，我们不仅能够缓解压力，还能发现新的可能性和解决方案。

2026024657.en_text: Optimism is not about ignoring problems but about facing them with courage and a belief in better outcomes.
2026024657.cn_text: 乐观并非回避问题，而是以勇气和对更好结果的信念去直面问题。

2026024658.en_text: Therefore, cultivating a positive outlook is essential for personal growth and success in an unpredictable world.
2026024658.cn_text: 因此，在这个充满不确定性的世界中，培养积极的人生态度对于个人成长和成功至关重要。

2026024681.en_text: On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to invite you to serve as a judge for our English Speech Contest.
2026024681.cn_text: 我谨代表学生会写信邀请您担任我校英语演讲比赛的评委。

2026024682.en_text: The event will be held in the lecture hall on November 12th at 7:00 PM, focusing on the theme of cross-cultural communication.
2026024682.cn_text: 本次活动将于11月12日晚7点在报告厅举行，主题为跨文化交流。

2026024683.en_text: Your expertise would greatly enrich the contest and inspire the participants.
2026024683.cn_text: 您的专业素养将使比赛增色不少，并对参赛选手产生激励作用。

2026024684.en_text: As a judge, you will evaluate contestants on pronunciation, content, and overall expression.
2026024684.cn_text: 作为评委，您将从发音、内容及整体表现三个方面对选手进行评价。

2026024685.en_text: Detailed scoring criteria will be provided beforehand.
2026024685.cn_text: 详细评分标准将提前提供。

2026024686.en_text: We would be honored if you could accept this invitation.
2026024686.cn_text: 若蒙应允，我们将不胜荣幸。

2026024687.en_text: Please let us know your availability at your earliest convenience.
2026024687.cn_text: 请您尽早告知能否出席。

2026024690.en_text: The cartoon illustrates fresh graduates at a crossroads, facing four paths: job hunting, postgraduate exams, overseas study, and entrepreneurship.
2026024690.cn_text: 这幅漫画描绘了应届毕业生站在十字路口，面临四条道路：求职、考研、出国深造和自主创业。

2026024691.en_text: Each path represents a unique future direction, highlighting the diverse opportunities available to today's graduates as they transition from academia to the professional world.
2026024691.cn_text: 每条道路都代表着一种独特的未来方向，凸显了当代毕业生从校园步入职场时所拥有的多元化机遇。

2026024692.en_text: This image underscores the expanding career choices for young people.
2026024692.cn_text: 这幅图像凸显了年轻人职业选择范围的拓展。

2026024693.en_text: Unlike the past, when traditional employment was the norm, modern graduates explore varied options.
2026024693.cn_text: 不同于过去传统就业占据主流的局面，当代毕业生正探索多样化的出路。

2026024694.en_text: Some pursue further studies, domestically or abroad, while others venture into entrepreneurship.
2026024694.cn_text: 有些人选择继续深造，或在国内或赴海外，还有些人则投身创业大潮。

2026024695.en_text: This diversity reflects the evolving job market and changing aspirations, driven by personal interests and meaningful careers.
2026024695.cn_text: 这种多元化反映了就业市场的演变以及受个人兴趣和有意义职业驱动的理想追求变化。

2026024696.en_text: The cartoon also suggests that choosing a path involves challenges and rewards, requiring thoughtful consideration.
2026024696.cn_text: 漫画还暗示，选择一条道路既蕴含挑战也带来回报，需要审慎权衡。

2026024697.en_text: Graduates should assess their strengths, interests, and goals before deciding.
2026024697.cn_text: 毕业生应在做出决定前充分评估自身优势、兴趣和目标。

2026024698.en_text: Universities play a vital role by providing guidance and resources.
2026024698.cn_text: 高校应通过提供指导与资源发挥关键作用。

2026024699.en_text: Society should foster an environment that encourages exploration, allowing young people to pursue dreams without undue pressure.
2026024699.cn_text: 社会应营造鼓励探索的氛围，让年轻人能够在免受过度压力的前提下追逐梦想。

2026024700.en_text: By supporting informed decisions aligned with personal and societal needs, we empower graduates and benefit the community, fostering innovation and progress.
2026024700.cn_text: 通过支持符合个人与社会需求的明智抉择，我们赋能毕业生并惠及社会，推动创新与进步。

2026024701.en_text: Encouraging exploration aids personal growth and contributes to societal advancement, creating a dynamic workforce for the future.
2026024701.cn_text: 鼓励探索既助力个人成长又促进社会发展，为未来打造充满活力的劳动力队伍。

2026024722.en_text: I am writing to offer several practical suggestions to enhance students' physical condition, which I believe is crucial for their overall well-being and academic performance.
2026024722.cn_text: 我写信旨在就改善学生身体状况提出若干切实可行的建议，我认为这对学生的整体健康和学业表现至关重要。

2026024723.en_text: First, I suggest extending the opening hours of sports venues, allowing students more flexibility to engage in physical activities.
2026024723.cn_text: 首先，我建议延长体育场馆的开放时间，使学生能够更灵活地参与体育活动。

2026024724.en_text: Second, organizing regular group sports events, such as running races or basketball tournaments, could effectively inspire students to participate in exercise.
2026024724.cn_text: 其次，定期组织集体体育活动，如跑步比赛或篮球赛事，可以有效激发学生的锻炼积极性。

2026024725.en_text: Third, introducing a wider variety of optional PE courses, such as yoga, swimming, or martial arts, would cater to diverse interests and encourage more students to stay active.
2026024725.cn_text: 第三，开设更加丰富的体育选修课程，如瑜伽、游泳或武术，可满足多元化的兴趣需求，促使更多学生积极参与体育锻炼。

2026024726.en_text: I sincerely hope my suggestions will contribute to better policy decisions.
2026024726.cn_text: 我真诚希望上述建议能够为制定更好的政策提供参考。

2026024729.en_text: The drawing vividly illustrates the evolving relationship between a mother and her daughter over three decades.
2026024729.cn_text: 这幅画生动地展现了母亲与女儿之间三十年来演变的关系。

2026024730.en_text: Initially, a young mother is seen holding her little daughter's hand, guiding and caring for her.
2026024730.cn_text: 最初，年轻的母亲牵着幼小女儿的手,给予引导和呵护。

2026024731.en_text: Later, the grown daughter supports her aging mother, walking hand in hand.
2026024731.cn_text: 后来,长大成人的女儿搀扶着年迈的母亲,手牵手同行。

2026024732.en_text: These images highlight the passage of time and changing roles within a family.
2026024732.cn_text: 这些画面凸显了时光的流逝和家庭角色的转换。

2026024733.en_text: The drawing conveys a clear message: family love is enduring, and the cycle of care defines familial relationships.
2026024733.cn_text: 这幅画传达了一个明确的寓意:家庭之爱恒久不变,关爱的循环是家庭关系的本质。

2026024734.en_text: Parents devote their time and energy to raising us, and as they age, it becomes our turn to care for them.
2026024734.cn_text: 父母倾注时间和精力将我们抚养成人,当他们年老时,便轮到我们来赡养照料。

2026024735.en_text: This mutual support symbolizes the deep bond that ties generations together, reminding us to appreciate our parents' sacrifices and reciprocate their love.
2026024735.cn_text: 这种相互扶持象征着维系世代的深厚纽带,提醒我们铭记父母的牺牲奉献并回报他们的养育之恩。

2026024736.en_text: In today's fast-paced world, it is easy to overlook family.
2026024736.cn_text: 在当今快节奏的社会中,人们很容易忽视家庭。

2026024737.en_text: However, we must cherish our loved ones, especially our parents, who have given so much for our well-being.
2026024737.cn_text: 然而,我们必须珍视至亲,尤其是为我们的幸福倾注良多的父母。

2026024738.en_text: Spending time with them, expressing gratitude, and ensuring their happiness are not just responsibilities but acts of love.
2026024738.cn_text: 陪伴他们,表达感恩,关注他们的幸福,这不仅是责任,更是爱的实践。

2026024739.en_text: By nurturing these bonds, we honor our parents and set an example for future generations, ensuring the cycle of love continues unbroken.
2026024739.cn_text: 通过维系这些纽带,我们既是对父母的尊敬,也为后代树立榜样,确保爱的传承生生不息。

2026024761.en_text: I am writing to recommend *The Little Prince* for our upcoming reading session.
2026024761.cn_text: 我写信推荐《小王子》作为我们即将举行的阅读会书目。

2026024762.en_text: This timeless classic, written by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, uses simple fairy-tale language to convey profound truths about love, friendship, and personal growth.
2026024762.cn_text: 这部由安托万·德·圣埃克苏佩里创作的永恒经典，以简洁的童话语言传达了关于爱、友谊和个人成长的深刻真理。

2026024763.en_text: Its poetic storytelling and philosophical reflections make it a meaningful read for people of all ages.
2026024763.cn_text: 其诗意的叙事和哲学思考使其成为适合各年龄段读者的佳作。

2026024764.en_text: The book’s short chapters are perfect for group sharing, allowing us to discuss its themes in depth.
2026024764.cn_text: 该书短小的章节设置非常适合小组分享，便于我们深入讨论其主题。

2026024765.en_text: Moreover, it is widely available in various translated versions, making it accessible to everyone.
2026024765.cn_text: 此外，该书有多种译本且广泛发行，便于所有成员获取。

2026024766.en_text: I believe it will inspire thoughtful discussions and bring us closer as a group.
2026024766.cn_text: 我相信它会激发深入的讨论，并增进我们的团队凝聚力。

2026024767.en_text: Looking forward to hearing your thoughts during the session.
2026024767.cn_text: 期待在阅读会上听到各位的见解。

2026024770.en_text: The cartoon vividly depicts a family reunion where four individuals sit around a table filled with food, yet none are engaging in conversation.
2026024770.cn_text: 这幅漫画生动描绘了一场家庭聚会场景：四人围坐在摆满食物的餐桌旁，却无人交谈。

2026024771.en_text: Instead, each person is absorbed in their smartphone, highlighting a growing issue in modern society: the overuse of technology and its impact on human relationships.
2026024771.cn_text: 相反，每个人都专注于自己的智能手机，凸显了现代社会日益严峻的问题：技术过度使用及其对人际关系的冲击。

2026024772.en_text: This image reflects a troubling reality.
2026024772.cn_text: 这幅图像折射出一个令人担忧的现实。

2026024773.en_text: Smartphones, while convenient, have significantly reduced face-to-face communication.
2026024773.cn_text: 智能手机虽然便捷，却大幅削弱了面对面的交流。

2026024774.en_text: Even during gatherings meant for bonding, people often prioritize virtual interactions over real-life connections.
2026024774.cn_text: 即便在本应增进感情的聚会中，人们也常将虚拟互动置于现实联结之上。

2026024775.en_text: This behavior undermines the purpose of such events and weakens emotional ties.
2026024775.cn_text: 这种行为有悖此类活动的初衷，并削弱了情感纽带。

2026024776.en_text: The allure of digital devices has led to a sense of isolation, even in the presence of loved ones.
2026024776.cn_text: 电子设备的诱惑力造成了一种孤立感，哪怕身处至亲之中亦是如此。

2026024777.en_text: If this trend continues, relationships may become increasingly superficial and fragile.
2026024777.cn_text: 若这一趋势延续，人际关系可能愈发流于表面、趋于脆弱。

2026024778.en_text: To address this issue, we must strike a balance between technology and personal interactions.
2026024778.cn_text: 要解决这一问题，我们必须在技术应用与人际互动之间寻求平衡。

2026024779.en_text: During social occasions, putting aside phones and engaging in meaningful conversations can foster deeper connections and create lasting memories.
2026024779.cn_text: 在社交场合放下手机、开展有意义的对话，能够增进深层联结、缔造长久回忆。

2026024780.en_text: Families and friends might also adopt habits like phone-free meals to encourage interaction.
2026024780.cn_text: 家人和朋友亦可培养「无手机就餐」等习惯以促进互动。

2026024781.en_text: Ultimately, no digital interaction can replace the authenticity of face-to-face communication.
2026024781.cn_text: 归根结底，任何数字化互动都无法替代面对面交流的真实性。

2026024782.en_text: By prioritizing real connections, we can preserve the essence of human relationships and enrich our lives.
2026024782.cn_text: 唯有将真实联结置于优先地位，我们方能守护人际关系的本质、充实自身生活。

2026024803.cn_text: 欢迎各位新入学的国际学生！

2026024804.en_text: We are delighted to introduce you to our university library, a place designed to support your academic journey.
2026024804.cn_text: 我们很高兴向各位介绍本校图书馆，这里将为您的学术之旅提供全面支持。

2026024805.en_text: The library is open daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
2026024805.cn_text: 图书馆每日开放时间为上午8:00至晚上10:00。

2026024806.en_text: With your student ID card, you can borrow up to 10 books for a period of 30 days.
2026024806.cn_text: 凭学生证，您可借阅图书最多10册，借期为30天。

2026024807.en_text: Additionally, you have free access to our extensive online databases and well-equipped group study rooms.
2026024807.cn_text: 此外，您还可免费使用我们丰富的在线数据库资源和设施完善的小组学习室。

2026024808.en_text: Please remember to maintain silence inside the library and return borrowed books on time to avoid fines.
2026024808.cn_text: 请务必在馆内保持安静，并按时归还所借图书，以免产生滞纳金。

2026024809.en_text: Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to visit the library service desk.
2026024809.cn_text: 如有任何疑问或需要帮助，欢迎前往图书馆服务台咨询。

2026024812.en_text: The two pictures depict contrasting scenes.
2026024812.cn_text: 这两幅图描绘了截然不同的场景。

2026024813.en_text: In the first, a father lounges on the sofa, smoking and watching TV, while ordering his son to study.
2026024813.cn_text: 第一幅图中，父亲懒散地斜躺在沙发上，一边抽烟看电视，一边命令儿子去学习。

2026024814.en_text: The boy looks unmotivated, clearly uninspired by his father’s behavior.
2026024814.cn_text: 男孩看起来毫无动力，显然未能从父亲的行为中得到任何激励。

2026024815.en_text: In the second, the father and son sit together at a desk, both focused on studying, creating a positive and motivating atmosphere.
2026024815.cn_text: 第二幅图中，父子二人并肩坐在书桌旁，双双专注于学习，营造出积极向上、相互激励的氛围。

2026024816.en_text: These images convey a powerful message: actions speak louder than words.
2026024816.cn_text: 这些图像传递了一个有力的信息：行动胜于言辞。

2026024817.en_text: Children are highly impressionable and often mimic their parents’ behavior.
2026024817.cn_text: 儿童极易受到影响，往往会模仿父母的行为。

2026024818.en_text: Simply telling children to work hard is insufficient; parents must lead by example.
2026024818.cn_text: 仅仅口头要求孩子努力学习是远远不够的，父母必须以身作则。

2026024819.en_text: When parents demonstrate discipline and a commitment to learning, they naturally instill these values in their children.
2026024819.cn_text: 当父母展现出自律精神和对学习的执着投入时，这些品质便会自然而然地植入孩子心中。

2026024820.en_text: This alignment between words and actions fosters responsibility and self-discipline in children, shaping their character and future.
2026024820.cn_text: 这种言行一致能够培养孩子的责任感和自律能力，从而塑造他们的品格和未来。

2026024821.en_text: In today’s competitive world, parents should reflect on their own habits.
2026024821.cn_text: 在当今竞争激烈的社会中,父母应当反思自身的行为习惯。

2026024822.en_text: Instead of imposing demands, they should create a supportive environment through their actions.
2026024822.cn_text: 与其一味提出要求，不如通过自身行动营造一个支持性的成长环境。

2026024823.en_text: By setting a good example, parents not only encourage their children’s growth but also strengthen the parent-child bond.
2026024823.cn_text: 通过树立良好榜样，父母不仅能促进孩子的成长，还能增进亲子关系。

2026024824.en_text: Leading by example is a powerful way to nurture the next generation, ensuring they grow up with strong values and a clear sense of purpose.
2026024824.cn_text: 以身作则是培育下一代的有力途径，确保他们成长为拥有坚实价值观和明确人生方向的人。

2026024845.cn_text: 尊敬的詹姆斯·库克教授：

2026024847.en_text: I am pleased to recommend two must-visit attractions that showcase the charm and culture of our city.
2026024847.cn_text: 我很高兴向您推荐两处必游景点，它们充分展现了本市的魅力与文化底蕴。

2026024848.en_text: First, the ancient city wall is a historical treasure that offers stunning views and fascinating stories.
2026024848.cn_text: 首先，古城墙是一处历史瑰宝，既可饱览壮丽景色，又蕴含着动人的历史故事。

2026024849.en_text: Walking along it provides a glimpse into our city’s rich past and is perfect for history enthusiasts.
2026024849.cn_text: 沿城墙漫步可领略本市深厚的历史积淀，尤其适合历史爱好者。

2026024850.en_text: Second, the botanical garden is a serene retreat filled with diverse plants and beautiful scenery.
2026024850.cn_text: 其次，植物园是一处静谧的休憩之地,园内植物种类繁多,景色优美。

2026024851.en_text: It’s an ideal spot for relaxation and escaping the city’s hustle.
2026024851.cn_text: 这里是放松身心、远离都市喧嚣的理想场所。

2026024852.en_text: Both sites are easily accessible and affordable, ensuring a memorable experience.
2026024852.cn_text: 这两处景点均交通便利、费用合理,定能让您收获难忘的游览体验。

2026024853.en_text: I hope you enjoy exploring these wonderful places!

2026024856.en_text: The two pictures illustrate contrasting attitudes toward books and reading.
2026024856.cn_text: 这两幅图描绘了对待书籍与阅读的两种截然不同的态度。

2026024857.en_text: In the first, a boy proudly stands in a library filled with books, seemingly satisfied with his collection.
2026024857.cn_text: 第一幅图中，一个男孩自豪地站在堆满书籍的书房里，似乎对自己的藏书颇为满意。

2026024858.en_text: In the second, another boy sets a goal of reading 20 books in a year and is actively engaged in reading, showing a purposeful approach.
2026024858.cn_text: 第二幅图中，另一个男孩设定了一年阅读20本书的目标，正积极投入阅读之中，显示出一种有计划的行动方式。

2026024859.en_text: This contrast reveals an important truth: owning books does not guarantee knowledge.
2026024859.cn_text: 这一对比揭示了一个重要道理：拥有书籍并不等同于拥有知识。

2026024860.en_text: Many people collect books as symbols of intellect, but these often remain unread, serving only as decoration.
2026024860.cn_text: 许多人收藏书籍以彰显学识，但这些书往往束之高阁，沦为摆设。

2026024861.en_text: This behavior wastes resources and overlooks the true purpose of books—to be read and understood.
2026024861.cn_text: 这种做法既浪费资源，又背离了书籍的本质用途——供人阅读与理解。

2026024862.en_text: In contrast, the second boy demonstrates meaningful learning by setting goals and actively reading.
2026024862.cn_text: 相比之下，第二个男孩通过制定目标并付诸实践，展现了真正意义上的学习。

2026024863.en_text: His actions highlight the value of purposeful engagement with books.
2026024863.cn_text: 他的行为凸显了有目的地与书籍互动的价值所在。

2026024864.en_text: To benefit from books, we must read with discipline and focus.
2026024864.cn_text: 要从书籍中真正获益，我们必须保持自律与专注地阅读。

2026024865.en_text: Setting realistic goals, like the boy in the second picture, helps transform ownership into meaningful learning.
2026024865.cn_text: 像第二幅图中的男孩那样设定切实可行的目标，有助于将藏书转化为真实的知识积累。

2026024866.en_text: Reading with curiosity allows us to absorb knowledge and apply it in life.
2026024866.cn_text: 带着求知欲阅读能让我们吸收知识并将其运用于实际生活。

2026024867.en_text: Ultimately, it is not the number of books we own but the wisdom we gain and use that matters.
2026024867.cn_text: 归根结底，重要的不是我们拥有多少书籍，而是我们从中获得并运用了多少智慧。

2026024868.en_text: This approach ensures books fulfill their purpose, enriching our minds and fostering growth.
2026024868.cn_text: 这种态度能确保书籍实现其应有价值，充实我们的心智并促进自我成长。

2026024889.en_text: On behalf of the university, I am writing to sincerely invite you to attend our annual graduation ceremony, which is a significant event for both our graduates and the entire academic community.
2026024889.cn_text: 我谨代表学校诚挚邀请您出席我校一年一度的毕业典礼，这对我们的毕业生和整个学术界都是一个意义重大的活动。

2026024890.en_text: The ceremony is scheduled to take place in the university grand hall at 9 a.m.
2026024890.cn_text: 典礼定于6月20日上午9点在学校大礼堂举行。

2026024892.en_text: During the event, you will have the honor of presenting awards to outstanding graduates, followed by an academic tea party where you can engage with faculty and students.
2026024892.cn_text: 活动期间，您将有幸为优秀毕业生颁奖，随后是学术茶话会，届时您可与师生进行交流。

2026024893.en_text: Relevant invitation cards and detailed schedules are attached for your reference.
2026024893.cn_text: 相关邀请函和详细日程安排已随附供您查阅。

2026024894.en_text: Your presence would be greatly valued to celebrate this memorable occasion with us.
2026024894.cn_text: 您的莅临将使这一难忘时刻更具意义。

2026024897.en_text: The cartoon vividly depicts a student standing in front of a course selection board, carefully choosing courses that promise high scores and minimal homework while deliberately avoiding those that are innovative but challenging.
2026024897.cn_text: 这幅漫画生动地描绘了一名学生站在选课板前，仔细挑选那些承诺高分且作业少的课程，同时刻意回避那些富有创新性却颇具挑战的课程。

2026024898.en_text: This image humorously yet profoundly reflects a common phenomenon on campuses today: the tendency of students to prioritize short-term ease over long-term growth.
2026024898.cn_text: 这一画面幽默而深刻地反映了当今校园的一种普遍现象：学生倾向于将短期的轻松置于长期的成长之上。

2026024899.en_text: Such behavior, while understandable, can have significant consequences.
2026024899.cn_text: 这种行为虽然可以理解，却可能带来严重后果。

2026024900.en_text: By opting for easier courses, students may miss out on opportunities to develop critical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills—qualities that are essential for future success.
2026024900.cn_text: 选择较为容易的课程，学生可能会错失培养批判性思维、创造力和问题解决能力的机会——而这些品质对未来的成功至关重要。

2026024901.en_text: Challenging and innovative courses, though demanding, often provide the intellectual stimulation and practical knowledge necessary to build core competitiveness in an increasingly complex world.
2026024901.cn_text: 富有挑战性和创新性的课程虽然要求严格，却往往能够提供在日益复杂的世界中构建核心竞争力所必需的智力激发和实用知识。

2026024902.en_text: They encourage students to step out of their comfort zones and prepare them for the uncertainties and challenges of their careers.
2026024902.cn_text: 它们鼓励学生走出舒适区，为应对职业生涯中的不确定性和挑战做好准备。

2026024903.en_text: Therefore, university students should adopt a far-sighted perspective when selecting courses.
2026024903.cn_text: 因此，大学生在选课时应采取长远眼光。

2026024904.en_text: Instead of focusing solely on immediate rewards like high grades or reduced workload, they should prioritize courses that offer substantial academic and personal growth.
2026024904.cn_text: 与其只关注高分或减少作业量等即时回报，不如优先选择那些能够带来实质性学术和个人成长的课程。

2026024905.en_text: After all, the ultimate goal of education is not just to achieve short-term success but to lay a solid foundation for lifelong learning and development.
2026024905.cn_text: 毕竟，教育的终极目标不仅是取得短期成功，更是为终身学习与发展奠定坚实基础。

2026024926.en_text: I'm delighted to hear about your interest in our Aiding Rural Primary Schools project.
2026024926.cn_text: 得知你对我校「援助农村小学」项目感兴趣,我深感欣慰。

2026024927.en_text: This initiative aims to support children in remote mountainous areas by improving their education and overall well-being.
2026024927.cn_text: 该项目旨在通过改善教育条件和整体福祉,为偏远山区儿童提供支持。

2026024928.en_text: Volunteers are required to visit these schools every two weeks.
2026024928.cn_text: 志愿者须每两周前往这些学校开展活动。

2026024929.en_text: During the visits, you will teach English, organize engaging art and cultural activities, and distribute donated stationery to the left-behind children, helping them to grow and learn in a nurturing environment.
2026024929.cn_text: 活动期间,你将教授英语课程,组织富有趣味的艺术文化活动,并向留守儿童发放捐赠文具,帮助他们在充满关爱的环境中健康成长、快乐学习。

2026024930.en_text: To join, you should have a good command of English and be available on weekends.
2026024930.cn_text: 申请加入者需具备良好的英语水平,且周末时间可自由支配。

2026024931.en_text: If you have any further questions or need additional details, please don’t hesitate to contact me.
2026024931.cn_text: 如有任何疑问或需了解更多详情,请随时与我联系。

2026024934.en_text: In the cartoon, two climbers are depicted scaling a steep mountain.
2026024934.cn_text: 漫画中描绘了两名登山者正在攀登一座陡峭的山峰。

2026024935.en_text: One, overwhelmed by exhaustion, wants to give up, but his partner encourages him to rest and continue.
2026024935.cn_text: 其中一人因极度疲惫想要放弃，但他的同伴鼓励他休息片刻后继续前行。

2026024936.en_text: This scene highlights the importance of persistence and support in overcoming challenges.
2026024936.cn_text: 这一场景凸显了坚持与支持在克服挑战过程中的重要性。

2026024937.en_text: The image conveys an inspiring message: the path to our goals is often filled with difficulties and fatigue.
2026024937.cn_text: 这幅图画传达了一个励志信息：通往目标的道路往往充满困难与疲惫。

2026024938.en_text: Giving up not only stops progress but also wastes previous efforts.
2026024938.cn_text: 放弃不仅会中止进步，还会令之前的努力付诸东流。

2026024939.en_text: Instead, taking a break can rejuvenate us, allowing us to continue with renewed determination.
2026024939.cn_text: 相反，适当休息可以使我们恢复活力，从而以重振的决心继续前行。

2026024940.en_text: Support from others is crucial, reminding us we are not alone.
2026024940.cn_text: 来自他人的支持至关重要，它提醒我们并非孤军奋战。

2026024941.en_text: This message is relevant in many areas of life, from academics to careers and personal growth.
2026024941.cn_text: 这一信息在生活的诸多领域都具有现实意义，从学业到事业乃至个人成长。

2026024942.en_text: It teaches us that setbacks are opportunities to pause, reflect, and gather strength.
2026024942.cn_text: 它教导我们，挫折是暂停脚步、反思自省和积蓄力量的契机。

2026024943.en_text: In our endeavors, challenges are inevitable.
2026024943.cn_text: 在我们的奋斗历程中，挑战是不可避免的。

2026024944.en_text: When faced with difficulties, maintaining a positive mindset, taking breaks, and seeking support are essential.
2026024944.cn_text: 面对困难时，保持积极心态、适时休整和寻求支持至关重要。

2026024945.en_text: By focusing on our goals and working with others, we can overcome obstacles and achieve success.
2026024945.cn_text: 聚焦目标并与他人协作，我们便能克服障碍并获得成功。

2026024946.en_text: Like the climbers, persistence and teamwork can lead us to our dreams.
2026024946.cn_text: 正如这些登山者一样，坚持不懈与团队协作能够引领我们实现梦想。

2026024947.en_text: The cartoon reminds us that success thrives on resilience and collaboration, inspiring us to embrace challenges and believe that no peak is insurmountable.
2026024947.cn_text: 这幅漫画提醒我们，成功植根于韧性与合作，激励我们拥抱挑战，坚信没有不可逾越的高峰。

2026024969.en_text: The Student Union is excited to announce a campus singing contest for international students, offering a platform to showcase musical talents and celebrate cultural diversity.
2026024969.cn_text: 学生会欣然宣布将为国际学生举办校园歌唱比赛,旨在为大家提供展示音乐才华和弘扬文化多样性的平台。

2026024970.en_text: The event includes solo and group categories, with songs in any language welcomed.
2026024970.cn_text: 比赛设有独唱和合唱两个类别,欢迎使用任何语言演唱。

2026024971.en_text: It promises to be a vibrant celebration of music and creativity.
2026024971.cn_text: 这必将成为一场音乐与创意交织的精彩盛会。

2026024972.en_text: The preliminary round will be held on October 15th, and the grand final on October 22nd.
2026024972.cn_text: 初赛定于10月15日举行,总决赛定于10月22日举行。

2026024973.cn_text: 优胜者将获得丰厚奖品。

2026024974.en_text: Interested students must submit their applications to the Student Union office by October 10th.
2026024974.cn_text: 有意参赛的同学须于10月10日前将报名表提交至学生会办公室。

2026024975.en_text: Join us to share your passion for singing and create unforgettable memories!
2026024975.cn_text: 欢迎大家踊跃参与,分享歌唱热忱,共同谱写美好回忆!

2026024976.en_text: The two cartoons vividly illustrate contrasting attitudes toward work.
2026024976.cn_text: 这两幅漫画生动地展示了对待工作的两种截然不同的态度。

2026024977.en_text: On the left, a girl is diligently completing her tasks ahead of schedule, her face glowing with satisfaction.
2026024977.cn_text: 左图中，一位女孩正勤奋地提前完成任务,脸上洋溢着满足的神情。

2026024978.en_text: On the right, a boy is procrastinating, lounging idly until the last minute.
2026024978.cn_text: 右图中，一位男孩正在拖延，懒散地闲躺直至最后一刻。

2026024979.en_text: As the deadline approaches, he appears overwhelmed and stressed, struggling to finish his work.
2026024979.cn_text: 随着截止日期临近，他显得不知所措且压力重重，艰难地赶工。

2026024980.en_text: These contrasting scenarios highlight the importance of time management in achieving better outcomes and maintaining well-being.
2026024980.cn_text: 这些对比鲜明的场景凸显了时间管理对于取得更好成果和维持身心健康的重要性。

2026024981.en_text: The message is clear: procrastination often leads to unnecessary stress and poor performance.
2026024981.cn_text: 寓意十分明确：拖延往往导致不必要的压力和糟糕的表现。

2026024982.en_text: While delaying tasks may seem tempting, it creates a cycle of anxiety and inefficiency.
2026024982.cn_text: 尽管推迟任务可能看似诱人，但它会造成焦虑与低效的恶性循环。

2026024983.en_text: In contrast, proactive planning ensures higher-quality results and a sense of accomplishment.
2026024983.cn_text: 相反，提前规划能够确保更高质量的成果并带来成就感。

2026024984.en_text: Many individuals underestimate the time and effort required to complete their responsibilities effectively, which can hinder personal and professional growth.
2026024984.cn_text: 许多人低估了有效履行职责所需的时间和精力，这可能妨碍个人与职业成长。

2026024985.en_text: This underscores the need to manage time wisely.
2026024985.cn_text: 这凸显了合理管理时间的必要性。

2026024986.en_text: To overcome procrastination, cultivating good habits is essential.
2026024986.cn_text: 要克服拖延症，培养良好习惯至关重要。

2026024987.en_text: Setting clear goals, creating realistic schedules, and breaking tasks into smaller steps can help maintain steady progress.
2026024987.cn_text: 设定明确目标、制订切实可行的时间表并将任务分解为更小的步骤，有助于保持稳步推进。

2026024988.en_text: Rewarding oneself for timely completion of tasks reinforces positive behavior.
2026024988.cn_text: 对按时完成任务给予自我奖励可以强化这种积极行为。

2026024989.en_text: By embracing diligence and discipline, like the girl in the cartoon, we can achieve success while enjoying a more balanced and fulfilling life.
2026024989.cn_text: 像漫画中的女孩那样秉持勤奋与自律，我们便能在享受更加平衡充实生活的同时取得成功。

2026025012.en_text: Congratulations on your decision to work in China!
2026025012.cn_text: 祝贺你决定来中国工作！

2026025013.en_text: To help you succeed, I have some suggestions.
2026025013.cn_text: 为帮助你顺利求职，我有一些建议。

2026025014.en_text: First, focus on jobs that match your academic background and skills, as this will enhance your competitiveness.
2026025014.cn_text: 首先，应专注于与你学业背景和专业技能相匹配的岗位，这将增强你的竞争力。

2026025015.en_text: Learning basic Chinese workplace etiquette and cultural norms is also essential for adapting quickly.
2026025015.cn_text: 学习基本的中国职场礼仪和文化规范对于快速适应也至关重要。

2026025016.en_text: Additionally, use trusted job platforms and network with professionals in your field to discover opportunities.
2026025016.cn_text: 此外，应使用可靠的求职平台，并与你所在领域的专业人士建立联系以发掘机会。

2026025017.en_text: Improving your Chinese language skills will further boost your chances and show your commitment to integrating into the local culture.
2026025017.cn_text: 提升中文水平将进一步增加你的成功几率，并展现你融入本土文化的诚意。

2026025018.en_text: Be patient and persistent, as finding the right job takes time.
2026025018.cn_text: 要有耐心并坚持不懈，因为找到理想的工作需要时间。

2026025022.en_text: In the cartoon, a young boy looks troubled because his classmates find learning traditional opera uninteresting.
2026025022.cn_text: 在这幅漫画中，一个小男孩看起来很苦恼，因为他的同学们觉得学习传统戏曲索然无味。

2026025023.en_text: His father reassures him, emphasizing that pursuing what he truly loves is the most important thing.
2026025023.cn_text: 他的父亲安慰他，强调追求自己真正热爱的事情才是最重要的。

2026025024.en_text: This simple scene conveys a profound lesson about staying true to one's passions despite others' opinions.
2026025024.cn_text: 这个简单的场景传递了一个深刻的道理，即要忠于自己的热情，不受他人意见左右。

2026025025.en_text: The picture underscores the importance of remaining loyal to our genuine interests rather than succumbing to societal trends or peer pressure.
2026025025.cn_text: 这幅图强调了忠于自己真正兴趣的重要性，而不是屈从于社会潮流或同辈压力。

2026025026.en_text: In today's competitive world, it is easy to be influenced by others' judgments, but true passions provide purpose and lasting joy.
2026025026.cn_text: 在当今竞争激烈的世界中，人们容易受到他人评判的影响，但真正的热情能赋予生活目标和持久的快乐。

2026025027.en_text: They enrich our lives and help us discover our unique potential.
2026025027.cn_text: 它们丰富我们的生活，帮助我们发现自身独特的潜能。

2026025028.en_text: Even if our interests are not widely appreciated, they can bring immense personal satisfaction and foster resilience and creativity.
2026025028.cn_text: 即使我们的兴趣未能获得广泛认可，它们也能带来极大的个人满足感，并培养韧性与创造力。

2026025029.en_text: For young people, confidence in their passions is essential.
2026025029.cn_text: 对年轻人而言，对自己热情的自信至关重要。

2026025030.en_text: Parents, like the father in the cartoon, play a vital role in nurturing this confidence through encouragement.
2026025030.cn_text: 父母，如同漫画中的父亲，通过鼓励在培养这种自信方面发挥着关键作用。

2026025031.en_text: Society should also respect diverse interests, creating an environment where individuals can pursue their dreams without fear of judgment.
2026025031.cn_text: 社会也应当尊重多元化的兴趣，营造一个让个人能够无惧评判地追求梦想的环境。

2026025032.en_text: Schools and communities can promote activities that celebrate different talents.
2026025032.cn_text: 学校和社区可以推广各类活动以彰显不同才能。

2026025033.en_text: Ultimately, staying true to one's passion is key to a fulfilling life, enabling happiness, self-actualization, and a sense of accomplishment.
2026025033.cn_text: 归根结底，忠于自己的热情是获得充实人生的关键，它能带来幸福、自我实现和成就感。

2026025057.en_text: I am writing to sincerely invite you to organize and lead a student team for the upcoming international innovation contest, which will be hosted by our university next month.
2026025057.cn_text: 我写信诚挚邀请您组织并带领一支学生团队参加下月将在我校举办的国际创新竞赛。

2026025058.en_text: This prestigious event aims to foster creativity and collaboration among students from around the world.
2026025058.cn_text: 这项享有盛誉的赛事旨在促进世界各地学生之间的创新思维与团队协作。

2026025059.en_text: The contest focuses on various fields of innovation, including technological development and creative design.
2026025059.cn_text: 本次竞赛涵盖多个创新领域,包括技术开发和创意设计。

2026025060.en_text: It offers not only generous rewards but also valuable opportunities for global academic exchange.
2026025060.cn_text: 竞赛不仅设有丰厚奖励,还为参赛者提供宝贵的国际学术交流机会。

2026025061.en_text: Your expertise and guidance would undoubtedly inspire participants and help them produce outstanding and competitive works.
2026025061.cn_text: 您的专业造诣和悉心指导必将激励参赛者,帮助他们产出优秀且富有竞争力的作品。

2026025062.en_text: For your convenience, I have attached the detailed contest brochure.
2026025062.cn_text: 为便于您了解详情,现随信附上赛事宣传册。

2026025063.en_text: I truly hope you can accept this invitation and contribute to the success of this event.
2026025063.cn_text: 我衷心期待您能接受邀请,为本次赛事的成功举办贡献力量。

2026025066.en_text: The cartoon depicts two students discussing a campus lecture notice.
2026025066.cn_text: 这幅漫画描绘了两名学生正在讨论一则校园讲座通知。

2026025067.en_text: One student dismisses lectures outside their major as irrelevant, while the other argues that attending such lectures can offer valuable insights and benefits.
2026025067.cn_text: 一名学生认为本专业以外的讲座毫无意义，而另一名学生则主张参加此类讲座能够提供宝贵的见解和收益。

2026025068.en_text: This humorous yet thought-provoking scene highlights a common mindset among college students regarding cross-disciplinary learning.
2026025068.cn_text: 这一幽默而发人深省的场景凸显了大学生对于跨学科学习的一种普遍心态。

2026025069.en_text: The underlying message of the cartoon is clear: students should not confine themselves to their own fields of study but should instead embrace opportunities for interdisciplinary learning.
2026025069.cn_text: 这幅漫画的深层寓意十分明确：学生不应将自己局限于本专业领域，而应积极拥抱跨学科学习的机会。

2026025070.en_text: Attending lectures outside one’s major can significantly broaden perspectives, foster innovative thinking, and even enhance understanding within one’s specialized area.
2026025070.cn_text: 参加本专业以外的讲座能够显著拓宽视野、培养创新思维，甚至加深对本专业领域的理解。

2026025071.en_text: In today’s rapidly evolving world, where challenges often require knowledge from multiple disciplines, such an approach is not just beneficial but essential.
2026025071.cn_text: 在当今快速演进的世界中，各类挑战往往需要多学科知识的融合，这种学习方式不仅有益，更是必不可少。

2026025072.en_text: To promote this mindset, universities should take proactive steps to organize more high-quality interdisciplinary lectures and encourage participation.
2026025072.cn_text: 为促进这种理念，高校应当主动采取措施，组织更多高质量的跨学科讲座并鼓励学生参与。

2026025073.en_text: Meanwhile, students need to cultivate an open and curious attitude, making full use of the diverse learning resources available on campus.
2026025073.cn_text: 与此同时,学生需要培养开放好奇的心态，充分利用校园内多样化的学习资源。

2026025074.en_text: By doing so, they can achieve holistic personal and academic growth, equipping themselves to tackle complex real-world problems with creativity and confidence.
2026025074.cn_text: 唯有如此，他们才能实现全面的个人与学业成长，使自己具备以创造力和自信应对复杂现实问题的能力。

2026025094.en_text: We are currently recruiting one student research assistant for Professor Smith's research project on campus sports activities.
2026025094.cn_text: 我们目前正在为史密斯教授的校园体育活动研究项目招聘一名学生研究助理。

2026025095.en_text: This is a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in academic research and contribute to the understanding of sports on campus.
2026025095.cn_text: 这是一个获得学术研究实践经验并为理解校园体育活动作出贡献的宝贵机会。

2026025096.en_text: The main responsibilities include collecting and analyzing campus sports data, organizing and sorting questionnaire results, and assisting in regular project meetings.
2026025096.cn_text: 主要职责包括收集和分析校园体育数据、整理和归类问卷调查结果以及协助定期召开项目会议。

2026025097.en_text: Applicants should possess strong data analysis skills, have sufficient spare time throughout the research period, and demonstrate a passion for sports, which will be considered a plus.
2026025097.cn_text: 申请人应具备较强的数据分析能力，在整个研究期间有充足的课余时间，并对体育运动充满热情者将优先考虑。

2026025098.en_text: Interested students are required to submit their application forms to the research office no later than this Friday.
2026025098.cn_text: 有意者请于本周五之前将申请表提交至研究办公室。

2026025100.en_text: The cartoon illustrates a lively dragon boat race in a picturesque village.
2026025100.cn_text: 这幅漫画描绘了风景如画的村庄里一场热闹的龙舟比赛。

2026025101.en_text: Several boats compete fiercely on the river, with rowers paddling in unison.
2026025101.cn_text: 几艘龙舟在河上激烈竞渡,划手们齐心协力、步调一致。

2026025102.en_text: On the riverbank, villagers cheer enthusiastically, creating a festive atmosphere.
2026025102.cn_text: 河岸上,村民们热情欢呼,营造出浓郁的节日氛围。

2026025103.en_text: Two elderly spectators marvel at the growing popularity of this annual event, which reflects the community's enthusiasm for traditional activities and the bonds they foster.
2026025103.cn_text: 两位年长的观众惊叹于这一年度盛事日益增长的人气,这反映出社区对传统活动的热情以及这些活动所促进的情感纽带。

2026025104.en_text: This scene underscores the revival and appreciation of traditional folk culture in rural areas.
2026025104.cn_text: 这一场景凸显了农村地区传统民俗文化的复兴与传承。

2026025105.en_text: Dragon boat races, as a vital part of cultural heritage, not only bring joy but also connect people with their roots.
2026025105.cn_text: 龙舟竞渡作为文化遗产的重要组成部分,不仅带来欢乐,更让人们与文化根脉紧密相连。

2026025106.en_text: Such events enrich spiritual lives, foster unity, and instill pride in the community.
2026025106.cn_text: 此类活动丰富了精神生活,增进了团结,并在社区中激发了自豪感。

2026025107.en_text: They also provide younger generations with opportunities to engage in preserving these traditions, ensuring their relevance in modern times.
2026025107.cn_text: 它们还为年轻一代提供了参与保护传统的机会,确保这些传统在当代社会保持生命力。

2026025108.en_text: The enduring charm of such customs highlights their value even in a rapidly modernizing world.
2026025108.cn_text: 这些习俗历久弥新的魅力彰显了它们即便在快速现代化的当今世界依然具有的价值。

2026025109.en_text: To sustain traditions like dragon boat racing, villages can organize more events and use social media for promotion.
2026025109.cn_text: 为了传承龙舟竞渡等传统,乡村可以组织更多活动并利用社交媒体进行推广。

2026025110.en_text: Engaging younger audiences ensures these customs thrive for future generations.
2026025110.cn_text: 吸引年轻受众可以确保这些习俗在未来世代蓬勃发展。

2026025111.en_text: Additionally, local governments can support these activities through funding and promotion.
2026025111.cn_text: 此外,地方政府可以通过资金支持和宣传推动这些活动。

2026025112.en_text: With collective efforts, traditional culture can remain vibrant, strengthening community bonds and preserving a shared identity.
2026025112.cn_text: 通过共同努力,传统文化可以保持活力,增强社区凝聚力并维护共同的文化认同。

2026025133.en_text: I'm glad to offer you practical tips for your oral report.
2026025133.cn_text: 很高兴能为你的口头报告提供一些实用建议。

2026025134.en_text: First, you can choose a representative ancient Chinese scientist, such as Zhang Heng, and introduce his significant inventions, like the seismoscope, along with the historical background of his era.
2026025134.cn_text: 首先，你可以选择一位具有代表性的中国古代科学家，例如张衡,介绍他的重要发明(如地动仪)以及他所处时代的历史背景。

2026025135.en_text: Adding vivid anecdotes about his life will make your presentation more engaging and memorable.
2026025135.cn_text: 加入一些关于他生平的生动轶事，会让你的演讲更具吸引力和感染力。

2026025136.en_text: Additionally, you could include relevant pictures or diagrams in your PPT to visually support your points.
2026025136.cn_text: 此外，你可以在PPT中加入相关图片或图表，以直观呈现你的观点。

2026025137.en_text: Practice your speech several times to ensure smooth delivery and proper time management.
2026025137.cn_text: 多次练习演讲，以确保表达流畅、时间把控得当。

2026025138.en_text: If possible, seek feedback from friends to refine your performance.
2026025138.cn_text: 如果可能，向朋友征求反馈意见，以便进一步完善你的表现。

2026025139.en_text: I hope these suggestions help you achieve an excellent result.
2026025139.cn_text: 希望这些建议能帮助你取得优异成绩。

2026025142.en_text: The cartoon illustrates local citizens engaging in fitness activities in a new neighborhood park, with a young boy expressing gratitude for the convenient leisure space.
2026025142.cn_text: 这幅漫画描绘了当地居民在新建社区公园内进行健身活动的场景，一名小男孩对便利的休闲空间表达了感激之情。

2026025143.en_text: This reflects the community’s positive reception.
2026025143.cn_text: 这反映了社区的积极回应。

2026025144.en_text: The accompanying bar chart shows a rise in the number of parks in the city, from 406 in 2020 to 532 in 2021, reaching 670 in 2022.
2026025144.cn_text: 配套的柱状图显示该市公园数量呈上升趋势，从2020年的406个增至2021年的532个，并在2022年达到670个。

2026025145.en_text: This growth indicates the city’s commitment to expanding green spaces and enhancing residents’ quality of life.
2026025145.cn_text: 这一增长表明该市致力于扩大绿地空间、提升居民生活品质。

2026025146.en_text: The combination of the cartoon and chart underscores the local government’s efforts to improve public green facilities, making leisure spaces more accessible.
2026025146.cn_text: 漫画与图表的结合凸显了地方政府改善公共绿地设施、提高休闲空间可及性的努力。

2026025147.en_text: These initiatives not only enhance the urban environment but also promote healthier and more active lifestyles.
2026025147.cn_text: 这些举措不仅改善了城市环境，还促进了更健康、更积极的生活方式。

2026025148.en_text: Parks are vital for relaxation, exercise, and social interaction, significantly contributing to the community’s physical and mental well-being.
2026025148.cn_text: 公园对于休闲放松、体育锻炼和社交互动至关重要，对社区的身心健康有显著贡献。

2026025149.en_text: The increasing number of parks also reflects a vision of sustainable urban development, ensuring long-term benefits for future generations.
2026025149.cn_text: 公园数量的增加也体现了可持续城市发展的理念，为子孙后代确保了长远利益。

2026025150.en_text: To build on these efforts, authorities could diversify park facilities to cater to all age groups by adding playgrounds, fitness equipment, and quiet zones.
2026025150.cn_text: 为进一步推进这些努力,相关部门可通过增设儿童游乐场、健身器材和静谧区域来丰富公园设施,以满足各年龄段人群的需求。

2026025151.en_text: Organizing community events like yoga sessions or cultural activities could further enrich the park experience, creating inclusive, vibrant spaces that foster a stronger sense of belonging among residents.
2026025151.cn_text: 组织瑜伽课程或文化活动等社区活动,可进一步提升公园体验,打造包容且富有活力的空间,增强居民的归属感。

2026025173.en_text: I'm thrilled to hear that you're interested in the upcoming craft demonstration activity.
2026025173.cn_text: 得知你对即将举办的手工艺展示活动颇感兴趣，我深感欣慰。

2026025174.en_text: The young craftsmen will showcase innovative works that blend traditional craftsmanship with modern design elements, offering a unique perspective on cultural heritage.
2026025174.cn_text: 届时，青年工匠们将展示融合传统技艺与现代设计元素的创新作品,为文化遗产的传承提供全新视角。

2026025175.en_text: Additionally, they will host interactive hand-making workshops where students can experience the joy of creating their own crafts.
2026025175.cn_text: 此外,他们还将举办互动式手工制作工坊,让同学们亲身体验手作的乐趣。

2026025176.en_text: I truly appreciate your willingness to assist.
2026025176.cn_text: 对你的鼎力相助,我深表感谢。

2026025177.en_text: You could take charge of on-site venue arrangement and participant check-in on the event day.
2026025177.cn_text: 你可以负责活动当日的现场场地布置及参与者签到工作。

2026025178.en_text: If you have any other creative ideas or suggestions, please don't hesitate to share them.
2026025178.cn_text: 若有其他创意想法或建议,请不吝赐教。

2026025179.en_text: I'm confident we'll have a successful collaboration.
2026025179.cn_text: 我坚信我们的合作必将圆满成功。

2026025182.en_text: The table shows the ownership of air conditioners, refrigerators, and washing machines per 100 Chinese households from 2014 to 2023.
2026025182.cn_text: 该表呈现了2014年至2023年间每百户中国家庭空调、冰箱和洗衣机的拥有量。

2026025183.en_text: Over this period, all three categories saw steady growth, reflecting improvements in living standards and economic development.
2026025183.cn_text: 在此期间，这三类家电均呈稳步增长态势，反映出生活水平的提升与经济的持续发展。

2026025184.en_text: These appliances have become increasingly accessible, symbolizing China's rapid progress.
2026025184.cn_text: 这些家用电器日益普及，象征着中国的快速进步。

2026025185.en_text: Air conditioners experienced the most significant rise, nearly doubling from 75.2 units in 2014 to 145.9 units in 2023.
2026025185.cn_text: 空调拥有量增幅最为显著,从2014年的75.2台增长近一倍至2023年的145.9台。

2026025186.en_text: Refrigerators increased from 85.5 to 103.4 units, while washing machines grew from 83.7 to 98.2 units, though at a slower pace, suggesting market saturation in some areas.
2026025186.cn_text: 冰箱从85.5台增至103.4台,洗衣机从83.7台增至98.2台,但增速相对缓慢,表明部分地区市场已趋于饱和。

2026025187.en_text: This data highlights rising incomes, technological advancements, and improved distribution networks.
2026025187.cn_text: 这些数据反映了居民收入的增加、技术的进步以及流通网络的完善。

2026025188.en_text: It also indicates a narrowing gap between urban and rural ownership, though disparities persist in less developed regions.
2026025188.cn_text: 数据还显示城乡拥有量差距正在缩小,尽管欠发达地区仍存在一定差距。

2026025189.en_text: This trend underscores the role of economic growth in enhancing living conditions and driving demand for modern appliances.
2026025189.cn_text: 这一趋势凸显了经济增长在改善生活条件和拉动现代家电消费需求中的重要作用。

2026025190.en_text: To address remaining disparities, policymakers should provide subsidies for rural areas, while manufacturers should focus on affordable, energy-efficient products.
2026025190.cn_text: 为缩小现存差距,政策制定者应向农村地区提供补贴,制造商则应专注于开发价格亲民、节能环保的产品。

2026025191.en_text: Such efforts will promote equity, improve living standards, and support sustainable development.
2026025191.cn_text: 这些举措将促进公平,提升生活水平,并助力可持续发展。

2026025192.en_text: By working together, the public and private sectors can ensure a more inclusive and prosperous future.
2026025192.cn_text: 通过公私部门协同合作,可为构建更加包容与繁荣的未来提供保障。

2026025217.en_text: I’m thrilled to hear that you were deeply moved by the handwritten family letters I shared.
2026025217.cn_text: 得知你对我分享的手写家书深受感动，我倍感欣喜。

2026025218.en_text: These letters are indeed priceless treasures, serving as heartfelt records of family affection and communication.
2026025218.cn_text: 这些信件确为无价之宝，承载着家庭情感与交流的真挚记录。

2026025219.en_text: Most of them were written by relatives to express their longing and care for loved ones in the days before digital communication became flourishing.
2026025219.cn_text: 它们大多写于数字通信普及之前，由亲人执笔，寄托着对远方至亲的思念与关怀。

2026025220.en_text: Currently, these letters are on public display at the city cultural museum, which is open from 9 a.m.
2026025220.cn_text: 目前这些信件正在市文化博物馆公开展出，开放时间为每日上午九时至下午五时。

2026025223.en_text: If you’re planning to visit, I’d be delighted to accompany you and share the fascinating background stories behind these letters.
2026025223.cn_text: 若你有意前往参观，我十分乐意陪同并为你讲述这些信件背后的动人故事。

2026025224.en_text: Let me know your schedule, and we can arrange a visit together.
2026025224.cn_text: 请告知你的时间安排，我们可共同商定参观事宜。

2026025227.en_text: The pie chart illustrates consumers' attitudes towards elderly-care robots.
2026025227.cn_text: 饼状图展示了消费者对养老护理机器人的态度。

2026025228.en_text: Specifically, 39.3% of consumers fully accept these robots, 32.8% partially accept them, while 27.9% refuse to accept the product.
2026025228.cn_text: 具体而言，39.3%的消费者完全接受这类机器人，32.8%部分接受，而27.9%拒绝接受该产品。

2026025229.en_text: Meanwhile, the bar chart reveals that safety is the top concern for 46.3% of consumers, followed by price at 24.9% and convenience at 10.7%.
2026025229.cn_text: 与此同时,柱状图显示46.3%的消费者将安全性视为首要关注点，其次是价格(24.9%)和便利性(10.7%)。

2026025230.en_text: It is noteworthy that nearly three-quarters of consumers express an open attitude towards this innovative product, which reflects a promising market potential.
2026025230.cn_text: 值得注意的是，近四分之三的消费者对这一创新产品持开放态度，这反映出其具有广阔的市场前景。

2026025231.en_text: However, the fact that safety ranks as the primary concern highlights a significant barrier to wider acceptance.
2026025231.cn_text: 然而，安全性位列首要关注点这一事实，凸显了该产品获得更广泛接受所面临的重大障碍。

2026025232.en_text: Price and convenience, though less critical, also play important roles in shaping consumers' decisions.
2026025232.cn_text: 尽管价格和便利性的重要性相对较低，但它们在影响消费者决策方面同样发挥着重要作用。

2026025233.en_text: To further promote the adoption of elderly-care robots, manufacturers should prioritize safety optimization, ensuring that the products meet rigorous standards and alleviate users' concerns.
2026025233.cn_text: 为进一步推动养老护理机器人的普及，制造商应将安全性优化置于首位，确保产品符合严格标准并消除用户顾虑。

2026025234.en_text: Additionally, setting reasonable prices is essential to make the robots more accessible to a broader audience.
2026025234.cn_text: 此外，制定合理价格对于使机器人为更广泛人群所接受至关重要。

2026025235.en_text: Improving operational convenience, such as user-friendly interfaces and enhanced functionality, can also enhance consumer satisfaction.
2026025235.cn_text: 改善操作便利性，如提供用户友好的界面和增强功能，也能提升消费者满意度。

2026025236.en_text: With these improvements, elderly-care robots have the potential to significantly ease the challenges posed by an aging population, providing comfort and support to the elderly while reducing the burden on caregivers.
2026025236.cn_text: 通过这些改进，养老护理机器人有望显著缓解人口老龄化带来的挑战，为老年人提供关怀与支持，同时减轻护理人员的负担。
